jobs.title: Maintenance Technician
jobs.description:
Are you the passionate technician we're looking for to strengthen our team? Agristo, a market leader in the food industry, is looking for a preventive maintenance technician who is passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. As a technician, you play a crucial role in ensuring maximum uptime for our machinery.

Are you up to the challenge?

Then this job at Agristo, at our Wielsbeke site, is for you!

What will you be doing at Agristo?
As a maintenance technician, you're passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. Your objective? To ensure smooth operation and minimise downtime.
  • Set an example by following the prescribed guidelines and procedures for a (food) safe, environmentally friendly and orderly working environment.
  • As a technician, you recognise potential problems before they cause breakdowns. You report these observations accurately, enabling us to act proactively and minimise unscheduled downtime.
  • You carry out planned maintenance tasks, such as inspections, lubrications, adjustments and replacements.
  • You will work closely with our operational teams and your technical colleagues to optimise the maintenance plan.
  • You will provide the necessary support and follow-up to external collaborators to ensure that their contribution is effective and efficient. In addition, you will mentor technical trainees and new employees to help them progress in their role.
  • You will keep accurate records of maintenance work carried out, using the maintenance software (Ultimo).
  • You have technical training or equivalent experience.
  • You have several years' experience as a technician and a passion for technology.
  • You have knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems.
  • You have a proactive attitude.
  • You have logical thinking and good problem-solving skills, enabling you to work independently.
  • You are a team player who contributes to smooth communication and collective success.
  • You speak Dutch, French or English and are prepared to understand colleagues who speak other languages.
  • You are prepared to work in a 2-shift system.

jobs.title: Operator coordinator packaging
jobs.description:
At Agristo, you are the key player in the packaging process: from frozen fries to a perfectly packaged and palletized product. With your technical affinity and problem-solving abilities, you manage our packaging lines, coordinate the planning, and ensure a flawless process. Are you looking for a challenging role with responsibility, teamwork, and growth opportunities in a dynamic work environment? Join us and grow with a strong, ambitious family business!

What will you be doing at Agristo?
  • Process Management: You are responsible for the entire packaging process, from frozen fries to a fully palletized and packaged product.
  • Operation and Adjustment: You provide first-line support for any issues on the line, make adjustments when necessary, and continuously expand your technical knowledge of our processes.
  • Planning & Coordination: You monitor and adjust the packaging schedule, coordinating its execution with the team leader to meet the planned goals.
  • Cleanliness and Hygiene: You ensure a clean and organized work environment by overseeing and coordinating cleaning tasks.
  • Material Management: You are responsible for the timely ordering and availability of necessary materials, such as film, cardboard, and spices.
  • Problem Solving: You proactively identify issues in the packaging process and take corrective actions to ensure continuity.
  • Administrative Support: You perform administrative tasks, such as reporting incidents and documenting process information.
  • Packaging Testing: You assist in and conduct packaging process tests in collaboration with Agristo colleagues.
  • Knowledge Sharing: You contribute to the development of instructions and training materials and support knowledge transfer within the team.
  • Employee Guidance: You mentor and support team members, helping them enhance their skills and knowledge.

With this diverse range of responsibilities, you are an essential link in ensuring a smooth and high-quality packaging process!
  • You have solid experience as a packaging operator in the food industry or have already gained experience in a coordinating role.
  • You possess technical and process insight.
  • You have a problem-solving mindset, are not afraid to critically assess existing processes, and take initiative to implement improvements.
  • You speak Dutch, French, or English and are willing to communicate with colleagues who speak different languages.

jobs.title: Operator production
jobs.description:
At Agristo, we believe in continuous growth and development, both for our processes and for our people. Join us and help build an efficient and forward-thinking work environment together!

What will you be doing at Agristo?
  • You monitor, adjust, and optimize the production process to ensure continuity and efficiency, always in consultation with your team leader.
  • You follow the daily schedule and adapt smoothly to changes: starting and stopping the production line, implementing product changes, and performing thorough cleanings.
  • You ensure that all installations comply with the strictest hygiene and safety standards. Need support from colleagues? You provide clear instructions.
  • You accurately record production data and the use of auxiliary materials in our ERP system.
  • You adjust process parameters to achieve the best results every time.

Ready to grow? Great! We offer you the opportunity to:
  • Deepen your knowledge in specific areas such as quality, control systems, packaging, and planning.
  • Apply your expertise in these areas actively each year.
  • Contribute to a versatile team environment where collaboration and responsibility are key. #OneTeam
  • Are you an enthusiastic and driven doer with common sense who wants to go for it together with a team?
  • Do you enjoy tackling issues and do you see yourself thinking about improvement actions for the production line?
  • Do you like variation, challenges and are you motivated to learn new things?
  • Are you interested in technology and food?
  • Familiar with working with computers and keen to learn new programmes?
  • You will work in two shifts during the week from 05h-13h or from 13h-21h.

jobs.title: HOTELRECEPTIONIST / HOTELRECEPTIONISTE (Front Office)
jobs.description:
Flanders Hotel Brugge is een charmant, familiaal viersterrenhotel in het historische hart van Brugge. Gastvrijheid, kwaliteit en persoonlijke service staan bij ons centraal. Om ons enthousiaste Guest Services-team te versterken, zoeken wij een ervaren en talenknappe hotelreceptionist(e) met een passie voor hospitality.

Ben jij commercieel ingesteld, hou je van contact met internationale gasten en werk je graag in een professionele maar warme omgeving? Dan ben jij misschien de collega die wij zoeken.

Jouw functie

Als hotelreceptionist(e) ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze gasten en draag je dagelijks bij aan een onvergetelijke verblijfservaring.

Je takenpakket omvat onder meer:

  • Het professioneel ontvangen, inchecken en uitchecken van gasten.
  • Het behandelen van reservaties, administratieve taken en correspondentie.
  • Het verstrekken van toeristische informatie over Brugge en de hotelvoorzieningen.
  • Het beantwoorden van vragen en het oplossen van klachten op een gastgerichte manier.
  • Het actief inspelen op commerciële opportuniteiten en het bieden van een uitstekende service.
  • Het samenwerken met verschillende afdelingen binnen het hotel.
  • Het zelfstandig beheren van de receptie tijdens bepaalde shifts.

Elke dag is anders: je komt in contact met gasten uit de hele wereld en maakt deel uit van een dynamische en boeiende werkomgeving.

Jouw profiel

Wij zoeken een collega die ervaring combineert met enthousiasme en een echte passie voor gastvrijheid.

Je beschikt over:

  • Ervaring als hotelreceptionist(e) of een gelijkwaardige functie binnen de hospitalitysector.
  • Een zeer goede kennis van Nederlands, Frans en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
  • Een basiskennis van Duits; kennis van Spaans of andere talen is een extra troef.
  • Goede computervaardigheden en affiniteit met moderne hotelsoftware.
  • Een commerciële ingesteldheid en een sterk verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel.
  • Een verzorgde en professionele uitstraling.

Daarnaast ben je:

  • Gastvrij, spontaan en behulpzaam.
  • Zelfstandig, maar ook een echte teamspeler.
  • Flexibel op het vlak van shifts en weekendwerk.
  • Stressbestendig en oplossingsgericht.
  • Iemand die initiatief neemt, logisch nadenkt en werk ziet.
  • Bereid om indien nodig sporadisch in te springen als nachtreceptionist(e).
  • Op zoek naar een langdurige samenwerking.

jobs.title: Global Infrastructure & Network Services Manager
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international organization operating across multiple regions, with a complex and geographically distributed business environment.

As part of an ongoing technology and transformation journey, the company is investing in the modernization of its digital landscape, infrastructure services, cybersecurity capabilities, cloud technologies, and operational resilience. Technology plays a key role in supporting business performance, operational continuity, and long-term growth.

The organization combines the stability of an established international business with an evolving operating model and a strong focus on continuous improvement.

To support this transformation, they are looking for their future Head of Network Infrastructure.

The position offers an international working environment, exposure to strategic initiatives, and the opportunity to contribute to major technology decisions while collaborating with teams across multiple countries and functions.


Jobomschrijving

As Head of Network Infrastructure, you will be responsible for defining and delivering the global infrastructure and network services strategy while ensuring operational excellence across the organization.

Infrastructure & Network Strategy

  • Define and execute the global infrastructure and network roadmap.
  • Establish technology standards, governance frameworks, and best practices.
  • Drive modernization initiatives across network, cloud, datacenter, workplace, and infrastructure services.
  • Ensure alignment between technology priorities and business objectives.



Service Ownership & Operations

  • Oversee the delivery and lifecycle management of global infrastructure and network services.
  • Ensure high levels of availability, security, performance, and reliability across all environments.
  • Monitor service quality and lead continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Support business-critical operations through resilient and scalable infrastructure solutions.



Security & Risk Management

  • Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to ensure infrastructure and network services meet security standards.
  • Support compliance, risk mitigation, disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives.
  • Contribute to the protection of both corporate and operational environments.



Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Manage relationships with external service providers and technology partners.
  • Oversee contract performance, service quality, and budget management.
  • Work closely with business leaders, enterprise architects, and regional IT teams to prioritize initiatives and investments.



Leadership

  • Lead and develop a global team of infrastructure and network professionals.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.
  • Drive capability development and succession planning within the organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong infrastructure and networking expertise with strategic leadership capabilities and experience operating in large international environments.

Experience

  • Proven experience managing enterprise infrastructure and network services.
  • Strong background in multinational or highly distributed organizations.
  • Experience leading geographically dispersed technical teams.
  • Demonstrated success managing third-party providers and large-scale service delivery environments.



Technical Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure technologies.
  • Solid expertise in networking, connectivity, cloud platforms, and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with LAN, WAN, SD-WAN, wireless networks, firewalls, remote access solutions, and cloud networking.
  • Knowledge of infrastructure governance, service management, and operational excellence frameworks.
  • Familiarity with industrial, manufacturing, or operational technology environments is considered an advantage.



Leadership & Soft Skills

  • Strategic thinker with strong business acumen.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to influence senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Results-oriented mindset with a focus on service quality and continuous improvement.
  • Comfortable navigating complex international environments and transformation programs.



Languages skills

  • English is mandatory, as it is the primary working language within the international organization and across global stakeholders.
  • French or Dutch is strongly preferred, given the Brussels-based location of the role and the interactions with local and regional teams.

jobs.title: Inside sales administrator
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established and specialized company operating in the field of machinery and railway equipment. They are known for their dynamic SME environment and strong team collaboration.


Jobomschrijving

The Internal Sales Representative plays a key role in supporting the sales team by managing quotations, processing orders, and ensuring smooth communication between customers, suppliers, and internal departments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Receive and handle price requests via email, phone, and other channels
  • Request quotations from suppliers and negotiate pricing and conditions with the Sales Director
  • Prepare and send customer quotations
  • Enter offers and orders into the ERP system (knowledge of Navision or Business Central is a strong asset)
  • Follow up on ongoing quotations in collaboration with the sales team
  • Monitor and manage ongoing orders (delivery timelines, framework agreements)
  • Handle customer complaints and provide appropriate solutions
  • Send payment reminders when required
  • Collaborate closely with the administrative team
  • Support the preparation of trade shows and exhibitions
  • Assist in preparing orders and coordinating shipments
  • Ensure electronic registration of warehouse entries and exits
  • Participate in inventory counts when needed
  • Provide occasional support in the warehouse (receiving and shipping goods)

Profile

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Previous experience in a back-office or order processing role
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office
  • Trilingual: Dutch / French and English or German
  • Detail-oriented, stress-resistant, and versatile
  • Reliable, consistent, and commercially minded



Nice to have:

  • Knowledge of ISO 9001 and/or VCA standards

jobs.title: Service technieker
jobs.description:
Als service technieker ben je dagelijks op pad om onderhoud en herstellingen uit te voeren aan elektrische en HVAC-installaties. Je zorgt ervoor dat systemen veilig en betrouwbaar blijven werken. Naast technische werken, ben je ook het aanspreekpunt voor klanten en geef je advies over het gebruik en onderhoud van hun installaties.

Je dag begint meestal met een planning van de uit te voeren opdrachten. Je voert inspecties en preventief onderhoud uit bij klanten ter plaatse. Bij storingen ga je op zoek naar de oorzaak en herstel je het probleem zo snel mogelijk. Je documenteert elke uitgevoerde taak en rapporteert hierover. Tussendoor neem je de tijd om klanten professioneel te woord te staan en werk je samen met collega’s om de service te optimaliseren.

Ben jij communicatief sterk, werk je graag zelfstandig én in team, en hou je van afwisseling? Dan is deze job iets voor jou. Solliciteer snel en ontdek hoe jij het verschil kan maken als service technieker.

  • Je hebt affiniteit met techniek en bent bekwaam met gereedschappen en meetinstrumenten
  • Je communiceert vlot en professioneel met klanten
  • Je kan zowel zelfstandig als in team werken
  • Je bent goed georganiseerd en kan efficiënt prioriteiten stellen
  • Ervaring is een pluspunt, maar schoolverlaters zijn ook welkom
  • Je hebt een diploma op minimaal lager secundair onderwijsniveau of hoger
  • Je bent bereid om fulltime te werken (38-40u/week)

jobs.title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Python Engineer – Web Crawling & Data Extraction (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
About the Job

We build and operate large-scale web crawling and extraction systems that turn unstructured, dynamic websites into clean, structured and correct data. You'll own crawlers end-to-end: discovery, resilient fetching against real anti-bot defenses, and turning HTML/PDF into trustworthy structured output.


What you will do


  • Build and scale crawlers that handle dynamic, large-scale sites, and keep them running as those sites change and fight back.
  • Stay ahead of anti-bot measures: TLS/browser fingerprinting, proxies, session and rate-limit strategy, and change detection.
  • Turn raw HTML and PDF into clean, correct structured data (including LLM-assisted extraction), where silently wrong output is worse than a crash.
  • Design and operate pipelines for ingestion, deduplication, versioning and enrichment.
  • Ship and run containerized apps in the cloud, with CI/CD.
  • Shape our technical architecture and engineering culture.


Our Tech Stack

Python, Docker, GCP (Cloud Run jobs), Azure Blob Storage, MongoDB. Go services and a React frontend on the periphery. You don't need all of it on day one, but you do need to ramp up fast.


Your profile

  • 3+ years of professional software development (5+ for the senior track).
  • Strong Python: real production code, async.
  • Hands-on web scraping at scale, including firsthand experience with anti-bot defenses and the failure modes of large-scale collection.
  • A data-correctness mindset: you care that extracted data is right, not just that the job finished.
  • Docker, at least one major cloud (GCP, Azure or AWS), Git and comfort on the CLI.
  • A clear communicator who works well in a small, fast-moving team.

Nice to have:

  • LLM-assisted extraction or other work with LLMs, ML pipelines or data labeling workflows.
  • Go or Java/Spring Boot.
  • Frontend (React), or eagerness to pick it up.
  • Terraform, Kubernetes and modern DevOps tooling.


Why us?

  • A vibrant in-office culture in Munich, with the option to work from home up to 60% of the time.
  • Flexible working hours.
  • 30 vacation days per year (including 4 "company rest days" over Christmas).
  • 30 days of "workation" per year, within the EU and selected countries.
  • High autonomy and flat hierarchies.
  • EGYM Wellpass for unlimited access to fitness courses and gyms.
  • Udemy access for online courses.


Closing

Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

jobs.title: Master Trainer OpenAI (AI & Cloud Partners) (m/w/d), Munich
jobs.description:
Your mission

You train the technical teams of strategic cloud partners to build, integrate and support AI applications with confidence. Your audience is solution architects, field engineers, developers, technical consultants and sales engineering teams.

You take a proven AI curriculum and make it work for cloud partner audiences: real deployment scenarios, partner-specific examples, live troubleshooting. You are the technical face of our client in the room.


Your tasks include:

  • Deliver instructor-led bootcamps, technical workshops, train-the-trainer sessions and hands-on labs for cloud partner organisations.
  • Adapt core AI training content for partner audiences such as solution architects, field engineers, developers and partner enablement leaders.
  • Translate AI capabilities into practical cloud scenarios, reference architectures and customer-facing use cases.
  • Lead practical exercises on how to build, integrate, deploy, evaluate and support AI applications in cloud environments.
  • Troubleshoot participant issues live, from lab setup and API calls to code samples and implementation questions.
  • Work with program leadership and partner enablement stakeholders to refine delivery plans and localise examples.
  • Keep delivery quality high across regions, cohorts and groups with different technical maturity.
  • Capture recurring knowledge gaps and recommend improvements to content, labs and facilitation guides.


Your profile

You move comfortably between developer-level detail, cloud architecture context and an executive-friendly explanation. You are energised by teaching complex material and you earn credibility with engineers by knowing your stuff.


Experience & Education

  • More than 5 years of professional experience in technical training, developer education, solution architecture, technical consulting, partner engineering, software development or cloud enablement.
  • Experience delivering technical workshops, bootcamps, labs or train-the-trainer sessions for professional audiences.
  • Strong practical fluency with generative AI, LLM concepts, prompt engineering, APIs, SDKs and modern AI application patterns.
  • Hands-on familiarity with cloud platforms and partner environments such as AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure or Oracle Cloud.
  • Fluent English; a second language (French, Spanish or German) is a strong plus.
  • Located in or near a major EMEA city with an airport (for example Munich or Frankfurt).
  • Willingness to travel for partner workshops and regional programs (approx. 25-35%).
  • Of advantage: familiarity with Amazon Bedrock (AWS Bedrock).
  • Of advantage: experience enabling cloud partners, hyperscalers, systems integrators or partner field organisations.
  • Of advantage: experience building hands-on labs, certification pathways or partner academies.

Skills & Attributes

  • Explains cloud and AI concepts clearly to engineers, architects and business stakeholders alike.
  • Facilitates live technical labs and solves setup, code and API issues on the spot.
  • Strong executive presence and professional conduct with senior partner stakeholders.
  • Adapts content and communication style to different proficiency levels, regions and roles.
  • Reads, explains and lightly modifies sample code in Python or JavaScript.
  • Understands RAG, vector search, AI agents and workflow orchestration well enough to teach them.
  • Of advantage: experience with developer relations, sales engineering enablement or solution architect training.


Why us?

You teach AI to the people who bring it to enterprise customers, with a premium learner experience as the standard.

Impact: Your sessions build the technical confidence that drives AI adoption across partner field teams in EMEA.

Responsibility: You own the delivery quality of your workshops and represent a leading AI company directly with strategic partners.

Dynamics: AI products change fast, and so does your content; you work in a small team that decides quickly.

Development: Product training and credentialing are provided, and you grow into a specialist role in a new, high-visibility training program.


Benefits

  • Home office and workation possibility
  • Flexible working hours
  • Subsidised EGYM Wellpass
  • Apple hardware (laptop & iPhone)


These are the recruiting steps that await you:

  1. Culture Fit - Get to know Rike or Kim from our People team. Learn more about nonplusultra and our culture.
  2. Content & Role Fit Interview - Go deeper into the role with Matze Schulz and a technical colleague from OpenAI.
  3. Case Study - Work through a practical training scenario together with Matze Schulz and a technical colleague from OpenAI.

This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge.   • Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications.
  • Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge: Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Assess advanced analytical techniques: Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation.

  • Specialized analytical skills: Familiarity with techniques such as mass spectrometry, HPLC, GC, NMR, trace analysis, titrimetry, and laboratory QA/QC procedures.
  • Scientific evaluation skills: Ability to identify factual inaccuracies, assess scientific arguments, interpret experimental scenarios, and distinguish sound conclusions from flawed reasoning.

What You Need to Make a Difference

    Strategic Data Governance & Framework Establishment

    Define, implement, and maintain the product data governance strategy, standards, and policies for the Medium Gas Turbines business area.

    Align product data governance initiatives with broader organizational digital transformation roadmaps and corporate standards.

    Lead the consolidation, optimization, and governance of product data tools, PLM systems, and associated engineering workflows to improve data quality, efficiency, and lifecycle traceability.

    Collaborate with engineering, IT, and operations to streamline data exchange, system integration, and configuration management processes.

    Establish and maintain standards for configuration control and product structure definition across relevant technical teams.

    Leadership & Capability Building

    Build, lead, and develop the newly formed Product Data Governance department, managing capacity planning and competency development.
    Promote data-driven ways of working across the Product Lifecycle organization and sister business units by establishing clear ownership, shared standards, and effective collaboration.
    Manage departmental budget, resource allocation, and stakeholder communications up to senior leadership levels.

Education

    Bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering, computer science, information management, or a related technical field.
    At least eight years of experience in product data management, product lifecycle management, or data governance within a complex engineering or manufacturing environment.
    Proven track record of leadership, team building, and managing organizational change in a multinational setup.

Skills

    Data Governance & Management: Strong expertise in Product Data Management (PDM), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), data quality and integrity, configuration management, and Master Data Management (MDM).
    Leadership & Strategy: Proven ability to translate product data strategy into clear priorities, measurable outcomes, and sustainable ways of working, combined with strong capabilities in team leadership and development, strategic planning, stakeholder management, change management, and resource and capacity planning.
    Technical & Domain Knowledge: Strong knowledge of engineering data systems, gas turbine product structures, and process optimization, combined with excellent communication skills in Swedish and English and the ability to explain complex product data topics to both technical and senior leadership audiences.

Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

jobs.description:
(English text below)

Om jobbet

Söker du ett aktivt, praktiskt arbete där du får vara med och tillverka hälsoprodukter från grunden? Hos Swedish Nutra i Mellersta Hamnen, Malmö, är ditt huvudsakliga fokus den dagliga produktionen av våra flytande kosttillskott. Samtidigt värdesätter vi ett praktiskt och mekaniskt intresse—vi söker dig som gillar teknik och vill lära dig hur vår produktionsutrustning fungerar.

Vi är ett starkt växande familjeföretag där kvalitet alltid går före kvantitet. Du behöver inte ha lång tidigare erfarenhet; har du rätt inställning, god noggrannhet och ett tekniskt handlag utbildar vi dig grundligt på plats!

Arbetsuppgifter

Rollen kombinerar praktiskt produktionsarbete med ett naturligt engagemang i våra maskiner:

    Produktion (Huvudfokus): Aktivt delta i den dagliga tillverkningen, blandningen, fyllningen, etiketteringen och emballeringen av våra produkter.
    Maskindrift & Underhåll: Lära dig vår produktionsutrustning för att sköta omställningar, övervaka drift, utföra löpande rengöring samt hantera allt från lättare förebyggande underhåll till mer omfattande tekniska arbeten vid behov.
    Kvalitet & Hygien: Säkerställa att produkterna hanteras korrekt och att produktionslokalerna håller högsta renhets- och hygienstandard.

Arbetstider & Anställningsvillkor

    Heltid (40 h/vecka), dagtid.
    Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning (vi tillämpar provanställning).
    Arbetet är fysiskt och tyngre lyft förekommer i det dagliga flödet.

Vem söker vi?

    Praktisk & Drivande: Du trivs med fysiskt produktionsarbete och att se färdiga produkter lämna linjen.
    Mekaniskt intresse: Du har en naturlig känsla för teknik, tycker om att förstå hur maskiner fungerar och trivs med praktiskt arbete.
    Noggrann & Kvalitetsmedveten: Du är exakt i ditt arbete och förstår vikten av noggrann hygien.
    Språk: Goda/flytande kunskaper i antingen svenska och engelska är ett krav.
    Meriterande: Erfarenhet inom produktion, maskindrift eller underhåll (gärna inom kosttillskott, livsmedel, läkemedel eller kosmetika).

Om Swedish Nutra

Swedish Nutra är ett Malmöbaserat familjeföretag som tillverkar flytande kosttillskott för en global marknad. Hos oss möter du ett ungt, drivet och mångkulturellt team där engelska är en helt naturlig del av vardagen. Vi erbjuder en varm och engagerande arbetsmiljö där varje medarbetare räknas och där det finns goda möjligheter att växa.

Arbetsplats: Swedish Nutra AB, Lodgatan 19, 211 24 Malmö.

Process & Machinery Operator – Liquid Supplements

About the Job

Looking for an active, hands-on role manufacturing high-quality health products from start to finish? At Swedish Nutra in Mellersta Hamnen, Malmö, your main daily focus will be running our liquid supplement production line. We also place great value on practical technical curiosity—we are looking for someone who enjoys working with machinery and wants to master how our equipment operates.

We are a fast-growing family company where quality always takes priority over quantity. Extensive industry experience isn't required; if you bring a strong work ethic, keen attention to detail, and a practical technical mindset, we will fully train you on-site!

Key Responsibilities

This role combines daily hands-on manufacturing with active involvement in machine operations:

    Production (Main Focus): Take an active role in daily manufacturing, including ingredient mixing, bottling, labeling, and final packaging.
    Machine Operation & Upkeep: Master our production equipment to handle line changeovers, monitor operations, perform routine cleaning, and assist with preventative maintenance troubleshooting when needed.
    Quality & Hygiene: Maintain strict standards for hygiene, product handling, and overall workplace cleanliness.

Working Hours & Terms

    Employment type: Permanent position (probationary period applies).
    The role involves physical labor and heavy lifting.

Qualifications

    Hands-on Drive: You thrive in an active factory environment and enjoy seeing products go from raw ingredients to finished goods.
    Technical Aptitude: You have a natural curiosity for machinery, like understanding how equipment works, and enjoy practical problem-solving.
    Detail-Oriented & Quality-Minded: You work with high accuracy and recognize the vital importance of strict food and hygiene standards.
    Languages: Good language skill in English and Swedish is required
    Pluses: Prior experience in manufacturing, machine operation, or equipment maintenance (especially within food, supplements, pharma, or cosmetics).

About Swedish Nutra

Swedish Nutra is a Malmö-based family business producing premium liquid supplements distributed worldwide. We offer a warm, collaborative workplace culture where every team member is valued and given room to grow.

Location: Swedish Nutra AB, Lodgatan 19, 211 24 Malmö, Sweden

If you haven't heard from us within two weeks, it means we have moved forward with other candidates for this role. We sincerely appreciate your interest!

jobs.title: Legal Counsel
jobs.description:
If you are a commercially minded lawyer who wants to take ownership of complex, business-critical matters, work close to senior decision-makers as well as make an impact in a broad range of legal, strategic and business initiatives across an internationally listed company, take this unique opportunity to become our new

Legal Counsel, Corporate Legal

We are now looking for an experienced Legal Counsel to join Corporate Legal at SKF's global headquarters in Gothenburg. You will take a leading legal role in selected matters, with direct exposure to senior stakeholders and responsibility for delivering practical solutions on some of SKF's most strategic and business-critical initiatives.

What we and the role offers:

Corporate Legal is part of SKF's lean corporate center and the wider Group Legal & Compliance function. We are a small, strong and business-centric team supporting SKF's leadership and key stakeholders in the central group functions. Our mandate covers matters of strategic importance, significant legal or commercial risk and a broad range of operational legal questions. Working at the intersection of law, business, technology and corporate governance, you will gain direct insight into key decisions and the opportunity to influence how complex matters are structured and executed across a large international corporation. The role has a distinctly global reach, offering frequent opportunities to work alongside legal colleagues, business leaders and specialists across SKF's worldwide organisation.

Our work spans many of the legal areas that support SKF's business and long-term development, including strategic projects and collaborations, M&A, governance, commercial contracting, IT, innovation and technology development, litigation and claims management, corporate finance, marketing and media.



What you can expect in the role:

    Independently manage your matters from initial assessment through drafting, negotiation, decision and implementation, while knowing when to involve colleagues or external counsel
    Form a clear legal view, recommend a course of action and help stakeholders move from analysis to decision and implementation
    Advise senior stakeholders across Finance, Treasury, Investor Relations, Sustainability, IT, Supply Chain, Communications, People Experience (HR) and other group functions.
    Draft, negotiate and review a wide range of agreements
    Support M&A, strategic projects, governance, commercial contracts, technology and innovation initiatives
    Manage litigation and claims-related matters
    Provide pragmatic, business-focused legal advice and risk management support
    Collaborate with legal colleagues and business leaders across SKF's global organization, giving you the opportunity to build an international network and contribute across jurisdictions while helping stakeholders meet business objectives and manage legal risk.



What makes this role particularly unique is the combination of autonomy and breadth of the Corporate Legal mandate. Few in-house legal positions at large international companies offer exposure to such a wide range of matters together with genuine responsibility for shaping solutions. You can remain a broad corporate lawyer while building a recognized area of expertise in the fields that genuinely interest you and that align with our business. We think lawyers perform at their best when they pair a wide view of the business with deeper knowledge in the areas that interest them most. As a result, the exact shape of the role will develop over time depending on your experience, interests and strengths, as well as the needs of the business.

We expect you to have/be:

    Master's degree in law (LLM).
    Extensive relevant experience from a well-renowned law firm, an international company or a combination of both.
    Comfortable in leading discussions and challenging constructively and making progress when the path is not yet fully defined.
    Establish credibility with senior stakeholders through effective communication, integrity, engagement and turn legal analysis into practical options.
    Analytically skilled with the ability to approach complex issues with commercial curiosity, integrity and a can-do attitude.
    Experience in commercial contracts or transactions is valuable.
    Enjoy variety and are comfortable switching between high-level strategic discussions and detailed legal analysis.
    Eager to continue to learn and develop across an evolving legal landscape.
    Collaborative and confident working across cultures and functions
    Proficiency in both verbal communication and presentations in English. Swedish is desirable, and so is other languages.

What you'll love about SKF...

*A culture of diversity and inclusion!

SKF is committed to creating a diverse environment, and we firmly believe that a diverse workforce is essential for our continued success. Therefore, we only focus on your experience, skills, and potential. Come as you are – just be yourself #weareSKF

*Fair and transparent compensation!

We provide transparent salary information in line with local legislation and base our decisions on objective criteria to ensure fairness and consistency throughout the recruitment process.



Some additional information

This position is located in Gothenburg, Sweden, on a local contract.

You will report to the Director Corporate Legal, who is located in Gothenburg, Sweden. If you have any questions about the position, please contact Pernilla Book by phone/Teams/email.

For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Katrin Edelmann, Talent Acquisition Partner Europe & Africa who is located in Schweinfurt, Germany at katrin.edelmann@skf.com. Please note that we can't accept applications via email.

Is this you?

If the answer is yes, submit your application in English no later than 19th October 2026. Please note that we can't accept applications via email.

To support a transparent process, SKF may include pre-employment assessments as well as verify the information in your application before hiring. Verification processes will follow applicable laws and regulations

jobs.title: Electronic Hardware Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Company description:

AVL is one of the world’s leading mobility technology companies for development, simulation and testing in the automotive industry, and beyond. The company provides concepts, solutions and methodologies in fields like vehicle development and integration, e-mobility, automated and connected mobility (ADAS/AD), and software for a greener, safer, better world of mobility.

Job description:

As an Electronic Hardware Design Engineer, you will play a key role in developing innovative solutions within the rapidly evolving field of automotive electronics. We are looking for a driven individual who is motivated to continuously broaden their expertise in electronic hardware, contributing both at customer sites and to the development of our in-house capabilities. The position is part of our Hardware and Systems Development team, based in Gothenburg, Sweden.

AVL takes part in a wide range of projects within Vehicle, Hybrid and Electromobility in the automotive industry. AVL MTC has approximately 200 employees based in Gothenburg, Stockholm, Haninge and Södertälje. As an engineer at AVL you will work with cutting edge technology in collaboration with experts in the global AVL team and our successful customers. You will be working close to our local customers in Gothenburg area within the AVL facilities or as Resident Engineer at customers in Sweden.


    As an Electronics Hardware Design Engineer, you will be responsible for specification, development, commissioning and validation of power inverter HW system and its subsystems (e.g. control board, power supply, gate driver board and power modules)
    Define and develop requirements, design as well as Architectures for new and existing Hardware concepts in the area of Power inverter controls, DC-DC converter controls, Zone Controller, Body controller, Battery management system and Driver assistance systems
    Create product specific and complex controls electronics while balancing constraints in space, EMI/EMC, cost and manufacturability
    Responsible for definition of detailed verification tests for the newly developed electronics. Support the actual testing and troubleshooting effort to ensure success of the newly developed designs
    Create new designs and concepts within standard automotive development process
    Good system understanding to translate requirements of hardware coming from electronics designers and software coming from the software development teams  
    Ability to work in an agile manner while operating in international teams
    Interaction and communication on technical topics with engineering teams of international customer base  

Profile description:


    Degree in Electronics/Electrical/Mechatronic engineering with relevant work experience in Electronics and Mechatronics  
    6-8 years automotive demonstrable experience in development of Embedded Hardware and Power Electronics  
    Good knowledge of handling EMC/EMI requirements, trouble shooting and engineering methods to maintain compliance
    Multiple years of experience in schematic and layout design in Altium designer and electronics simulation in LTspice.
    Knowledge of Automotive domain i.e. Design Standards and design processes  

Personal attributes:


    Excellent communication and presentation skills in English including on-site presentations at customers. Swedish is meritorious.
    Ability to adapt to customer cultures and create new opportunities to grow local expertise within the field of Electromobility.
    Self-directed, systematic, and structured approach to work.
    Teamplayer with ability to get along with a diverse set of team members
    High level of integrity and responsibility.
    B category Driving license.

We offer:


    Be part of our pioneering work– together with our customers we shape the future of mobility!
    Competitive compensation packages
    Collective Agreement and insurances
    Working with international OEMs
    International and innovative collaborations

Interested?

In this recruitment process, we apply continuous selection. The process may move quickly, and the position may be filled before the final application deadline.

jobs.title: Elektroniikan testausinsinööri, junior tai senior
jobs.description:
Kiinnostaako sinua elektroniikan testaus, PCBA-kehitys ja käytännönläheinen laboratoriotyö? Nautitko teknisten ongelmien ratkaisemisesta ja yhteistyöstä elektroniikkasuunnittelun sekä tuotannon asiantuntijoiden kanssa?

Etsimme ALTENille **elektroniikan testausinsinöörejä junior- ja senioritasolle**. Tehtävän sisältö ja vastuualueet mukautuvat kokemuksesi, osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksenkohteidesi mukaan. Roolisi voi painottua esimerkiksi PCBA-korttien verifiointiin, laboratoriotestaukseen, tuotannon testauksen kehittämiseen, vika-analyysiin tai näiden yhdistelmään.

Tehtävässä työskentelet analogia- ja digitaalielektroniikan sekä mahdollisesti myös tehoelektroniikan ja teholähderatkaisujen parissa. Pääset osallistumaan elektroniikkatuotteiden kehitykseen, testaukseen ja tuotantoon saattamiseen tuotteen elinkaaren eri vaiheissa aina suunnittelun verifioinnista tuotannon käynnistämiseen ja jatkuvaan kehittämiseen asti.

Junioriosaajalle tehtävä tarjoaa mahdollisuuden kehittää käytännön osaamista elektroniikan testauksesta ja PCBA-kehityksestä kokeneiden asiantuntijoiden tukemana. Kokeneemmalle osaajalle rooli tarjoaa mahdollisuuden vastata vaativista teknisistä selvityksistä, testauksen suunnittelusta, juurisyyanalyyseistä ja eri asiantuntijaryhmien välisestä yhteistyöstä.

Kokemuksesi ja osaamistasosi mukaan tehtäviisi voi kuulua:

- PCBA-korttien laboratoriotestaus, verifiointi, validointi ja suorituskyvyn arviointi

- Sähköisten mittausten tekeminen analogia-, digitaali- ja tehoelektroniikan sekä teholähteiden piireille

- Prototyyppien, kehitysversioiden ja tuotannossa olevien laitteiden vianetsintä

- PCBA-suunnittelun verifioinnin ja tuotekehityksen tukeminen

- Piirikaavioiden tulkitseminen sekä piirien toiminnan analysointi komponentti- ja järjestelmätasolla

- Tuotannon testausvaatimusten, testausspesifikaatioiden, menettelyohjeiden ja testausraporttien laatiminen

- Testattavuuden huomioiminen uusien PCBA-ratkaisujen suunnittelussa

- Tuotannon testauskonseptien arviointi ja validointi ennen niiden käyttöönottoa

- Tuotannon testausratkaisujen käyttöönoton ja tuotannon ylösajon tukeminen

- Mittausjärjestelmien arviointiin, kuten Gauge R&R -tarkasteluihin, osallistuminen

- Vikojen paikantaminen komponenttitasolla sekä juurisyyanalyysien tekeminen

- PCBA-korttien prototypointi, muokkaaminen, korjaaminen ja uudelleentyöstäminen

- Teknisten havaintojen ja kehitysehdotusten tuottaminen suunnittelun tueksi

- Tuotteiden luotettavuuden selvityksiin ja jatkuvaan kehittämiseen osallistuminen

- Yhteistyö elektroniikkasuunnittelun, järjestelmäsuunnittelun, laadun, tuotannon, komponenttitekniikan ja tuotannon testauksen asiantuntijoiden kanssa


Senioritason tehtävässä voit lisäksi ottaa vetovastuuta vaativista vikaselvityksistä, testauksen suunnittelusta, teknisestä päätöksenteosta ja testauskäytäntöjen kehittämisestä.

Toivomme sinulta:

- Soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta esimerkiksi elektroniikan, sähkötekniikan, automaation tai sulautettujen järjestelmien alalta

- Analogia- ja digitaalielektroniikan perusteiden tuntemusta

- Kiinnostusta tai kokemusta PCBA-korttien testauksesta, verifioinnista, vianetsinnästä tai suunnittelusta

- Kykyä lukea piirikaavioita ja ymmärtää elektronisten piirien toimintaa

- Käytännön kokemusta laboratoriolaitteista, kuten oskilloskoopeista, yleismittareista, teholähteistä, elektronisista kuormista tai tehoanalysaattoreista

- Järjestelmällistä ja analyyttistä ongelmanratkaisukykyä

- Hyviä yhteistyö- ja viestintätaitoja

- Oma-aloitteista ja käytännönläheistä työskentelyotetta

- Hyvää englannin kielen taitoa


Tehtävän vaativuustason mukaan arvostamme lisäksi kokemusta yhdestä tai useammasta seuraavista osa-alueista:

- PCBA-suunnittelu, verifiointi ja validointi

- Tehoelektroniikka tai teholähdeteknologiat

- Komponenttitason vianetsintä ja vika-analyysi

- Vaativien sähköisten vikojen tutkiminen ja juurisyiden tunnistaminen

- Tuotantoympäristöt ja tuotannon testaus

- Tuotannon testausvaatimusten ja testausspesifikaatioiden laatiminen

- Design for Testability eli testattavuuden huomioiminen suunnittelussa

- Mittausjärjestelmäanalyysit

- PCBA-korttien korjaaminen, muokkaaminen ja prototypointi

- Tuotteiden luotettavuustutkimukset

- Työskentely elektroniikkasuunnittelijoiden kanssa tuotekehitysympäristössä


ALTEN Finlandilla pääset osaksi matalahierarkkista ja asiantuntevaa työyhteisöä, jossa osaamisen kehittämiseen panostetaan aidosti. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden työskennellä vaativissa ja kansainvälisissä suunnittelu- ja kehitysprojekteissa sekä tehdä yhteistyötä eri alojen kokeneiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Saat käyttöösi myös kattavat henkilöstöedut ja joustavat työskentelymahdollisuudet.

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja ansioluettelosi palkkatoiveineen viimeistään 25.10.2026. Paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan.

jobs.title: ​E-Bike Driver / Delivery Courier​ in Malmö
jobs.description:
Connecting Jobs, run by the non-profit organization Beredskapslyftet, supports newcomers in taking their first steps into the Swedish labour market – while at the same time helping employers access new talent.

Join Connecting Jobs and TENT in Malmö on October 20th for a recruitment event where you will have the opportunity to meet several employers in one place.

How does it work?

    This isn’t an open walk-in event — attendance is by invitation only.
    Apply to one or more of the open vacancies below.
    Recruiters will review your CV against that role’s requirements.
    If you’re a good match, you’ll receive an invitation to attend.

We are now looking for E-Bike Driver / Delivery Courier for MoveByBike, company that is building the urban logistics of the future with electric cargo bikes. For more information, visit movebybike.se (http://movebybike.se).

Location:
Malmö

Who we are looking for:
E-Bike Driver / Delivery Courier

Responsibilities:

    Deliver goods safely and efficiently using electric cargo bikes (el-lastcyklar)
    Typical deliveries include parcels, food products, batteries, and other items to customers across the city.

    You have basic knowledge of Swedish language

jobs.title: Nail Technician
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about the art of nail care and dedicated to creating exceptional salon experiences? We are looking for an experienced Nail Technicians to  join our team and bring your expertise to a salon renowned for luxury and relaxation. jobs.title: Commercial Floor Installers
jobs.description:

Floor Form (Ireland) Limited are seeking Commercial Floor Installers to join the team based in Co. Meath. jobs.title: Taloushallinnon asiantuntija
jobs.description:
**Avoin työpaikka: Taloushallinnon asiantuntija**

Etsimme tilitoimistoomme Keminmaahan tarkkaa, oma-aloitteista, asiakaslähtöistä ja kehityshaluista taloushallinnon ammattilaista vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Haluaisitko työskennellä paikallisessa ja sopivan kokoisessa työyhteisössä, jossa pääset hyödyntämään ja kehittämään osaamistasi monipuolisesti?

Tässä tehtävässä vastaat asiakkaidemme taloushallinnon sujuvuudesta. Työpäiväsi koostuvat monipuolisista tehtävistä, joihin kuuluvat muun muassa:

- **Juokseva kirjanpito:** Kuukausittainen kirjanpito, alv-laskenta ja viranomaisilmoitukset.

- **Tilinpäätökset:** Vastaat tilinpäätösten valmistelusta ja laatimisesta.

- **Verotus:** Veroilmoitusten täyttö ja verolaskenta eri yhtiömuodoille.

- **Palkanlaskenta:** Osaaminen plussaa, ei välttämätöntä.

- **Kehittäminen:** Osallistut taloushallinnon prosessien ja järjestelmien digitalisointiin ja tehostamiseen yhdessä muiden kanssa.


Tehtävänkuvaa voidaan rakentaa osaamisesi ja vahvuuksiesi mukaan.

Olet etsimämme henkilö, jos sinulla on ymmärrystä ja motivaatiota oppia uutta taloushallinnon prosesseista ja halu työskennellä tarkkuutta vaativassa ympäristössä. Toivomme sinulta:

- **Kokemusta:** Mielellään vähintään muutaman vuoden kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä (kirjanpito/tilinpäätökset).

- **Koulutusta:** Tehtävään soveltuvaa kaupallista koulutusta (esim. merkonomi, tradenomi).

- **Asennetta:** Olet ratkaisukeskeinen, vastuuntuntoinen ja kykenet itsenäiseen ja hallittuun työskentelyyn. Viihdyt asiakastyössä, jossa voit omalla osaamisellasi auttaa asiakkaita menestymään.


Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä tehokkaassa mutta rennossa työyhteisössä. Meillä saat:

- Vastuullisen ja itsenäisen roolin vakaassa yrityksessä.

- Mahdollisuuden hyödyntää ja kehittää omaa ammattitaitoasi.

- Hyvät ja ajantasaiset työvälineet ja ohjelmat.

- Mahdollisuudet osittaiseen etätyöhön.

- Lounas- ja virike-etu, kilpailukykyinen palkka osaamisen mukaan, välittävät työkaverit ja sovitut lisäkoulutusmahdollisuudet.


**Kiinnostuitko?**

Hae tehtävää viimeistään **31.10.2026** mennessä lähettämällä CV:si ja hakemuksesi palkkatoiveineen osoitteeseen marjo.viinikka@actora.fi. Työn aloitusajankohta voidaan sopia joustavasti.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Marjo Viinikka numerosta 0400600574.

jobs.title: zelfstandig werkend koks I
jobs.description:
Ter versterking van ons team zoeken wij twee enthousiaste, zelfstandig werkende koks I met passie voor de Chinese en Indische keuken. Je werkt in een gezellige omgeving waar vakmanschap, samenwerking en kwaliteit centraal staan.

1. Jouw takenpakket bestaat uit het verrichten van voorbereidende werkzaamheden waaronder het wassen van groente, snijden en fileren van vis, het snijden van lam en rundvlees voor het maken van verschillende gerechten met een keukenteam dat bestaat uit ongeveer 3 collega’s met aan het hoofd de chefkok,

2. Bereiden en maken van de gerechten en uitvoeren van tussentijdse kwaliteit- als hygiënische controles,

3. Gereed maken en controleren van gerechten voor uitgifte van gerechten waarna de bedieningsmedewerkers deze kan overnemen voor het plaatsen bij warmhoud rechaud,

4. Plannen van de dagelijkse werkzaamheden en bestellen van voedingsmiddelen en andere voorraadaanvullingen bij vaste leveranciers en controleren van bestelde voedingsmiddelen;

5. Toezien op de werkzaamheden van de hulpkracht(en), geven van aanwijzingen en instructies;

6. Dagelijks voor sluiting het schoonmaken van de eigen werkomgeving, keukenapparatuur en -machines en het assisteren van de eventueel aanwezige keukenhulp bij het geheel schoonmaken van de keuken als het opslaan van geleverde goederen,

7. Een goede teamspeler die zich flexibel opstelt en beschikt over goede communicatievaardigheden,

8. Bijdragen aan kwaliteit en optimalisatie en aanpassing van menukaarten als het uitwerken van receptuur en bereidingsinstructies.

Je hebt een afgeronde MBO-3 opleiding (of vergelijkbaar), met aantoonbare kennis van basis kooktechnieken.

jobs.title: Zelfstandig werkende koks 1 voor Big Rabbit Enschede
jobs.description:

jobs.title: zelfstandig werkend koks I
jobs.description:
Aan de gezellige Maasboulevard met uitzicht op de Sint Servaasbrug zoeken wij 3 zelfstandige koks I die ons keukenteam willen versterken. Wij bieden jou een professionele werkomgeving met een goede sfeer die gekoppeld is aan ons trendy concept.

WERKZAAMHEDEN

1 Je voert voorbereidende werkzaamheden uit, waaronder het wassen van groenten, het snijden en fileren van zalm, en het snijden van lamskoteletten en rundvlees voor de bereiding van stoneplate-gerechten. Dit doe je samen met een keukenteam van circa acht collega’s, onder leiding van de chef-kok.

2 Je bereidt en maakt diverse gerechten, waarbij je tussentijds kwaliteits- en hygiëne controles uitvoert volgens de geldende richtlijnen.

3 Je maakt gerechten gereed voor uitgifte en voert hierbij een eindcontrole uit, waarna de bedieningsmedewerkers (of robots) de gerechten kunnen bezorgen.

4 Je plant de dagelijkse werkzaamheden en plaatst bestellingen voor voedingsmiddelen en andere voorraad aanvullingen bij vaste leveranciers. Tevens controleer je de geleverde producten op kwaliteit en kwantiteit.

5 Je houdt toezicht op de werkzaamheden van hulpkrachten, geeft instructies en stuurt waar nodig bij.

6 Voor sluitingstijd zorg je voor een schone werkplek, reinig je keukenapparatuur en -machines, en assisteer je bij het schoonmaken van de gehele keuken en het opslaan van geleverde goederen.

7 Je draagt bij aan het verbeteren van de kwaliteit, denkt mee over optimalisaties en helpt bij het samenstellen en aanpassen van menukaarten, recepturen en bereidingsinstructies.

Je hebt een afgeronde MBO-3 opleiding (of vergelijkbaar), met aantoonbare kennis van basis kooktechnieken. Je bent een echte teamspeler, stelt je flexibel op en beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager KRESS (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Das erwartet Dich bei uns:

Du willst nicht nur betreuen, sondern gestalten? In dieser Rolle bist Du Treiber:in des Wachstums im Pro-Business-Segment der DAU-Region.
Mit einem klaren Blick für Potenziale und Strukturen baust Du gezielt neue Kundenbeziehungen auf, entwickelst ein tragfähiges Kundennetzwerk und positionierst KRESS langfristig im professionellen Markt. Dabei denkst Du in Märkten, nicht in Einzelkontakten – und legst die Basis für nachhaltigen Vertriebserfolg.

Wir suchen einen Key Account Manager (m/w/d), der idealerweise entweder aus der Region Augsburg/Nürnberg/München oder Hannover/Bremen/Magdeburg kommt.


Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du entwickelst Strategien mit Weitblick: Gemeinsam mit dem KRESS Vertriebsmanagement EU erarbeitest Du eine gezielte Vertriebsstrategie für die DAU-Region – mit besonderem Fokus auf gewerbliche und kommunale Zielgruppen
  • Du analysierst den Markt: Durch gezielte Markt- und Wettbewerbsanalysen gewinnst Du wertvolle Einblicke in Potenziale der DAU-Region und nutzt diese für Deine Vertriebsplanung
  • Zielkunden definieren? Genau Dein Ding: Du identifizierst strategisch relevante Kundengruppen – von kommunalen Dienstleistern bis hin zu spezialisierten Gewerbekunden – und entwickelst systematische Ansprachekonzepte
  • Du überzeugst Kunden mit unserem Konzept: Du präsentierst die Marke KRESS und unsere Produkte mit Leidenschaft und Fachkenntnis – durch professionelle Vorführungen, Anwendungstrainings und individuelle Beratung direkt vor Ort
  • Du überzeugst mit Know-how und Auftritt: Du präsentierst unsere Produkte und das KRESS-Konzept mit Begeisterung – durch professionelle Vorführungen, Anwendungstrainings und individuelle Beratung direkt beim Kunden
  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung: Du betreust Key Accounts persönlich, strategisch und partnerschaftlich – und etablierst KRESS als starken Anbieter im Pro-Business-Segment
  • Du kennst Dich im Ausschreibungsgeschäft aus: Du unterstützt den Fachhandel bei öffentlichen Vergaben und sorgst für Sichtbarkeit unserer Marke in Ausschreibungsprozessen
  • Du positionierst KRESS im kommunalen Umfeld: Mit Dir wird KRESS zur bevorzugten Marke für Städte, Gemeinden und kommunale Betriebe in der DAU-Region
  • Du nutzt Events als Vertriebsplattform: Fachmessen, Kundenveranstaltungen und Trainings formst Du zu echten Markenerlebnisse und stärkst damit unsere Sichtbarkeit durch PR-Maßnahmen
  • Du siehst das Big Picture: Du beobachtest Trends, Kundenbedarfe und Wettbewerber und leitest daraus klare Impulse für Vertrieb und Produktmanagement ab
  • Du verbindest Welten: Als Schnittstelle zwischen Außendienst, Fachhandel und Produktmanagement sorgst Du für Klarheit, Feedback und Produktnähe
  • Du lieferst Ergebnisse: Mit Deinem Engagement stärkst Du unsere Marktpräsenz, entwickelst den Kundenstamm weiter und erreichst gemeinsam mit uns die Vertriebsziele in der DAU-Region


Was uns überzeugt:

  • Deine Skills: Deine Souveränität im Umgang mit Kunden, Deine klare Kommunikation und Deine technische Beratungskompetenz machen Dich zum echten Bindeglied zwischen Markt und Marke
  • Deine Erfahrung zählt: Du hast fundierte B2B-Vertriebserfahrung – idealerweise mit erklärungsbedürftigen Produkten im technischen oder öffentlichen Sektor
  • Struktur und Selbstständigkeit: Du arbeitest organisiert, vorausschauend und bist gerne eigenverantwortlich unterwegs
  • Reisebereitschaft bringst Du mit: Mobilität innerhalb der DAU-Region ist für Dich selbstverständlich
  • Sprachlich fit: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab


Was wir bieten:

  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag: Sei ein Teil unseres Unternehmenserfolgs und nutze durch abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeiten deinen individuellen Gestaltungsspielraum, um Deine Karriere voranzutreiben
  • Voll ausgestattet: Von uns bekommst Du einen Dienstwagen, auch für die private Nutzung inkl. Tankkarte
  • On top: Zur Verbesserung unseres ökologischen Fußabdrucks bieten wir Dir die Möglichkeit des Job Bike Leasings mit 50 % Zuschuss an
  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Darunter verstehen wir auch die Bezuschussung der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge in Höhe von 50 %
  • Über unseren Personalkauf gibt es das passende Werkzeug auch für Deine privaten Projekte – on top bekommst Du weitere Rabattmöglichkeiten dank unseres Corporate Benefits Programms
  • Strukturiertes Onboarding – eine Einarbeitung, damit Du Deine Aufgaben und Positec mit den Marken WORX & KRESS schnell kennenlernst

jobs.title: Pedagogisk leder - 100 % vikariat, Setskog barnehage
jobs.description:
Er du raus, leken og kreativ, til barns beste, og liker å være aktiv sammen med barna nede på gulvet eller ute i naturen? Da ønsker vi at du søker jobb hos oss! 

Vi har ledig følgende stilling: 

  • Pedagogisk leder – 100 % vikariat i perioden 16.10.2026 - 16.04.2027, med mulighet for forlengelse 

Setskog barnehage er en en-avdelings barnehage med 21 barn i alderen 1-6 år, som holder til i bygda Setskog, i Aurskog-Høland kommune. Vi er en del av Setskog oppvekstsenter, der barnehage, skole og SFO er «under samme tak», og vi har et godt samarbeid. Barnehagen ligger landlig til og bruker nærområdet til lek og aktivitet. I vår barnehagehverdag ønsker vi at lek og læring går hånd i hånd, og vi liker å skape varierte dager, slik at barna får øve seg på ulike utviklingsområder, både gjennom lek og i temaarbeid. 

Vi kan tilby store lekearealer både inne og ute, et godt utviklet fagmiljø og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø. Alle kommunale barnehager i Aurskog-Høland har lokal bemanningsnorm på 5,5 barn pr. voksen, og spesialpedagog er tilknyttet barnehagen. 

Setskog barnehage har positive og engasjerte ansatte, med 3 pedagoghjemler og erfarne barne- og ungdomsarbeidere, der alle har barns beste i fokus. Vi er opptatt av at hverdagen preges av lek og aktivitet, til glede for både barn og ansatte. Vi ønsker å skape et godt foreldresamarbeid til det beste for barna, og barnehagen jobber kontinuerlig for å skape et inkluderende språk- og lekemiljø gjennom trygghet og trygg tilknytning, der de ansatte støtter og legger til rette for at alle skal føle seg inkludert. 

Du er en pedagogisk leder som:

  • Er løsningsorientert, nytenkende og ser muligheter fremfor begrensninger i arbeid med faglig og pedagogisk utvikling i barnehagen.
  • Lar deg begeistre av barnas lek, og er opptatt av å skape et godt leke – og språkmiljø.
  • Bidrar til å skape et godt fellesskap, tenker helhetlig og samarbeider godt med personalet og foreldrene i barnehagen.
  • Ved å være del av en liten personalgruppe må se viktigheten av å være fleksibel og kunne samarbeide godt med kollegaer, og legge til rette for både barnegruppens og enkeltbarnets behov.
  • Har gode lederegenskaper, er beslutningsdyktig og tydelig på en raus måte. 

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Godkjent utdanning som barnehagelærer, eller annen treårig pedagogisk utdanning på høgskolenivå med videreutdanning i barnehagepedagogikk. Har du pedagogisk utdannelse fra utlandet, må denne være godkjent som barnehagelærer av Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse.
  • Norskferdigheter i henhold til barnehageloven § 28.
  • Gode digitale ferdigheter. 

Personlige egenskaper:

  • Selvstendig, løsningsorientert og gode samarbeids og relasjonsferdigheter.
  • Profesjonell, faglig engasjert og reflektert, med høy arbeidskapasitet.
  • God rollemodell.  

Vi tilbyr: 

  • Et godt faglig miljø som bidrar til faglig utvikling.
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø i en liten personalgruppe. 
  • Muligheter for kompetanseheving og tverrfaglig samarbeid.
  • Motiverte og kreative medarbeidere. 
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. 

Personlig egnethet blir vektlagt ved alle ansettelser. 

Politiattest må framlegges før tiltredelse. 

Vår visjon er muligheter, miljø og mangfold. Sammen gjør vi det umulige mulig, velger grønt først og lar ulikhetene forme vår felles fremtid. Vi har et ansvar for fortid, nåtid og skaper et samfunn i takt med sin samtid, og vi legger til rette for at Aurskog-Høland er et godt sted å leve, bo og arbeide. 

Våre verdier som ligger til grunn for alt arbeid som skjer i kommunen er; Åpenhet, Tillit og Samhandling. 

Vår kommune har fokus på et inkluderende arbeidsliv og er opptatt av at arbeidsstyrken skal gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet. Likeverd, likestilling og mangfold er en del av kulturen vår, og vi har nulltoleranse for diskriminerende praksis og oppførsel.   

Etter søknadsfristen vil det bli utarbeidet en offentlig søkerliste, i samsvar med Offentleglova § 25. Vi gjør oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkeren kan bli offentliggjort selv om søkeren har bedt om ikke å bli oppført på den offentlige søkerlisten. Søkere vil bli varslet i forkant dersom anmodning om unntak fra offentlighet ikke tas til følge. 

Alle attester/tjenestebevis og vitnemål må lastes opp sammen med søknad og CV i rekrutteringsportalen, EasyCruit innen søknadsfristen. Har du utdanning fra utlandet legger du ved godkjenning fra HK-dir. https://hkdir.no/utdanning-fra-utlandet. 

Ønskes ytterligere informasjon om stillingen, ta gjerne kontakt med virksomhetsleder Vigdis Aaserud, e-post: vigdis.aaserud@ahk.no, eller tlf.: 479 05 153. 

Informasjon om den enkelte barnehage får du på hjemmesiden: Aurskog-Høland kommune - Barnehagetilbudet vårt (aurskog-holand.kommune.no)


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kommunen ligger under en time fra Oslo, Gardermoen og Charlottenberg, og kun 30 minutter fra Lillestrøm og store deler av Romerike. Vi er Oslos nærmeste villmark med et rikt dyreliv og et flott kulturlandskap, og med flere tettsteder der Bjørkelangen er kommunesenteret. Aurskog-Høland kommune er en fremtidsrettet organisasjon der medarbeiderne er den viktigste ressursen for at vi skal lykkes i å skape det mangfoldige og gode liv for våre innbyggere og gjester. Det gjør vi best sammen, og som ansatt er vi opptatt av å gi deg ansvar og spennende arbeidsoppgaver, samtidig som vi legger til rette for faglig utvikling. Aurskog-Høland ble som én av tre kommuner nominert som Årets kulturkommune 2023-2024, ligger på første plass på Romerike i saksbehandling av byggesaker, og havnet i 2022 på 14. plass over landets best styrte kommuner. Vi ønsker oss flere initiativrike og dyktige medarbeidere som setter pris på å bli utfordret og som aktivt bidrar i løsningen av kommunens oppgaver. Vi er en kommune i vekst. Det gir oss mange muligheter i tiden fremover. Vi kan tilby spennende og utviklende oppgaver.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer
jobs.description:
WHO ARE WE?

Nordhealth (OB:NORDH) is the leading provider of cloud-based Practice Information Management Software (PIMS) to veterinary and therapy professionals.

Over the last three years, we have grown our Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) and team size by almost 10x. Today, more than 30,000 therapy and veterinary professionals use our software everyday to help treat over 20 million patients annually across 35+ countries. Its been an exciting growth journey so far and we are just getting started. Our mission is to enable healthcare professionals to deliver better patient care through software, with a goal to help serve over 200 million patients by 2030. In support of this growth mission, in May 2021, Nordhealth raised €120M through a public-listing on Euronext Growth Oslo stock exchange.

Nordhealth is a remote-first company, headquartered in Helsinki, Finland. Our 430+ employees work either remotely or from offices/collaboration hubs. While our market presence is currently strongest in the Nordics, our customer base is rapidly growing in North America and Europe, with clients in the US, UK, Spain and many others. For more information, visit our companys website at www.nordhealth.com [http://www.nordhealth.com/]



ABOUT THE ROLE


We are here to create great healthcare products. Thats at our very core, but its the people who make companies great, not the other way around. We spend more time with our co-workers than anyone else in our lives. Being part of an exceptional team is not only important for your personal mindfulness but key for your professional progression.

Were now looking for Staff Engineer for our veterinary unit, to support the AI growth of our PMS, Provet!



YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE:

* Accuracy of AI scribe and possibly fine tuning;

* Developing internal models to predict trends;

* Help with predictions what actions the user should take.



WHAT WILL HELP YOU TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE?

Ideally, you have already gained some experience from working in a fast growing, global SaaS company.In addition, our humble wishlist includes:

* Ability to contribute to, and improve, our data warehouse infrastructure to better support AI features and functionality;

* Have previously built novel AI features in a PMS to allow medical professionals to be more effective in their roles;

* Have mentored and supported other engineers.




WHATS IN IT FOR YOU?

At Nordhealth, we do things a little bit differently. We value continuous improvement, diverse teams and autonomy which drive our collaboration. Our global healthcare domain is rapidly developing and we are seeking colleagues who enjoy working in this type of environment.

In addition, we offer:

* The chance to work in a meaningful industry and in a fast-growing, global company on a path to changing digital healthcare

* Competitive compensation and benefits

* Learning and professional growth opportunities

* The tools you need, and enjoy using

* Frequent company events and talented colleagues from around the world

If you enjoy working in a fast-growing and international environment with the possibility to make an impact, this might be the perfect job for you. Apply now! We'll fill the position as soon as we find the right person.




Recruitment Fraud Alert

Nordhealth only communicates with candidates through our Applicant Tracking System (Teamtailor: @ finnishnetsolutions.teamtailor-mail.com) or via official @nordhealth.com emails (e.g. name.surname@nordhealth.com or careers@nordhealth.com). We post roles only on our Careers page, LinkedIn, and trusted job boards. Contact from any other source should be considered suspicious. If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent Nordhealth and you are unsure of their legitimacy, please contact us directly at careers@nordhealth.com. Your safety and trust are very important to us!

jobs.title: Senior Hardware Engineer
jobs.description:
Creo Center on monialainen tuotekehityskumppani organisaatioille, jotka haluavat onnistua uusilla innovaatioilla tai edistämällä nykyisten tuotteiden kehitystä. Laajan palveluportfoliomme avulla pystymme tarjoamaan korkeatasoista suunnittelua eri alojen tuotekehityshankkeisiin ja olemaan strateginen kumppani sekä paikallisille että kansainvälisille yrityksille. Asiakkaitamme ovat pääasiassa tuotekehityksen huippuorganisaatiot, johtavat valmistavan teollisuuden yritykset sekä innovatiivisia tuoteideoita kehittävät startupit. Kasvumme ja kansainvälistymisemme ansiosta olemme usean palvelualueen osalta toimialamme edelläkävijöitä, ja tahtotilamme on kasvaa ja kehittyä entisestään yhdeksi merkittävimmistä tuotekehitysorganisaatioista Pohjoismaissa niin tuotekehityksen osa-alueilla kuin tuotekehityslähtöisen digitaalisen siirtymän toteuttajana.

Etsimme nyt Senior Hardware Engineeriä modernien teknologioiden ja innovatiivisten ratkaisujen pariin Espooseen, Turkuun tai Ouluun!

Roolisi meillä

Senior Hardware Engineerin roolissa vastaat elektroniikkaratkaisujen suunnittelusta kokonaisvaltaisesti, aina konseptista tuotantoon saakka. Toteutamme projekteja laajasti erilaisille kansainvälisille yrityksille ja työsi kohteena voikin olla esimerkiksi tietoliikenne- ja verkkolaitteita, medikaalilaitteita, energiateknologiatuotteita tai kuluttajatuotteita. Projektimme ovat teknisesti haastavia kokonaisuuksia, joissa elektroniikka, firmware, käyttöjärjestelmät ja järjestelmäintegraatiot yhdistyvät toimiviksi ja luotettaviksi laiteratkaisuiksi. Kehitämme ratkaisuja, joita ei ole aikaisemmin toteutettu sellaisinaan, joten pääset soveltamaan olemassa olevia teknologioita uusilla tavoilla sekä oppimaan jatkuvasti uutta erilaisten käyttöjärjestelmien, teknologioiden, laiteympäristöjen ja toimintamallien muodossa.

Roolin painotus vaihtelee projekteittain ja muotoutuu myös oman taustasi ja vahvuuksiesi mukaan. Sulautettujen järjestelmien moniosaajatiimimme kasvaa ja kehittyy vauhdilla, joten halutessasi saat mahdollisuuden ottaa laajempaakin vastuuta niin projekteista kuin tiimin toiminnastakin.

Millaista henkilöä etsimme?

Haemme tehtävään henkilöä, jolla on vahvaa kokemusta elektroniikkasuunnittelusta ja kyky ottaa haltuun laajojakin teknisiä kokonaisuuksia ja uusia innovaatioita.

Toivomme sinulta:

* Useamman vuoden kokemusta laaja-alaisten elektroniikkaratkaisujen suunnittelusta

* Soveltuvaa teknistä korkeakoulututkintoa

* Kokemusta tuotekehitysprosessin eri vaiheissa toimimisesta aina konseptista tuotantoon saakka

* Tuntemusta yleisimmistä sulautetuista piirisarjoista

* Syvällistä osaamista elektroniikkasuunnittelun ohjelmistoista, kuten Altiumista tai PADSista

* Katsomme eduksi, jos sinulla on myös tehoelektroniikkaosaamista

Teknisten taitojen lisäksi arvostamme erityisesti rakentavaa ongelmanratkaisukykyä. Sinulla on tarkkuutta huomioida yksityiskohdat ja täsmällisyytesi näkyy niin suunnittelussa kuin dokumentaatiossakin. Pystyt toimimaan niin itsenäisesti kuin osana isompaa tuotekehitystiimiä ja kommunikoit sujuvasti sidosryhmien kanssa sekä suomeksi että englanniksi. Suhtaudut positiivisesti uusien teknologioiden haltuun ottamiseen, innostut aidosti tuotekehitystehtävistä ja luontaisen uteliaisuutesi ansiosta haluat kehittyä alallasi yhä paremmaksi asiantuntijaksi.

Miksi Creo Centerille?

Creo Centerillä olet osa yli 160 asiantuntijan tuotekehitysyhteisöä, jossa huippuosaaminen kasvaa ja kehittyy monialaisessa yhteistyössä. Tarjoamme sinulle:

Kehittyvän uran: Asiantunteva kollegaverkosto ja laaja, erilaisista toimialoista koostuva asiakaskuntamme tarjoavat sinulle jatkuvasti uusia oppimismahdollisuuksia. Nopeasti kasvavassa organisaatiossa pääset kehittämään uutta ja vaikuttamaan tiimin ja yksikön toimintatapoihin!

Kattavat henkilöstöedut: Tarjoamme sinulle lounasedun, puhelinedun, työmatkaedun tai työsuhdepyörän, laajennetun työterveyden sekä kattavan vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksen.

Osuuden yhteisistä onnistumisista: Uskomme yhteisiin onnistumisiin ja jaamme vuosittain People-bonuksen puitteissa osan liikevoitostamme kaikkien työntekijöidemme kesken.

Sujuvan työarjen: Työskentelemme hybridisti joustavilla työajoilla, koska haluamme tukea työn ja muun elämän yhdistämistä. Varmistamme työn sujuvuutta myös panostamalla moderneihin työvälineisiin ja ohjelmistoihin sekä viihtyisiin toimitiloihin.

Toivottavasti kuulemme sinusta pian!

Jos haluat olla mukana luomassa tulevaisuuden tuotteita, haethan tehtävää mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään 8.11.2026 ja olemme sinuun yhteydessä. Tehtävä on vakituinen sekä kokoaikainen ja alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

Jos sinulle jäi vielä kysymyksiä rooliin tai rekrytointiin liittyen, lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Design Managerimme Karl-Erik Gustafsson p. 040 7374 651, arkipäivisin klo 14-16 välillä.
