jobs.title: Bilbolaget i Lycksele utökar och söker ytterligare en bilsäljare
jobs.description:
Är du en engagerad säljare som brinner för kundrelationer, affärer och bilar? Vill du arbeta självständigt i ett stabilt företag med stark lokal förankring och goda utvecklingsmöjligheter? Då kan du vara den vi söker!

Vi på Bilbolaget i Lycksele utökar och söker nu ytterligare en resultatinriktad säljare med fokus på Volvo selekt samt begagnade bilar för både privat- och företagskunder.

Om rollen

Som bilsäljare hos oss får du en varierad och affärsdriven roll där du ansvarar för hela kundresan – från första kontakt till levererad bil och fortsatt relation. Du arbetar självständigt mot tydliga mål, med stöd av försäljningschefen och dina kollegor.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att:

Sälja Volvo Selekt och begagnade bilar till privat- och företagskunder. Aktivt bearbeta nya och befintliga kunder. Bygga långsiktiga och förtroendefulla kundrelationer. Planera och delta i kundträffar, event och andra marknadsaktiviteter. Erbjuda företagets tjänster och lösningar, exempelvis serviceavtal och Volvokort. Säkerställa en professionell och personlig kundupplevelse genom hela bilaffären.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som är kreativ, driven och har en tydlig säljprofil. Du arbetar kanske redan med försäljning av kapitalvaror eller har dokumenterad erfarenhet av kundbearbetning och försäljning.

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du:

    Motiveras av att skapa affärer och nå uppsatta mål.
    Tar stort eget ansvar och arbetar strukturerat.
    Är initiativrik och trivs med uppsökande försäljning.
    Har lätt för att skapa kontakt och utveckla långsiktiga relationer.
    Är lyhörd och har en god förmåga att förstå kundens behov.
    Vill ge kunderna i Lycksele med omnejd service i toppklass.

Vi värdesätter din inställning, ditt engagemang och din vilja att utvecklas. Ett genuint intresse för människor, affärer och bilar är en självklar fördel.

Därför ska du välja Bilbolaget

Hos oss blir du en del av ett tryggt och väletablerat företag med lång erfarenhet, starka varumärken och ett tydligt kundfokus. Du får möjlighet att utvecklas i din roll samtidigt som du arbetar nära både kunder och kollegor på den lokala marknaden.

Bilbolaget eftersträvar en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka. Vi välkomnar därför sökande med olika erfarenheter och bakgrunder.

Om Bilbolaget

Bilbolaget är Norrlands största återförsäljare av bilar. På våra olika anläggningar representerar vi Volvo, Ford, Polestar och Lynk & Co samt erbjuder ett stort utbud av begagnade bilar.

Med cirka 500 medarbetare på 15 orter i norra Sverige har vi sedan 1932 varit en stabil och långsiktig partner för alla bilägare.

Bilbolaget är en del av Persson Invest, en familjeägd koncern som även är verksam inom skog, lastbilar, bussar, förnybar energi och fastigheter. Koncernen omsätter 8,5 miljarder kronor och har ca 1600 anställda.

Ansökan

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt. Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning. Vi genomför bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidater.

Har du frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta:

Göran Sahlén, försäljningschef

Telefon: 0611-52 10 26

E-post: goran.sahlen@bilbolaget.com

Om oss

Bilbolaget är Norrlands största återförsäljare av Volvo, Ford, Polestar, Lynk & Co och begagnade bilar. Vi erbjuder försäljning av person- och transportbilar, hyrbilar, verkstadstjänster, däckhotell, tankning, tvätt, laddning och bildelar. jobs.title: OT SECURITY LEAD TO OX2
jobs.description:
How do you secure renewable energy assets where industrial control systems, cloud platforms and cybersecurity come together? At OX2, protecting wind, solar and energy storage facilities mean understanding both the technology behind energy production and the risks that come with connected systems. We are now looking for a OT Security Lead to take ownership of our cybersecurity priorities with operational technology at the center and help shape how security is managed across our growing energy portfolio.

YOU WILL

OX2 is a renewable energy company developing, constructing, owning and operating large-scale wind, solar and energy storage projects. As the company expands its role as an independent power producer, cybersecurity is an important part of ensuring that its energy assets and the systems supporting them remain secure and reliable.  As OT Security Lead, you will take overall responsibility for cybersecurity across OX2's IT and operational technology environments, with a clear focus on OT. You will work across industrial control systems, cloud platforms and corporate IT, setting security requirements and ensuring that risks are understood and addressed throughout the development and operation of energy assets.

You will make risk-based decisions about which security measures are needed, where they should be implemented and how they should be prioritized across different facilities. Working closely with plant engineers, IT teams, suppliers and senior stakeholders, you will translate security requirements into practical solutions that work in operational environments.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

    

Own and prioritize the CSMS pipeline across OX2's wind, solar and energy storage assets.

    

Define security architecture and requirements across OT and IT, including SCADA, plant control systems, remote sites, Azure, AWS and SaaS environments.

    

Apply IEC 62443 and security principles such as zones and conduits, secure remote access, least privilege and security by design.

    

Establish and enforce cybersecurity requirements for suppliers, technology partners and external service providers.

    

Assess cybersecurity risks in vendor selection, acquisitions and divestments, contributing to cyber due diligence.

    

Govern external security partners and managed security service providers, including incident response and security delivery.

    

Translate NIS2 and relevant cybersecurity legislation into practical security measures across the business

    

The role involves collaboration across OX2's international business.

YOU ARE

You have a strong background in cybersecurity. You understand the challenges of protecting systems where security, availability and operational requirements need to work together. You have worked with OT and industrial control systems, including areas such as SCADA, plant networks and remote access. You have practical experience with IEC 62443 and understand how to apply security principles such as network segmentation, zones and conduits, least privilege and security by design. You also understand the connections between OT, corporate IT and cloud environments.

Your experience extends beyond individual projects. You have taken responsibility for security across multiple sites or technical environments, setting priorities, assessing risks and ensuring that security measures are implemented. You are used to working with external suppliers and know how to establish requirements and challenge solutions. Experience with MSSP governance, incident response or cyber due diligence is particularly valuable.

You are naturally curious and enjoy exploring new technologies and approaches to security. You make well-founded decisions. You can discuss technical details with engineers while explaining risks and priorities clearly to management. Most importantly, you follow through and make sure security requirements lead to real improvements. You have a relevant educational background and are fluent in English. Experience from energy, utilities, industrial automation or other critical infrastructure environments is particularly valuable, but not essential if you bring strong practical OT security experience.

At OX2, you will have the opportunity to influence how cybersecurity is managed across an international portfolio of renewable energy assets. You will work close to the technology behind energy production, with the responsibility and autonomy to develop security capabilities that protect both current operations and future assets.

WANT TO KNOW MORE?

For questions about the role, please contact recruitment consultant Johanna Värmfors at johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com or +46 730 821 230, or Artan Bitiqi at artan.bitiqi@nexergroup.com or +46 723 61 28 44.

We are looking forward hearing from you!

ABOUT OX2

OX2 is a renewable energy company accelerating the transition to a sustainable energy system. Through its integrated model as an independent power producer (IPP), OX2 develops, constructs, owns and manages renewable energy assets across onshore and offshore wind, solar and energy storage.  With a diversified portfolio of approximately 33 GW across development, construction, asset management and operations, OX2 combines entrepreneurial project development with long-term ownership and value creation. The company operates in five European markets and Australia, has approximately 500 employees, and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.  OX2 is owned by EQT, one of the world's largest private equity investors.

jobs.title: Commissioning Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced commissioning professional to lead the overall commissioning programme on a major data centre project in Seinäjoki, ensuring coordinated delivery from design and construction readiness through integrated systems testing, final handover, and transition to operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Commissioning Strategy & Leadership**

- Own the commissioning strategy, execution plan, team structure, system boundaries, tagging process and governance.

- Lead, manage and coordinate the mechanical, electrical, controls and integrated commissioning teams, setting clear responsibilities, priorities and performance expectations.

- Act as the primary commissioning interface with project management, construction, design, QA/QC, HSE, planning, commercial, client and operational teams.

- Chair daily coordination, weekly management, readiness, integration and handover meetings. Record and close decisions, actions and constraints.


**Programme, Planning & Readiness**

- Develop and maintain the integrated commissioning programme, linking construction completion, vendor activities, energisation, system start-up, functional testing, IST and handover milestones.

- Maintain the commissioning resource plan, tracking personnel, vendors, temporary requirements, permits and test equipment against the programme.

- Lead readiness reviews and confirm construction, QA/QC records, permits, access, ownership, isolations, temporary requirements and vendor attendance before energisation or testing.

- Monitor progress, forecast constraints and implement recovery plans where commissioning milestones are at risk.


**Technical Governance & Quality**

- Oversee commissioning input to design reviews, technical submittals, RFIs, RAMS, inspection and test plans, test scripts, switching procedures and vendor documentation.

- Ensure test procedures and acceptance criteria comply with contract requirements, approved design, manufacturer guidance, Finnish and European standards and industry best practice.

- Provide governance for factory witness testing, site acceptance testing, energisation, functional performance testing and integrated systems testing.

- Track defects, non-conformances, punch-list items and technical risks to agreed closure dates, supported by weekly ageing reviews and completion evidence.


**Integration, Testing & Handover**

- Own the Level 0 to Level 5 commissioning process across CFCI and OFCI systems, including mechanical, electrical, BMS, EPMS, life-safety and specialist vendor interfaces.

- Own project LOTO and area-control permits for commissioned and energised systems, including access, boundaries, authorised personnel and transfer of control.

- Lead the development, approval and execution of the integrated systems testing plan, scenarios, scripts, safety controls and final reports.

- Coordinate beneficial-use areas, phased turnover, client witnessing, demonstrations, operator training and transition to operations.

- Ensure turnover packs, commissioning records, certificates, red-line drawings, O&M information and final dossiers are complete and accepted at each stage.


**Reporting & Stakeholder Management**

- Support control of commissioning expenditure across direct labour, subcontractors, specialist vendors, temporary plant, test equipment, material requirements and variations, working with the commercial team to identify forecast changes and protect the approved budget.

- Report weekly and monthly on WBS progress, readiness, resources, lookaheads, risks, defects, late deliveries, recovery actions and key decisions.

- Maintain effective relationships with the client, contractors and vendors and resolve interface issues before they affect safety, quality or programme.

- Maintain consistent use of EIDA, SharePoint and other project platforms for commissioning schedules, tagging, test evidence, approvals, defects, turnover status and management reporting.


**Qualifications & Experience**

- Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent recognised professional or trade qualification supported by relevant commissioning leadership experience.

- At least five years experience in a Commissioning Manager role on large-scale data centre, mission-critical, industrial or similarly complex projects, or demonstrable equivalent experience supported by broader commissioning leadership responsibility.

- Proven experience managing multidisciplinary commissioning teams and contractor and vendor delivery, supported by extensive commissioning knowledge of the mechanical, electrical, controls and life-safety systems typically installed on data centre projects.

- Strong knowledge of commissioning Levels 0–5, including digital completion controls, energisation, functional testing, IST, turnover and operational handover.

- Thorough understanding of Finnish and European regulations, codes, standards, safety requirements and accepted commissioning practice.

- Excellent leadership, planning, decision-making, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

- Ability to produce high-quality management reports, presentations, programmes, risk assessments and technical documentation.

- Fluency with both written and spoken in English.


**Desirable Criteria**

- Previous hyperscale or enterprise data centre commissioning management experience.

- Experience managing phased handover and live operational interfaces on multi-building or campus projects.

- Authorised Person, switching, safety management or recognised commissioning certification.


**What We Offer**

Youll lead commissioning activities on a major data centre project in Seinäjoki, working with multidisciplinary teams, contractors, vendors, and the client to ensure safe and successful delivery from initial readiness through final handover and transition to operations. We offer competitive compensation, a lunch benefit, and a dynamic, international project environment.

jobs.title: Commissioning Engineer (Mechanical)
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced mechanical commissioning professional to coordinate mechanical and integrated commissioning on a major data centre project in Seinäjoki. You will support delivery from design and construction readiness through testing and final handover, coordinating with contractors, vendors, the project team and client to ensure mechanical systems are fully tested and all Level 0–5 commissioning and turnover documentation is complete.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Planning, Design & Coordination**

- Develop commissioning activities within the project programme, aligned with stakeholder and contract requirements.

- Review the issued-for-construction design and report commissioning risks, opportunities, scope gaps and programme impacts.

- Coordinate mechanical readiness reviews before start-up and testing, confirming completion, QA/QC records, RAMS, permits, access, isolations, controls, temporary requirements and vendor attendance.

- Provide commissioning input at coordination, design, integration, discipline, OFCI and CFCI meetings.


**Technical Reviews & Commissioning Controls**

- Review and comment on technical submittals, RFIs, vendor test scripts, commissioning RAMS and related commissioning documentation.

- Review contractor and vendor test packs against the design, employers requirements, approved submissions and applicable standards.

- Attend factory tests and complete site or vendor QA/QC inspections against approved requirements.

- Manage commissioning records, evidence, approvals and reporting in SharePoint, EIDA and project platforms.


**Testing, Integration & Performance Verification**

- Witness field testing and commissioning activities, record results and report defects, deviations and incomplete works.

- Coordinate CFCI and OFCI vendors and track commissioning progress from Level 0 to Level 5.

- Coordinate with the integration team to capture programme crossovers, dependencies, deliverables and beneficial-use areas.

- Analyze functional performance logs and monitoring data with the BMS contractor and other specialists to verify system performance.


**Management, Reporting & Quality**

- Provide discipline updates at weekly commissioning meetings and close assigned actions promptly.

- Monitor construction progress with the mechanical, electrical and CSA discipline leads to identify scope gaps, missed opportunities and risks arising from programme variance.

- Maintain a daily commissioning diary and issue a concise weekly report in the agreed project format.

- Review mechanical commissioning certification and submit traceable evidence for authorized approval.


**Turnover & Handover**

- Coordinate mechanical turnover packs at each commissioning level, verify supporting evidence, and prepare EIDA forms for authorized approval.

- Support integrated systems testing, client witnessing, demonstrations, operator training and final transition to operations.


**Commissioning Scope**

- Mechanical plant and systems, including chillers, cooling towers or dry coolers, pumps, heat exchangers, ventilation systems, fuel systems where applicable, water-treatment systems, drainage and associated controls.

- BMS interfaces, control sequences, alarms, trends, functional performance testing and integrated operation.

- Mechanical interfaces with electrical systems, fire alarm, life-safety systems, utilities and specialist vendor packages.

- Factory and site testing, flushing, pressure and leak testing, balancing, start-up, functional, failure-mode and integrated systems testing.

- Digital commissioning records, tagging, test packs, certification, turnover dossiers and final handover evidence.


**Qualifications & Experience**

- Mechanical, Building Services or related qualification, with 5+ years commissioning experience on large industrial, mission-critical or data centre projects.

- Proven ability to plan, manage and execute full integrated systems testing, including development and completion of IST documentation on a digital platform.

- Thorough understanding of Finnish and European building regulations, standards, codes, commissioning practices and mechanical system integration requirements.

- Strong organization and prioritization skills, with a record of meeting deadlines and budgets.

- Strong communication and reporting skills with clients, contractors, vendors and project management.

- Demonstrated ability to coordinate contractors, vendors and multidisciplinary interfaces while maintaining collaborative working relationships.


**What We Offer**

You'll play an important role in commissioning the mechanical systems of a major data centre project in Seinäjoki, working closely with contractors, vendors, and multidisciplinary project teams to ensure systems are tested, verified, and ready for operation. From design reviews and construction readiness through functional testing, integrated systems testing, and final handover, youll help coordinate activities, resolve technical issues, and ensure commissioning documentation is complete and traceable. We offer competitive compensation, a lunch benefit, and the opportunity to develop your expertise in a dynamic, international project environment.

jobs.title: Associate professor in Environmental and Energy Systems Analysis
jobs.description:
Join Chalmers and help shape the future of sustainable maritime transport through internationally leading research with real-world impact. This position offers the opportunity to build and lead your own research agenda in a dynamic, collaborative environment at the forefront of the energy and environmental transition.

Chalmers University of Technology strives for academic excellence while also addressing the challenges and needs of society and industry. We offer a creative and dynamic environment for research, education, innovation and applied science. We aim to become a globally leading university of technology, with a strong emphasis on high-quality research and education, openness and collaboration.

At the recently formed https://www.chalmers.se/en/departments/env/ we identify, analyse and describe the major environmental challenges of our time, with the aim of developing models, tools and competitive technological solutions to support the transition in sectors such as energy, transport and heavy industry. A significant part of our research takes a systems perspective, focusing on the interaction between technology, society and the environment in order to develop resilient solutions for the future.

As part of the formation of our new department, we invite applications for a position as associate professor, focusing on environmental and energy systems analysis, in the area of maritime transport.

About the role

The associate professor is expected to lead, advance, and develop research in the area of maritime transport. Particular emphasis will be placed on research assessing the environmental impacts of shipping. Teaching responsibilities include close collaboration with Chalmers school of Maritime studies, and development of courses, primarily at master's and doctoral level, connected to the research area. Utilization of research results is an important part of the role, and the associate professor is expected to interact with both public and private stakeholders.

The appointment as Associate Professor is a permanent faculty position.

About the division and department

The Department of Environmental and Energy Sciences consists of five research divisions, with the common goal of providing excellent research that can enable solutions for transition to a sustainable society. The department offers a dynamic and inspiring academic environment, and well-developed networks with industry and relevant public stakeholders at national, international and global levels. The Maritime Environmental Science Division, with about 20 employees, strives to be a key player that provides science for the development of a sustainable transport sector with focus on maritime transport. We contribute by producing new knowledge through a combination of modelling and experimental work, and the development of new technology and decision support.

Your responsibilities

The position includes conducting and advancing research, education, and collaboration in close cooperation with colleagues across the department and university. In this role, you will be expected to:

    Conduct and lead research as an independent Principal Investigator at a high international standard.
    Contribute to teaching at all levels in collaboration with other faculty members.
    Continuously develop your pedagogical skills and actively contribute to the development of courses and educational programmes.
    Foster a vibrant academic culture and participate in departmental and university-wide activities.
    Supervise undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral students.
    Apply for external research funding to further strengthen and advance your research programme.
    Contribute to the development of your discipline both nationally and internationally.
    Actively support the dissemination and utilization of research results and contribute to academic citizenship.

Qualifications and merits

To qualify for the Associate Professor position, you have a doctoral degree in a relevant field and demonstrate independent scientific research of a high international quality and growing production of research.

You have:

    Performed research that has resulted in publications and presentations in relevant and respected venues for your field
    Demonstrated ability to acquire research funding
    Demonstrated ability to establish national and international collaborations.
    Supervised doctoral students as main and/or assistant supervisor
    Higher Education pedagogical training in accordance with the current SUHF recommendation (preferable)
    Teaching experience, including course development
    Well established national and international networks within the subject area
    Documented utilization of your research results in relevant societal fora
    Contributed to a good working environment in your current and former workplaces
    Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, in English

Det er totalt åtte miljøterapeutstillingar i bufellesskapet, som alle jobbar i langvaktturnus. Bufellesskapet er lokalisert på Brattholmen, på Lille Sotra.

Arbeidsoppgåver:

  • Miljøterapeutisk oppfølging av ungdom i bufellesskapet
  • Skape tillit og trygg relasjon til ungdommen med fokus på å utvikle sjølvstende
  • Samarbeid med relevante samarbeidspartnarar.
  • Arbeida i tråd med gjeldande lovverk, faglege retningslinjer og vedtekne rutinar.
  • Bidra til fagutvikling, kvalitetsarbeid og eit godt arbeidsmiljø.
  • Forvaltning etter lov om barnevern

Kvalifikasjonar: 

Må ha:

  • Bachelorutdanning innan relevant fagområde barnevernspedagog, sosionom eller vernepleier.
  • Relevant erfaring frå arbeid med ungdommar, med vekt på miljøterapeutisk arbeide, relasjonsbygging og TBO.
  • Gode norskkunnskapar, både munnlege og skriftleg.
  • Førarkort klasse B.

Ønskjeleg med:

  • God skriftleg framstilling

Personlege eigenskapar:

  • Er trygg, robust og bevarer ro og fagleg vurderingsevne i krevjande situasjonar.
  • Har gode relasjonelle ferdigheiter og evne til å skapa tillit over tid.
  • Er fleksibel, løysingsorientert og tek ansvar.
  • Har gode samarbeidsevner og trives med å arbeide tett sammen med kollega og samarbeidspartnere.
  • Bidreg aktivt til eit godt arbeidsmiljø og fagleg utvikling.

 Anna:

For tida er arbeidet organisert i døgnturnus. Turnus inneber samanhengande arbeids periodar på 2-3 døgn på arbeidsstaden, etterfølgt av friperiodar.

Arbeidstidsordninga er etablert for å ivareta brukaren sine behov og kan bli endra behova i tenesta eller andre vilkår tilseier det.

Gyldig politiattest må leggjast fram før tilsetjing.

Vi tilbyr:

  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordningar
  • Lønn etter gjeldande tariffavtale
  • Ei meiningsfull og fagleg spennande stilling der du kan gjera ein forskjell
  • Moglegheiter for fagleg utvikling, rettleiing og tverrfagleg samarbeid.
  • Eit godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte og dyktige kollegaer

 

Kontakt

Avdelingsleiar Marian Austrheim tlf: 92485977 Marian.Austrheim@oygarden.kommune.no

Einingsleiar barnevern Hege Gundersen tlf: 93484846 Hege.Gundersen@oygarden.kommune.no

 

 

Øygarden kommune ønskjer eit arbeidsmiljø prega av mangfald, og at våre medarbeidarar i størst mogleg grad skal spegla mangfaldet i befolkninga. Vi oppmodar alle som er kvalifiserte til å søkja jobb hos oss uansett alder, funksjonsevne, kjønn, eller minoritetsbakgrunn. Som IA-verksemd ønskjer kommunen å leggja til rette for arbeidsforholda dersom du har behov for det.

Etter utløpet til søknadsfristen, vert det sett opp ei offentleg søkjarliste med namn, alder, stilling eller yrkestittel og bustads- eller arbeidskommune for kvar søkjar. Det kan gjerast unntak frå innsyn for opplysningar om ein søkjar dersom vedkomande sjølv ber om det. Opplysningar om ein søkjar, kan verta offentlege sjølv om søkjaren har bede om ikkje å vert ført opp på søkjarlista. Dersom oppmodinga ikkje vert teken til følgje, vert søkjaren varsla om dette. Ved vurderinga av om ei slik oppmoding skal takast til følgje, skal det leggjast vekt på om det knyter seg særleg offentleg interesse til stillinga.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Øygarden kommune er den nest største kommunen i Vestland fylke med om lag 40 700 innbyggjarar og om lag 2 800 tilsette. Straume er kommunesenter (ca. 15 minutt køyring frå Bergen) med kommunedelsenter på Rong, Ågotnes og i Skogsskiftet. Administrasjonsspråket i Øygarden er nynorsk. Øygarden kommune har sett seg som mål å vera ein framtidsretta og kunnskapsbasert samfunnsutviklar med fortrinn innanfor energi, teknologi og marine ressursar. Kommunen skal løfta fram viktige verdiar som felles kultur, språk og identitet. Vi har ambisjonar om å vera ein handlekraftig og effektiv organisasjon med god leiing, høg kompetanse og kvalitet.

jobs.title: BPA-assistenter søkes til ung mann i Oslo – dag, kveld, helg og natt.
jobs.description:
Vil du ha en meningsfull jobb og bli en viktig del av hverdagen til en musikk- og matglad ung mann?

Vi ønsker å styrke assistentteamet rundt en sosial og aktiv ung mann som bor hjemme med familien på Løren og Nordstrand i Oslo. Nå søker vi 2–3 nye BPA-assistenter, og har særlig behov for deg som har mulighet til å jobbe både dag- og kveldsvakter i ukedagene.

Han trives med musikk, matlaging, bilturer, cafébesøk og å være ute blant folk. Han får jevnlig oppfølging som en del av sin rehabilitering, og hverdagen består av en kombinasjon av aktiviteter, hvile, avtaler og små og store opplevelser.

Som assistent blir du en del av et team rundt ham, hvor trygghet, gode relasjoner og stabilitet i hverdagen står sentralt..

Hva går jobben ut på?

Som BPA-assistent bidrar du til at han kan gjennomføre hverdagen og aktivitetene sine med den støtten han trenger. Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet være:

  • Bistand i daglige rutiner og personlig stell
  • Følge til avtaler, blant annet fysioterapi, ergoterapi og annen helseoppfølging
  • Aktivitet og trening etter avtale med familien
  • Turer, bilturer, cafébesøk, kino og andre sosiale aktiviteter
  • Hjemmeaktiviteter og støtte i daglige gjøremål
  • Bistand ved forflytning

Arbeidsdagene vil variere ut fra planer, aktiviteter og behov.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Det viktigste for oss er at du er en person som bidrar til trygghet og stabilitet, og som ønsker å bli kjent med ham og hverdagen hans.

Vi tror du vil passe godt i rollen dersom du:

  • Er omsorgsfull, stabil og ansvarsbevisst
  • Møter andre med respekt og nysgjerrighet
  • Har en positiv og trygg fremtoning
  • Er tålmodig og god til å bygge relasjoner
  • Er komfortabel med en ung og direkte person som er tydelig på egne interesser og ønsker
  • Er strukturert, samtidig som du kan være fleksibel når hverdagen krever det

Det er en fordel om du kjenner deg igjen i det unge voksne miljøet i assistentteamet, som i dag hovedsakelig består av personer i alderen ca. 22–35 år, men vi vurderer selvfølgelig søkere bredt.

Førerkort klasse B er en fordel.

Arbeidstid og behov

Vi har først og fremst behov for assistenter som har god tilgjengelighet på ukedager, både på dagtid og kveldstid.

Det ledige behovet er per nå omtrent:

  • Ukedager: 3 x 8-timersvakter per uke, fordelt på både tidlig- og senvakter
  • Helg: 2–3 x 8-timersvakter per måned
  • Natt: 3–4 nattevakter per måned

Du trenger ikke nødvendigvis å kunne dekke alle typer vakter. Skriv gjerne tydelig når og hvor mye du har mulighet til å jobbe.

Vi ser for oss å ansette 2–3 nye assistenter, slik at vi får et stabilt og fleksibelt team rundt ham.

Vi tilbyr
  • En meningsfull jobb hvor du blir en viktig del av en ung manns hverdag
  • God opplæring og oppfølging
  • Et inkluderende assistentteam
  • Varierte arbeidsdager
  • Mulighet for både faste vakter og tilkallingsarbeid
  • Lønn etter tariff
Høres dette ut som noe for deg?

Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg. Fortell oss litt om deg selv, hvorfor du kunne tenke deg å jobbe som BPA og hvilke dager og tidspunkter du vanligvis har mulighet til å jobbe.

Vi vurderer kandidater fortløpende.

Før eventuell ansettelse må det fremlegges politiattest, jf. helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven § 5-4. Attesten skal ikke være eldre enn tre måneder.

Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon skal BPA bidra til muligheten til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv, med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse.

BPA handler om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker på lik linje med andre samfunnsborgere.

Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

jobs.title: Våken nattevakt søkes til blid og smart muskelsyk 8-åring
jobs.description:
Jeg er en åtte år gammel jente som bor sammen med mamma, pappa, søster og bror i Bjørnafjorden. Jeg går på vanlig skole på dagtid, på dans på kveldstid og liker å være med venner og familien min. På grunn av en medfødt muskelsykdom trenger jeg en del ekstra hjelp i hverdagen.

Jeg sitter i rullestol og har nedsatt bevegelse i hele kroppen. Jeg trenger hjelp til blant annet forflytning, stell, sondemat, behandling med pustemaskiner, ta frem leker til meg og være med til venner. På grunn av pusten må jeg alltid ha noen som kjenner meg i nærheten av meg.

Jeg har god kontroll på hva jeg trenger, og kan instruere mye. Jeg har assistenter slik at mamma og pappa kan få litt avlastning, få prioritere alle barna sine og bare få være mamma og pappa. De er likevel lett å få tak i om det skulle være noe.

Jeg er nå på utsikt etter assistenter som ønsker å jobbe natt.

Nattevakten går fra 22.00 – 08.00 og Om natten er BPA våken og overvåker pusten min. 

Jeg er på jakt etter tilkalling assistenter, med mulighet for fast på sikt.

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner
  • Snakke og skrive flytende norsk
  • Ha førerkort klasse B
  • Ha plettfri vandel
  • Være fleksibel
  • Ønske å jobbe med barn og bidra til likestilling

Grunnet arbeidets art vil kvinner mellom 18 og 40 år prioriteres. All nødvendig opplæring vil bli gitt, og det er derfor ikke krav til utdanning eller tidligere erfaring.

Vi kan tilby
  • En spennende og variert arbeidshverdag
  • Erfaring fra helse- og omsorgssektoren
  • Erfaring med PEG-sonde og diverse pustemaskiner
  • Gratis e-læringskurs
Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper jeg å høre fra deg!

Ta kontakt med koordinator Trine Solberg på ts@assent.no for å høre hva vi kan tilby

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Assent har organisert BPA-tjenester siden 2014. I dag har vi konsesjon på levering av BPA i flere kommuner over hele landet. Vi har medarbeidere med god kjennskap til ordningen og arbeidsgiverrollen, samt lang erfaring med organisering av individuelle tjenester både i og utenfor hjemmet. For oss er det viktig at arbeidleder i størst mulig grad kan leve et uavhengig og selvstendig liv. Assent er medlem i NHO og våre tjenester er i henold til ISO 9001,ISO 14001 og OHSAS 18001.

jobs.title: Nattevakter – 3 midlertidige stillinger à 65,7 % Hjemmetjenesten, Lødingen kommune
jobs.description:
Vil du gjøre en viktig jobb mens resten av Lødingen sover? Vi søker tre nattevakter til hjemmetjenesten for perioden 19. oktober 2026 til 1. februar 2027. Det er mulighet for forlengelse og fast ansettelse.

Om stillingene
Du får primæransvar for oppfølging av én enkelt bruker. Ansvar for utrykninger til hjemmeboende pasienter med trygghetsalarm i Lødingen sentrum. Du er også støtte for nattevaktene i miljøtjenesten når de trenger bistand i situasjoner som omfattes av vedtak etter helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven kapittel 9 om bruk av tvang og makt.

Du samarbeider tett med nattevaktene på sykehjemmet og i miljøtjenesten, så du står ikke alene i jobben.

Du jobber turnus med nattevakter fra kl. 22.00 til 08.00, etter mønsteret 3 netter på, 7 netter fri, 4 netter på og 7 netter fri.

Du får grundig opplæring
Vi vil at du skal føle deg trygg i jobben fra første natt. Derfor får alle nyansatte en grundig opplæring før de starter. Den omfatter:

  • Opplæringsvakter sammen med erfarne kolleger
  • Innføring i oppfølgingen av brukeren du får primæransvar for
  • Opplæring i trygghetsalarmer og utrykning
  • Opplæring i kapittel 9 og i hvordan du skal bistå miljøtjenestens nattevakt
  • Innføring i dokumentasjon og journalsystem

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Primæransvar for oppfølging og ivaretakelse av én bruker gjennom natten
  • Utrykning til hjemmeboende pasienter ved trygghetsalarm
  • Bistand til nattevaktene i miljøtjenesten ved behov for støtte knyttet til kapittel 9-vedtak
  • Samarbeid med nattevaktene på sykehjemmet og i miljøtjenesten
  • Dokumentasjon i pasientjournal

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Helsefaglig utdanning
  • Søkere uten formell helsefaglig kompetanse, men med relevant erfaring fra helse og omsorgsarbeid, oppfordres også til å søke
  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Erfaring med kapittel 9 er en fordel, men ikke et krav

Personlige egenskaper

  • Du er trygg, selvstendig og tar ansvar
  • Du er rolig og løsningsorientert når noe uforutsett skjer
  • Du er pålitelig og samarbeider godt med andre
  • Du møter tjenestemottakere/brukere og pasienter med respekt og omsorg

Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.

Vi tilbyr

  • Grundig opplæring før du starter
  • Mulighet for forlengelse og fast ansettelse
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med erfarne kolleger
  • Lønn etter Hovedtariffavtalen i KS
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

Annet

  • Tilsettingen skjer fortløpende, så send søknaden din så snart som mulig
  • Politiattest må legges fram før tiltredelse, jf. helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven § 5-4
  • Du vil få taushetsplikt etter gjeldende lovverk
  • Søknadsfrist: 02.11.2026. det vil bli gjort tilsettinger så snart vi får kvaifiserte søkere, så send inn søknad så raskt som mulig. 
  • Kontakt: Har du spørsmål om stillingene, kan du kontakte avdelingsleder Dagmar Leiknes, tlf. 951 45 255, e-post: Dagmar.leiknes@lodingen.kommune.no.

Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Lødingen ligger vakkert til ved Vestfjorden i Nordland fylke. Storslagen natur og fine friluftsmuligheter er tilgjengelig rett utenfor stuedøra. Kommunens to tusen innbyggere kan nyte alt fra late dager på badestranda Bankfjæra og fjellturer både sommer og vinter, til gode forhold for jakt, fiske og padling. Ta gjerne en tur opp på Møysalen - som er kåret til Norges vakreste fjelltur. Kommunen har de siste årene investert i ny barnehage, kunstgressbane, sykehjemsfløy og 1-10 skole med storsal. Lødingen kommune har en sentral beliggenhet med kort veg til regionale senter som Sortland, Harstad og Narvik, en times kjøretur til Harstad/Narvik lufthavn Evenes. Regionen kan skilte med spektakulære natur- og kulturopplevelser. Lødingen kommune - midt i hjertet av Lofoten og Vesterålen.

Vi held til i nye og moderne lokale på Øystre Slidre helsetun, der fleire helse- og omsorgstenester er samla. Lokala ligg sentralt til på Heggenes, med flott utsikt over Heggefjorden og mot Jotunheimen. Vi ønskjer å vere ein naturleg del av nærmiljøet, og det er mange aktivitetar på Helsetunet. Velferdsteknologi er eit satsingsområde. Vi jobbar kvar dag for å gje gode tenester til alle brukarane våre.

 

Vi ser fram til å høyre frå deg!

  • Gje tenester til brukarar etter enkeltvedtak og etter gjeldande styringsdokument

  • Gode haldninger til brukarar og ser verdien av nytekning innan kvardagsmestring, miljøarbeid og velferdsteknolog

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nasjonalparkkommunen Øystre Slidre ligg ved inngangsporten til Jotunheimen, med Beitostølen som et naturleg utgangspunkt. Vegen er kort til toppturar både sommar og vinter. 

Friluftsliv, jakt, fiske og stølsliv er viktig i kommunen. Du finn mellom anna deler av Langsua nasjonalpark, eit stort turløypenett og milevis med skiløyper i heile kommunen. På Valdresflye varar skisesongen lenge.  Velkommen til rein naturglede!

Reiseliv og jordbruk er blant dei største  næringane, og det finst spanande arbeidsplassar innan fleire bransjar.Øystre Slidre har dei siste åra hatt vekst i folketallet.

Øystre Slidre kommune skal tilby gode tenester til innbyggarar og tilreisande i alle aldersgrupper. Nytt og moderne helsetun stod ferdig i 2021. Eit rikt kulturtilbod, eit godt  tilbod til barn og unge og ein unik dugnadsånd er med på å gjere kommunen til ein attraktivt stad å bu. 

Gode handelstilbod finn ein både i kommunen og rundt regionsenteret Fagernes.

Vil du vite meir om Valdres? Vi har unik natur, kultur og er ein attraktiv region, sentralt i Norge. Les meir på valdres.no.

jobs.title: Radiologist for adaptable position at Namsos Hospital in Trøndelag
jobs.description:
On behalf of Namsos Hospital, part of Helse Nord-Trøndelag Health Trust, we are looking for a skilled and motivated radiologist for a permanent position.

Namsos Hospital serves a population of approximately 39,000 people across 19 municipalities in northern Trøndelag and the Bindal area in Nordland. The health trust has around 3,700 employees and provides specialist healthcare services within emergency medicine, internal medicine, surgery, maternity care and psychiatry.

 

Trøndelag is located in the heart of Norway and offers a unique combination of urban life, coastal beauty and access to nature. The region is ideal for outdoor activities such as hiking, skiing, fishing and cycling. Read more about living in Trøndelag here.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Performing CT and X-ray examinations
  • Conducting ultrasound and basic interventional procedures
  • MRI and mammography
  • Participating in the department’s daily operations, including on-call rotation (currently a 1-in-5 senior consultant rota; junior doctors often cover first-line call)
  • Collaborating with clinical departments and primary care services

Qualifications:

  • Medical license and radiology specialty certification from an EU/EEA country
  • Broad experience in CT, X-ray, ultrasound, and simple interventional procedures
  • MRI and/or mammography experience is a strong advantage
  • Proficient in English and motivated to learn Norwegian. A free language course will be provided

Personal qualities:

  • Ability to work independently, systematically and accurately
  • Good communication and teamwork skill
  • Adaptability and a willingness to learn
  • Strong emphasis on personal suitability

Namsos Hospital offers:

  • A friendly and inclusive workplace
  • Professional development opportunities, including courses and continuing education
  • Structured rotation for senior physician leave
  • Salary in accordance with national agreements
  • Pension scheme with 2% employee contribution
  • Group life and accident insurance

Benefits through Dignus Medical:

  • Free online language course with a private tutor
  • Assistance with obtaining Norwegian medical authorization
  • Relocation support for you and your family
  • Ongoing career guidance and follow-up throughout the process

Do you want to know more? Don’t hesitate to get in touch – we hope to hear from you!

 

You can also register your CV or sign up for our newsletter to stay updated on future opportunities.

Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. jobs.title: Customer Success Advisor - German speaking
jobs.description:
The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The role

Customer Service Advisors are the first point of contact for potential customers as well as new and existing customers, and thus the “face” of iwoca. You handle incoming calls, emails and web chats, supporting entrepreneurs with general inquiries, new applications and repeat loans. You highly value our customer service and support customers with your excellent communication skills so they can successfully utilise our products.

A fundamental component for our success is to convince and inspire customers and partners of our mission - this ranges from hair salons and dental practices to financial advisory services and banks.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Demonstrates curiosity to use and learn more about AI tools. You’ll already be comfortable using AI tools in practical ways to help solve problems, increase productivity and improve quality of work, showing good judgement about when to use them and the ability to explain the reasoning behind that use.

We look for people who are smart, humble, motivated and always looking to improve.

  • You enjoy communicating with customers and live "customer centricity". Your greatest motivation is achieving success with our customers.

  • You have completed a commercial training / business studies (kaufmännische Ausbildung / betriebswirtschaftliches Studium) and can add value with relevant professional experience in customer service (experiences in the banking environment or a fintech are a plus).

  • You are highly motivated, organised, a true team player and have a 'hands-on' mentality.

  • You possess C1-level German communication skills (both written and spoken) and are comfortable collaborating in English within our diverse, international office.

  • An independent, team-oriented and reliable way of working is a given.

Don’t take this list as prescriptive: it’s just to give you a sense of who might do well at the job. We’d still love to hear from you if you don’t hit every point on the list, or if you have other experience.

Your mission:

  • You are responsible for the overall customer satisfaction and ensure that customer inquiries via phone, email or web chat are handled promptly and efficiently.

  • You answer questions about our products, the application process and our service in general, supporting both new and existing customers.

  • You assist entrepreneurs in completing their applications and providing the necessary documents required for a credit decision.

  • You collaborate with various teams within iwoca to achieve the best outcome for our customers.

  • You proactively participate in the development of iwoca by providing regular insights on customer feedback, opportunities to improve our processes or new offerings from our competitors.

Work-life balance is incredibly important at iwoca and we offer flexible working so you can make better use of your free time. This is a hybrid role in which you can split your time between the office and home.

We want to make iwoca a place where everyone feels welcome, where you can confidently be yourself. We understand that inclusivity, and diversity that comes through greater inclusivity, isn't an optional add-on; it's the core ingredient of what makes us great. We care about making iwoca a healthy and happy community for all of our team members to thrive in.

The salary

We expect to pay from £28,000 — £36,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

jobs.title: Technical Web Specialist (12-month fixed term contract)
jobs.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

As a Technical Web Specialist, you’ll be the connective tissue between our web team and the rest of the business. This role exists because great websites aren’t just built — they’re coordinated, prioritised, and protected from chaos. Sitting at the intersection of Marketing and Web Development, you’ll own the intake and lifecycle of web requests, ensure every project is properly scoped before it touches the dev queue, and support the team in delivering an ambitious web roadmap.

But this role doesn’t stop at coordination. You’ll also be hands-on in the quality of what we ship — reviewing copy and UX before pages go live, supporting CRO initiatives, and acting as a critical second pair of eyes on every significant release. You care as much about whether a page converts as whether it launches on time.

If you’re someone who thrives on bringing order to complexity, understands how a website is actually built, and can hold your own in a room with developers, designers, and marketers alike, this is your role.


What You’ll Do

Technical Ownership & QA

  • Build and ship pages/components directly in Storyblok CMS: component configuration, staging, QA, and production deployment across market versions

  • QA every release technically — rendering, functionality, and cross-browser/device behaviour, not just copy and visual polish

  • Use AI tools as a core part of daily production work (drafting, layout variants, QA support), and know where AI output still needs a human check, particularly around localisation nuance and experiment validity

Request Triage & Scoping

  • Own intake for web requests: qualify, triage, and estimate technical complexity and dependencies before anything is scoped or scheduled

  • Enforce briefing standards and know enough technically to explain why a brief is incomplete

  • Decide what can be handled directly vs. what needs to go to the development team, and write specs the team can act on without excessive clarification

Project Coordination

  • Act as day-to-day PM between the development team and business stakeholders: track scope, delivery, and risk

  • Maintain the web backlog and sprint board with clear status, ownership, and blockers

  • Support CRO initiatives: help build A/B test setups, document hypotheses, and track experiment results

Process & Reporting

  • Maintain intake templates, briefing standards, and triage criteria

  • Produce regular status updates and pipeline reports for the Head of Web and wider leadership


What We’re Looking For

Must-haves

  • 2 to 4 years in a web operations, technical/digital project management, or web production role, ideally with hands-on CMS or front-end exposure — not purely marketing coordination

  • Working technical literacy: solid HTML/CSS fundamentals, understanding of how a CMS is structured (Storyblok, Contentful, Webflow or similar), staging vs. production workflows, and what a QA process actually checks

  • Comfortable using AI tools hands-on in production (prompting for drafts, QA’ing AI output) and able to articulate where AI isn’t reliable enough to trust unsupervised

  • Product/project-management instincts: can scope a request, size complexity, sequence competing priorities, and brief external developers with minimal hand-holding

  • Confident translating between technical and non-technical stakeholders, and comfortable pushing back on a brief or a deadline when needed

  • Strong written communication: a clear brief, a precise QA note, a concise status update

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with Storyblok or a comparable headless CMS

  • Familiarity with web analytics or conversion tracking concepts

  • Exposure to A/B testing/CRO tools, or basic SQL

  • Experience briefing or QA’ing a development team

  • Basic understanding of Core Web Vitals / page performance

  • Familiarity with SEO fundamentals as they intersect with web production


What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12–16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 “Work from Anywhere” days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

No two days look quite the same: you will resolve what you can yourself and work with the wider team on the trickier problems, building your product knowledge as you go.

We are looking for someone with solid Sage 200 support experience who wants to broaden across our wider product range over time. There is genuine manufacturing ERP expertise to build here, and a clear path to grow as you develop and as we bring Cim360.cloud to market.

AI tooling is part of how we work, and you will be encouraged to use and build your skills with modern AI assistants as part of the day job.

  • Work the incoming support queue, handling 1st and 2nd line cases across our product range for both direct customers and reseller partners, by phone, email, and ticket.

  • Work closely with the rest of the support team, lending your weight across the desk during busier periods to keep response times sharp for customers and partners.

  • Diagnose and resolve issues directly where possible, working from the knowledgebase and your growing product knowledge.

  • Investigate configuration and data issues, including running SQL queries where needed.

  • Escalate the more complex cases clearly, with good detail and reproduction steps.

  • Keep cases updated and communicate clearly with both customers and partners throughout.

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

 

Kraken’s Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, 2D and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

 
 

The opportunity

As our Senior Performance Video Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid video for Kraken and Krak. You ideate, generate, edit and ship, and you treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and speed leadership: you set the bar for paid video on the team, work with AI-enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with video questions.

 

  • Own paid video for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.

  • Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform’s specs and native feel.

  • Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets.

  • Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn’t. Keep your tooling current as the models change, and build repeatable workflows the rest of the team can reuse.

  • Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, including experimental ones alongside BAU work, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.

  • Version and localize video at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you’ll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.

  • Build creative with testing in mind. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts.

  • Flex into AI-assisted paid static when a campaign calls for it, working from the team’s brand baselines.

  • Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.

  • Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on.

 
 

What you bring

  • 5+ years in performance video creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

  • A portfolio submitted with your application. Paid video above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you’re able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed.

  • Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.

  • High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.

  • Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

  • Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You’re fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision.

  • Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic instincts and a feel for what’s about to feel dated.

  • Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.

  • Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with work that survives risk warnings, disclaimers and market-specific requirements.

  • A solid copywriting instinct for scripts and on-screen text. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.

jobs.description:
HOLA! 🇪🇸 At Villa Valentina we are looking for you!

About Villa Valentina

Inspired by the warmth of a Spanish farmhouse, Villa Valentina brings people together through Mediterranean flavours, heartfelt hospitality and dishes made for sharing. Relaxed, vibrant and full of character, it is a place where guests feel like old friends — and our team brings that feeling to life every day.

Part of Urban Italian Group

Urban Italian Group is one of Europe's fastest-growing hospitality groups, bringing together distinctive restaurant brands, passionate people and memorable guest experiences. As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities for those who want to build their careers with us.

The Role

As a Kitchen Assistant, you’ll play an important role in keeping our kitchen running smoothly every day, working alongside our chefs, you’ll support with food preparation, organisation and cleanliness while learning how a busy professional kitchen operates. It’s a great opportunity for someone who enjoys working as part of a team and wants to develop their skills within hospitality.

What you'll be doing

    

Support the kitchen team with basic food preparation

    

Help keep kitchen areas clean, organised and ready for service

    

Assist chefs during preparation and service when required

    

Receive, store and organise ingredients and deliveries correctly

    

Follow food safety, hygiene and HACCP procedures

    

Support with stock rotation and minimise food waste

    

Maintain cleanliness of kitchen equipment, utensils and work areas

    

Work closely with the whole kitchen team to ensure smooth daily operations

    

Bring a positive and helpful attitude to every shift

You'll thrive in this role if you

    

You have a positive attitude and a genuine passion for food and hospitality.

    

You are hardworking, reliable, and always willing to support your teammates.

    

You thrive in a fast-paced kitchen environment and enjoy being part of a dynamic team.

    

You understand the importance of cleanliness, hygiene, and food safety standards.

    

You are flexible, proactive, and happy to take on different tasks when needed.

    

You are eager to learn, develop your skills, and grow within the kitchen.

    

Previous experience in a professional kitchen is a plus, but a great attitude and willingness to learn are just as important.

Our culture and values

We believe we work with people, not food. Guided by our values of Trust, Inclusion, Passion and Excellence, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and empowered to grow.

What do we offer?

    

Be part of one of Europe’s fastest-growing hospitality groups.

    

Build your career across multiple brands and countries.

    

Work alongside talented people who genuinely love hospitality.

    

International career opportunities.

    

Referral bonus scheme.

    

Shared accommodation (where applicable).

    

Friends for life.

Sound like your kind of place?

If you are excited by joining us, we would love to hear from you. Bring your energy, personality and passion for hospitality to Villa Valentina.

Urban Italian Group is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the selection process, please tell our Talent Acquisition Team.

jobs.title: Familjerätten söker vikarierande familjerättssekreterare
jobs.description:
Jönköpings kommun är en stor arbetsgivare med hundratals olika yrkesroller. Vi växer i takt med att kommunen utvecklas med fler invånare, fler bostäder och större utbud. Vi är alltid på jakt efter ny kompetens - medarbetare med olika bakgrunder och erfarenheter, med den gemensamma drivkraften att vilja skapa en bättre kommun att besöka, leva, verka och bo i.

Söker du ett meningsfullt arbete där du kan göra skillnad? Är du en trygg och engagerad socionom med intresse av det familjerättsliga området? Då är det här jobbet för dig då vi nu söker en vikarie till Familjerätten.

Ditt nya jobb

Familjerätten har till uppgift att med barnets bästa i fokus, utreda och stödja barn och föräldrar i familjerättsliga frågor, så som vårdnadsutredningar, frivilliga och remitterade samarbetssamtal, umgängesstöd, medgivande- och adoptionsutredningar, samt faderskaps- och föräldraskapsutredningar. Till våra umgängesstödsärenden har vi en barnanpassad lokal och erfarna umgängesstödjare.

Just nu fokuserar vi lite extra på att förfina vårt arbete med samarbetssamtal, för att särskilt inkludera barnen i samtalen. Vi lägger även en stor tyngdpunkt vid arbetet med våld i nära relation, då alla barn har rätt att leva ett liv fritt från våld. Vi fokuserar också på den förebyggande insatsen Barn i föräldrars fokus (BiFF) som är en föräldrautbildning i grupp.

Din kompetens

Du som söker tjänsten har en socionomexamen. Vi ser gärna att du har erfarenhet av utredningsarbete inom myndighetsutövning och tidigare har arbetat med familjerättsliga frågor, detta är meriterande för tjänsten. Vidare har du mycket goda kunskaper om aktuell lagstiftning och du ska ha god förmåga i svenska språket, detta gäller både att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift samt läsförståelse.

B körkort krävs för tjänsten.

Du är nyfiken på att lära dig mer samtidigt som du redan besitter förmåga att möta människor som är i svåra livssituationer. Du hjälper gärna till där det behövs och trivs både med att arbeta i par och mer självständigt. Du är intresserad av att skapa goda relationer, är lyhörd för andra och har ett tydligt barnperspektiv, samtidigt som du har förmåga att göra svåra bedömningar. Du tycker att samarbete är viktigt och du förstår myndighetsrollen. Vidare är du trygg i dig själv och knyter med enkelhet kontakter med andra människor. För dig är det viktigt med engagemang, ansvar och delaktighet i vår verksamhetsutveckling och du delar gärna med dig av din kunskap.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Vi erbjuder dig

Hos oss får du individuell lönesättning, 7 h arbetsdag, handledning, introduktion, friskvårdsbidrag samt betald semester första året. Läs mer om våra förmåner här

Välkommen till oss

Socialtjänsten i Jönköpings kommun är en starkt sammanhållen förvaltning med ett tydligt fokus på de personer vi är till för. Vi gör skillnad för våra invånare. Familjerätten tillhör Individ- och familjeomsorgen (IFO) i Jönköping. Arbetsplatsen är belägen i Huskvarna Stadshus. På Familjerätten har vi arbetat särskilt med att sprida kunskap om vårt arbete till övriga enheter inom barn och unga samt öka vår samverkan till enheten Våld i nära relation. Familjerätten arbetar på uppdrag av tingsrätten när föräldrar inte är överens i frågor om vårdnad-, boende- och umgänge, med alltifrån utredningar, samarbetssamtal och umgängesstöd.

Vi är en grupp om 13 handläggare, 2 1:e familjerättssekreterare, 1 administratör och 1 enhetschef. Arbetet sker med stöd från oss alla. Du får ett härligt gäng som kollegor med lång erfarenhet av familjerättsligt arbete. Vi prioriterar gemenskap och trivsel.

Du får en trygg start och en bra introduktion i vårt arbete och är du ny i kommunen får du också ett kommunövergripande introduktion.

Bra att veta

Rekryteringen avser en tidsbegränsat vikariattjänst som familjerättssekreterare, heltid, med tillträde och avslut enligt överenskommelse. Din arbetsplats blir i Huskvarna stadshus.

I din ansökan vill vi att det finns ett CV samt bifogat examensbevis och aktuella tjänstgöringsintyg. All din tjänstgöring ska kunna styrkas med intyg där det framgår befattning och vilken omfattning du arbetat. Även om du redan arbetar hos oss behöver du visa upp examensbevis och tjänstgöringsintyg för tjänster du haft utanför kommunen. Ansökningar som inte uppfyller detta kommer inte att prioriteras. Urval sker löpande och intervjuer planeras till v. 41 och v. 42.

Den här befattningen är arbetsvärderad och återfinns i basgrupp G. För mer information om befattningens löneintervall se: Lön-och-lönestatistik open_in_new

Innan eventuell anställning ska du uppvisa ett för tjänsten godkänt utdrag från polisens registerutdrag.

Vill du veta mer?

Rekryterande chef: Lynn Carlsson, tel: 036-10 28 01. Fackliga representanter: Fackliga Soc

Tillsammans gör vi Jönköpings kommun bättre – för alla. Kom och jobba med oss. Välkommen att söka tjänsten!

Jönköpings kommun strävar efter att erbjuda en attraktiv arbetsplats som är fri från diskriminering och ger lika möjligheter för alla.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför vänligt men bestämt alla samtal om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp.

jobs.title: CLOUD & INFRASTRUCTURE LEAD TO OX2
jobs.description:
What does it take to keep a growing renewable energy business connected, secure and ready for the future? At OX2, cloud infrastructure supports everything from daily operations and business-critical systems to data platforms and AI. We are now looking for a Cloud & Infrastructure Lead to take ownership of our infrastructure landscape, shape its technical direction and ensure that our platforms support the business as it continues to develop.

YOU WILL

OX2 is a renewable energy company developing, constructing, owning and operating large-scale wind, solar and energy storage projects. As OX2 expands its role as an independent power producer, the demand for its digital infrastructure continues to grow. Secure, reliable and well-managed cloud platforms are essential to supporting operations across different markets, as well as the company's ambitions within data and AI.

As Cloud & Infrastructure Lead, you will take overall responsibility for OX2's cloud and infrastructure environment, spanning Azure, AWS and the services connecting them. You will set technical expectations, evaluate proposed solutions and follow up on delivery. You will also work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure that infrastructure decisions support both operational needs and future digital initiatives.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

    

Own and develop OX2's cloud infrastructure, including Azure and AWS architecture, landing zones, standards and governance.

    

Set technical direction across enterprise networking, connectivity and core infrastructure services.

    

Oversee identity and endpoint management, Windows and Linux environments, backup and recovery.

    

Strengthen cloud security and operational resilience, including disaster recovery, patching and vulnerability remediation.

    

Drive FinOps and cloud cost optimization, improving transparency around consumption, budgets and infrastructure investments.

    

Manage infrastructure suppliers and managed service providers, ensuring clear responsibilities, measurable service levels and reliable delivery.

The role has a broad international scope, with close collaboration across OX2's technology organization, business stakeholders and external partners

YOU ARE

You have a solid background in cloud and infrastructure and experience taking responsibility for complex technical environments. You understand how architecture, networking, security and operations fit together. You bring strong experience from Azure or AWS, or both, and a good understanding of enterprise networking and infrastructure architecture. You are familiar with infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform, and have experience with several of the services surrounding cloud infrastructure, such as Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Windows or Linux environments, and backup and recovery.

You have worked closely with external suppliers or managed service providers and know how to set requirements, evaluate technical solutions and follow up on delivery. You also understand the financial side of infrastructure and have experience improving operational efficiency and managing cloud costs. You are comfortable making decisions and challenging established ways of working when needed. With a practical approach, you can move between detailed technical discussions and conversations with senior management, explaining not only what needs to be done but also why it matters to the business. You have a relevant educational background and are fluent in English. Experience from the energy sector, critical infrastructure or another regulated environment is valuable, but not required.

At OX2, you will have the opportunity to influence the infrastructure supporting an international renewable energy business. With broad responsibility and considerable autonomy, you will help shape the technical foundation for OX2's operations and continued development within data, AI and digital services

WANT TO KNOW MORE?

For questions about the role, please contact recruitment consultant Johanna Värmfors at johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com or +46 730 821 230, or Artan Bitiqi at artan.bitiqi@nexergroup.com or +46 723 61 28 44.

We are looking forward hearing from you!

ABOUT OX2

OX2 is a renewable energy company accelerating the transition to a sustainable energy system. Through its integrated model as an independent power producer (IPP), OX2 develops, constructs, owns and manages renewable energy assets across onshore and offshore wind, solar and energy storage.

With a diversified portfolio of approximately 33 GW across development, construction, asset management and operations, OX2 combines entrepreneurial project development with long-term ownership and value creation. The company operates in five European markets and Australia, has approximately 500 employees, and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. OX2 is owned by EQT, one of the world's largest private equity investors.
