jobs.title: Head of Years (Up to Year 4)
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE
Aiglon College is an international boarding school based in the Swiss Alps with a worldwide reputation for providing a challenging and transformational holistic education in an inspiring setting within a safe, caring and supportive framework. The School is CIS accredited, and caters for 500 students aged 5-18 representing 65 nations. In their final years students prepare for Cambridge IGCSEs and the IB Diploma Programme but our distinct learning philosophy begins to become embedded from our youngest students. The Junior school is a connected part of the whole school but is also a distinct section separate from the Senior School with a dedicated focus on students up to Year 8.

The school wishes to appoint, for August 2027 (possibly January or April 2027 for the right candidate), an innovative, caring, and dynamic Head of Years (Up to Year 4) who will provide operational leadership, and support strategic development, for the lower junior phase up to Year 4, line manage class teachers and teaching assistants up to Year 4, and work in close partnership with the Director of Junior School and Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics.

The ideal candidate for this position would be an experienced primary/early years specialist with leadership experience, ideally in an international setting, who has expertise in early childhood education, literacy and numeracy foundations, and outdoor/experiential learning. Knowledge of inquiry based learning, project based learning, or biophilic education would be preferable.

This position involves a teaching component and presents a unique opportunity to lead and nurture our youngest learners in a world-class alpine environment.

KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

To put the students first.
To lead the day-to-day operational and educational provision for students up to Year 4, working in close partnership with and under the strategic oversight of the Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics.
To participate actively in Junior School Leadership Team meetings and contribute to strategic planning for the lower primary phase.
Direct line management of classroom teachers and teaching assistants across years up to Year 4, fostering a collaborative, supportive, and high-performing staff team.
Direct operational delivery and coordination of the Mountain School programme up to Year 4, working closely with the Head of Junior Expeditions and the Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics.
To be the primary point of contact for day-to-day academic, pastoral, and operational matters for families and day students up to Year 4.
To uphold the ethos and values of the school and to be a role model for staff and students.
Become involved in discipline and pastoral matters up to Year 4, ensuring student behavior aligns with school expectations.
To ensure smooth transition and induction for children entering Year 1 and progressing through to Year 4, preparing them seamlessly for upper junior years (Years 5-6).
To ensure the Guiding Principles are embedded throughout the daily routine and learning environment of students up to Year 4.
To participate in staff recruitment for lower junior phase positions as required by the Director of Junior School and Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics.
To carry out tasks as delegated by the Director of Junior School and Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics.
To be a classroom teacher with a reduced teaching load (approx 20% reduction).
To embrace innovative forms of assessment, play-based learning, and holistic reporting for young learners.

Responsibility for the Wellbeing and Safeguarding of Students

To oversee the daily pastoral care, wellbeing, and progress tracking of all students up to Year 4.
To appreciate the key role of safeguarding in managing student interventions and work closely with the Junior School DSL, Director of Junior School, and wellbeing team.
To work with the Director of Junior School, Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics and Junior School DSL in the implementation of policies and statements of good practice for safeguarding, wellbeing, and healthcare in lower primary.
To implement a nurturing and sequential Wellbeing programme across years up to Year 4 aligned with the Spirit Curriculum.
To promote Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion formally within the Spirit Curriculum to build a kind, positive, and inclusive culture among young learners.
To liaise with the Junior Activities Coordinator and House teams to ensure appropriate co-curricular activities, sports, and outdoor experiences for students up to Year 4.

Academic Responsibilities

To lead the daily implementation and delivery of the lower junior curriculum (up to Year 4), including the 'Wonder' projects and early literacy/numeracy frameworks.
To work closely with the Head of Junior Expeditions to plan and deliver the experiential Mountain School curriculum for students up to Year 4.
To champion sustainability, outdoor exploration, and biophilic education within the classroom and Mountain School activities.
To ensure Aiglon's Guiding Principles for learning are embedded in all teaching and learning activities for students up to Year 4.
To assist in monitoring student progress, organising learning interventions, and supporting personalised learning in coordination with the Head of Learning Support and Head of EAL.
To support the Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics in teacher professional reviews and development for staff who teach up to Year 4.
To assist in overseeing internal assessments, reporting structures, and parent-teacher communication up to Year 4.
To promote and ensure effective and safe usage of school educational technology (such as Google Apps for Education and age-appropriate devices).
To participate in staff development days and continuous professional learning for the lower primary phase.
To monitor and enhance standards of teaching, learning, and classroom environment up to Year 4.
Undertake any other task which may be reasonably required by the Director of the Junior School or Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics.
Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people.
Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times.
Embrace artificial intelligence and other related educational innovations to enhance early learning experiences.

This job outline only contains the main accountabilities relating to the post of Head of Years (Up to Year 4) and does not describe in detail all of the duties required to carry them out. The Head of Years (Up to Year 4) may be required to undertake other duties and responsibilities that are commensurate with the nature and level of the post.

Software Compliance Engineer (m/w/d)
====================================











Software prägt die Produkte von morgen. Mit deinem Know\-how in Cybersecurity, regulatorischer Compliance, Safety und Qualität stellst du sicher, dass unsere Softwarelösungen weltweit den höchsten Anforderungen entsprechen. Als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Entwicklung, Product Management und Quality Management begleitest du Produkte über ihren gesamten Lebenszyklus und leistest einen entscheidenden Beitrag zu sicheren, zuverlässigen, gesetzeskonformen und marktfähigen Lösungen.







Über uns
=========



Bei Hexagon sind wir weltweit führend im Bereich Messtechnologien. Unsere Lösungen für Präzisionsmessung, Positionierung und Autonomie verändern einige der wichtigsten Branchen der Welt \- und schaffen die Verlässlichkeit, auf die unsere Kunden beim , Navigieren und Innovieren vertrauen.



Von Mikrometern bis zum Mars steigern wir Produktivität, Qualität, Sicherheit und Nachhaltigkeit dort, wo es am meisten darauf ankommt. Wir helfen Unternehmen, intelligenter zu arbeiten, Risiken zu reduzieren und neue Effizienzniveaus zu erreichen.



Mit Blick nach vorn begleiten wir unsere Kunden auf dem Weg zu echter Autonomie und unterstützen sie dabei, Herausforderungen wie Nachhaltigkeit und demografischen Wandel mit Zuversicht zu begegnen.



Mit rund 16\.000 Mitarbeitenden in 50 Ländern vereint Hexagon globale Präsenz, Expertise und Innovationskraft, um in einigen der wichtigsten Branchen der Welt nachhaltig etwas zu bewegen.



Erfahre mehr unter .



Software Compliance Engineer (m/w/d)
====================================



Das spricht dich an
===================







* Mitarbeit in Innovationsprojekten zur Sicherstellung der Software\-Compliance.  
* Definition und Pflege von Software\-Compliance\- und Qualitätsanforderungen.  
* Moderation von und Mitarbeit bei Cybersecurity\-Risikoanalysen.  
* Betreuung regulatorischer Anforderungen wie Cyber Resilience Act (CRA), NIS2, EU Data Act im Projekt.  
* Koordination von Software\-Zertifizierungen und Compliance\-Nachweisen.  
* Durchführung von Schulungen und Awareness\-Massnahmen.  



Das macht dich aus
==================







* Bachelor oder Master in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Quality Management mit Software\-Bezug oder einem verwandten Gebiet.  
* Nachgewiesene Projekterfahrung, ausgeprägte organisatorische Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, mehrere Prioritäten parallel zu steuern.  
* Grundverständnis von Softwareentwicklungsprozessen, inklusive agiler Methoden.  
* Technisches Verständnis regulierter Umgebungen und relevanter Compliance\-Standards.  
* Analytische Denkweise mit der Fähigkeit, rechtliche und regulatorische Dokumente zu interpretieren und anzuwenden.  
* Ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Fähigkeit zur Koordination unterschiedlicher Stakeholder\-Gruppen.  
* Sehr gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse.  



Was dich erwartet

jobs.title: Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics  (Up to Year 8)
jobs.description:
JOB PURPOSE
Aiglon College is an international boarding school based in the Swiss Alps with a worldwide reputation for providing a challenging and transformational holistic education in an inspiring setting within a safe, caring and supportive framework.  The School is CIS accredited, and caters for 500 students aged 5-18 representing 65 nations.  In their final years students prepare for Cambridge IGCSEs and the IB Diploma Programme but our distinct learning philosophy begins to become embedded from our youngest students. The Junior School is a connected part of the whole school but is also a distinct section separate from the Senior School with a dedicated focus on students up to Year 8.

The school wishes to appoint, for August 2027 (possibly January or April 2027 for the right candidate), an innovative and dynamic Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics (Up to Year 8) who will take a whole school role in leading the educational provision of the Junior School and the inspirational ‘wonder’ curriculum for students up to Years 6 including Mountain School.

The ideal candidate for this position would be an experienced Junior/Prep school specialist with leadership experience, ideally in an international setting, who has expertise in the creation and implementation of junior specific curriculum programmes. A knowledge of project based learning, inquiry based learning or biophilic education would be preferable.

This position involves a teaching component but this is a unique opportunity to introduce, develop and promote a world leading junior curriculum.

KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
To put the students first.
To lead the junior school and the educational provision, deputising for the Director of Junior school when required and being a key member of the Junior School Leadership Team.
To take a lead role in establishing and implementing a vision for world-class education at Aiglon.
To work with the Director of Junior School and to ensure that an Aiglon student’s education is relevant, broad, balanced and effective across all aspects of school life.
To carry out tasks as delegated by the Director of Junior School and Deputy School Director (Academics) to the planning, monitoring and promotion of academic and student welfare matters.
To uphold the ethos and values of the school and to be a role model for staff and students.
To be fully involved in whole school strategic planning, and the implementation and development of the school’s vision for education and wellbeing.
To be a member of the extended Leadership Team, including the Academic Leadership Group.
Be involved in discipline matters and ensure students behave appropriately and in line with the school’s expectations.
To line manage and work in close partnership with the Head of Year (Up to Year 4) (who directly manages the teachers and teaching assistants in these year groups and the Mountain School for those years), maintaining oversight across curriculum implementation, pastoral care, and operational leadership for the lower junior years, as well as line managing Year 5-6 classroom teachers.
To liaise closely with Assistant Heads and Heads of Department in the senior school to ensure that the curriculum for Years 7 and 8 is exciting, dynamic, and of a high standard, effectively preparing students for IGCSE and IB programmes.
To ensure the Guiding Principles are embedded throughout the school, and specifically within the provision for junior school students.
To be actively involved in staff recruitment as required by the School Director and Director of Junior School.
To be a teacher with a reduced teaching load (approx 50%).
To embrace innovative forms of assessment and holistic reporting.

Responsibility for the Wellbeing and Safeguarding of Students

To lead strategic interventions for junior school students and ensure consistent tracking of student progress from an academic point of view.
To appreciate the key role of safeguarding in managing student interventions and work closely with the Director of Junior School and wellbeing team to ensure all students are supported.
To work with the Director of Junior School, Deputy School Director (Pastoral) and Junior School DSL in the implementation of policies and statements of good practice for safeguarding, wellbeing and health care.
To ensure there is a comprehensive Wellbeing curriculum that is sequential through all years up to Year 8 and links with the Years 9-13 programmes.
To work with the Deputy School Director (Pastoral) to help ensure Diversity, Equity and Inclusion are taught formally within the Spirit Curriculum to help promote a positive, kind and inclusive culture at school.
To develop service opportunities for junior students within a structured service programme.
To liaise with the Director of Junior School, Director of Character and Junior Activities Coordinator to help ensure there is a challenging co-curricular programme in place that includes activities, sports and expeditions for the junior school.

Academic Responsibilities

To manage and develop the Junior curriculum (Up to Year 8) at Aiglon.
To work closely with the Head of Junior Expeditions and the Head of Years (Up to Year 4) to plan, deliver, and oversee an experiential Mountain Curriculum spanning up to Year 6.
To champion sustainability, environmental stewardship, and biophilic education within the junior curriculum and Mountain School programme.
To ensure the Guiding Principles for learning are embedded throughout the academic side of the school as a member of the Academic Leadership Group (ALG)
To take the lead on overseeing junior cohorts and courses. Working with the Deputy School Director (Academics) to ensure standards and criteria for these courses are met and supporting the associated year groups.
To structure and organise the system of interventions associated with student data and, when appropriate, be involved in those interventions. To assist in overseeing the general provision for personalised learning.
To work with the Deputy School Director (Academics) in the preparation and implementation of policies and statements of good practice for the academic curriculum.
To work with the Deputy School Director (Academics) in the management of the teacher professional review and development process.
Together with the Deputy School Director (Academics), to oversee assessment in the school including internally set examinations and to be responsible for the school reporting and assessment structure and to monitor its delivery.
To work with the Head of Learning support and Head of EAL to ensure all learners are supported in making progress.
To analyse and disseminate data from year group CEM examinations and to oversee target setting and the administration of other measures of value-added and academic performance.
To promote and ensure effective usage of school systems such as Google Apps for Education.
Oversee staff development days across the school year in conjunction with the Director of Junior School and Deputy School Director (Academics).
To be involved in monitoring and enhancing the standards of teaching and learning throughout the school.
Undertake any other task which may be reasonably required by the School Director and Director of Junior School.
Understand and implement all school policies and procedures, particularly those relating to safeguarding children and young people.
Understand the School’s Guiding Principles and uphold the ethos of the School at all times.
Embrace artificial intelligence and other related innovations in order to work towards the creation of the classroom of tomorrow.

This job outline only contains the main accountabilities relating to the post of Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics (Up to Year 8) and does not describe in detail all of the duties required to carry them out. The Head of Junior Curriculum and Academics (Up to Year 8) may be required to undertake other duties and responsibilities that are commensurate with the nature and level of the post.

jobs.description:

Chief of Staff (a) (80\-100%)
=============================




**Technology \& Leadership – dafür steht Consult \& Pepper. Als spezialisierte Personalberatung besetzen wir seit über 25 Jahren anspruchsvolle Fach\- und Führungspositionen. Dabei arbeiten wir branchenagnostisch mit Start\-Ups, KMUs und internationalen Grosskonzernen zusammen.**

**Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt von einem familiären Miteinander, offener und manchmal etwas sehr direkter Kommunikation sowie einem starken Teamgeist. Kollegiale Unterstützung, kurze Entscheidungswege und gemeinsame Events sorgen dafür, dass Arbeit bei uns nicht nur erfolgreich, sondern auch menschlich ist.**

**Zur Unterstützung unserer beiden Co\-CEOs suchen wir ein neugieriges, lernfähiges und umsetzungsstarkes Organisationstalent mit hoher Technologieaffinität als « Chief of Staff».**




**Deine Herausforderung**

Du stehst kurz vor deinem Studienabschluss oder hast diesen gerade hinter dir – und suchst keinen klassischen Einstiegsjob? Du möchtest nicht in einem Traineeprogramm eine Station von vielen durchlaufen, sondern direkt erleben, wie ein Unternehmen geführt wird?  
In dieser vielseitigen Stabsrolle erhältst du Einblick in nahezu alle Bereiche eines KMUs, unterstützt die Geschäftsleitung im operativen Tagesgeschäft und übernimmst zunehmend eigene Projekte und Verantwortungsbereiche.

Deine Aufgabenschwerpunkte sehen wie folgt aus – wobei sich deine im Laufe der Zeit verändern und weiterentwickeln wird.

* **Management Support \& Business Operations (\~40%)**
    + Du unterstützt unsere beiden Co\-CEOs im operativen Tagesgeschäft und hältst ihnen bei administrativen und organisatorischen Aufgaben den Rücken frei
    + Du bereitest Präsentationen, Auswertungen, Controllings und Entscheidungsgrundlagen auf
    + Du koordinierst zentrale interne Abläufe und entwickelst bestehende Instrumente und Prozesse weiter
    + Du bist Anlaufstelle für unsere Mitarbeitenden bei organisatorischen und administrativen Fragestellungen
* **Provider Management \& Infrastruktur (\~15%)**
    + Du koordinierst schrittweise unsere externen Partner und Dienstleister, insbesondere in den Bereichen IT, LinkedIn und Jobplattformen
    + Du verwaltest zentrale Firmenaccounts, Lizenzen und Verträge und behältst Kosten, Laufzeiten und Leistungen im Blick
    + Du stellst gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern sicher, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden über eine funktionierende und zeitgemässe Arbeitsumgebung verfügen
* **Marketing \& Kommunikation (\~20%)**
    + Du gestaltest unseren Unternehmensauftritt auf LinkedIn sowie weitere zentrale Kommunikationskanäle mit
    + Du verantwortest unser Newslettering und unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Website
    + Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Marketing\- und Kundenaktivitäten
* **Digitalisierung, AI \& Projekte (\~25%)**
    + Du treibst Projekte in den Bereichen AI, Digitalisierung und Business Development voran
    + Du beobachtest technologische Entwicklungen und prüfst, wie neue Tools und AI\-Anwendungen bei C\&P sinnvoll eingesetzt werden können
    + Du unterstützt die Co\-CEOs bei konzeptionellen und strategischen Projekten und bringst diese in die Umsetzung



**Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen**

* Du hast dein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik oder BWL (Uni/FH) abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz davor
* Du besitzt relevante Praxiserfahrung, die du während oder nach deinem Studium \- z.B. via Praktika, Teilzeittätigkeit oder im Rahmen einer Festanstellung \- sammeln durftest
* Du hast eine ausgeprägte Affinität für Technologie, Digitalisierung und AI und freust dich daran, neue Tools auszuprobieren. Dabei denkst du realistisch und weisst, dass wir keine Luftschlösser bauen und dass der konkrete Nutzen gegeben sein muss
* Du wendest die Microsoft 365 Tools gut und gerne an \- insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel
* Du magst Zahlen, bist zuverlässig und gehst die Dinge strukturiert an
* Du bist ein Organisationstalent oder willst und kannst eines werden. So oder so hast du eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und die Fähigkeit, dich rasch in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.
* Du willst, dass deine Marketingaktivitäten Wirkung im Ziel haben. Das Look \& Feel ist dir dabei aber nicht egal.
* Du bist keine Diva und dir nicht zu schade, dir auch mal die schmutzig zu machen und in einem KMU Aufgaben zu erledigen, die eigentlich nicht in deinem Stellenbeschrieb stehen
* Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse
* Du bist so humorvoll, dass du zuweilen auch mal über dich selber lachen kannst



**Wir suchen kein fertiges Profil. Wir suchen jemanden am Anfang seiner oder ihrer Karriere, dem wir zutrauen, sehr schnell zu lernen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit den beiden Eigentümern und Co\-CEOs von Consult \& Pepper zusammen und erlebst aus nächster Nähe, wie ein KMU geführt und weiterentwickelt wird.**  
**Du wirst dabei nicht nur an konzeptionellen und strategischen Themen arbeiten. Zu einem KMU gehören genauso administrative Aufgaben und ganz pragmatische Probleme, die gelöst werden müssen. Genau diese Mischung macht die aus.**

**Möchtest du Unternehmertum nicht nur aus dem Studium kennen, sondern im Alltag erleben und mitgestalten?**

Dann freuen sich  **und Saia** über deine Bewerbungsunterlagen oder deinen Anruf (\+ ).



![Consult & Pepper AG]( )

* Consult \& Pepper AG  
Löwenstrasse 9  
6004 Luzern

jobs.title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Akutpsychiatrie 80-100% für die Region Laufenburg gesucht
jobs.description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Laufenburg suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Akutpsychiatrie.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Laufenburg: das Wichtigste in Kürze

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Akutpsychiatrie

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Laufenburg

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Laufenburg liegt im Norden des Kantons Aargau direkt an der Grenze zu Deutschland und besticht durch seine malerische Lage am Rhein. Sie profitieren von einer ausgezeichneten Verkehrsanbindung mit direktem Bahnzugang und guter Autoanbindung via Autobahn. Die Region bietet Ihnen ein attraktives Arbeitsumfeld mit einer Mischung aus Industrie, Mittelstand und Dienstleistungen, kombiniert mit hoher Lebensqualität und guten Freizeitmöglichkeiten.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutpsychiatrie in Laufenburg aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Akutpsychiatrie

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutpsychiatrie in Laufenburg verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für Diplommierte Pflegefachpersonen in der Psychiatrie ist in der Region Laufenburg äusserst angespannt, und spezialisierte Fachkräfte sind stark begehrt. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Chancen auf eine schnelle Anstellung mit attraktiven Arbeitsbedingungen, da Kliniken und psychiatrische Institutionen permanent qualifiziertes Personal suchen. iPersonal as erfahrener Vermittler kennt die lokalen Anforderungen und Arbeitgeber im Kanton Aargau und erleichtert Ihnen den Einstieg durch massgeschneiderte Stellenangebote, umfassende Begleitung und direkten Kontakt zu renommierten Einrichtungen in Ihrer gewünschten Region.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Laufenburg

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind
- Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutpsychiatrie in Laufenburg

jobs.title: Global Commercial Lead, Dravet
jobs.description:
Job Description

About This Role: As the Global Commercial Lead Dravet, you will be at the forefront of our global commercialization strategy. You will be responsible for leading the Global Marketing team, driving the development of campaigns, messages, omni-channel content, and marketing tactics. Your immediate focus will be to optimize short-term brand plans for revenue maximization, ensuring support for hitting annual revenue targets. In this dynamic role, you will also provide critical commercial insights for long-term strategic decisions, including lifecycle management. By owning the target product profile throughout the lifecycle, you'll ensure asset value maximization through launch and beyond. Partnering with regional teams and G10 affiliates will be crucial to forecasting and identifying business opportunities. You will also lead external stakeholder engagement and contribute to franchise strategy, driving cross-functional alignment and operating within a Product Development & Commercialization model.


What You’ll Do:
- Develop and lead global commercialization strategies to maximize revenue across key markets.
- Own and implement short-term brand plans with a focus on immediate revenue targets.
- Lead the Global Marketing team in developing campaigns, messages, and omni-channel content.
- Provide commercial input into long-term strategic decisions, such as lifecycle management and indication expansion.
- Maintain ownership of the target product profile throughout its lifecycle.
- Support asset value maximization through launch and lifecycle management.
- Drive product development strategies for pipeline indications and disease expansion.
- Partner with regional teams and G10 affiliates to forecast and identify business opportunities.
- Lead competitive intelligence and market leadership efforts.
- Engage with external stakeholders, including clinicians, policy stakeholders, and advocacy groups.
- Plan and execute launch readiness and execution where relevant.
- Drive cross-functional alignment and lead teams in a matrix environment.
- Operate within a Product Development & Commercialization model.

Who You Are: You are an accomplished leader with a strategic mindset and a passion for driving commercial success. You excel in developing and executing complex strategies that span both short-term and long-term objectives. Your ability to collaborate across functions and influence without direct authority allows you to lead effectively in a matrix environment. You thrive in dynamic settings and are skilled at engaging external stakeholders to maximize asset value. Your experience in global markets, particularly in rare, neuro, and immuno areas, equips you to drive innovation and revenue growth.


Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree required (in a relevant field such as business, life sciences, or related discipline).
- Advanced degree preferred (e.g., MBA, MSc, PhD)

Required Skills:
- At least 15 years of experience in pharma/biotech.
- Proven experience in biotech product launch.
- Direct affiliate in-market experience.
- P&L experience strongly preferred.
- Area experience in rare, neuro, or immuno sectors.
- 5 years of ex-US experience strongly preferred.
- Strong leadership in cross-functional alignment and matrix environments.
- Expertise in external stakeholder engagement and competitive intelligence.

* Examiner la jurisprudence des juridictions de première et de deuxième instance relative aux procédures et à l'évaluation de l'invalidité, rédiger des mémoires juridiques

* Expérience confirmée de plusieurs années dans des fonctions dirigeantes et aptitude à la collaboration interdisciplinaire
* Sens de l'engagement, capacité à travailler de manière autonome, maîtrise d'une langue officielle et capacité à communiquer couramment dans une deuxième
* Très bonnes connaissances des assurances sociales, en particulier de l'AI
* Sensibilité politique et aptitude à la négociation
* Excellentes compétences relationnelles, capacité à s'imposer, esprit d'initiative et souplesse


  **En quelques mots**



En tant que responsable du secteur Procédures et rentes, vous gérez les relations avec les organes d'exécution externes et les fournisseurs de prestations du système de l'AI. Vous êtes l'interlocuteur des offices AI et du SMR pour tout ce qui concerne les rentes et les procédures au sein de l'AI.



  **Ce que nous offrons**







*  **Travailler pour la Suisse** Nous nous engageons pour le succès du modèle suisse et pour le bien\-être de la population.
*  **La diversité au quotidien** Nous veillons à l'égalité des chances, qui nous permet de déployer nos compétences et d'exprimer des points de vue différents.
*  **Santé au travail** Nous assistons et conseillons nos collaboratrices et collaborateurs pour toutes les questions liées à la santé physique ou psychique.

jobs.description:
Ref 2578337 \| Date: 11 Sept 2026

![Novelis Switzerland SA]( )



Novelis est animé par la volonté de façonner ensemble un monde durable.



En tant que leader mondial de produits et services innovants et le plus grand recycleur d'aluminium au monde d'aluminium, nous travaillons en partenariat avec des clients des secteurs de l'automobile, de l’aéronautique, des canettes et des spécialités pour fournir des solutions qui améliorent les avantages de l'aluminium léger.



Nous disposons d'un réseau coordonné d'opérations de laminage et de recyclage techniquement sophistiquées sur 29 sites dans 9 pays d'Amérique du Nord, d'Amérique du Sud, d'Europe et d'Asie, avec 12,750 employés dans le monde. Le siège se situe à Atlanta, aux États\-Unis.  



Nous comptons parmi nos clients certaines des marques les plus importantes et les plus connues au monde, notamment Coca\-Cola, BMW, Jaguar Land Rover, Airbus, Boeing, Nespresso, Samsung, et d'autres. En outre, Novelis est à la pointe de l'industrie grâce à ses efforts en matière de durabilité et de recyclage.



Participez à notre mission de créer un monde durable et commencez dès que possible à travailler sur notre site de **Sierre**, en Suisse.

**Metallurgy Modeling Scientist (m/f/d)**



Nous recherchons actuellement un ingénieur ou un chercheur hautement motivé et qualifié dans les domaines de l'ingénierie computationnelle, de la science des matériaux, de la métallurgie ou du génie mécanique pour rejoindre notre équipe sur notre site de Sierre, en Suisse.



Le développement et la production futurs d'alliages d'aluminium recyclés de haute qualité nécessitent des processus rapides et adaptatifs qui relient en temps réel le processus de fabrication et la métallurgie, ainsi qu'une prévision précise des performances.







**Vos responsabilités:**



Vous ferez partie de l’équipe chargée de poursuivre le développement de cadres de modélisation avancés en R\&D pouvant être appliqués à différentes activités à l’échelle mondiale. Cela comprend les responsabilités suivantes :



* Développer un cadre d’ingénierie computationnelle intégrée des matériaux (ICME), combinant des modèles basés sur la physique, des approches fondées sur les données et des outils numériques pour des applications à l’échelle industrielle.
* Traduire les connaissances relatives aux alliages d’aluminium, à la métallurgie, au laminage et aux procédés de finition en modèles prédictifs de microstructure et de performance permettant le développement virtuel de procédés et de produits.
* Collaborer avec les sites de production afin de garantir une adoption réussie et la concrétisation de la valeur ajoutée pour l’entreprise.


Merci de postuler avant le 2 octobre 2026\.



\-\-\-\-\-



We are currently seeking a highly motivated and skilled engineer or scientist in the field of Computational Engineering, Materials Science, Metallurgy, or Mechanical Engineering to join our team at our Sierre location in Switzerland.



The future development and production of high\-quality recycled aluminium alloys require fast and adaptive processes that link process and metallurgy in real time, along with precise performance prediction.







**Your responsabilities:**



You will be part of the team to further develop advanced modelling frameworks in R\&D



that can be applied across different operations globally. This includes the following



responsibilities:



* Develop an Integrated Computational Materials Engineering (ICME) framework, combining physics\-based models, data\-driven approaches, and digital tools for industrial\-scale applications.
* Translate aluminium alloy, metallurgy, rolling and finishing process knowledge into predictive microstructure and performance models that enable virtual process and product development.
* Collaborate with manufacturing sites, ensuring successful adoption and business value realization.


**How to convince us:**



* Master's degree in Materials Science, Metallurgy, Computational Engineering, or a related field; PhD preferred.
* Strong expertise in physical metallurgy, with deep knowledge of texture evolution, recrystallization and precipitation phenomena
* Experience with computational materials engineering approaches and modelling tools such as VPSC, DAMASK, CP\-FEM
* Proficiency in scientific programming and data analysis ( Python, MATLAB or similar).
* Ability to bridge the gap between advanced materials science and industrial application by communicating complex technical concepts clearly across all organizational levels.
* Fluent in English; French is an advantage.
* Demonstrated innovation mindset, curiosity and passion for continuous learning, with a self\-driven, highly autonomous and result\-oriented working style.






Please apply before 2nd October, 2026\.

Sens des responsabilités et faire preuve de dynamisme, rigueur, anticipation, précision, autonomie et loyauté  
Compétences scientifiques, techniques et humaines permettant de travailler dans une équipe pluridisciplinaire  
Pourquoi choisir la Clinique de La Source ?  
Rejoindre la plus grande Clinique privée du canton de Vaud et évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, reconnu pour son expertise et son savoir\-faire

Bénéficier de conditions d'engagement attractives et de prestations sociales avantageuses (accueil et intégration, participation LaMal, LPP avantageuse, rabais, etc.)  
Concilier vie professionnelle et vie privée, grâce à des possibilités de travail à temps partiel, jusqu'à plus de 7 semaines de vacances, des congés non payés, des jours fériés compensés et la valorisation du temps de change

jobs.title: Montør med hænderne skruet rigtigt på søges til Sjælland
jobs.description:
Er du praktisk anlagt, har hænderne skruet rigtigt på og lyst til at lære noget nyt? Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Vi søger en dygtig og ansvarsbevidst montør til en spændende virksomhed på Sjælland med opstart den 1. november 2026.

Du behøver ikke være uddannet glarmester eller tømrer. Det vigtigste er, at du har god praktisk sans, teknisk forståelse og trives med at arbejde med hænderne.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Du kommer til at arbejde med forskellige montageopgaver hos både private kunder og på nybyggerier rundt omkring på Sjælland.

Dine opgaver vil bl.a. omfatte:

  • Opmåling og montering af bruseglas og andre glasløsninger

  • Montering af New Yorker-vægge, spejle og badeværelsestilbehør

  • Opmåling, tilskæring og montering af aluminiumsprofiler

  • Selvstændig udførelse af montageopgaver hos kunder

Du vil i den første periode køre sammen med en erfaren kollega, som sørger for grundig oplæring, så du bliver godt klædt på til opgaverne.


Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har hænderne skruet rigtigt på og god praktisk forståelse

  • Arbejder omhyggeligt og har øje for detaljen

  • Er selvstændig, mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Har lyst til at lære og udvikle dine færdigheder

  • Har almindeligt kørekort (kategori B)

  • Gerne bor centralt på Sjælland, da arbejdet foregår forskellige steder på øen

Erfaring med montage, håndværk eller lignende er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og alsidig hverdag med varierende arbejdsopgaver

  • Grundig oplæring af en erfaren kollega

  • En startløn på 200–210 kr. i timen afhængigt af kvalifikationer

  • Opstart den 1. november 2026

  • Et Try & Hire-forløb med henblik på fastansættelse hos virksomheden

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig!

Send dit CV til os hurtigst muligt. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.description:
Toimintamme laajentuessa erikoispaperitehtaallamme Tervakoskella, haemme kokeneita prosessiteollisuuden osaajia. Käynnistämme syksyllä 2027 uuden tuotantolinjan, jossa tullaan valmistamaan sähköeristemateriaaleja (mm. puristekuitulevyjä). Investointi on merkittävä askel Tervakoski Oy:n kasvulle, ja tarjoaa nyt ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden olla mukana rakentamassa uutta tuotantolinjaa alusta lähtien.

Haemme ensimmäisessä hakuvaiheessa osaajia sekä uudelle tuotantolinjalle että sen myötä sisäisesti vapautuviin tuotannon tehtäviin nykyisille paperikoneille. Uudelle tuotantolinjalle sijoittuvat henkilöt osallistuvat tuotantolinjan käyttöönottoon, testaukseen ja prosessien kehittämiseen ennen varsinaisen tuotannon käynnistymistä, toimien mahdollisesti samalla myös tuotantomme muissa työtehtävissä.

Työ uudella tuotantolinjalla tulee käynnistysvaiheen jälkeen olemaan vuorotyötä. Erityisesti käynnistysvaiheessa työ voi sisältää myös muita työaikajärjestelyjä, jonka vuoksi arvostamme joustavuutta. Paperikoneille sijoittuvat henkilöt tulevat työskentelemään työaikamuodossa TAM37 12 h.



Odotamme sinulta:

- Tehtävään soveltuvaa prosessiteollisuuden ammatti-, erikoisammatti- tai AMK-tutkintoa
- Kokemusta paperi- tai kartonkituotannosta
- Ideanikkarimaista ongelmaratkaisijaluonnetta
- Kehitysmyönteisyyttä, joustavuutta sekä valmiutta toimia muuttuvassa ympäristössä
- Aitoa kiinnostusta uuden oppimiseen ja tuotannon kehittämiseen
- Sitoutunutta, motivoitunutta ja innovatiivista asennetta
- Hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja



Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Vakituisen työsuhteen kansainvälisessä toimintaympäristössä
- Monipuolisia työtehtäviä alan johtavassa yrityksessä
- Mahdollisuuden itsesi ja työympäristösi kehittämiseen
- Osaavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön
- Työskentelyn taloudellisesti vakaassa kasvavassa yrityksessä.



Arvostamme aiempaa kokemusta tuotantolinjan käynnistämisestä ja siihen liittyvässä projektityössä mukana toimimisesta. Katsomme eduksi myös hyvän suomen ja englannin kielen taidon.

jobs.title: Storsjarmør trenger din hjelp!
jobs.description:
Storsjarmør trenger flere gode hjelper i hverdagen

Jeg er en gutt på 6 år som bor sammen med mamma og min storebror. Jeg har flere diagnoser, men det som du bør vite spesielt om er epilepsien min. Jeg er multisyk og lungesyk/hjertesyk. Jeg kan bevege meg, men trenger assistanse til alt av forflytning og personlig hygiene. Medisinske apparatet som vi sammen må bli venner med er bi-pap (pustemaskin) og forstøver som er i daglig bruk. Trenger bistand til forflytning og mobilisering, stimulering, og noen flere bestevenner på laget. Jeg har også CVK, PEG, og er på matpumpe hele døgnet.

Pusten min kan skremme oss, og noen ganger snur tilværelsen svært fort og du som skal bli min venn: må ha tæl til og stå i dette sammen med meg! ALT dette får du opplæring til!

Jeg elsker alt i fra å sitte på fanget og få kos, til å ligge på gulvet og leke. Her kan jeg leke med heisekranen og klosser. Selv om jeg har en fysisk funksjonsnedsettelse skjønner jeg alt det som foregår rundt meg og jeg klarer å kommunisere det jeg ønsker - mye med tegn til tale.

Livet mitt kan snu på sekunder, slik at det er viktig at du kan tørre å stå sammen med meg uansett hvor jeg er. Sykehuset er i perioder mitt andre hjem.

Dine arbeidsoppgaver blir

  • overvåke meg på natt og endre stilling
  • leke med meg på dagtid
  • utføre personlig hygiene
  • være avlaster for mamma
  • lage sondemat
  • ellers være der jeg er og sikre at jeg er trygg

Du må være

  • Fleksibel
  • glad i å være med barn
  • tålmodig
  • ikke redd for å ta i et tak
  • ha førerkort
  • ha plettfri vandel

Hva kan Prima Assistanse tilby:

  • Egen kontaktperson i Prima Assistanse
  • En meningsfull jobb hvor du kan gjøre en forskjell
  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver hvor ingen dag er helt lik
  • Ansattfordeler
  • Kurs gjennom Prima Assistanse
  • Lønn og andre vilkår ihht. Landsoverenskomsten for BPA


Erfaring med PEG, CVK og metningsmåler er en fordel, men ikke noe krav. Du vil få opplæring i det du trenger, men du må være tøff nok til å tørre dette.

God kjemi mellom deg og meg er alfa omega for at vårt samarbeid skal fungere godt.

Vi har nå behov for flere å spille på. Arbeidstiden blir i hovedsak natt. Selv om dette i hovedsak er tilkalling, kan det bli mulighet for mer fast og mulighet for å kunne jobbe mye i perioder.

Mamma vil være arbeidsleder og Prima Assistanse arbeidsgiver.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

jobs.title: Einherjar søker iskriger!
jobs.description:
Er du klar for en variert, spennende og meningsfull deltidsjobb? Jeg er en aktiv mann på 30 år som ser etter min neste «viking» – en pålitelig, engasjert og god BPA-assistent som vil være med å holde hverdagen i full gang.

Jeg bor i Elverum sammen med samboeren min og vår firbente venn (hund). MS gir meg utfordringer med syn og balanse, så jeg bruker rullestol til daglig, selv om jeg går litt selv også. Likevel stopper ikke det meg fra å leve et aktivt liv: jeg spiller ishockey og håndball, brenner for politikk og er engasjert i foreningsliv.

Nå trenger jeg deg som kan være mine ekstra øyne, hender og støtte i forbindelse med ishockey-treninger på Hamar.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

Arbeidsoppgavene vil kunne variere med hverdagen min, men det jeg søker nå er:

  • Kjøre bil.
  • Hjelpe med organisering og tilrettelegging i forbindelse med ishockey.
  • Praktisk bistand i min hverdag, både hjemme og utenfor hjemmet.
  • Assistanse til husdyrhold.
  • Bistand ved deltakelse på idrettsaktiviteter, møter og arrangementer.
  • Lese og fylle ut skjemaer.
  • Handle mat og tilberede mat.

Arbeidstid

Stillingen er i utgangspunktet på ca. 9 timer i uken/25%, primært fordelt på:

·       Onsdag ettermiddag

·       Søndag ettermiddag/kveld

Siden jeg har et aktivt liv, kan det også bli muligheter for ekstravakter ved arrangementer eller turer.

Oppstart så snart som mulig.

Hvem er du?

Du trenger ingen spesiell fagbakgrunn – personlig egnethet og god kjemi betyr alt.

Du må derimot ha førerkort klasse B og være over 25 år grunnet forsikringer.

Jeg tror du vil trives godt om du:

  • Liker ishockey og idrett
  • Er praktisk anlagt, selvgående og initiativrik.
  • Er glad i hunder og glad i å være i aktivitet.
  • Har god humor, står støtt i hverdagen og er pålitelig.
  • Sterk i kroppen – for å kunne bistå meg i forflytning.
  • Fleksibel

Hva tilbyr jeg?

  • En uformell, trivelig og fartsfylt arbeidsplass.
  • Varierte arbeidsdager der ingen uke er helt lik.
  • Ordnet arbeidsforhold, opplæring og lønn etter gjeldende avtaler.
  • Egen kontakperson i Prima Assistanse
  • Kurs gjennom Prima Assistanse
  • Lønn og andre vilkår ihht Landsoverenskomsten for BPA

Jeg er arbeidsleder og Prima Assistanse vil være arbeidsgiver.

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Send en kort søknad og CV der du forteller litt om deg selv, så tar vi en kaffeprat! Kun aktuelle kandidater blir kalt inn til intervju.

jobs.title: Tenure-track position in Archaeology
jobs.description:
About the position 

A tenure-track position (tenure-track in a postdoctoral position and tenured as associate professor) in Archaeology is available at The Department of Archaeology, Conservation and History (IAKH), University of Oslo. IAKH comprises the three disciplinary fields of archaeology conservation and history. The archaeology section has nine academic faculty positions, each with teaching and research components. The section’s research profile and teaching program are internationally oriented and span archaeologies of the Stone Age to the present. The announced position is focused on GIS, statistics and Mesolithic archaeology in Scandinavia.

The announced tenure-track position starts as a full-time postdoctoral position (SKO 1352) for a period of six years, including a 25 % component devoted to teaching and administrative duties. These duties include obtaining basic pedagogical qualifications. A formal midterm evaluation will be held in the fourth year of this period, and the candidate will receive feedback on performance relative to the requirements for the six-year tenure-track period. Toward the end of the six-year period, the candidate will be evaluated for a tenured position as associate professor (SKO 1011). During the final assessment, the candidate’s research performance will first be assessed by an expert (adjudication) committee within the candidate’s subject area. Subsequently, the candidate will be interviewed by an internal interview committee assessing the full range of criteria in the contract of employment.


More about the position 

Applicants apply with a research project including GIS, statistics and the Mesolithic in Scandinavia to be carried out in the initial six years period. In the application letter, candidates should also describe long term plans for building an international research group, for future development of the teaching in Stone Age Archaeology, for contributing to the public dissemination of research, and for developing their own academic career. 

The contract of employment will specify results, requirements, and criteria regarding academic production, public dissemination, research leadership and teaching that the candidate must fulfil during the six-years period to be favourably evaluated for a tenured position. According to the Regulations on appointments to tenure-track positions, with supplementary provisions for UiO, the contract of employment will also specify the criteria for the midterm and final assessment of competencies and milestones. Candidates will also be evaluated on personal suitability and ability to contribute to academic citizenship, both during the initial hiring process and during the mid-term and final evaluations. The contract of employment will further outline the Department’s obligations in supporting the candidate’s research as well as offering academic mentorship, guidance and training. 

Make sure to follow the description of required results necessary in order to be eligible for the tenured position as associate professor.


Requirements 
  • PhD or equivalent academic qualifications within archaeology of the Mesolithic in Scandinavia, with a clear profile in GIS and statistical analysis, granted within the past five years (excluding documented parental and sickness leaves) 
  • Thorough knowledge of the material culture of the Mesolithic in Scandinavia 
  • Demonstrated ability to handle large datasets, geographical information systems and theoretical perspectives on archaeological methodology/practice 
  • Experience in handling of archaeological data using high-end digital tools for quantitative and/or qualitative analysis 
  • Experience with interdisciplinary research approaches within the environmental humanities and/or crossing over to natural sciences 
  • Documented pedagogical skills (either a teaching course certificate or based on teaching experience), see how to document your pedagogical skills 
  • Documented potential for project acquisition 
  • Interest and ability in leadership and administration 
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English and a Scandinavian language 
  • Personal suitability and motivation for the position 

To be eligible, candidates must have submitted for final evaluation or defended their doctoral dissertation within five years preceding the application deadline. In the former case, the appointment will be contingent upon the successful defence of the thesis. Someone who has been employed for more than one year in an ordinary postdoctoral position at the University of Oslo cannot be employed in a postdoctoral position on tenure-track terms.


In the evaluation of the applications, emphasis will be placed on:
  • The research project’s scientific merit and contribution to GIS-based and statistical approaches to the Mesolithic in Scandinavia, including the applicant’s academic and personal ability to carry out the project 
  • The applicant’s long-term plans for building and leading an international research group and successfully join in academic collaboration within and across disciplines, including plans for obtaining external research funding 
  • Academic qualifications and academic production. Originality and quality of publications will be weighted more heavily than quantity 
  • Interest in and motivation for teaching, ability to inspire and provide guidance to students, and potential to teach university-level courses about Stone Age Archaeology and within Archaeology more generally 
  • Interest and ability in leadership and administration, including collaborative skillsExperience with and potential for popular dissemination and public outreach 
  • Academic citizenship, personal suitability and potential to contribute to a positive working environment and the long-term development of teaching and research at the Department 

In the evaluation of the qualified candidates the full range of these criteria will be explicitly addressed and assessed. Academic quality, development, potential and breadth will be prioritised in this order. 

The appointed candidate should demonstrate mastery of both English and one of the Scandinavian languages as working languages.


We can offer you 
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities. 
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Postdoctoral Fellow, position code 1352 in salary range NOK from 595 000 to 677 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

Read more about the benefits of working in the public sector at Employer Portal.


We need different perspectives in our work 

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

We will provide appropriate accommodations should you need them. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.

We hope you will apply for the position with us. 


Application

Your application must include: 

  • Application letter describing the applicant’s qualifications and motivation for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (including list of education, previous and current positions, teaching experience, administrative experience, and other qualifying activities) 
  • List of publications 
  • Project description (3 - 5 pages, maximum 14,000 characters. See Template for project descriptions) 
  • A realistic progress plan for all six years, including activities beyond the postdoctoral research project itself, such as teaching, professional development and project development 
  • Two writing samples (e.g. two chapters from the PhD dissertation or two academic articles) 
  • Copies of educational certificates 

Please note that all documents should be in English (or a Scandinavian language), either in the original or in translation. 

The application with attachments must be delivered in our electronic recruiting system, jobbnorge.no. Applicants with education from non-Norwegian universities must attach an explanation of their grading systems.


Selection procedure

As the first step in the evaluation process, a Selection Committee will assess all applications and invite the most qualified applicants to submit a teaching portfolio and academic works (up to 7 publications) for expert assessment. Academic texts, except for the two writing samples, shall therefore not be enclosed with the initial application. Applicants who are invited to submit academic works are asked to select three works, published within the last 5 years, to be considered as most relevant for the position. In longer publications (monographs), applicants should specify the most relevant pages. Applicants are also asked to submit a teaching portfolio of 3-6 pages documenting educational certificates, competence and experience, including a reflection note in which your own practice and learning vision is anchored in the principles of Scholarship of Teaching and Learning (SoTL). 

Finally, the most highly ranked candidates will be invited for at least one interview and trial lecture. Ranked candidates will be asked to provide a list of 3 reference persons (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and phone number). References are contacted after the interviews.


General information

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The primary method of communication throughout the process will be e-mails and messages through the recruitment system Jobbnorge. When you receive a notification of a message in Jobbnorge, please log in to read it, as it may be important.

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews. 

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian) and Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

The Department of archaeology, conservation and history (IAKH) is comprised of three disciplines which in different ways study the past.The department has internationally oriented archaeologists, the only conservation program in Norway and the biggest group of historians in Scandinavia. The department has close to 100 employees, including non-permanent research fellows. The study programs span archaeology from the Stone Age to the Middle Ages, object and paintings conservation, and history from Antiquity to the present age.

About the Position:
We are looking for Lift Operators for the 2026/2027 winter season. We are recruiting full-time employees.
Throughout the winter, we welcome thousands of enthusiastic skiers to our resort and work hard to ensure they have a great experience. We operate 12 different ski lifts that transport our guests throughout the resort.

As a Lift Operator, you will assist guests in boarding and disembarking from our lifts safely and efficiently. The role includes daily lift inspections, basic maintenance tasks, snow clearing, and the installation and maintenance of safety fencing and signage.

Lift Operators are part of the ski resort's rescue and emergency response team. Applicants should therefore be in good physical condition and comfortable working at heights. Previous experience from other ski resorts is an advantage but not required, as full training will be provided. You should be able to work independently while also being a reliable team player.

Key Responsibilities
.    Daily inspection of ski lifts
.    Daily maintenance and reporting
.    Assisting guests with boarding and disembarking lifts
.    Providing guests with the highest level of service

Qualifications/skills
.    Proficiency in at least one Scandinavian language
.    Must be at least 18 years old and hold a valid Category B driving licence
.    As Lift Operators are part of the ski resort's rescue and emergency response team, applicants should be physically fit and comfortable working at heights
.    Strong customer service skills
.    Willing and eager to learn

What We Offer
.    Competitive salary, free season pass, and attractive staff discounts
.    Assistance with accommodation
.    Close access to mountain activities and outdoor recreation
.    A varied and sometimes fast-paced working environment
.    An exciting workplace that is continuously developing
.    A great team spirit and fantastic colleagues

Rauland Skisenter AS is one of Telemark's largest tourism companies and among the larger ski resorts in Norway. We are dedicated to creating great skiing experiences for the whole family in a snow-reliable mountain destination.

Rauland is located in the municipality of Vinje, an area with a long tradition of tourism and hospitality. Rauland town center offers a wide range of shops, restaurants, and services. Our operations are based at Vierli, Tiur, and Holtardalen.

Our employees are our most valuable resource. During the high season, we employ nearly 100 staff members of all ages and from many different countries. Experience working with SuccessFactors.

    

Experience working with Medvind.

jobs.title: BPA-assistent søkes til min hverdag på gården
jobs.description:
Hei, du! Er du klar for å bli med på et eventyr på en gård? Jeg er en voksen dame som sitter i rullestol, og jeg leter etter en BPA-assistent som kan hjelpe meg med å leve livet mitt fullt ut! Jeg bor på en koselig gård med mannen min, tre ungdommer og to energiske hunder. Her er det alltid liv og røre!

Jeg elsker å strikke, lage mat og tilbringe tid ute, enten i hagen eller på småturer. Jeg trenger en assistent som kan hjelpe meg med litt av hvert, og som har godt humør!

Jeg trenger assistanse til:

  • Praktisk bistand i hjemmet (renhold, matlaging, hage mm.)
  • Ærend ute (handling, legetimer, frisør)
  • Personlig hygiene og forflytning
  • Sosiale aktiviteter og fritid
  • Litt trening og tøying for å holde meg i form
  • Lufteturer med hundene
  • Bistå med kjøring når det trengs
  • Små reiser kan forekomme, men det avtales på forhånd

Jeg ser etter deg som:

  • Er positiv og omsorgsfull
  • Er fleksibel og liker å ha varierte dager
  • Har gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Har førerkort klasse B

Vi tilbyr:

  • Fleksibel stilling som tilkallingsvikar med mulighet for videre vakter/fast ansettelse
  • Vi gir deg grundig opplæring og støtte
  • Lønn etter tariff
  • En meningsfull jobb hvor du virkelig kan gjøre en forskjell!

Jeg vil gjerne høre fra deg. Send oss en kort søknad hvor du forteller litt om hvem du er, hvorfor du ønsker jobben, og når du har mulighet til å jobbe.

Før eventuell ansettelse må det fremlegges politiattest, jf. helse- og omsorgstjenesteloven § 5-4. Attesten skal ikke være eldre enn tre måneder.

Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

jobs.title: Miljøterapeut i barnevernsinstutusjon
jobs.employer: HUMAN CARE UNG AS KONTOR BERGEN
jobs.description:
Vil du være en del av løsningen? Vi søker miljøterapeuter i barnevern

Hver dag gjør våre ansatte en innsats som betyr alt for menneskene vi er her for. I Humana omsorg og assistanse jobber vi etter visjonen om at alle har rett til et godt liv, ja alle. Nå leter vi etter deg som vil være en helt avgjørende del av løsningen for våre ungdommer.

Som en av Norges største private aktører er vi en uunnværlig partner for det offentlige. For å styrke laget vårt i region Vest Bergen, søker vi nå engasjerte kolleger til 100 % faste stilling i medleverturnus. Du vil inngå i en turnusordning på 3-7-4-7, der du bor på avdelingen i tre eller fire døgn og har syv døgn fri mellom hver arbeidsperiode. Avdelingene våre i Askøy og Øygarden er godkjent for målgruppene omsorg og behandling, og det er plass til 3 ungdommer her i aldersgruppen 13-18 år.

Vi søker også etter en nattevakt i en 59,15% stilling, med arbeidstid fra 22-07.

En jobb preget av glede, engasjement og ansvar

Ingen dager er like hos oss. Som miljøterapeut spiller du en nøkkelrolle i det daglige miljøarbeidet og behandlingen av ungdommene våre. Du blir en relasjonsbygger som skaper et hjem preget av forutsigbarhet, trygghet, rammer og kjærlighet. I tillegg vil du delta aktivt i planlegging, evaluering og drøfting av tiltak, samt bidra med nødvendig dokumentasjon og rapportering for å sikre god drift.

Dette er en krevende jobb som ikke passer for alle. Vi ser etter deg som allerede har noen års erfaring fra barnevernsinstitusjon og som utstråler trygghet og ro. Du evner å se ungdommenes behov bak følelsesuttrykkene, og du vet at endringsarbeid krever tålmodighet. Hos oss får du bruke ditt faglige engasjement til å se muligheter der andre ser hindringer.

Hva skal til for å lykkes hos oss?

  • Du har treårig høyskoleutdanning innen helse- og sosialfag, fortrinnsvis som barnevernspedagog, sosionom eller vernepleier.

  • Miljøarbeidere med relevant erfaring vil også kunne vurderes for stillingen.

  • Du har erfaring fra miljøterapeutisk arbeid i barnevernsinstitusjon, spesielt med ungdom som målgruppe og arbeid med utfordrende atferd.

  • Du har gode norskferdigheter, både skriftlig og muntlig.

  • Du har gyldig førerkort klasse B.

  • Du har norsk pass eller gyldig arbeidstillatelse.

  • Du må kunne fremlegge godkjent politiattest i henhold til Barnevernloven § 12-11, jf. politiregisterloven § 39, første ledd (attesten skal ikke legges ved selve søknaden).

Bli en del av et sterkt lag

Når du begynner hos oss, blir du en del av et faglig sterkt miljø med fokus på kontinuerlig kompetanseheving gjennom hyppig opplæring og veiledning. Som en av Norges største private aktører er vi en uunnværlig partner for det offentlige, og vi kombinerer menneskelig nærhet med høy kvalitet.

Vi tilbyr et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med stedlig ledelse, gode muligheter for personlig utvikling og interne karrieremuligheter. Du får også konkurransedyktige lønnsbetingelser, gode medlevertillegg, samt solide pensjons- og forsikringsordninger.

Er du klar for å bli en del av løsningen sammen med oss? Hvis du kjenner deg igjen i våre verdier og ønsker å ta ansvar på et lag som bygger morgendagens omsorg, vil vi gjerne høre fra deg!

For mer informasjon om stillingen, ta gjerne kontakt med institusjonsleder Rune Hovland på telefon 957 96 734.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Humana omsorg og assistanse utvikler og leverer omsorgs- og assistansetjenester etter enkeltmenneskers behov og samfunnets ønsker. Vi yter tjenester innenfor områdene helse og omsorg, brukerstyrt personlig assistanse, barnevern institusjon og fosterhjem, praktisk bistand og hjelpetiltak.

Vi er et av Norges største private helseforetak, og vi arbeider etter visjonen, Alle har rett til et godt liv.

jobs.title: Responsable Agence Interim FH
jobs.description:
Notre client est un acteur du travail temporaire et de l’insertion professionnelle solidement implanté sur son territoire. Dans le cadre d’une évolution interne, nous recherchons son/sa futur(e)

Responsable d’Agence de Travail Temporaire de travail d’insertion f/h.

Vous prenez la responsabilité d’une agence performante, disposant d’un portefeuille clients actif et d’une équipe expérimentée et autonome.

Votre enjeu : pérenniser l’existant tout en donnant une nouvelle impulsion au développement commercial de l’agence.

Responsable d’Agence de Travail Temporaire f/h

Nord Moselle – CDI – Cadre (35h forfait jour)

Vos missions

Avant tout développeur(se) commercial(e), vous êtes présent(e) sur le terrain et animez votre réseau afin de développer l’activité de l’agence.

Vous aurez notamment pour missions de :

-fidéliser et développer le portefeuille clients existant ;

-prospecter de nouvelles entreprises et détecter les opportunités commerciales ;

-développer et animer un réseau professionnel auprès des entreprises et partenaires du territoire ;

-construire les offres commerciales et contribuer aux réponses aux appels d’offres ;

-piloter l’activité et la performance économique de l’agence ;

-manager une équipe de deux collaborateurs autonomes, dans un esprit de confiance, de reconnaissance et de cohésion ;

-Superviser l’activité d’une autre agence, à 45 km de l’agence principale, qui ne compte pas de collaborateur permanent, en assurant le suivi et le développement de son portefeuille clients ainsi que la continuité de l’activité auprès des salariés intérimaires.;

-intervenir en appui de l’équipe et dans la résolution des situations sensibles lorsque nécessaire.

-Construire et piloter les parcours d'insertion de l'agence

-

Vous justifiez d’une expérience professionnelle d’au moins 5 ans et avez démontré votre capacité à développer et animer un réseau professionnel pour générer de nouvelles opportunités commerciales.

Au-delà d’un diplôme ou de la connaissance du secteur du travail temporaire, c’est avant tout votre personnalité et votre tempérament commercial qui feront la différence.

Orienté(e) développement et conquête, vous êtes sincère dans la relation, pugnace, dynamique et investi(e). Vous aimez le terrain, créer du lien, développer votre réseau et transformer les opportunités identifiées en business concret.

Doté(e) d’une forte conscience professionnelle et du goût du challenge, vous êtes autonome, polyvalent(e), adaptable et orienté(e) solutions. Vous savez également fédérer une petite équipe avec bienveillance, reconnaissance et esprit collectif.

Rémunération : à convenir selon profil et expérience
Véhicule de service

Un accompagnement d’un mois est prévu lors de votre prise de fonction afin de faciliter la transmission de l’activité, des clients et du réseau.

Vous souhaitez conjuguer développement commercial, autonomie et management de proximité, tout en prenant les rênes d’une agence qui dispose déjà de bases solides pour poursuivre son développement ? Rencontrons-nous.

jobs.title: Associate Professor in Digital Health, Artificial Intelligence and Society
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
The School of Medicine seeks to appoint a 1.0 FTE Associate Professor in Digital Health, Artificial Intelligence and Society to provide academic leadership at a moment of profound technological transformation in healthcare and higher education. This is a strategic joint appointment between the School of Medicine and the University. The postholder will devote approximately half of their activity to establishing institutional capability in Digital Health, AI and Connected Health within medicine. The other half will be dedicated to a new university-wide initiative, currently in development, that will explore how artificial intelligence may fundamentally reshape learning, universities, knowledge creation and professional formation. The postholder will be expected to play a formative role in shaping this initiative from its earliest stages. Post status: Specific Purpose Contract This employment is not offered on an indefinite duration basis as the appointment is required to deliver a defined, specific and time-limited, programme to establish a university-wide ecosystem for responsible AI innovation in medicine, education and research. When the specific programme of work is completed, there will no longer be a need for the role. Hours of Post: Hours of work for academic staff are those as prescribed under Public Service Agreements. For further information please follow this link: http://www.tcd.ie/hr/assets/pdf/academic-hours-public-service-agreement.pdf Salary: Appointment will be made on Associate Professor Salary Scale commensurate with qualifications / experience and in line with Public Sector Pay Policy [€93,914 - €121,273 per annum] https://www.tcd.ie/hr/assets/pdf/monthly-academic.pdf How to apply: Applicants should submit: 1. Cover Letter (maximum one page) 2. Curriculum Vitae 3. Teaching Statement (maximum two pages) 4. Research and Scholarship Statement (maximum two pages) 5. Vision Statement outlining how they would contribute to building capacity in Connected Health, Digital Health and AI Literacy within Trinity College Dublin (maximum two pages) Applications are only accepted via the Trinity College Dublin vacancy page. Candidates who do not submit the above application documents will not be considered for shortlisting. Any applications which are still in progress at the closing time on the specified closing date will be cancelled automatically by the system. Please see the Job Description below for this position. Informal enquiries about this post should be made to Colin Doherty, Professor Consultant, Clinical Medicine, E: CDOHERT@tcd.ie At Trinity, we are committed to equality, diversity, and inclusion.
