jobs.title: Analytical Chemistry Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytical Chemistry Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in United Kingdom.

Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology.


Accountabilities
  • Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications.
  • Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge: Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Assess advanced analytical techniques: Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation.
  • Identify and document model weaknesses: Record reproducible errors, reasoning gaps, inaccurate interpretations, and other failure patterns to support systematic improvements in model performance.
  • Contribute to AI training and evaluation: Provide detailed scientific feedback, propose corrections, and recommend improvements to prompts, evaluation criteria, and testing methodologies.
  • Support scientific quality assurance: Apply principles of method validation, quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), and analytical data interpretation to evaluate the reliability of AI-generated outputs.
  • Communicate scientific reasoning clearly: Explain conclusions, demonstrate analytical approaches, and document the steps behind technical judgments to help improve model transparency and reliability.

    • Requirements

  • Education: A PhD in analytical chemistry or a closely related chemical science discipline is preferred. Equivalent advanced expertise supported by relevant professional or research experience may also be valuable.
  • Technical expertise: Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry principles, instrumentation, spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical methods, quantitative analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Research or laboratory experience: Experience in laboratory-based research, analytical method validation, pharmaceutical or environmental testing, instrumentation-intensive studies, or related scientific applications is highly desirable.
  • Specialized analytical skills: Familiarity with techniques such as mass spectrometry, HPLC, GC, NMR, trace analysis, titrimetry, and laboratory QA/QC procedures.
  • Scientific evaluation skills: Ability to identify factual inaccuracies, assess scientific arguments, interpret experimental scenarios, and distinguish sound conclusions from flawed reasoning.
  • Written communication: Excellent technical writing skills and the ability to explain complex scientific concepts clearly, precisely, and logically.
  • Analytical thinking: Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to break down complex problems and document reproducible findings.
  • AI training readiness: Interest in evaluating AI-generated content, identifying model limitations, and contributing to the development of more reliable scientific AI systems.
  • Working arrangements: Ability to work independently in a remote freelance environment, manage assignments effectively, and provide a secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection.

    • Benefits

  • Competitive hourly compensation: A pay range of $8–$65 per hour, with the final rate determined by expertise, professional experience, and geographic location. The final offer may vary from the advertised range.
  • Remote flexibility: Work remotely from India, with the flexibility associated with a freelance contract arrangement.
  • Meaningful scientific impact: Help shape AI systems that may support scientific education, research, analytical problem-solving, and laboratory workflows.
  • Intellectually stimulating work: Apply advanced analytical chemistry knowledge to challenging scientific questions and emerging AI evaluation tasks.
  • Specialized professional contribution: Use your research, instrumentation, and laboratory expertise in an innovative technology-focused environment.
  • Independent contractor arrangement: Manage your work in a freelance capacity, subject to project requirements and applicable engagement terms.
  • Benefits clarification: This is a contract position. Company-sponsored benefits, including health insurance and paid time off (PTO), are not provided. Contractors are responsible for supplying their own computer and high-speed internet connection.

jobs.description:
Primary location:
HELSINKI

Vastaanottovirkailija yö, Original Sokos Hotel Albert

Original Sokos Hotel Albert on pieni ja mutkaton hotelli Helsingin trendialueella.

Etsimme nyt vastaanottovirkailijaa hotellin yövuoroon. Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen (90 h/3vko).

Vastaanottovirkailijan tehtävässä olet avainasemassa luomassa asiakkaillemme unohtumattomia elämyksiä. Olet iloinen ja reipas, positiivisesti asioihin suhtautuva asiakaspalvelun ammattialainen, joka haluaa jättää vieraille muistijäljen. Laadukas asiakaspalvelu on sinulle sydämen asia ja viihdyt ympäristössä, jossa yksikään työpäivä ei ole samanlainen. Työvuoroissa toimit ajoittain itsenäisesti, joten työskentelet oma-aloitteisesti, kannat vastuuta ja pidät langat käsissäsi myös yksin.

MITÄ TARJOAMME SINULLE:
Monipuoliset työtehtävät
Vahvan tuen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön
Mahdollisuuden oppia, kehittyä ja laajentaa omaa osaamista
S-ryhmän kattavat henkilöstöedutostoalennukset S-ryhmän kaupoista, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja liikennemyymälöistä
kattavat työterveyspalvelut
normaalia laajemman vakuutusturvan

Innostavat työkaverit, jotka haluavat vieraiden viihtyvän

MITÄ ODOTAMME SINULTA:
Iloista, reipasta ja positiivista asennetta
Hyviä tiimityöskentelytaitoja
Joustavuutta muuttuvissa tilanteissa
Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa
Aikaisempi kokemus vastaanoton työstä sekä Opera Cloud -järjestelmästä ovat eduksi
Kykyä työskennellä yövuoroissa

Lisätietoja ja hakuohjeet

Työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva ja kokoaikainen 90 h/3vko. Aloitus sopimuksen mukaan.Jos kiinnostuit ja koet olevasi etsimämme työkaveri, täytä hakemus oheisesta linkistä viimeistään 19.10.2026. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän löydettyämme sopivan henkilön.Lähetäthän hakemuksesi meille ainoastaan sähköisen hakulomakkeen kautta, emme huomioi sähköpostitse lähetettyjä hakemuksia.

Mikäli sinulla on mielessä kysymyksiä tehtävään tai meillä työskentelyyn liittyen,hotellipäällikkö Ida Lajomajuttelee mielellään kanssasi lisää niistä.Idantavoitat parhaitensähköpostilla ida.lajoma@sok.fi.

Eezy Oyj toimiiSokotelinvirallisena rekrytointikumppanina hoitaen rekrytoinnin ensimmäiset vaiheet. SokotelOy on osa S-ryhmää. Me operoimme Suomessa neljäätoista Sokos Hotels -ketjun hotellia ja kahdeksaa Radisson Hotels -ketjun hotellia. Sokotel Oy toimii pääkaupunkiseudulla, Tampereella ja Oulussa.

Sokotelille on myönnetty Suomen innostavimmat työpaikat tunnustus sekä Hyvän mielen työpaikka sertifikaatti.Ihminen, kasvu ja kehittyminen ovat toimintamme keskiössä, ja meiltä saat takuun hyvästä johtamisesta.Sokotel on nikotiiniton työpaikka.

jobs.title: IT Business Partner, Norlandia Health & Care Group, Espoo
jobs.description:
WE ARE LOOKING FOR AN IT BUSINESS PARTNER - FINLAND TO JOIN NORLANDIA HEALTH & CARE GROUP AT OUR ESPOO OFFICE

Norlandia Health & Care Group, NHC, provides high-quality early childhood education, elderly care, disability services, child welfare services, patient hotel services, and home care services across Finland. Our operations are built on high quality, responsibility, and a people-centered approach. We are now looking for an experienced IT professional to join our Finnish support organization to strengthen IT services for our businesses and support the continuous development of our operations.

ABOUT THE ROLE
As an IT Business Partner - Finland, you will be responsible for the overall IT function of Norlandia Finland and serve as a trusted IT partner to the business. The role acts as the primary IT partner for the Finnish business while working as an integrated member of the NHC IT organization. The role reports to the Finland Country Manager and NHC IT.

You will work closely with business functions, managers, service providers, and NHC IT team. You approach IT challenges in a practical, proactive, and service-oriented manner, finding effective solutions that support daily operations. Success in this role requires the ability to understand the bigger picture while also being willing to take hands-on responsibility when operational situations require it.

The role includes travel to our locations across Finland sometimes even on a short notice.

NHC has an external IT operation partner, Sopra Steria, who delivers first line support and operates the M365 tenant for all countries in NHC Group. In addition, NHC Group has a centralized internal IT department, NHC IT, which is located in Oslo and Stockholm. NHC IT delivers second and third line support, including network Services to all countries in NHC Group.

EXPECTED SKILLS
Experience in managing outsourced IT services and suppliers
Service Level Agreement (SLA) follow-up
IT Service Management
Vendor Management
Experience in coordinating site openings, acquisitions and IT integrations
Network competence (patching, IPv4, Meraki, Unifi, etc.)
M365, AD DS, Windows 11, Intune environment
Project management in IT projects (startups, system implementation, etc.)
Basic knowledge of office hardware
Ability to develop AI use in the organization is regarded as a benefit

IT uses ServiceNow as a ticketing system and CMDB, and it is an advantage if you are used to ServiceNow or other ticketing systems.

WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU
Relevant education and several years of experience in managing, maintaining, and developing IT systems
Strong knowledge of Microsoft environments and related services
Experience in coordinating IT services, vendor relationships, and technical solutions
Ability to work independently, systematically, and in a solution-oriented manner, strong ability to actively seek for solutions for future challenges as well
Excellent collaboration, communication, and customer service skills
Willingness to travel between locations across Finland when required
Experience working in a multi-site organization or service business environment is considered an advantage
Excellent Finnish language skills as well as good written and spoken English

WHAT WE OFFER
A responsible and versatile key role in a growing nationwide organization
The opportunity to influence the development of NHC's IT environment and digital solutions
An independent role where you can make full use of your expertise
Support from a professional and caring work community
Flexible working arrangements and the possibility of partial remote work
Comprehensive Norlandia employee benefits

APPLICATION
Interested in the role?
Please submit your application by 31.10.2026. We will review applications and interview candidates throughout the application period, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate has been identified.

For more information about the position, please contact:
Elisabeth Dragseth, Head of NHC Group IT, by phone at +4748503114 or by email at elisabeth.dragseth@nhceurope.com

Robert Larsson, Head of IT Operations - NHC Group IT, by phone at +46721580079 or my email at robert.larsson@nhceurope.com

jobs.title: Host/vært søges til Tamashii
jobs.description:
Tamashii er Norrlysts nyeste restaurantprojekt – en ambitiøs og æstetisk kulinarisk destination med høje ambitioner og et klart mål. Vi har netop slået dørene op til en stemningsfuld restaurant i hjertet af København, og vi søger nu en imødekommende og engageret vært/værtinde, der kan sikre, at vores gæster føler sig set, velkomne og hjemme fra første øjeblik.

Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • Elsker at arbejde med mennesker og sætter en ære i at skabe varme og mindeværdige gæsteoplevelser

  • Har erfaring fra en tilsvarende rolle i kvalitetsbevidste restauranter eller hoteller

  • Er smilende, nærværende og professionel – også i travle situationer

  • Har blik for detaljen og forstår at læse både stemningen og gæsternes behov

  • Er struktureret og arbejder proaktivt med overblik og ro

  • Har interesse for gastronomi og lyst til at være en del af noget ambitiøs

Dine opgaver vil inkludere:

  • At tage imod og byde gæsterne velkommen med overskud og varme

  • Bordplanlægning og koordinering af ankomst og seating

  • Kommunikation med køkken og servering, så gæsteoplevelsen er gnidningsfri

  • Besvarelse af forespørgsler og håndtering af reservationer

  • At være en synlig og betryggende vært gennem hele serviceoplevelsen

  • Skabe ro, overblik og god stemning i restauranten – hver aften

  • Hjælpe i cocktailbaren med servering

Hvad vi tilbyder

  • En central rolle i et ambitiøst, professionelt og passioneret team

  • En mulighed for at blive en del af et nyt og toneangivende restaurantprojekt

  • Et arbejdssted med højt til loftet, plads til personlighed og udvikling

  • Tæt samarbejde med køkken, restaurantchef og Norrlyst-familien

  • Et stærkt fællesskab og en arbejdsplads med fokus på kvalitet og arbejdsglæde

Vil du være ansigtet, stemmen og nærværet i Københavns næste store restaurantoplevelse?
Send os din ansøgning og fortæl os, hvorfor netop du skal være vært/værtinde på Tamashii

jobs.title: Site Manager till FirstOffice Stockholm
jobs.description:
Om företaget

FirstOffice, en affärsenhet inom det börsnoterade fastighetsbolaget Corem, erbjuder flexibla kontorslösningar med arbetsplatser, mötesrum och service i professionella och inspirerande miljöer. Konceptet bygger på att det ska vara enkelt att flytta in och enkelt att vara kund – kontor, service och gemensamma ytor samlas i en flexibel helhetslösning där företagen kan fokusera på sin egen verksamhet.

Läs mer om FirstOffice här: FirstOffice

Om rollen

Som Site Manager ansvarar du för flera av FirstOffice enheter i Stockholm. Rollen är bred, självständig och affärsnära, där du är naturlig del av den dagliga verksamheten och har regelbunden kontakt med kunder och medlemmar. Du arbetar med allt från visningar, uthyrning och inflyttningar till att lösa praktiska frågor och säkerställa att service och drift håller en hög nivå.

Teamet du ingår i utgår från Kista och där finns även FirstOffice tjänstebilar. Du kommer att ha fasta dagar då du jobbar från kontoret i Kista och övriga dagar utgår du från de FirstOffice-enheter du ansvarar för.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden

I rollen ansvarar du för att skapa en välfungerande vardag för våra kunder och samtidigt driva affären framåt. Du arbetar både operativt och relationsskapande, med tydligt fokus på service, uthyrning och resultat.

Du kommer bland annat att:

    

Driva och utveckla dina enheter mot uppsatta mål inom uthyrning, kundnöjdhet och resultat

    

Bearbeta leads, genomföra visningar och driva uthyrningsprocessen från första kontakt till tecknat avtal

    

Bygga och utveckla långsiktiga relationer med både befintliga och potentiella kunder

    

Säkerställa en hög servicenivå och en välfungerande daglig drift på enheterna

    

Arbeta aktivt med nätverkande, kundaktiviteter och lokal marknadsbearbetning

    

Ansvara för budget, resultatuppföljning samt planering och utveckling av dina enheter

    

Samarbeta nära med övriga Site Managers, Service Managers och andra funktioner inom FirstOffice och Corem

Vi söker

Vi söker dig som trivs i en bred och operativ roll där du är nära både verksamheten och kunderna. Du har ett naturligt affärsdriv, tycker om att bygga relationer och ser möjligheter i det dagliga kundmötet. Du är prestigelös och lösningsorienterad och trivs med att växla mellan kundkontakt, praktiska frågor och administration. För dig är hög service och en välfungerande drift grunden för nöjda kunder och goda resultat. Whether you're in the kitchen or on the floor, you'll be part of a team that brings energy, personality and pride to everything it does.

International career opportunities.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance (Software)
jobs.description:
Welcome to Our World of Simulation

Our vision is to change the world of education by developing and selling simulation-based training tools, and we are looking for more people who want to be a part of that journey. We are an ambitious yet unpretentious company, with a wide diversity among our employees, creating a dynamic and resourceful team. We are eager to find solutions together and enjoy the high pace forward.

Our head office is based in Tanumshede in northern Bohuslän, Sweden, but we are a highly global company with sales representatives and resellers all over the world. Our simulators exist on every continent, and we have only started. We want you to be a part of our journey ahead!

ABOUT THE POSITION

This role will be an important piece in our business, where you will test our various products and tools before they are released to the market. You will also contribute to the development of the QA function.

You will assist the development teams with testing to find bugs and problems from the end user's perspective. An important part of the job is to identify and communicate these bugs and issues clearly and constructively. You will also work strategically, identifying possible risks and helping with developing our processes in a pro-active manner.

TASKS

    Identify bugs and report them in our bug management tool.
    Communicate feedback to the development teams.
    Use digital dashboards to summarize the status of ongoing projects.
    Visit industries and customers to learn how real machines (e.g., tracked excavators) work.

QUALIFICATIONS

    Ongoing or completed studies in game development or a similar software development industry.
    Previous experience with similar tasks is a merit but not a requirement.
    Good knowledge of English.

PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS

    Problem solving skills and willingness to understand hardware and digital systems.
    Has a passion for playing modern computer games.
    Can communicate feedback constructively in digital formats.
    Strong self-drive and initiative.

INFORMATION & APPLICATION

    Start: By agreement
    Scope: Full‑time, we apply a 6‑month probationary period
    Location: Göteborg / Falun / Tanumshede
    Benefits: We have a collective agreement with Unionen, offer a generous wellness allowance to support your health, and provide a private health insurance that gives you quick access to care when you need it.

Selection is ongoing, so you are welcome to submit your application as soon as possible!

jobs.title: Nordic Head Chef & QA Lead
jobs.description:
**Location: Helsinki Airport, Finland or Stockholm Arlanda Airport, Sweden**

**Shape the future of food safety, quality and culinary excellence across the Nordics**

Are you an experienced food safety and quality professional with strong culinary credibility? Do you thrive in a role where you can influence standards across multiple countries, locations and concepts?

We are looking for a **Nordic Head Chef & Quality Assurance Lead** to take ownership of food safety, quality assurance and culinary standards across Avolta's Nordic food & beverage operations. In this highly visible regional role, you will safeguard compliance, drive continuous improvement and help ensure that every guest experience meets the highest standards of quality and food safety.

**Your Mission**

As Nordic Head Chef & Quality Assurance Lead, you will lead food safety and culinary standards across the Nordics, ensuring full HACCP compliance, operational excellence, regulatory adherence and a consistently high-quality guest experience while protecting the company's reputation and supporting business performance.

**What You'll Be Doing**

**Lead Food Safety & Quality Assurance**

- Own and continuously develop the Nordic HACCP and Food Safety framework.

- Drive compliance with food safety legislation, policies and company standards across the Nordic countries (Sweden, Finland and from 2027 also Latvia).

- Lead food safety audits, inspections and corrective action processes.

- Own the governance of product specifications, allergen declarations and nutritional information.

- Investigate food safety incidents and drive preventive actions.

- Ensure all locations remain audit-ready and operate to the highest hygiene and food safety standards.


**Drive Culinary Excellence**

- Define and maintain culinary standards across the Nordic region.

- Own recipe development, recipe costing and product specifications.

- Ensure consistency in food quality, preparation methods and presentation.

- Support menu launches, new concepts and commercial initiatives.

- Monitor food quality performance and drive continuous improvement.


**Partner with the Business**

- Work closely with Operations, Procurement, Supply Chain and F&B teams.

- Collaborate with suppliers and manufacturers to ensure quality and specification compliance.

- Act as the key food safety expert for the business.

- Coach and develop Kitchen Managers and kitchen teams across the Nordics.

- Build a strong food safety culture and capability within the organisation.


**What We're Looking For**

- Professional culinary qualification or equivalent experience.

- At least five years' leadership experience in multi-site food service, hospitality, travel retail, catering, restaurant or retail food operations.

- Strong expertise in HACCP, food safety management systems and food legislation.

- Proven experience leading audits, inspections and compliance programmes.

- Experience developing standards, processes and training programmes.

- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

- Fluent English and either Swedish or Finnish.

jobs.title: Kitchen Sous Chef – Yakitori Specialist at La Pausa Restaurant
jobs.description:
English Version Below

Køkken Souschef med speciale i Yakitori hos La Pausa Restaurant

Vi søger en dygtig og erfaren køkken souschef med speciale i japansk yakitori til vores køkken.

Du bliver en central del af køkkenteamet og får ansvar for den daglige drift af yakitori-køkkenet samt for at sikre høj kvalitet og ensartethed i tilberedning og grillning.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil være:

  • Tilberedning og tilberedningsforberedelse af yakitori

  • Grillning af yakitori på professionelt niveau

  • Ansvar for den daglige drift og organisering af yakitori-køkkenet

  • Koordinering og vejledning af køkkenpersonalet

  • Sikring af kvalitet, smag, præsentation og ensartede standarder

  • Udvikling og design af nye yakitori-retter og menuer

  • Bidrage til udvikling af køkkenets koncept og arbejdsgange

  • Sikre god hygiejne, orden og effektivt serviceflow

  • Assistere køkkenchefen og varetage dennes funktion efter behov

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har solid erfaring med japansk køkken og særligt yakitori

  • Har dokumenterede færdigheder inden for yakitori-tilberedning og grillning

  • Har erfaring med at arbejde professionelt med yakitori-grill

  • Har forståelse for råvarer, udskæring, marinering, tilberedning og grillteknikker

  • Har erfaring med menuudvikling og gerne udvikling af nye yakitori-koncepter

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for et køkkenområde

  • Har gode samarbejds- og lederevner

  • Kan arbejde struktureret og bevare overblikket i et travlt køkken

  • Har fokus på kvalitet, detaljer og gæsteoplevelsen

Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra en restaurant, hvor yakitori udgør en væsentlig del af køkkenets koncept.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En spændende stilling med ansvar og mulighed for at sætte dit præg på køkkenet

  • Mulighed for at udvikle nye retter og menuer

  • Et professionelt og dynamisk arbejdsmiljø

  • Mulighed for faglig udvikling og større ansvar

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling. Løn og øvrige ansættelsesvilkår aftales efter kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Vi søger en souschef, som ikke blot kan tilberede yakitori, men som har et stærkt fagligt niveau inden for hele yakitori-processen og kan være med til at udvikle og drive et professionelt yakitori-køkken.

ENGLISH:

Kitchen Sous Chef – Yakitori Specialist at La Pausa Restaurant

We are looking for a skilled and experienced Kitchen Sous Chef specializing in Japanese yakitori to join our kitchen team.

You will play a key role in the daily operation of the yakitori kitchen and will be responsible for maintaining a consistently high standard of preparation, grilling, quality and presentation.

Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Preparation and mise en place of yakitori

  • Professional yakitori grilling

  • Responsibility for the daily operation and organization of the yakitori kitchen

  • Coordinating and guiding kitchen staff

  • Ensuring consistent quality, taste, presentation and preparation standards

  • Developing and designing new yakitori dishes and menus

  • Contributing to the development of the kitchen concept and working procedures

  • Maintaining high standards of hygiene, organization and service flow

  • Assisting the Head Chef and taking responsibility in their absence when required

We expect you to:

  • Have solid professional experience in Japanese cuisine, particularly yakitori

  • Have proven skills in yakitori preparation and grilling

  • Have professional experience working with a yakitori grill

  • Have a strong understanding of ingredients, cutting techniques, marinating, preparation and grilling techniques

  • Have experience with menu development and preferably developing new yakitori concepts

  • Be able to work independently and take responsibility for a kitchen section

  • Have good teamwork and leadership skills

  • Be organized and able to maintain an overview in a busy kitchen

  • Have a strong focus on quality, detail and the guest experience

Experience from a restaurant where yakitori is an important part of the kitchen concept will be considered an advantage.

We offer:

  • An exciting position with responsibility and the opportunity to influence the development of the kitchen

  • The opportunity to develop new dishes and menus

  • A professional and dynamic working environment

  • Opportunities for professional development and increased responsibility

This is a full-time position. Salary and employment terms will be agreed according to qualifications and experience.

We are looking for a sous chef who not only knows how to prepare yakitori, but who has a strong professional understanding of the entire yakitori process and can help develop and operate a professional yakitori kitchen.

jobs.title: Sales Executive  - Ready to turn Software/ERP expertise into closed deals? Interform HQ Birkerød, DK or Remote
jobs.description:
The role

Interform builds InterformNG2, an Output Management platform that sits next to the ERP and handles the documents a business runs on: invoices, labels, delivery notes, e-invoicing. When output fails, shipments stop and invoices get rejected. Our customers buy certainty that this never happens.

You will sell InterformNG2 to new customers across Europe - with our core markets in the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux and the UK - typically manufacturing, logistics and distribution companies running ERPs such as Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics or IBM i. You own the full sales cycle from first conversation to signed agreement.

There is no BDR team here, but you are not starting from a blank sheet either. We identify the most relevant accounts together, backed by an AI-driven engine that tracks buying signals across our markets. Your job is what happens next: the outreach, the conversations, the proposals and the close.

What you will do

  • Turn qualified target accounts into meetings, pipeline and closed deals across your European territory.

  • Open doors through direct outreach and your own network of ERP consultants, partners and IT decision-makers.

  • Run full sales cycles - qualification, demo coordination, proposal, negotiation, close - in close collaboration with the rest of the commercial team.

  • Work with our partner ecosystem around Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i and other ERP platforms as a second route to market.

  • Feed what you learn in the market back into how we position and price.

Who you are

  • Driven. You show up every day ready to do your best, and you keep that standard through long sales cycles.

  • Connected in the ERP ecosystem. Ecosystem knowledge is essential in this role: you know at least one major ERP ecosystem in real depth - the partners and implementation consultants in it, how they influence a deal and when to bring them in - and you bring a working network you can call on from day one.

  • Self-starting. You plan your own work, execute without being chased, and deliver.

  • Accountable. You own your number and you follow up - customers can trust that you are always a step ahead.

  • At home in the ERP world. You have sold software or services into environments running Infor, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, IBM i or comparable ERP platforms, and you speak the language of IT managers and operations directors.

  • AI-forward. You already use AI in your daily sales work - research, preparation, follow-up - and want a company that works the same way.

  • A closer. You have proven you can turn outreach into pipeline and pipeline into signed deals - not just manage inbound.

  • Languages: fluent English is required. German, Danish or Dutch on top is a strong advantage - ideally you cover one of our core markets natively.

What we offer

  • A place in a solid company: profitable, in strong growth, and with a large market still ahead of us.

  • A product that is easy to stand behind: more than 4,500 installations worldwide, and customers who stay.

  • A defined category - Output Management - where we compete on depth, not noise.

  • Short decision paths and direct access to management.

  • An AI-driven account-based marketing engine that shows you which companies are in the market - so your time goes to conversations, not list-building.

  • A competitive package that rewards what you close.

About Interform A/S

Interform has built Output Management software since 1987 from our headquarters in Birkerød, Denmark. Our platform, InterformNG2, works with any ERP, any format and any environment - customers change or upgrade their ERP and keep their output running. Our first customer from 1987 is still with us today. Our customer base is international - companies across the Nordics, Germany and Austria, Benelux, the UK and further afield - and our own team works across borders in the same way, with colleagues based in Denmark and Germany. We are a profitable, solidly run company in strong growth, and investment backing supports continued development of the platform.

Practical details

  • Location: our office in Birkerød, Denmark, or remote from anywhere in our European markets - we already have employees working outside Denmark, so a distributed setup is nothing new to us.

  • Travel: limited. Most sales work runs remotely, with occasional customer, partner and event travel.

  • Reports to: our Chief Commercial Officer - you will work alongside the rest of the commercial team.

  • Start: as soon as possible. We review applications on an ongoing basis.

How to apply

Upload your CV and cover letter, including the deals you are most proud of.

Birkerød I Remote

på telefon 2620 8245

jobs.title: Daglig leder
jobs.description:
Daglig leder søges til Min Købmand i Givskud

Vil du stå i spidsen for en lokal butik i rivende udvikling, hvor kundeservice, struktur og frihed under ansvar går hånd i hånd? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Hos Min Købmand i Givskud søger vi en passioneret og erfaren daglig leder. Du får det overordnede ansvar for den daglige drift og skal være med til at sikre, at vores kunder altid møder en indbydende butik med friske varer og et højt serviceniveau.

Om jobbet

Som daglig leder får du en central og alsidig rolle, hvor du både arbejder strategisk og har fingrene helt nede i den daglige drift.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver bliver at:

  • Lede og fordele arbejdet blandt butikkens medarbejdere, så alle kender deres opgaver og trives i hverdagen.

  • Varetage varebestilling og sikre optimal lagerstyring, så vi minimerer spild og altid har de rigtige varer på hylderne.

  • Udarbejde arbejdsplaner, der sikrer den rette bemanding i butikkens åbningstid.

  • Igangsætte og uddelegere opgaver til natholdet, som pakker onlineordrer og fylder op på hylderne. Natholdet klarer sig selv i tidsrummet kl. 20.00 – 06.30, indtil dagholdet møder ind.

Vi forventer af dig

Vi leder efter en profil, der har solid erfaring fra detailbranchen og forstår dynamikken i en lokalbutik.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra en selvstændig købmand – eller måske har du selv været selvstændig erhvervsdrivende tidligere.

  • Har stærke lederegenskaber og formår at sætte klare rammer, så de forskellige hold (herunder natholdet) kan arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Er struktureret, handlekraftig og tager ejerskab over dine ansvarsområder.

  • Har flair for tal, systemer og planlægning.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende lederstilling med stor indflydelse på butikkens succes og hverdag.

  • Dygtige og engagerede kollegaer i et uformelt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Løn og ansættelsesvilkår, der matcher dine kvalifikationer.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Er det dig, vi leder efter? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

  • Ansøgningsfrist: 15. november 2026

  • Opstart: Efter aftale, dog senest 1. februar 2027

  • Kontaktperson: Bo

  • Telefon: 22 52 29 69

  • Arbejdssted: Min Købmand Givskud, Vejlevej 70, Givskud, 7323 Give

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Monil is building world-leading technology for virtual fencing and livestock monitoring. In just four years, we’ve grown to over 1,000 customers and more than 50,000 collars across multiple markets. We are now entering a new phase of international growth, and the next generation of products and capabilities will be critical to our success.

At the heart of our solution is a collar that combines animal interaction, sensors, positioning, and wireless communication. Operating in remote environments with only a small solar panel as its energy source, the collar must reliably deliver virtual fencing and continuous livestock monitoring under strict energy and connectivity constraints.

We're looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer who wants to build products that operate in the real world and have a direct impact on sustainable agriculture and animal welfare.


Key responsibilities

  • Design and develop embedded software for next-generation livestock monitoring devices

  • Lead firmware development from concept through deployment and field validation

  • Build reliable low-power systems using cellular, GNSS, wireless communication, sensors, and on-device machine learning

  • Work closely with hardware, cloud, and product teams to bring new features from concept to field deployment

  • Drive software quality, architecture, and technical best practices across the platform


We believe you have

  • 5+ years of experience in embedded software development

  • Strong C/C++ skills and experience developing firmware for resource-constrained systems

  • Experience with modern embedded software architectures, development practices, and CI/CD

  • Experience building connected embedded systems and working with communication protocols

  • Solid understanding of low-power system design and energy-constrained devices

  • Experience with one or more of the following:

    • Cellular technologies (LTE-M, NB-IoT, 4G/5G)

    • GNSS

    • Bluetooth Low Energy and other wireless technologies

    • Sensor integration, signal processing, edge ML

    • Device management and OTA updates


We believe you are

  • Passionate about building reliable products that operate in challenging real-world environments

  • Comfortable taking ownership and driving projects from idea to deployment

  • Pragmatic, curious, and motivated by solving complex engineering challenges

  • A strong collaborator who communicates effectively across technical and non-technical teams


We offer

  • Meaningful impact on animal welfare and sustainable agriculture

  • Challenging engineering problems in low-power, connected systems

  • Opportunity to shape industry-leading products during a period of international growth

  • A collaborative environment with significant ownership and learning opportunities

  • Competitive compensation and benefits


Requirements

Candidates must have the right to work in Norway or within the EU/EEA, as we are unable to support relocation or visa sponsorship from outside this area. Application deadline: August 16th 2026

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Accelerate the worlds transition to sustainable agriculture by automating animal care. We design and build high-tech smart collars that benefits both farmer, animal and environment: - The farmer saves time and money on building fences and animal feed - The animals spend less time inside and more time grazing on open pastures - The smart collars enable grazing techniques that boost soil health and reduce the need for artificial fertilizer

Vi søker en person som bor i Trysil-området, og som er selvstendig, løsningsorientert og serviceinnstilt.

Førerkort og tilgang til bil anses som en fordel, ettersom deler av stillingen forutsetter fysisk oppmøte.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Stillingen består hovedsakelig av digital forvaltning. Det vil si at du som utleieforvalter har ansvar for kommunikasjon med gjester før, under og etter oppholdet, samt koordinering av det praktiske rundt utleien. Siden arbeidet i all hovedsak er digitalt, kan de fleste arbeidsoppgaver gjennomføres uavhengig av sted, og de fleste henvendelser lar seg løse uten fysisk oppmøte.

Den resterende delen av stillingen innebærer fysisk oppmøte ved behov - eksempelvis bistand til gjester på stedet eller befaring av nye eiendommer som skal inn i porteføljen.

Arbeidsmengden varierer gjennom året, og stillingen egner seg godt som en fleksibel deltidsjobb.

Vi tilbyr

Hos oss kan du forvente varierte arbeidsoppgaver - alt fra digitalt arbeid i form av kommunikasjon med gjester og koordinering av renhold mellom gjesteoppholdene, til fysisk arbeid som befaring av nye eiendommer.

Hos oss kan du også forvente en god mengde fleksibilitet. Mesteparten av arbeidet kan du gjennomføre digitalt, noe som gir deg muligheten til å jobbe fra der det passer deg best.

Du kan også forvente en rettferdig og konkurransedyktig lønn. Vi er opptatt av at alle som jobber hos oss skal trives, føle mestring og få en lønn som gjenspeiler innsatsen de legger ned.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

EnkelBnb er et forvaltningsselskap som bistår eiendomseiere med utleie av deres eiendom gjennom utleie på plattformer som Airbnb, Booking.com, Finn.no.

Vi ivaretar hele utleieprosessen på vegne av eiere som ikke selv har anledning til å håndtere utleien - herunder annonsering, gjestekommunikasjon, inn- og utsjekk, og løpende oppfølging.

Vi har drift i både Oslo, Bergen, Trondheim og Tromsø, og høsten 2026 etablerer vi oss i Trysil. I den forbindelse søker vi lokale utleieforvaltere som kan bistå med driften i Trysil.

jobs.title: Vi søker avdelingsleder til Innlandet
jobs.description:
Ramudden Norge er en del av Ramudden Global med over 5 000 medarbeidere og virksomhet i 13 land. Felles for oss alle er én viktig oppgave: å få folk trygt hjem hver dag. I Norge består vi av over 500 medarbeidere og leverer sikkerhetstjenester på vei og byggeplasser

Nå ser vi etter en engasjert avdelingsleder som vil ta ansvar ved avdelingen vår på Hamar. Stillingen er et vikariat med ønsket oppstart snarest og varighet til og med juni 2027, med mulighet for forlengelse.

Vi ser etter deg som trives med å være i front, tør å gå nye veier og motiveres av å finne nye muligheter og spille andre gode. Som avdelingsleder får du ansvar for å lede, videreutvikle og styrke salgs- og prosjektorganisasjonen, med et tydelig fokus på mennesker, kunder og gode resultater.

 

Rollen som avdelingsleder

Som avdelingsleder får du ansvar for faglig og administrativ ledelse, organisering og drift av avdelingen. Du vil være tett på både medarbeidere, kunder og den daglige driften, samtidig som du får en sentral rolle i å utvikle avdelingen videre og sikre gode leveranser og resultater.

Dine viktigste ansvarsområder vil blant annet være:

  • Sikre god drift, kvalitet og lønnsomhet i prosjekter og leveranser
  • Videreutvikle relasjoner med eksisterende kunder og skape nye muligheter i markedet
  • Følge opp økonomi, budsjett, ressursplanlegging og resultater
  • Lede og utvikle medarbeidere og arbeidsmiljøet i avdelingen
  • Bygge samarbeid på tvers av avdelinger og fagområder
  • Sørge for at sikkerhet alltid ligger til grunn for det vi gjør 

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter en trygg og tydelig leder som trives med å være tett på den daglige driften. Du har god forståelse for helheten, samtidig som du er opptatt av menneskene og det som skjer i avdelingen.

Du kommuniserer godt og bygger gode relasjoner, både internt og med kunder. Du bidrar til struktur og godt samarbeid i avdelingen, har et tydelig kundefokus og god forretningsforståelse.

Vi tror du vil lykkes i rollen dersom du har:

  • Relevant utdanning, gjerne innen tekniske fag eller ledelse
  • Ledererfaring – gjerne fra virksomhet innen bygg- og anleggsbransjen eller industri

  • Erfaring med kundeoppfølging og relasjonsbygging
  • Førerkort klasse B (BE er ønskelig)
  • Gode kommunikasjonsevner på norsk og engelsk, skriftlig og muntlig

 

Hva får du hos oss?

Hos oss får du en sentral lederrolle hvor du får være tett på både kolleger, kunder og drift. Du blir en del av et selskap med høye ambisjoner og dyktige kolleger som deler kunnskap og spiller hverandre gode.

Vi tilbyr:

  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med høyt tempo og stor takhøyde
  • Muligheten til å bidra til et viktig sikkerhetsarbeid
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

 

Høres dette ut som noe for deg?

Da håper vi du sender oss en søknad. Vi vil gjerne høre mer om hvem du er, erfaringen din og hvorfor du ønsker å bli en del av Ramudden. Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

The Opportunity

At Easee, we're building technology that makes electrification effortless. Our products are used across Europe, and our success depends on attracting people who share our ambition, curiosity, and commitment to great results.

As our Product Manager, Energy Management, you'll play a key role in giving Easee's energy-management hardware portfolio, including the Equalizer products, accessories, and add-ons, clear end-to-end ownership. This is a new position, created to turn energy management from something that mainly helps sell chargers into a portfolio that creates value in its own right.

Working closely with Engineering (embedded, apps, platform and cloud, hardware), Energy Services, Commercial, Product Marketing, Operations, and the leadership team, you'll own the strategy, business case, and roadmap, and see products through discovery, launch, and phase-out. It's a chance to dive deep into customer and installer needs, hardware economics, and Europe's evolving energy market.

What's in it for you

  • Take part in shaping Easee's energy-management offering, working alongside some of the experts behind one of the world's best-selling EV chargers

  • Real ownership of a portfolio from strategy and commercial case through to field performance

  • Collaboration with CEO and leadership team for strategy input and portfolio decisions

  • A chance to define how Easee connects EV charging with local generation, storage, and the wider energy ecosystem

Core Outcomes

Short-term

  • You've established a clear strategy, value proposition, roadmap, and performance baseline for the energy-management hardware portfolio

  • You've identified and begun closing the most important product, installation, reliability, and ecosystem gaps for priority residential (SDU) and apartment-block/commercial (MDU) use cases

  • You've created a coherent end-to-end proposition across hardware, firmware, software experience, installation, compatibility, support, and commercial positioning

  • You've shown measurable improvement in customer, installer, product, and commercial outcomes

  • You're delivering a recognisable Easee experience in energy management: simple to install, intuitive to use, reliable in operation, and smart in how it manages energy

Long-term

  • You've validated commercial models that capture part of the customer value created, where there is evidence of willingness to pay

  • The offering is more intelligent and automated, so customers can lower costs, make better use of local energy, or manage capacity with minimal effort

  • The portfolio is a scalable, interoperable part of the wider energy ecosystem, connecting EV charging with controllable loads, local generation, storage, energy services, and third-party platforms

  • Compatibility extends beyond Easee hardware where it creates meaningful customer value

What you need to bring along

Dare: We challenge assumptions and explore new possibilities.

jobs.title: Research Scientist - 3D Reconstruction (SfM & SLAM)
jobs.description:
SpAItial is pioneering the next generation of World Models, pushing the boundaries of generative AI, computer vision, and the simulation of reality. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the physics and geometry of our world. Our mission is to redefine how industries, from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema, generate and interact with physically-grounded 3D environments.

We're seeking a Research Scientist focused on 3D reconstruction. You will advance methods that recover accurate camera poses and geometry from real-world imagery, working with both classical multi-view geometry and state-of-the-art learned reconstructors. The work includes structure-from-motion, bundle adjustment, SLAM, or feed-forward reconstruction, with a focus on robustness, accuracy, and methods that hold up on diverse real-world data.

Responsibilities

  • Design camera pose estimators and 3D reconstructors.

  • Build robust SfM and camera tracking pipelines for a variety of input imaging sensors.

  • Develop bundle adjusters and nonlinear optimizers, including non-perspective camera formulations.

  • Integrate and extend SOTA feed-forward reconstructors (VGGT, DA3, Pi3)

  • Advance deep multi-view stereo, learned matching, and monocular depth methods for dense geometry.

  • Build evaluation metrics for pose accuracy and reconstruction quality, and drive improvements against public & internal benchmarks.

  • Scale reconstruction methods to large, diverse real-world datasets while keeping them reliable and efficient.

  • Collaborate with researchers to bring reconstruction advances into production systems.

Key Qualifications

  • PhD in computer vision with a research focus on 3D reconstruction; publications at top venues (CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS).

  • Deep understanding of multi-view geometry: camera models, epipolar geometry, triangulation, PnP, etc.

  • Strong familiarity with SOTA deep reconstructors (VGGT, DA3, Pi3) and related areas such as deep MVS, learned matching, and monocular depth estimation.

  • Hands-on experience with SfM/SLAM systems (COLMAP, ORB-SLAM) and nonlinear least-squares solvers (Ceres).

  • Experience shipping production-grade 3D reconstruction systems is a strong plus.

jobs.title: Research Scientist - Robot Learning (VLA / WAM)
jobs.description:
SpAItial is pioneering the next generation of World Models, pushing the boundaries of generative AI, computer vision, and the simulation of reality. We are moving beyond 2D pixels to build models that natively understand the physics and geometry of our world. Our mission is to redefine how industries, from robotics and AR/VR to gaming and cinema, generate and interact with physically-grounded 3D environments.

We're seeking a Research Scientist to train the policies that turn a world model into a robot that acts. You will own vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAM) end to end, starting, including data, backbone, action representation, training runs, and the evaluation that tells us whether a policy is genuinely competent or merely lucky. A world model that understands geometry and physics still doesn't act on its own; the policy is what closes that gap. This is a senior, hands-on research role for someone who has already trained manipulation policies that worked, and who can say precisely why the ones that didn't failed.

Responsibilities

  • Own the training pipeline for vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAM) end to end, from data to a policy running on a robot.

  • Contribute to setting the technical direction for embodied research at SpAItial.

  • Close the sim-to-real gap through domain randomization, system identification, and calibration, and build evaluation that predicts real-world transfer.

  • Adapt VLM backbones for control: encoder choice and adapter strategies, co-training.

  • Curate and weight the training mix across heterogeneous robot datasets, spanning differing embodiments, action spaces, and sensor setups.

  • Design action representation and decoding, including tokenization, chunking, diffusion, and flow-matching action experts.

  • Build the world-model components that predict future observations conditioned on action.

  • Run post-training: supervised fine-tuning onto target embodiments, and RL for robustness beyond demonstrations.

Key Qualifications

  • A PhD in robotics, machine learning, or computer vision with a robot learning focus, from the PhD alone or followed by industry experience.

  • Publications at top venues such as (CoRL, RSS, ICRA, IROS or CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS), open-source work, and/or deployed systems.

  • Deep experience with modern robot policy designs (VLA, WAM, diffusion), trained end to end rather than fine-tuned from a released checkpoint.

  • Strong imitation learning fundamentals, and familiarity with RL fine-tuning of pretrained policies.

  • Fluency with VLM backbones and how to adapt them for control.

  • Expert Python and PyTorch, with multi-node distributed training experience (FSDP or equivalent).

jobs.title: Forklift Driver (trukkikuski) to Föglö, Åland Islands for the Fish Industry, 7mo fixed term ,
jobs.description:
--- *Suomeksi alla* ---

We are now looking for a forklift driver for a fixed term position with good possibility to continue further in the island of Föglö, Åland.

The job involves operating a forklift in various stages of production and storage, such as moving products, loading and unloading cargo, and ensuring the smooth flow of materials in the production area. The forklift in use is a counterbalanced electric forklift (brand: Linde). The work requires good precision, initiative, and the ability to operate safely in a busy environment. The working conditions are cool, around +2 – +6°C, so readiness to work in cold conditions is important. You will also drive the forklift on a slightly sloped yard. If necessary, you can also participate in other production-supporting tasks. At Kalaneuvos, you will become part of a skilled and truly collaborative "work family".

Who is this job suitable for?
We are looking for a communicative person who is capable of working independently and is not afraid to take initiative. Previous experience in operating a forklift is a requirement for this job. You will receive comprehensive training on the specific forklift model and the work environment. The job is suitable for someone who enjoys being close to nature, as the workplace is located on Föglö Island, in a scenic archipelago. You should be able to communicate in English to ensure smooth communication within the team.

- Working hours: 20-37,5h/weekk
- Salary: approx. 12,50-14,00 EUR/h in the beginning, depending on experience
- Collective agreement: Food Industry collective agreement
- Employment: through Bolt
- Start date: flexible according to agreement
- The role has possibility to advance into bigger role

Information about the workplace and practical arrangements:
Föglö does not have city services: the island has K-extra, a library, and a gym, while other city services can be found in Mariehamn, 35 minutes by ferry + 30 minutes by car. You can also manage without a car on the island, as the workplace is close to accommodation and there is a bus to Mariehamn. If desired, we can arrange accommodation for you: you will typically stay with another employee in a two- or three-room apartment, and the rent is around 300-450 EUR, which may or may not include electricity/water, depending on the apartment (you will receive exact information with the job offer).

About Kalaneuvos:
Kalaneuvos is the largest player in the Finnish fish industry and a pioneer in fish processing, fish wholesale, fish import and export, and fish farming. Kalaneuvos has been producing high-quality fish products for over 40 years, focusing not only on product quality but also on modern production methods and employee well-being. The Kalaneuvos brand offers a wide range of delicious fish products. For more information: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Please apply for the job soon: the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

--- SUOMEKSI ---

Haemme nyt trukkikuskia määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen luonnonhelmaan Ahvenanmaan Föglön saareen.

Työtehtäviin kuuluu trukin käyttö tuotannon ja varaston eri työvaiheissa, kuten tuotteiden siirtäminen, kuormien lastaus ja purku, sekä materiaalivirran sujuvuuden varmistaminen tuotantoalueella. Käytössä oleva trukki on vastapainoinen sähkötrukki (merkki: Linde). Työ vaatii hyvää tarkkuutta, oma-aloitteisuutta sekä kykyä toimia turvallisesti kiireisessä ympäristössä. Työskentelytilat ovat viileät, noin +2 – +6°C, joten valmius työskennellä kylmässä on tärkeää. Ajat trukkia myös hieman kaltevalla pihalla. Tarpeen mukaan voit osallistua myös muihin tuotantoa tukeviin työtehtäviin. Kalaneuvoksella pääset osaksi ammattitaitoista ja todellakin yhteen hiileen puhaltavaa "työperhettä".

Kenelle työ sopii?
Etsimme kommunikaatiotaitoista ja itsenäiseen työskentelyyn kykenevää henkilöä, joka ei pelkää tarttua toimeen. Aiempi kokemus trukin käytöstä on vaatimuksena tälle työlle. Saat toki kattavan perehdytyksen kyseiseen trukkimalliin sekä työympäristöön. Työ sopii luonnon läheiselle henkilölle, sillä työpaikka sijaitsee Föglön saarella, saaristomaisemissa. Puhuthan englantia, jotta kommunikaatio työporukassa sujuu ongelmitta.

- Työtunnit: 20-37,5h/vko
- Palkkaus: n. 12,50-14,00eur/h, kokemuksen mukaan
- Työehtosopimus: Elintarvikealan TES
- Työsuhde: Boltin kautta
- Aloitus joustavasti sopimuksen mukaan
- Roolissa on hyvä mahdollisuus edetä

Tietoa työskentelypaikkakunnasta ja käytännön järjestelyissä:
Föglössä ei ole kaupungin palveluita: saarella on K-extra, kirjasto ja kuntosali, ja muutoin kaupungin palvelut löytyvät esim. Maarianhaminasta, 35min lauttamatkan ja 30min ajomatkan päästä. Saarella pärjää myös ilman autoa, sillä työpaikka on lähellä majoitusta ja Maarianhaminaan pääsee bussilla. Halutessasi järjestämme sinulle majoituksen: majoitut tyypillisesti toisen työntekijän kanssa rivitalokaksiossa tai -kolmiossa, ja vuokra on n. 300-450eur, ja sisältää, tai ei sisällä sähköä / vettä, riippuen asunnosta (saat tarkan tiedon työtarjouksen yhteydessä).

Tietoa Kalaneuvoksesta:
Kalaneuvos on Suomen kalateollisuuden suurin toimija ja alan edelläkävijä kalanjalostuksessa, kalatukkukaupassa, kalan tuonnissa ja viennissä sekä kalankasvatuksessa. Kalaneuvos on valmistanut korkealaatuisia kalatuotteita jo yli 40 vuoden ajan panostaen tuotteiden laadun lisäksi nykyaikaisiin tuotantomenetelmiin sekä henkilöstön hyvinvointiin. Kalaneuvos-brändin alta löytyy laaja valikoima herkullisia kalatuotteita. Lisätietoja: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Haethan työpaikkaa pian: paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.title: Dizajnéri a správcovia databáz
jobs.description:
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards translating complex operational data into actionable insights for business operations stakeholders; ensure models are performant, scalable, and governed.

Build and maintain automated workflows and business applications using Power Automate and Power Apps, reducing manual effort across core operations processes (approvals, data collection, escalation routing).

Own the data layer: write and optimize DAX measures and Power Query transformations; connect to sources including SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, and Snowflake where applicable.

Collaborate with business operations teams to gather, challenge, and translate requirements into technical solutions — including scope control and managing change requests.

Administer production and distribution of internal financial reports, compile various cross functional reports. Drive the reporting simplification and efficiency.

Prepare, clean, and analyze large datasets from various sources (ERP, operational, and financial systems).

Maintain solution documentation, workspace governance, and RLS (row-level security) configurations in line with organizational data access policies.

Troubleshoot and resolve incidents across the Power Platform environment; support end-user adoption through training and hands-on guidance.

Contribute to the Centre of Excellence (CoE) standards for naming conventions, deployment pipelines, version control, and template reuse across the team.

Work within a GBS or shared-services operating model, balancing multiple stakeholder demands with clear SLA management and transparent prioritization.

Collaborate with senior management and provide update on financial reports, progress and modifications. Explain the variances to senior leadership team.

Support data governance and documentation of data sources, logic, and model results.

Communicate findings and analytical results in a clear and actionable way to non-technical stakeholders.

Keep up to date with emerging trends in AI, machine learning, and Power Platform technologies.

jobs.title: Správcovia objektov
jobs.description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

Evidencia a aktualizácia inventára IT hardvéru a softvéru. Spolupráca pri nákupe, príprave a vydávaní IT techniky novým zamestnancom. Základná správa tlačového prostredia vrátane riešenia bežných problémov s tlačiarňami a skenermi. Podpora výrobných pracovísk pri riešení základných IT problémov ovplyvňujúcich výrobnú prevádzku. Spolupráca pri aktualizáciách operačných systémov, aplikácií a bezpečnostných nástrojov. Vykonávanie pravidelných kontrol pridelených IT systémov podľa definovaných postupov. Spolupráca pri vedení a aktualizácii IT dokumentácie, interných postupov a prevádzkových záznamov. Eskalácia zložitejších technických problémov na IT špecialistu alebo IT administrátora senior. jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

jobs.title: Opatrovatelia a asistenti v zariadeniach pre staršie osoby a osoby so zdravotným postihnutím
jobs.description:
Ak Ti nie je ľahostajný život ľudí ohrozených stratou bývania a s nepriaznivým zdravotným stavom, príď do Útulku a zariadenia opatrovateľskej služby sv. Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - sprostredkovávať kontakt, prípadne distribuovať a sprevádzať klienta k odborníkovi, do nadväzných služieb (napr. sociálne, psychologické, pedagogické, zdravotné služby a pod.) s ohľadom na potrebu klienta, - vykonávať technicko-administratívne úkony v rámci evidencie terénnej sociálnej práce, - priebežný rozvoj odborných a sociálnych kompetencií, účasť na vzdelávaní a supervíziách, - vykonávať činností prevažne v prirodzenom prostredí klienta (v domácnosti, komunite, vo voľnom priestranstve), - dodržiavať Štandardy terénnej sociálnej práce a terénnej práce vo vylúčení a Etického kódexu sociálneho pracovníka a asistenta sociálne práce Slovenskej republiky.

jobs.title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

Understanding of capacity planning, network resilience, and failure-domain design.

Strong leadership, prioritization, and incident-coordination skills.
English and Russian at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.
