jobs.title: POMOĆNIK/CA ZA DJECU S TEŠKOĆAMA U RAZVOJU
jobs.description:
POMOĆNIK/CA ZA DJECU S TEŠKOĆAMA U RAZVOJU na određeno nepuno radno vrijeme do 15.07.2027. godine

N A T J E Č A J

za zasnivanje radnog odnosa na određeno vrijeme ½ radnog vremena

I. Raspisuje se natječaj za zasnivanje radnog odnosa u Dječjem vrtiću Runović (u nastavku teksta: Dječji vrtić) na radno mjesto POMOĆNIKA ZA DJECU S TEŠKOĆAMA U RAZVOJU, na određeno vrijeme do 15.07.2027. godine na ½ radnog vremena 1 izvršitelj (M/Ž).

Uvjeti: SSS u trajanju od četiri godine.

Pored navedenih uvjeta kandidati moraju ispunjavati i opće uvjete propisane općim propisima o radu:

1. Punoljetnost

2. Hrvatsko državljanstvo

3. Radni iskustvo u trajanju od 6 mjeseci na poslovima pomoćnik/ce za djecu s teškoćama u razvoju

4. Potvrda o završenoj djelomičnoj edukaciji – pomoćnik/ca za rad s djecom s teškoćama u predškolskom sustavu

5. Zdravstvena sposobnost za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta pomoćnika za djecu s teškoćama u razvoju.

6. Da nije roditelj ili drugi član uže obitelji djeteta kojem se pruža potpora.

Radni odnos u Dječjem vrtiću ne može zasnovati osoba koja ima zapreke definirane člankom 25. Zakona.

II. Prijavi na natječaj (u nastavku teksta: prijava) obvezno se prilažu sljedeći dokumenti:

  • životopis
  • dokaz o državljanstvu (preslika domovnice, važeće osobne iskaznice, putovnice ili vojne
  • iskaznice, sukladno članku 29. stavku 1. Zakona o hrvatskom državljanstvu (Narodne novine,broj: 53/91., 70/91., 28/92., 113/93., 130/11. i 110/15.)
  • dokaz o odgovarajućem stupnju obrazovanja
  • elektronički zapis odnosno potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje
  • Potvrda o završenoj djelomičnoj edukaciji – pomoćnik/ca za rad s djecom s teškoćama u predškolskom sustavu
  • kao dokaz o nepostojanju zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa sukladno članku 25. Zakon predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju dostavljaju se sljedeći dokumenti (ne stariji od tri mjeseca računajući od dana objave natječaja na Hrvatskom zavodu za zapošljavanje):
  • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak prema članku 25. stavku 2. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju
  • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi prekršajni postupak prema članku 25. stavku 4. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju potvrda nadležnog Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad da kandidat nema izrečenu mjeru za zaštitu dobrobiti djeteta iz članka 25. stavka 10. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju.

Prijavu i životopis potrebno je vlastoručno potpisati.

U prijavi se navode osobni podaci podnositelja prijave (osobno ime, OIB, datum i mjesto rođenja, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona ili mobitela, e-mail adresa) i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se prijavljuje.

Uvjerenje o zdravstvenoj sposobnosti dostavlja izabrani kandidat prije zasnivanja radnog odnosa, tj. potpisivanja ugovora o radu.

Dokumenti se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici, a izabrani kandidat dužan je prije potpisivanja ugovora o radu dostaviti na uvid izvornike dokumentacije priložene uz prijavu.

Dopunu prijave moguće je podnijeti zaključno do dana isteka natječajnog roka.

Ispunjavanje uvjeta određuje se na posljednji dan natječajnog roka.

III. Na natječaju ravnopravno mogu sudjelovati kandidati oba spola sukladno članku 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova (Narodne novine, broj: 82/08. i 69/17.), a izrazi koji se koriste u ovom natječaju uporabljeni su neutralno i odnose se na muške i ženske osobe.

IV. Osobe koje prema posebnim propisima ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, moraju se u prijavi pozvati na to pravo, odnosno uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu i imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat može ostvariti pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja, sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj: 121/17., 98/19., 84/21. i 156/23.) (u nastavku teksta: Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima), članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine, broj: 33/92., 57/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 2/94., 76/94., 108/95., 108/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.) (u nastavku teksta: Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata), članku 47. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj: 84/21.) (u nastavku teksta: Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj: 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) (u nastavku teksta: Zakon o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji) i članku 22. Ustavnog zakona o pravima nacionalnih manjina (Narodne novine, broj: 155/02., 47/10., 80/10. i 93/11.) (u nastavku teksta: Ustavni zakon) dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo te ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prilikom zapošljavanja sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima, uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je dostaviti, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta i dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja iz članka 103. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima, dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava %20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti u skladu člankom 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata, uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je priložiti, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, i sve potrebne dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta odredbe na koju se poziva, odnosno dokaz o priznatom statusu, dokaz da to pravo već nije koristio te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (ugovor, rješenje, odluka, sporazum i slično), a pravo prednosti ostvaruje samo pod uvjetom da nema osoba koje to pravo ostvaruju u skladu s odredbama Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 47. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata, dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja:https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju- %20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf.

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom te dokaz o prestanku radnog odnosa kod posljednjeg poslodavca (ugovor, rješenje, odluka i sl.).

Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja sukladno članku 22. Ustavnog zakona uz prijavu na natječaj, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, nije dužan dokazivati svoj status pripadnika nacionalne manjine

V. U skladu s uredbom Europske unije 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 17. travnja 2016. godine te Zakonom o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (Narodne novine, broj: 42/18.), prijavom na ovaj natječaj podnositelj prijave daje privolu za prikupljanje i obradu podataka iz natječajne dokumentacije, u svrhu provedbe ovog natječaja.

VI. Prijava s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta podnosi se u roku osam dana od dana objave natječaja na mrežnim stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i to isključivo preporučeno poštom, na adresu:

Dječji vrtić Runović, Runović 211, 21261 Runović, s naznakom. „Za natječaj – pomoćnik za djecu s teškoćama u razvoju“.

VII. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadržava sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju.

VIII. Osobe koje podnesu nepotpune i nepravodobne prijave na natječaj ne smatraju se kandidatima prijavljenim na natječaj.

IX. Dječji vrtić zadržava pravo da po raspisanom natječaju ne mora izvršiti izbor, te se u tom slučaju donosi odluka o poništenju natječaja bez mogućnosti ulaganja pravnog lijeka.

X. O rezultatima natječaja, kandidati će biti obaviješteni u zakonskom roku.

XI. Ovaj će se natječaj objaviti na oglasnoj ploči i mrežnim stranicama Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i na oglasnoj ploči Dječjeg vrtića.

RAVNATELJICA DJEČJEG VRTIĆA RUNOVIĆ

Marija Repušić

jobs.title: UČITELJ/ICE GLAZBENE KULTURE
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (" Narodne novine" broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 07/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23.), ravnateljica Osnovne škole Koprivnički Ivanec, Kunovec, Seljačke bune 10, 48 000 Koprivnica, objavljuje N A T J E Č A J za popunu radnog mjesta 1. učitelj/ica glazbene kulture - 1 izvršitelj/ica s nepunim radnim vremenom od 20 sati ukupnog tjednog radnog vremena (8 do 10 sati redovite nastave tjedno), na neodređeno vrijeme, mjesto rada Kunovec/Koprivnički Ivanec. UVJETI:
  • nepostojanje zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa u školskoj ustanovi iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi ("Narodne novine" broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 07/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23.),
  • prema Zakonu o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi ("Narodne novine" broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 07/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23.),
  • prema Pravilniku o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi („Narodne novine“ broj 6/19, 75/20.).
Uz prijavu na natječaj, kandidati su dužni priložiti:
  • životopis,
  • dokaz o stupnju i vrsti stručne spreme,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu,
  • dokaz nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (ne starije od 30 dana od dana objave natječaja),
  • elektronički zapis o podacima evidentiranima u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO-a.
Prijavu je potrebno vlastoručno potpisati. Navedene isprave odnosno prilozi dostavljaju se u neovjerenoj preslici i ne vraćaju se kandidatu nakon završenog natječajnog postupka. Prije sklapanja ugovora o radu odabrani kandidat dužan je sve navedene priloge odnosno isprave dostaviti u izvorniku ili ovjerenoj preslici. Sukladno članku 13. stavku 2. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova („Narodne novine“ broj 82/08. i 69/17.) na natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Izrazi koji se koriste u natječaju, a imaju rodno značenje, koriste se neutralno i odnose jednako na muške i ženske osobe. Kandidati koji će se u prijavi pozivati na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužni su priložiti svu potrebnu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji („Narodne novine“ broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23.), članku 48. stavku 1.-3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata („Narodne novine“ broj 84/21.), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“ broj 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13. i 98/19.), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom („Narodne novine“ broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20.) dužna je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja i ovisno o kategoriji u koju ulazi sve potrebne dokaze (članak 103.st.1.Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja te priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju (čl.49.st.1. Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Prijave na javni natječaj s dokazima o ispunjavanju uvjeta dostavljaju se poštom ili osobno u roku od 8 dana od dana objave natječaja, odnosno zaključno do 20.10.2026. godine, s naznakom „ZA NATJEČAJ – UČITELJ/ICA GLAZBENE KULTURE“ na adresu: OSNOVNA ŠKOLA KOPRIVNIČKI IVANEC, KUNOVEC, SELJAČKE BUNE 10, 48 000 KOPRIVNICA Nepotpune i nepravodobno dostavljene prijave neće se razmatrati. Kandidatom se smatra samo osoba koja podnese pravodobnu i potpunu prijavu te ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja. Ovaj Javni natječaj objavit će se na oglasnim pločama i mrežnim stranicama Škole i Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje. O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će, po završetku natječajnog postupka, biti obaviješteni na temelju obavijesti na mrežnim stranicama Škole (www.os-koprivnicki-ivanec.skole.hr). Za kandidate je obvezno usmeno vrednovanje koje priprema i provodi Povjerenstvo za vrednovanje kandidata na temelju Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi Koprivnički Ivanec. Područje provjere, pravni i drugi izvori za pripremu kandidata za usmeno vrednovanje, vrijeme i mjesto održavanja usmenog vrednovanja bit će objavljeno na web stranici Škole: www.os-koprivnicki-ivanec.skole.hr Podnošenjem prijave na natječaj kandidat daje izričitu privolu Osnovnoj školi Koprivnički Ivanec za prikupljanje, korištenje i obradu svih dostavljenih podataka u svrhu provedbe natječaja sukladno propisima koji uređuju zaštitu osobnih podataka (Opća uredbe (EU) 2016/679) o zaštiti osobnih podatka i Zakon o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka („Narodne novine“ broj 42/18.).

Zakona o ustanovama („Narodne novine“ broj: 76/93, 29/97, 47/99, 35/08, 127/19, 151/22) 5.hrvatsko državljanstvo Na temelju odredbe članka 13. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova, na oglašeno radno mjesto mogu se javiti osobe obaju spolova. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj kandidat je dužan priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta javnog natječaja u izvorniku/elektroničkom zapisu ili ovjerenom presliku, i to:
  • životopis (uključujući kontakt podatke), vlastoručno potpisan
  • dokaz o hrvatskom državljanstvu (domovnica, važeća osobna iskaznica ili putovnica)
  • dokaz o stečenom akademskom zvanju i akademskom stupnju (diploma)
  • elektronički zapis, odnosno potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje iz koje su vidljivi podaci o poslodavcu, početku i prestanku osiguranja, stvarnoj i potrebnoj stručnoj spremi, radnom vremenu i trajanju staža osiguranja
  • dokaz o ostvarenom radnom iskustvu na poslovima traženog akademskog zvanja i - akademskog stupnja (potvrda ili uvjerenje poslodavca ili preslike Ugovora o radu)
  • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv podnositelja prijave ne vodi kazneni postupak, ne starije od 30 dana od dana objave natječaja
  • izjava kandidata o nepostojanju zapreke iz članka 39. stavka 2. Zakona o ustanovama („Narodne novine“ broj: 76/93, 29/97, 47/99, 35/08, 127/19, 151/22), vlastoručno potpisana
Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužan se u prijavi na natječaj pozvati na to pravo i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Da bi ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, kandidat koji ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava, dužan je uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, kao i rješenje o priznatom statusu, odnosno potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102., stavak 1.-3. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti i dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta prednosti pri zapošljavanju, prema propisu koji je dostupan na Web stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja, putem poveznice: https://branitelji.gov.hr/o-ministarstvu/djelokrug/mjere/zaposljavanje-4413/prednost-pri-zaposljavanju/4414 https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Kandidat koji se u prijavi poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21, 13/26), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti i dokaze utvrđene u članku 49. stavku 1. navedenog Zakona: https://branitelji.gov.hr/zaposljavanje-4413/4413 https://www.zakon.hr/z/2851/zakon-o-civilnim-stradalnicima-iz-domovinskog-rata https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 48.f. Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“ broj: 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), uz prijavu na natječaj, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, dužan je priložiti i rješenje ili potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz koje je vidljivo takvo pravo. Kandidat koji se u prijavi poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20), uz prijavu na natječaj dužan je, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u javnom natječaju. Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave na natječaj neće se razmatrati. Kandidati koji ispunjavaju formalno - pravne uvjete iz natječaja, a podnijeli su pravovremene i potpune prijave, bit će pozvani na usmeni razgovor. O vremenu usmenog razgovora, kandidati će biti obaviješteni putem elektronske pošte nakon isteka roka za dostavljanje dokumentacije. Kandidati koji ne pristupe usmenom razgovoru smatra se da su povukli prijavu i više se ne smatraju kandidatima prijavljenim na natječaj. Ravnatelja (m/ž) imenuje Upravno vijeće Centra za pružanje usluga u zajednici Svitanje, uz prethodnu suglasnost ministra Ministarstva rada, mirovinskoga sustava, obitelji i socijalne politike. Osoba imenovana za ravnatelja (m/ž) sklapa s Centrom za pružanje usluga u zajednici Svitanje ugovor o radu u punom radnom vremenu na četiri godine. Ista osoba može biti ponovno imenovana za ravnatelja (m/ž). Prijavom na natječaj kandidat daje privolu Centru za pružanje usluga u zajednici Svitanje za prikupljanje i obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u prijavi povodom ovoga natječaja te dokumentaciji dostavljenoj s prijavom, u svrhu odabira kandidata te privolu za objavu informacije o izabranoj i imenovanoj osobi koja se objavljuje na internetskoj stranici Centra za pružanje usluga u zajednici Svitanje (www.centar-svitanje.hr), a koja uključuje ime i prezime odabranog kandidata te struku. Privola za prikupljanje i obradu osobnih podataka je uvjet za prijavu na ovaj natječaj. Kandidat može u svakom trenutku bez objašnjenja odustati od dane privole i zatražiti prestanak aktivnosti obrade svojih osobnih podataka, o čemu će mu se izdati potvrda. Prijave na natječaj podnose se poštom (preporučenom pošiljkom) u roku od 8 dana od objave javnog natječaja u Narodnim novinama, na adresu: Centar za pružanje usluga u zajednici Svitanje, Trg Tomislava dr. Bardeka 10/10 III. kat, Koprivnica, s naznakom: »Natječaj za ravnatelja (m/ž) – ne otvarati«. O rezultatu natječaja kandidati će biti obaviješteni u zakonskom roku sukladno članku 41. stavku 3. Zakona o ustanovama.

jobs.title: Value Strategist
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs is looking for a Value Strategist to help our customers identify, quantify, and realize the business value of ElevenLabs across our portfolio, with a primary focus on ElevenAgents.

This is a senior individual contributor role within our global Revenue organization, spanning the full customer lifecycle from early sales conversations through proof of concept, deployment, renewal, and expansion. You will work directly with customers and prospects to understand their businesses, build the case for investment, and establish how that value will be measured over time.

On our most strategic accounts, Deployment Strategists in our Forward Deployed Engineering team already build account-specific business cases and ROI narratives as part of delivery. You will partner with them rather than duplicate that work. Your mandate is the value discipline across the whole book: the Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial accounts where no one is embedded, and where value today is quantified deal by deal or not at all. You will build the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, and playbooks that let every seller articulate and measure value consistently, and you will use what you learn from strategic deployments to make that methodology sharper.

This is not a quota-carrying role, nor is it a traditional advisory function. We are looking for a builder and a doer: someone who can engage credibly with senior customer stakeholders, get deep into a customer's operations and data, build rigorous models themselves, and turn ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable recommendations.

You will define how ElevenLabs understands, measures, and communicates customer value globally.

In this role you will

  • Shape value from the beginning. Partner with Revenue teams and prospects early in the sales cycle to understand customer priorities, identify high-value opportunities, and establish the business case for investing in ElevenLabs.

  • Build our global value strategy. Develop the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, discovery approaches, and playbooks that define how ElevenLabs approaches value across industries and use cases.

  • Scale what works. Turn bespoke work with our largest customers into repeatable approaches that enable our Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial teams to articulate and measure value without requiring bespoke support for every customer.

  • Identify where ElevenLabs can have the greatest impact. Develop a deep understanding of a customer's business, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities to determine which use cases have the greatest potential and why.

  • Quantify the opportunity. Build rigorous financial and operational models that translate ElevenLabs use cases into measurable outcomes across revenue, cost, productivity, customer experience, and other relevant dimensions.

  • Define how value will be proven. Establish success metrics and measurement approaches for proofs of concept and deployments so that customers and ElevenLabs have a shared understanding of what success looks like from the outset.

  • Measure value realization. Partner with customers and internal teams after deployment to understand the impact ElevenLabs is delivering, identify gaps between expected and realized value, and determine where additional opportunities exist.

  • Support expansion and long-term customer value. Use insights from existing deployments to help customers understand what they have achieved and identify where ElevenLabs can drive additional impact.

  • Work directly with the data. Analyze customer and industry data, build models, pressure-test assumptions, and develop recommendations yourself. You should be equally comfortable working in the details and communicating the implications.

  • Partner with Deployment. On strategic accounts, work alongside Deployment Strategists who own the account-level business case, contributing methodology and capturing what works into reusable assets. Across the rest of the book, be the primary owner of value quantification and measurement.

  • Influence senior stakeholders. Communicate complex analysis simply and credibly, and engage with senior leaders internally and externally when the opportunity requires it.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of relevant experience across operating roles, strategy, management consulting, analytics, finance, customer strategy, or other roles requiring rigorous business problem solving.

  • Strong operating judgment. You understand how businesses work and can quickly get underneath a customer's operating model, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities.

  • Exceptional analytical ability. You can personally build sophisticated financial and operational models, work with incomplete or imperfect information, make assumptions explicit, and turn analysis into decisions.

  • Structured problem solving. You are comfortable starting with an ambiguous question such as "Where could AI create the most value in this business?" and developing a rigorous approach to answering it.

  • Customer credibility. You can work directly with customers across functions and levels, ask incisive questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and establish trust quickly.

  • Commercial judgment. You understand how business value connects to technology investment decisions and can partner closely with Revenue teams while maintaining an objective, customer-first perspective.

  • Excellent communication. You can distill complex analysis into a clear point of view and communicate it effectively in writing and verbally, from working teams through senior executives.

  • A builder mentality. You are excited to start by doing the work yourself, learn from customers, and turn what works into scalable methodologies and tools.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and pace. You can move quickly across industries, customer types, and use cases while maintaining a high bar for analytical rigor.

  • Ability to operate globally. You are comfortable partnering with teams and customers across regions and traveling when valuable for customer work.

  • Willingness to travel. Must be willing and able to travel up to 10% of the time.

Bonus points

  • Experience in strategy or management consulting, particularly in operational transformation, technology, customer experience, or growth.

  • Experience as an operator within a technology company or other fast-moving business.

  • Experience working on AI, automation, customer experience, or technology-enabled business transformation.

  • Experience developing business cases, value frameworks, or analytical methodologies that were ultimately scaled beyond an individual project or customer.

  • Experience working with enterprise customers on complex, cross-functional initiatives.

Location

This is a global role within the Revenue organization. The role can be based in San Francisco or remotely, with the option to work from our San Francisco office.

You will work with customers and ElevenLabs teams across regions and should expect travel for customer meetings and onsite work when it meaningfully advances the work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.description:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

About the Role
As a Customer Support Engineer, youʼll be on the front lines of our customer
experience. Youʼll work directly with customers to quickly triage issues, debug
problems, and ensure theyʼre getting the most out of HappyRobotʼs AI platform.

This role is a hybrid between technical support and customer engineering: youʼll
diagnose issues, design and test quick solutions, and collaborate closely with both
engineering and product teams to make our platform even stronger.

Youʼll also apply prompt engineering skills to help customers fine-tune their AI
workers, ensuring accuracy, reliability, and speed across real-world logistics
workflows.

This role is ideal for someone with strong technical fundamentals who wants to
grow into a more senior customer engineering or product-facing position over
time.


Tech Profile

  • Comfortable Full-Stack: Python, React, TypeScript, Node.js.

  • Experience managing APIs and integrations with third-party systems.

  • Some exposure to infrastructure and cloud deployments.

  • Familiarity with LLM prompting and tuning of voices/transcribers; eager to
    experiment and iterate.

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills — quick at identifying the root
    cause of issues.

Must Have

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English — able to explain
    technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Strong ability to triage, prioritize, and resolve issues independently under
    tight deadlines.

  • Curiosity and adaptability: you can learn customer workflows quickly and
    propose solutions.

  • Self-starter mindset — comfortable working independently, with a bias toward
    action.

  • Passion for delivering outstanding customer experiences.

Why join us?

  • Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

  • Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

  • Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

  • Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

  • Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

 

Our Operating Principles


Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

 

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

 

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

 

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

 

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

 

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

jobs.title: Logistic & Event Specialist
jobs.description:
**Logistics Specialist — Events, Cleaning & Facility Operations**

**Hype Siivous | Helsinki, Finland Full-time or part-time**

Hype Siivous is looking for a reliable, practical and proactive Logistics Specialist to support event preparation, cleaning and daily operations at an innovation facility hosting approximately 500–600 internal community and private events annually.

This hands-on role combines furniture setup, equipment movement, cleaning and facility support. You will take ownership of assigned tasks, communicate clearly and help leave every space safe, organised and ready for use.

Cleaning is a regular and essential part of this position. The role is not limited to event logistics or furniture preparation.

**_YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES_**

Event preparation and logistics Prepare meeting rooms and event spaces according to agreed floor plans and event requirements. Arrange tables, chairs and equipment with attention to presentation, accessibility and safe movement. Handle load-in and load-out: move furniture, equipment and supplies into and out of the venue. Move items between nearby spaces or locations, including driving when assigned. Support orderly venue entry and departure, keeping entrances, exits and circulation routes clear. Restore furniture and equipment after events. Check equipment and furniture and report damage or missing items. Follow safe lifting and handling procedures, using suitable equipment and team support.

Cleaning and facility care Clean and prepare spaces before, during and after events. Vacuum and mop floors, wipe tables, chairs and accessible surfaces, empty bins and remove ordinary waste. Carry out assigned cleaning of meeting rooms, event spaces, common areas, kitchens or kitchenettes, and washrooms. Leave spaces clean, organised and ready for their next use. Use cleaning products and equipment safely, following training and site instructions. Report maintenance needs, missing supplies and cleanliness or safety concerns.

Communication and ownership Coordinate with the Event Manager and facility team on schedules, layouts, changes and readiness. Plan and prioritise work during busy periods. Complete tasks with limited supervision while keeping colleagues informed. Provide clear handovers and report delays or unfinished tasks promptly. Follow through on commitments, take responsibility and ask for support when needed. Help coordinate practical setup tasks with colleagues when assigned.

The balance between logistics, event preparation and cleaning varies with the event schedule and facility needs. Duties are carried out within the agreed role, training and safe working practices.

**_What we are looking for_**

Relevant experience in event logistics, furniture setup, cleaning, facility operations or similar practical work. A valid category B driving licence and driving experience. Excellent practical English for understanding instructions, coordinating tasks and reporting issues. Finnish and/or Swedish language skills are an advantage, but are not required. Ability to safely perform physically demanding logistics and cleaning duties, using appropriate handling equipment and team support. Good understanding of room layouts and furniture positioning. Strong organisation, attention to detail and a cooperative attitude towards logistics and cleaning duties. Initiative, practical leadership and a strong sense of responsibility. A calm, solution-focused approach when schedules change or deadlines are tight. Ability to work independently while staying connected with the team.

Work eligibility: Applicants must have a valid right to work in Finland for this role and a lawful basis to reside in Finland. Where a residence permit is required, it must be valid and allow the work concerned. Relevant documentation will be verified before employment begins.

Preferred qualifications: An Occupational Safety Card (Työturvallisuuskortti) and Hygiene Passport (Hygieniapassi) are advantages, but are not mandatory requirements for applying.

**_Employment and working hours_**

Full-time: Permanent employment, 37.5 hours per week. Full-time work and onboarding start on 15 January 2027.

Part-time: Starts immediately and continues until further notice. Variable working hours of 0–20 hours per week. No minimum weekly hours are guaranteed.

Schedule: Monday to Saturday, with agreed early-morning, daytime or evening shifts according to event bookings. Workload varies seasonally, with greater staffing needs during busy periods. Flexibility means working agreed shifts—not being available around the clock. 6.5 hours a day.

Pay: According to the applicable collective agreement.

**_What we offer_**

A varied role combining event logistics, cleaning and facility support. An active innovation environment with community and private events. Opportunities to take ownership of practical operations and develop coordination skills. Collaboration with event management and the facility team. Onboarding into venue layouts, equipment, cleaning methods and safety procedures.

**_How to apply_**

Send your CV and a short introduction to **_employment@hypesiivous.fi_** by 31 October 2026.

Please include: Your relevant logistics, event preparation and cleaning experience. Your driving experience and licence category. Your language skills, including English and any Finnish or Swedish. Your availability and earliest starting date. Whether you are applying for part-time or full-time work. Whether you hold an Occupational Safety Card or Hygiene Passport. Confirmation of whether you currently have the right to work in Finland for this role.

Please do not send passport or residence-permit copies with your initial application. Relevant documentation will be checked securely before employment begins.

We assess applicants on their skills, experience and ability to perform the role safely.

· Perform thermomechanical analysis across metallic, composite, bonded, and polymeric structures under thermal cycling and operational loads

· Support experimental characterisation of propellant, liner, and bonded joint materials; feed test results (lap shear, peel, tensile, and DMA data) into material models and allowables

· Correlate FE predictions against strain gauge, load, and thermal test data; validate and update models accordingly

· Prepare stress reports, margin-of-safety calculations, and design justification documentation

Requirements

· Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field

· 3–5 years of industry experience in stress analysis of aerospace or mechanical structures

We are looking for a highly capable Flight Physics & Performance Engineer to support the development, implementation, and validation of high-fidelity simulation environments for missile system performance analysis. · Proven coding experience preferred: Python, C/C++, Rust.

· Experience with SIL, CIL, and HIL simulations and verification processes.

· Strong technical writing skills and experience in producing advanced engineering documentation.

jobs.title: Varastopäällikkö
jobs.description:
**Etsimme varastopäällikköä kehittämään ja johtamaan varastomme toimintaa**

Sun Effects Oy on suunnittelu- ja tuotantotalo, joka lisäksi vuokraa laadukasta tapahtumakalustoa ja maahantuo valaisinlaitteita.

**Valo-, nosto- ja ripustuskaluston** (rigging) lisäksi varastoimme **lavastus- ja somistemateriaalia**, joka ei aina sovellu tavanomaiseen lavavarastointiin. Jokainen kalustoryhmä vaatii oman tapansa säilyttää, pakata ja käsitellä – ja juuri siinä tarvitsemme sinun osaamistasi.

**Varastopäällikkönä** pyörität varaston arkea, johdat pientä tiimiä käytännönläheisesti ja ymmärrät kaluston liiketoiminnallisen potentiaalin. Toivomme, että sinulla on kokemuksen lisäksi omaa näkemystä varastonhallinnasta: miten tilaa, sijainteja, tavaravirtoja ja työvaiheita järjestetään niin, että kalusto löytyy, pysyy kunnossa ja liikkuu sujuvasti. Keikkojen pakkaamisesta ja purkamisesta huolehtivat yleensä projekteille palkatut teknikot.

**Tehtävässäsi**

· **Johdat varaston päivittäistä toimintaa** – keräilyt, lähtö- ja paluutarkastukset, kaluston kunnossapito ja huoltojen ohjaus, inventaariot sekä varaston järjestys, turvallisuus ja erilaisille kalustoryhmille sopivat säilytys- ja pakkausratkaisut.

· **Hallitset tavaravirrat** – varastomme kautta kulkevat myös maahantuomiemme valaisinlaitteiden lähetykset sekä päivittäiset pakettilähetykset ja -vastaanotot. Huolehdit, että saapuvat ja lähtevät toimitukset kirjataan, tarkastetaan ja lähetetään ajallaan.

· **Toimit esihenkilönä** varaston tuntityöntekijöille ja tarpeen mukaan työskenteleville freelancereille: suunnittelet työvuorot, perehdytät, jaat työt ja huolehdit, että jokainen tietää mitä tehdään ja miksi.

· **Varmistat riittävät resurssit -** buukkaat apuvoimia tarpeen mukaan huomioiden kiirehuiput ja loma-ajat.

· **Kehität vuokraustoiminnan tuloksellisuutta** – seuraat kaluston käyttöastetta ja kuntoa, tuot näkemystä hankintoihin ja hinnoitteluun, huolehdit että vauriot, puutteet ja lisätyöt kirjataan ja laskutetaan, ja palvelet vuokra-asiakkaita noudoissa ja palautuksissa.

· **Koordinoit logistiikkaa** - vastaat kuormien suunnittelusta ja kommunikoit sujuvasti tuotannon, myynnin ja logistiikkakumppaniemme kanssa kuljetusaikatauluista

· **Kehität varaston toimintaa** – sinulla on näkemystä prosessien, Rentmanin hyödyntämisen, viivakoodi-/RFID-merkintöjen, työturvallisuuden ja tilankäytön kehittämiseen.

· **Toimit kiinteässä yhteistyössä** huollon, tuottajien ja myynnin kanssa ja tuot varaston näkökulman mukaan jo projektien suunnitteluvaiheessa.

**Toivomme sinulta**

· **Ymmärrystä keikka-alan rytmistä ja halua oppia**, mitä kalusto vaatii. Kokemus tapahtuma-, AV-, valo-, ääni- tai vuokraamoalalta on plussaa, mutta ei välttämätöntä.

· **Esihenkilö- tai työnjohtokokemusta**, mieluiten myös vaihtuvista keikkatyöntekijöistä.

· **Kaupallista silmää** - näet kaluston pääomana, joka hyvin hoidettuna ja oikein käytettynä tuottaa.

· **Kokemusta varastonhallinta- tai vuokrausjärjestelmistä** – käytämme Rentmania, jonka tuntemus on etu.

· **Järjestelmällisyyttä ja kykyä hahmottaa isoja kokonaisuuksia** – organisoit, ennakoit ja siedät painetta. Pidät langat käsissäsi, vaikka samaan aikaan on käynnissä useita tuotantoja, vuokrauksia ja toimituksia.

· **Selkeää viestintää** suomeksi ja englanniksi.

· **Sujuvia perustaitoja toimisto-ohjelmista** (esim. Microsoft 365 tai Google Workspace)

· **B-ajokorttia ja työturvallisuuskorttia.**

**Katsomme eduksi**

· Kokemus prosessien kehittämisestä

· Trukinajotaito

· C-ajokortti ja kuormansidonnan osaaminen

jobs.title: Academic Dean for MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio
jobs.description:
Location: 100% remote (Ohio residency required)

Classification: Full-time, exempt
Reports to: School Leader

Pay Range: $40.00 - $48.00 per hour

Welcome to Miaplaza!

Our vision is to elevate online learning by applying the most successful approaches in virtual education to create an accessible and inclusive homeschool curriculum platform where all students can be successful!

MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio is our newest offering for Ohio families looking for a flexible public school option. The school will serve grades 7-11 in its first year. The school aims to serve 250 students year one, with plans to grow to over 1,000 students by 2030. ð

Role Summary

The Academic Dean leads the instructional team and is the school's authority on academic standards at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio (MOAO), including student conduct, attendance compliance, and academic integrity. This person is the primary leader for teacher supervision and development, oversees academic data and testing coordination, and works closely with the Student Support team (counselors and advisors), who lead student interventions and support. As a member of the MOAO leadership team, the Academic Dean contributes to schoolwide strategy and helps keep instruction, student culture, and compliance with Ohio requirements working together. The role calls for someone who can coach teachers with warmth and rigor, handle sensitive student and family situations with sound judgment, and use data to make decisions.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

Instructional Staff Management

  • Directly supervise instructional staff, holding weekly 1:1s focused on coaching, support, and goal setting.

  • Lead recruiting, onboarding, and training for new teachers.

  • Observe live instruction and office hours on a bi-weekly basis and provide actionable feedback.

  • Monitor grading practices to ensure students receive timely, high-quality feedback.

  • Complete annual and semi-annual walk-throughs and performance reviews as outlined by the ODEW and manage bi-weekly timecard approvals.

  • Coordinate instructional and grading coverage for teacher absences.

  • Address performance concerns through clear expectations, documentation, and, when needed, formal improvement plans in partnership with People Operations.

Student Conduct, Attendance & Academic Integrity

  • Own the school's student conduct process, from initial report through investigation, determination, and documentation, applying policy consistently and fairly and creating policy where needed.

  • Oversee academic integrity cases, including investigating suspected plagiarism, AI misuse, and other violations, and ensuring consistent, well-documented outcomes.

  • Own the school's truancy and attendance compliance process, including required notifications, documentation, and filings under Ohio law.

  • Partner with the Student Support team, which leads outreach, intervention plans, and ongoing student support. Hand off cases and coordinate so that accountability and support work together.

  • Serve as the escalation point for teachers and Student Support on conduct, attendance, and integrity concerns.

  • Communicate with students and families about conduct and integrity decisions in a way that is clear, respectful, and focused on getting students back on track.

  • Maintain accurate records and report on trends in conduct, attendance, and integrity cases to school leadership.Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â Â 

  • Keep handbooks, policies, and procedures current in these areas.

Academic Data & Testing Coordination

  • Analyze course-, teacher-, and school-level data on performance, engagement, and attendance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.

  • Turn data into action by recommending and implementing instructional strategies, and share insights with Student Support to inform their interventions.

  • Serve as the school's testing coordinator for Ohio state assessments and other required or school-administered testing, including scheduling, proctoring logistics, test security, accommodations coordination, and make-up testing.

  • Partner with the appropriate teams on state data reporting, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

  • Prepare clear summaries of academic and testing data for leadership, teachers, and families.

Professional Development

  • Design and lead regular PD sessions for instructional staff, informed by teacher feedback, observation, and student data.

  • Build a culture of continuous improvement, reflective practice, and growth for the instructional team.

  • Collaborate with school and company leadership on schoolwide professional learning priorities.

Curriculum & Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between the instructional team and the Content team on curriculum, checkpoint assignments, and MiaPrep platform issues.

  • Gather teacher and student feedback and make curriculum recommendations.

  • Support consistency in instructional practice and expectations across courses and departments.

  • Lead regular instructional team meetings to align resources, expectations, and practices.

  • Assist teachers in comparing their curriculum to the OST blueprints to identify gaps, and create a plan to fill these gaps in the short and long term.Â 

What We're Looking For

  • Proven leadership experience managing, coaching, or mentoring teachers

  • Sound judgment and a steady hand with sensitive student, family, and staff situations; knows when to resolve and when to escalate

  • A collaborative approach to working across teams, especially with student support professionals

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including documentation that holds up to scrutiny

  • A fair, consistent, relationship-first approach to discipline and accountability

  • Comfort with data and the ability to translate it into clear decisions

  • Exceptional organization and follow-through across many concurrent priorities

  • Resilient, adaptable, and committed to continuous improvement in a fast-paced environment

  • Growth mindset with a focus on coaching and constructive feedback

THIS POSITION IS FOR A CURRENT VACANCY, AND THE EMPLOYER INTENDS TO FILL THIS POSITION BY DECEMBER 1ST, 2026.



Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree required; master's degree in education, educational leadership, or a related field preferred

  • Valid Ohio teaching license and/or administrator license, or ability to obtain one, to be confirmed against current requirements

  • At least 3 years of teaching experience

  • At least 2 years of experience in a leadership role such as department chair, instructional coach, dean, or assistant principal

  • Experience in virtual school settings or teaching online

  • Experience supervising employees and conducting evaluations or performance reviews

  • Comfort working in online learning environments and with learning management and student information systems

The Ideal Candidate Brings:

  • Experience administering or coordinating standardized testing and working with student assessment data

  • Experience as a member of a founding team for a new school

Compensation & Benefits

  • The expected starting pay range is $40.00 - $48.00 per hour. An Academic Dean at MiaPrep Online Academy of Ohio works an average of 40 hours per week. When working year-round, this can equate to an annual pay range of $83,000 - $99,800.

Full-time employees receive 16 hours of floating holiday PTO per quarter and accumulate additional PTO at the rate of 1 hour per every 15 hours worked. Annually, this amounts to approximately 200hours per year or 25 eight-hour days on average.

Tether Evolution: At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.

Why Join Us?

Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If youâre passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. Weâve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.

If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job

QV.AC is a general purpose AI assistant that runs locally on your devices. It gives people real control over their data and how they use AI. No cloud dependency, no data harvesting, and no one else's servers between you and your assistant. Our focus is local, on-device, privacy-preserving AI, connected across Tether's peer-to-peer ecosystem. We're building the AI assistant people actually own. Product sets the direction.

We're looking for a Product Engineering Lead to turn that direction into features people love, built to a standard that holds up on real devices with real constraints. You lead the teams that build QV.AC's features and app experience on top of our local AI stack, each with its own lead. You report directly to the CTO and take direction from product. Product owns the what and the why. You own the how and the engineering bar.

The split is roughly 70% engineering leadership and 30% product. You're a combination of three things. You're an engineering leader who has helped teams ship consumer products at speed. You have real product sense and can partner with PMs as an equal, shaping what gets built, not just executing it. And you have an intuition for AI systems and their limits, so you can turn emerging capabilities into features that work reliably on-device, without needing to build the models yourself.

Responsibilities

  • Product Partnership - Work alongside QV.AC's product managers to turn vision and roadmap into scoped, buildable work.- Push back when scope and reality don't match, and propose better paths when they exist.- Bring an engineering perspective to product decisions, especially on what local models can do well today and what they can't yet.- Help the team move fast, using AI tools and quick prototypes to validate ideas before committing to them.

  • Leadership - Create clarity around team goals and make sure everyone knows what success looks like.- Mentor team leads to build strong team operating systems, improve how their teams work with others, and grow as leaders.- Lead by example: roll up your sleeves when the team needs it, and step back when they're ready to own it.



Mandatory:

  • Experience managing engineers or engineering leads who ship consumer product, ideally AI-powered apps.

  • Strong product sense: you can tell a good feature from a busy one.

  • Intuition for applied AI and on-device constraints: model size, latency, memory, battery, and the gap between a good demo and a reliable feature. You don't need ML research expertise, because our core abstracts it away.

  • You use AI tools heavily in your own work and enjoy experimenting with new models and capabilities.

  • Deep JavaScript and React.

  • Initiative, curiosity, resilience, and the ability to give and receive direct critique.

Preferred:

  • Bonus: Experience with local or on-device inference, LLM evals, cross-platform mobile and desktop apps, or open source.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods.Â We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

Senior Accountant

Fort de 50 ans d'existence, Baker Tilly Luxembourg est l'une des principales fiduciaires du pays, offrant une gamme complète de services aux entreprises nationales et internationales.

Baker Tilly Luxembourg est membre indépendant du réseau Baker Tilly International, présent dans 147 pays. Classé parmi les 10 plus grands réseaux de sociétés de conseil, comptabilité et d'audit au monde, il compte 754 bureaux et emploie plus de 50.400 personnes.

Idéalement situés en face de l'échangeur d'Howald, nos bureaux bénéficient d'un emplacement stratégique, avec un accès direct à la gare ferroviaire, aux autoroutes A3, A1 et A6, à des lignes de bus reliant le centre-ville et l'aéroport, ainsi qu'à une station de vélos et désormais le Tram, plaçant ainsi Baker Tilly Luxembourg au cœur de toutes les liaisons.

En rejoignant notre équipe en tant que Senior Accountant, vous contribuerez activement à une croissance ambitieuse au sein de l'un de nos départements, en mettant à profit et en développant votre expertise.

Vos responsabilités

• Vous serez en charge de la comptabilité de clients actifs dans les domaines les plus divers
• Vous serez en charge de l'établissement des comptes annuels
• Vous établirez les déclarations périodiques TVA et les déclarations fiscales sociétés

• Vous êtes titulaire d'une formation de niveau Bac+3/4 en comptabilité, économie ou gestion
• Vous avez une expérience d'au moins 3 à 5 ans dans un poste similaire, idéalement acquise en fiduciaire
• Vous êtes organisé(e) et êtes capable de travailler en autonomie

• Vous êtes flexible et doté d'un bon relationnel
• Maîtrise du français (la connaissance de l'anglais sera considérée comme un atout)
• Maitrise du logiciel comptable BOB est un atout
• Vous maîtrisez l'environnement Windows

Ce que nous vous offrons !  

• Un environnement de travail dynamique et innovant, au sein d'une fiduciaire de renom faisant partie d'un grand réseau international
• La possibilité de travailler sur des projets variés, stimulants et enrichissants
