jobs.title: Obsluha strojů na balení, plnění a etiketování, Obsluha strojů na balení, plnění a etiketování
Projektstilling i projekt med at være kirke for unge i Aarhus
jobs.description:
Kan du se dig selv i en vision om at folkekirken tilbyder et sted for unge i Aarhus, hvor man kan hænge ud og indgå i fællesskaber? Er du relationelt orienteret? Og har du det fint med både at sidde til planlægningsmøder og løfte konkrete, praktiske opgaver – så tror vi, at du vil finde dette opslag interessant.

For godt et års tid siden åbnede Christianskirken i Aarhus STEDET. Her kan unge i Aarhus hænge ud, sidde med deres studier, deltage i aktiviteter, møde andre unge til fællesspisning og få et møde med kirken i øjenhøjde. Er du den, som skal være med til at videreudvikle og konsolidere dét arbejde?

 

STEDET er fysisk lokation på Katrinebjerg, men det er også en måde at vise at kirken er mere end gudstjenester; at kirken er fællesskaber, samtaler om stort og småt, mulighed for at møde andre unge og et pitstop i den hverdag, som unge lever i.

 

Der er tale om en etårig projektstilling på 30 timer ugentligt, med eventuel mulighed for forlængelse, hvis den fremtidige finansiering falder på plads.

Opgaver

Som projektmedarbejder ved Christianskirken, skal du overordnet set være med til at udleve kirkens vision:

Christianskirken - et livstræ med mange grene, der

·        Rækker synligt ud i sognet

·        Peger opad og inspirerer til at søge Gud

·        Styrker og engagerer den enkelte og menigheden

 

    - for at gøre evangeliet kendt, troet og levet.

 

Konkret betyder det, at…

·        du – i samarbejde med bl.a. menighedsrådet, projektets styregruppe og den anden projektmedarbejder – sikrer den daglige drift på STEDET, og i mange sammenhænge er du STEDETs ansigt udadtil.

·        du er vært på STEDET, så de unge der kommer ind ad døren, mærker at de er velkomne her.

·        du ærligt kan sige, at du har lyst til at arbejde sammen med unge, er imødekommende og kan tage initiativ til fx en snak eller igangsætte brætspil.

·        du indgår i et samarbejde med ansatte og frivillige om at planlægge og afvikle forskellige typer af aktiviteter. Fx fællesspisning hvor du veksler mellem at stå i front og ”være den” og stå i baggrunden og få andre til at lykkes i deres frivillige opgave.

·        du sidder med i styregruppen (som består af repræsentanter for menighedsråd, ungdomsråd og ansatte ved Christianskirken) for STEDET, og er med til at sætte retning for projektet, og i mange tilfælde er du ansvarlig for at det som besluttes dér, bliver til virkelighed.

·        du vil være ansvarlig for rekruttering, fastholdelse og udrustning af frivillige. For STEDET er ikke noget, som laves for de unge, men noget vi laver sammen med unge.

·        du får til opgave at pleje og videreudvikle vores netværk med samarbejdspartnere og interessenter i Aarhus. Det er fx uddannelsesinstitutioner, NGO’er som arbejder med unge, naboer på Katrinebjerg, nøglepersoner i Aarhus kommune og kirker i Aarhus.

·        du løser forskellige administrative og koordinerende opgaver såsom at have overblik over vores forbrug og sørge for at betalinger sker rettidigt; booking af lokaler; forberedelse af møder, at vores tillidsbod har varer på hylderne m.v.

 

I det daglige er din nærmeste kollega vores projektmedarbejder, som har fokus på kommunikation og aktiviteter og den præst, som er tilknyttet STEDET og er projektleder. I har hver jeres ansvarsområder, men arbejder sammen om meget af det som sker på STEDET.

 

Vi forventer at du…

·        har en konstruktiv tilgang til tingene og kan samarbejde med både professionelle og amatører.

·        har erfaring fra selv at have frivilligt engageret, og gerne at du har erfaring med engagere, motivere og samarbejde andre frivillige på en måde, så de føler sig påskønnede og som en aktiv del af STEDETS liv og aktiviteter.

·       er nysgerrig på nye mennesker og har det godt med at samle mennesker.

·        kan se idéen i at vi som kirke laver dette tilbud til unge i vores by.

·        er i stand til at omsætte strategiske beslutninger til konkrete handlinger.

·        har syn for både helheden og detaljen, og trives med at arbejde både på et overordnet og et praktisk plan. Nogle dage vil du derfor sidde og udvikle en idé, og andre dage svinger du støvsugeren, så der er klar til næste event.

·        kan lide at arbejde i team med andre, samtidig med at du er god til at arbejde selvstændigt, systematisk og struktureret med dine opgaver.

·        har en faglig eller erfaringsmæssig baggrund, som er relevant for dette job.

·        er fleksibel ift arbejdstid. Der er primært tale om arbejde i dagtimerne, men der er også aftenarbejde i skiftende omfang.

·        kan identificere dig med Christianskirkens samspilsværdier - åbenhed, respekt, omsorg og engagement - samt evner at omsætte disse i relation til andre mennesker.

 

 

Om kirken:

Christianskirken er en aktiv kirke på Christiansbjerg. Kirkens arbejde præges af mere end 400 frivillige, der bidrager til kirkens liv og aktiviteter på forskellig vis.

Vi tilbyder bl.a.:

•        Samarbejde med engagerede kolleger i et godt arbejdsmiljø, der vægter teamsamarbejdet højt.

•        Godt besøgte gudstjenester, der i udtryk og stilarter rummer variation, tradition og fornyelse.  

•        Et rigt menighedsliv.

 

Har du lyst til at høre mere om stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte daglig leder, Vibeke Dahmen på 41 72 71 06 eller projektleder Lasse Holmgaard Iversen på 26 25 57 88.

Som ansat ved Christianskirken refererer du overordnet set til menighedsrådet som arbejdsgiver, repræsenteret ved menighedsrådets kontaktperson. I det daglige referer du til Christianskirkens daglige leder, Vibeke Dahmen, der vil forestå den daglige ledelsesopgave, samt til projektleder for STEDET, sognepræst Lasse Holmgaard Iversen. Beskrivelse af sognet kan findes på kirkens hjemmeside www.christianskirken.dk

jobs.title: Global Demo Engineer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As one of Notion’s founding Demo Engineers, you’ll build the global demo engine behind how we bring Notion’s most important customer stories to life. You’ll shape the standards, systems, and experiences that help our Sales teams demonstrate what is possible with Notion, from the first customer conversation through implementation and deployment.



This is a high-impact opportunity to create the function from the ground up. You’ll establish global standards, turn our strongest customer solutions into repeatable demos, and give regional teams the tools and autonomy to innovate. Your work will directly influence how customers understand Notion’s platform, AI capabilities, and potential to transform how their organizations work.



This role reports to the Global Head of Acquisition and partners closely with Sales, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Enablement, and PMM.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build the global demo engine that brings Notion’s most important customer stories to life
   
   - Partner with Enablement and PMM to define the core narratives, scripts, environments, and assets for each demo
   
   - Create a durable release and versioning process so demos stay current as the product evolves
   
   - Automate repeatable setup and maintenance wherever possible so the system can scale globally

 - Turn Notion’s strongest customer and internal solutions into reusable GTM assets
   
   - Identify high-impact use cases and transform them into repeatable, field-ready demos
   
   - Partner with FDE to package customer solutions, implementation guidance, and technical patterns into demos the field can confidently deliver
   
   - Work with GTM Systems to translate demos into workspaces that can be deployed in customer environments

 - Set the global standard for demo quality and help the field deliver it
   
   - Define what great looks like for each demo moment, from the first customer conversation to a tailored technical experience
   
   - Train and coach customer-facing teams on storytelling, environment setup, delivery, and troubleshooting
   
   - Partner with Enablement to create practical resources and programs that raise demo quality across regions

 - Create a clear path from experimentation to global scale
   
   - Give customer-facing teams a structured way to safely build, test, and pilot new demo concepts
   
   - Evaluate the strongest ideas and turn them into scalable standards, templates, and reusable assets

 - Serve as the strategic demo partner for high-impact opportunities
   
   - Advise teams on custom or personalized demos that fall outside the standard portfolio
   
   - Help teams balance customer relevance, technical credibility, and speed without compromising quality




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years in a technical or customer-facing role such as Solutions Engineering, Sales Engineering, Demo Engineering, Solutions Architecture, or Software Engineering

 - Experience designing and delivering technical demos, prototypes, or solution experiences for a SaaS product

 - Strong systems thinking, with experience building scalable standards, templates, documentation, versioning practices, and operating processes

 - Ability to translate complex product capabilities into clear, compelling customer stories tied to business value

 - Technical fluency across APIs, integrations, automation, data, permissions, and enterprise security concepts

 - Working proficiency with scripting or automation tools such as Python or JavaScript

 - Experience partnering across Sales, Product, Engineering, Enablement, and Marketing to drive alignment and deliver shared outcomes

 - Strong communication and coaching skills, with the ability to raise the capabilities of customer-facing teams

 - Comfort creating structure, setting priorities, and making progress in a fast-moving environment with evolving requirements




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience building or scaling a demo engineering, solutions engineering, or technical enablement function

 - Experience with enterprise sales cycles and complex, multi-stakeholder customer environments

 - Hands-on experience with demo automation platforms such as Consensus, Navattic, Reprise, Storylane, or Demostack

 - Experience supporting major product launches or global go-to-market programs

 - Familiarity with AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor

 - Experience with productivity, collaboration, AI, or horizontal SaaS products

 - Notion power user
   


TOOLS YOU'LL USE:

jobs.description:
Dans le cadre du développement d'une de nos sociétés nous ouvrons un poste de Technicien(ne).
Principalement dedié à la distribution, le déploiement, la maintenance et le service après-vente de robots professionnels, avec un premier focus sur les robots de nettoyage.

Dans le cadre du développement de notre centre technique en Suisse, nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) en robotique – Maintenance & SAV.

Votre mission

Vous assurez le diagnostic, la réparation, la maintenance, la configuration et la mise en service de robots professionnels de nettoyage.

Vous intervenez sur les différents systèmes qui composent les robots :

  • Électronique & électricité : batteries, cartes électroniques, moteurs, capteurs, LiDAR, câblages
  • Software : configuration, mises à jour, firmware, navigation, analyse des erreurs et diagnostics
  • Circuits d’eau : pompes, tuyaux, vannes, filtres, réservoirs et recherche de fuites
  • Aspiration & nettoyage : moteurs d’aspiration, turbines, filtres, brosses et systèmes de lavage
  • Mécanique : roues, transmissions, moteurs, démontage, réparation et remplacement de composants

Vous serez également amené(e) à préparer les nouveaux robots, effectuer les maintenances préventives, intervenir chez nos clients en Suisse et collaborer avec les équipes techniques de nos fabricants internationaux.

Requirements

Nous recherchons une personne technique, polyvalente, curieuse et orientée solutions, qui aime comprendre le fonctionnement d’une machine et rechercher l’origine d’une panne.

Formations recherchées :

  • Automaticien(ne) CFC
  • Mécatronicien(ne)
  • Électronicien(ne) CFC
  • Polymécanicien(ne) CFC
  • Technicien(ne) ES en systèmes industriels / automation
  • ou formation technique équivalente

Une expérience dans la robotique est un avantage, mais n’est pas obligatoire. Une expérience en maintenance de machines, équipements industriels ou électromécaniques est également très intéressante.


Compétences:

  • Bonnes connaissances en électronique, électricité et mécanique
  • Très bonne aisance informatique
  • Capacité à diagnostiquer et résoudre des problèmes techniques
  • Autonomie, rigueur et sens pratique
  • Intérêt pour la robotique et les nouvelles technologies
  • Français courant et bonnes connaissances d’anglais technique
  • Allemand : un avantage
  • Permis de conduire catégorie B

Benefits

Vous rejoignez un projet en forte croissance et participez au développement d’un centre d’expertise en robotique professionnelle en Suisse, avec des formations auprès de fabricants internationaux et la possibilité de travailler sur de nouvelles générations de robots.

jobs.title: Senior Regional Account Manager Schweiz (m/w/d) Westschweiz Genf, Jura, Freiburg, Bern und Wallis
jobs.description:
Über uns

Die FormMed HealthCare GmbH entwickelt Mikronährstoff-Präparate für Therapeuten und Ärzte aller Fachrichtungen. Mit über 400 Präparaten bieten wir das größte Mikronährstoff-Konzept Deutschlands. Über 7.000 Ärzte, medizinische Institute und Heilpraktiker arbeiten mit uns zusammen. Das macht FormMed zur Nr. 1 bei Ärzten und Therapeuten in Deutschland.

Es macht Spaß, bei uns zu arbeiten! Das Arbeitsumfeld ist trotz komplexer Anforderung menschlich und humorvoll, geprägt von Eigenverantwortung, kurzen Entscheidungswegen, schneller Umsetzung, langjährigen Mitarbeitern:innen und einer Führung durch Vertrauen. Wir verkaufen Gesundheit nicht nur nach außen, sondern leben sie auch nach innen. Du solltest diese Unternehmenskultur zu schätzen wissen und Dich bewusst dafür entscheiden.

Wegen unseres stetigen und schnellen Wachstums suchen wir viele neue Kollegen:innen, die uns noch weiter voranbringen und gut ins Team passen. Wachse mit uns und profitiere von einem Umfeld, das Dir große Sicherheit und viele Chancen bietet.


Deine Rolle

Du möchtest einen Markt nicht nur betreuen, sondern aktiv entwickeln und nachhaltige Partnerschaften aufbauen? Du verstehst Vertrieb als Beziehungsgeschäft mit Sinn – besonders im Gesundheitsumfeld?

FormMed steht für hochwertige Mikronährstofflösungen, wissenschaftliche Qualität und das gemeinsame Ziel, Gesundheit nachhaltig zu verbessern. In einem respektvollen, lernbereiten Umfeld arbeiten wir täglich daran, medizinische Expertise zugänglich zu machen und echte Wirkung zu erzielen.

Als Senior Regional Account Manager Westschweiz (m/w/d) verantwortest du den strategischen und nachhaltigen Ausbau unseres Vertriebsgebiets in der Westschweiz mit den Regionen Genf, Jura, Freiburg, Bern und Wallis. Du entwickelst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen gezielt weiter, identifizierst neue Marktpotenziale und gewinnst neue Partner im Gesundheitswesen.

Du repräsentierst FormMed als kompetenten und verlässlichen Partner gegenüber Ärzt, Therapeut, Apotheken und weiteren Gesundheitsfachpersonen. Dabei verbindest du ausgeprägte Vertriebsstärke mit Beratungskompetenz und einem echten Verständnis für die individuellen Bedürfnisse deiner Kunden. Du erhältst viel Gestaltungsspielraum, arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und hast die Möglichkeit, den Schweizer Markt aktiv mitzugestalten. Dabei wirst du Teil eines Teams, das Zusammenarbeit, Vertrauen und kontinuierliche Entwicklung lebt.

Wenn du Vertrieb mit Purpose verbinden, Beziehungen aufbauen und einen Markt nachhaltig entwickeln möchtest, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.
Wir suchen ab sofort einen Senior Regional Account Manager Westschweiz (m/w/d) in unbefristeter Anstellung für eine Vollzeittätigkeit im Vertriebsteam mit Fokus auf den Schweizer Markt und insbesondere die Westschweiz.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst die strategische und operative Verantwortung für dein Vertriebsgebiet in der Westschweiz und entwickelst dieses nachhaltig weiter.
  • Dein Vertriebsgebiet umfasst die Regionen Genf, Jura, Freiburg, Bern und Wallis.
  • Du gewinnst neue FormMed-Therapeut und baust unser Netzwerk im Schweizer Gesundheitswesen gezielt aus.
  • Du bringst dein bestehendes Netzwerk aktiv in die Zusammenarbeit mit FormMed ein und entwickelst neue Kontakte zu langfristigen Kundenbeziehungen.
  • Du betreust bestehende Kund systematisch weiter und entwickelst erfolgreiche Partnerschaften zu loyalen Key Accounts.
  • Du übernimmst die Umsatzverantwortung für dein Gebiet und steuerst deine Vertriebsaktivitäten konsequent anhand relevanter KPIs.
  • Du entwickelst eigenständig Strategien zur Marktdurchdringung, Neukundengewinnung und Kundenbindung.
  • Du führst persönliche Beratungsgespräche mit Ärzt, Therapeut, Apotheken und weiteren Gesundheitsfachpersonen und bist dabei kompetente Ansprechpartner auf Augenhöhe – fachlich, vertrieblich und menschlich.
  • Du konzipierst und begleitest individuelle Angebote und entwickelst gemeinsam mit deinen Kund passende Lösungen.
  • Du nutzt moderne Vertriebsinstrumente wie Microsoft Dynamics CRM, digitale Vertriebstools und KI-gestützte Anwendungen, um deine Aktivitäten effizient zu planen und erfolgreich umzusetzen.
  • Du beobachtest Markt- und Kundenentwicklungen in der Westschweiz, leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab und setzt diese eigenverantwortlich um.
  • Du identifizierst neue Marktpotenziale und entwickelst gezielte Strategien für deren Erschließung.
  • Du repräsentierst FormMed auf Fachveranstaltungen, Kongressen und relevanten Netzwerkveranstaltungen und stärkst damit unsere Präsenz im Schweizer Gesundheitsmarkt.
  • Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den nachhaltigen Umsatz- und Kundenaufbau in deinem Vertriebsgebiet.


Dein Profil

  • Du verfügst über mehrjährige, nachweisbare Vertriebserfahrung, idealerweise im Gesundheitswesen oder in einem vergleichbaren beratungsintensiven Umfeld.
  • Besonders willkommen sind Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Mikronährstoffe, Diagnostik, Arzneimittel, Nahrungsergänzung oder vergleichbaren Gesundheitsprodukten.
  • Du verfügst idealerweise über ein bestehendes Netzwerk im Schweizer Gesundheitswesen und zu Ärzten, Therapeuten, Apotheken oder weiteren Gesundheitsfachpersonen.
  • Du hast Freude daran, dein Netzwerk aktiv für den Aufbau neuer Geschäftsbeziehungen einzusetzen und langfristige Partnerschaften zu entwickeln.
  • Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder ein Studium im kaufmännischen, medizinischen oder gesundheitlichen Bereich ist von Vorteil.
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, strategisch und ergebnisorientiert und hast Freude daran, dein Vertriebsgebiet eigenverantwortlich aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Du verfügst über ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für Vertriebskennzahlen, KPIs und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge.
  • Du bist erfahren im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, idealerweise Microsoft Dynamics, sowie MS Office und modernen digitalen Vertriebstools.
  • Du überzeugst durch ein professionelles Auftreten, Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie und kannst medizinische und vertriebliche Themen verständlich und auf Augenhöhe vermitteln.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Französischkenntnisse und kannst Kunden sicher und professionell auf Französisch beraten und betreuen.
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse sind insbesondere für die Betreuung der Regionen Bern und Wallis von Vorteil.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich, bist gleichzeitig ein Teamplayer und bringst eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität mit.
  • Du hast Freude an persönlicher Kundenbetreuung und bist regelmäßig innerhalb deines Vertriebsgebiets unterwegs.
  • Du besitzt einen Führerschein der Klasse B und bringst eine hohe regionale Reisebereitschaft innerhalb der Westschweiz mit.


Warum wir?

  • Home-Office mit High-End-Ausstattung – modern, ergonomisch und perfekt für deinen Vertriebsalltag
  • Dienstwagen der gehobenen Mittelklasse – auch zur privaten Nutzung
  • Faire Arbeitszeiten & 25 Tage Urlaub – weil Work-Life-Balance für uns kein Buzzword ist
  • Attraktive Mitarbeiterkonditionen – z. B. auf unsere Präparate
  • Weiterentwicklung garantiert – fachlich wie persönlich, in internen Schulungen und externen Coachings
  • Ein Team, das dich trägt – regelmäßige Teamevents und ein wertschätzendes Miteinander inklusive


Wo soll ich mich melden?

Bewirb Dich jetzt und werde Teil eines Unternehmens, das Wissenschaft und Wirkung verbindet – mit Leidenschaft für Gesundheit und einem Arbeitsplatz, der inspiriert. Du möchtest mehr über FormMed und die Rahmenbedingungen erfahren? Dann ist Deine Ansprechpartnerin Tanja Seidemann (+49 160 / 94 16 18 07 ) aus dem People Team.

jobs.title: Holstedgaard søger en sygeplejerske gerne med psykiatrisk erfaring
jobs.description:
Vil du gøre en mærkbar forskel i krydsfeltet mellem psykiatri og somatik?

Brænder du for den komplekse psykiatriske sygepleje, og drives du af at opbygge stærke, tillidsfulde relationer til beboerne? Så har vi den helt rette stilling til dig på Holstedgaard i Næstved.

Hvem er vi?

Holstedgaard er et socialpsykiatrisk botilbud, hvor der bor 69 beboere fordelt på flere teams og med forskellige psykiatriske diagnoser. Som en særlig og spændende faglig udfordring har mange af vores beboere også komplicerede somatiske lidelser.

Dine vigtigste opgaver hos os vil være:

  • Helhedsorienteret sygepleje: Ansvar for den grundlæggende og komplekse sygepleje hos beboerne med et skarpt blik for både de psykiske og somatiske problemstillinger.

  • Faglig dokumentation: Sikre høj kvalitet i den sundhedsfaglige og socialpædagogiske dokumentation.

  • Metodisk arbejde: Indgå i teamsamarbejdet med afsæt i Holstedgaards socialpædagogiske metoder.

  • Tværfagligt samarbejde: At være en del af et tværfagligt team med blandt andet pædagoger, social- og sundhedsassistenter samt en skolelærer.

Dine kompetencer:

  • Du er uddannet og autoriseret sygeplejerske – gerne med erfaring inden for psykiatri eller en specialuddannelse i psykiatrisk sygepleje.

  • Du drives af at arbejde med mennesker med sammensatte behov og af at støtte dem i forhold til både personlig pleje og psykisk omsorg.

  • Du har lyst til at udvikle dig fagligt og ser fælles succes som målet.

  • Det er en fordel, hvis du har kendskab til principperne i Low Arousal, Recovery og KRAP-modellen – men det er ikke et krav, da vi sørger for, at du bliver klædt godt på hos os.

Det får du hos os:

  • Et stærkt fagligt miljø med regelmæssig ekstern supervision samt intern og ekstern undervisning.

  • En uformel personalekultur præget af nysgerrighed, fleksibilitet, åbenhed og engagement samt masser af humor og glæde.

  • En skøn samling af beboere, som altid byder på gode udfordringer og godt samvær.

  • Personalegoder: Sundhedsforsikring, adgang til motionsrum samt personalearrangementer og julegaver.

  • Pædagogiske måltider: Maden er inkluderet og dækket som en del af dit arbejde.

Det praktiske

  • Arbejdstid: Som udgangspunkt er stillingen enten en en aftenvagt eller dagvagt med arbejde i weekender og helligdage. De præcise rammer drøfter vi nærmere ved en eventuel samtale.

  • Straffeattest: Stillingen er omfattet af loven om pligt til at indhente straffeattest. Ansættelsen kan først påbegyndes, når en tilfredsstillende attest foreligger.

  • Kørekort: Ikke et must, men en absolut fordel.

Vil du vide mere?

Hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen, er du meget velkommen til at kontakte Ann-Sofie Hartvig på telefon 22 75 77 35.

Ansøgningsproces

Er denne stilling noget for dig? Så glæder vi os rigtig meget til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV.

Vi afholder ansættelsessamtaler løbende. Bemærk venligst, at vi ikke sender bekræftelse for modtagne ansøgninger. Hvis du ikke har hørt fra os inden annoncens udløb, er stillingen besat til en anden ansøger. Dine oplysninger gemmes og behandles fortroligt ud fra GDPR.

jobs.title: People Analytics Partner
jobs.description:
The People Analytics Partner serves as a strategic advisor to senior business and HR leaders across Marine, Energy and Group Functions, enabling data informed decisions on workforce, talent, organizational effectiveness and future workforce priorities.

By combining business acumen, consulting expertise and advanced analytics, the role translates complex business challenges into actionable workforce insights and recommendations. The People Analytics Partner partners closely with leaders to identify opportunities, address organizational challenges and maximize the impact of people-related investments and interventions.

Beyond delivering insights, the role plays a key part in advancing Wärtsilä's People Analytics capabilities. This includes shaping the People Analytics roadmap, supporting the evolution and adoption of Visier, onboarding new workforce data sources and ensuring that analytics solutions continue to meet evolving business and HR needs.

The role also acts as a catalyst for data-informed decision-making, helping build analytical capabilities across HR and promoting innovative approaches to address future workforce and work challenges.

We are ideally looking for an individual based in Finland to connect and align with senior stakeholders and group corporate functions and operate across global timezones, but would consider other European locations.

Key accountabilities:


1. Strategic Workforce Advisory & Business Partnering


* Partner with senior business leaders, HR Business Partners and COEs across Marine, Energy and Group Functions to identify strategic workforce challenges and opportunities.
* Shape and influence workforce, talent and organizational decisions through data-informed insights and evidence-based recommendations.
* Act as a trusted advisor on workforce composition, talent flows, retention, competences, leadership effectiveness and employee experience.
* Support business strategy execution by translating strategic priorities into workforce analytics and actionable recommendations.
* Facilitate strategic discussions with senior stakeholders, challenge assumptions and guide decision-making through data and evidence.
* Lead complex analyses to identify workforce trends, risks and opportunities impacting business performance.
* Deliver end-to-end people analytics projects, from problem definition and stakeholder engagement through analysis, recommendations and implementation support.
* Develop predictive, diagnostic and scenario-based analyses to support proactive workforce decisions.


2. People Intelligence & Analytics Platform Development


* Lead the onboarding and integration of new data sources into Visier, including talent, learning, engagement, organizational effectiveness and workforce planning data.
* Collaborate with HR COEs and business stakeholders to define business requirements and prioritize analytics development initiatives.
* Drive the development of scalable analytics solutions, dashboards and self-service capabilities.
* Contribute to the People Analytics roadmap, ensuring alignment between business priorities, HR strategy and technology investments.
* Champion data governance principles and support the continuous improvement of workforce data quality, accessibility and trust.
* Partner with HR Technology, Data Governance and Process Owners to continuously enhance Wärtsilä's People Analytics ecosystem.


3. Capability Building, Innovation & Thought Leadership


* Promote data-informed decision-making across HR and business communities.
* Build analytics capabilities within HR by educating stakeholders on workforce insights, analytics methodologies and best practices.
* Stay current with external trends in People Analytics, AI, workforce intelligence and employee listening.
* Drive the adoption of new analytics capabilities and innovative approaches to workforce decision-making.
* Contribute to the evolution of People Analytics methodologies, governance and operating models.


Experience & Qualifications:

Required


* Significant experience in People Analytics, Workforce Planning, HR Consulting or a related analytical role.
* Experience partnering with senior business and HR leaders in a global organization.
* Proven track record of leading complex analytics or consulting projects from concept to implementation.
* Experience working with workforce data, analytics platforms and visualization tools.
* English is our common business lannguage, fluency in both written spoken English is mandatory.


Preferred


* Master's in Business, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Psychology or a related field.
* 8-12+ years of relevant experience in consulting, People Analytics, Workforce Planning or HR Strategy.
* Experience with Visier and modern HR analytics ecosystems.
* Experience in predictive analytics, employee listening and organizational effectiveness.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled analytics and future workforce trends.


Contact & next steps:


We hope to hear from you soon by submitting your application through our careers portal. We aim to keep you updated on the process throughout.

jobs.title: Ræsting/Cleaning
jobs.description:
*Job Title:** Housekeeping & Breakfast Attendant
**Location:** Hótel Skógafoss / Hótel Anna, Skógar, Iceland
**Position:** Full-Time
**Start Date:** November 15, 2026

Hótel Skógafoss and Hótel Anna, located in the beautiful surroundings of South Iceland, are seeking a dedicated and versatile individual to join our team in a full-time capacity. The ideal candidate will be a proactive and reliable professional responsible for maintaining the highest standards of cleanliness and ensuring our guests have a wonderful start to their day.

**Key Responsibilities:**
* Performing comprehensive cleaning of guest rooms and public areas to ensure a comfortable and welcoming environment.
* Managing all aspects of the daily breakfast service, including setting up and replenishing the buffet, and ensuring the dining area is clean and well-presented.
* Handling the hotel's laundry services, including washing, drying, and folding linens.
* Providing excellent customer service, assisting guests with inquiries, and processing payments for breakfast when required.

**The Ideal Candidate:**
* Has proven experience in housekeeping and/or food and beverage service.
* Is fluent in English and possesses excellent communication skills. Proficiency in other languages is a strong asset.
* Holds a valid B-category driver's license.
* Is a dependable team player with a positive attitude and a strong work ethic.
* Is flexible and willing to work a varied schedule.

**What We Offer:**
* A stable, full-time position in a friendly and dynamic work environment.
* Competitive wages according to the collective bargaining agreement with the VLFS union.
* **On-site accommodation is available for a fee.**
* The opportunity to live and work in one of Iceland's most scenic areas.

**How to Apply:**
We are reviewing applications on an ongoing basis.

Interested parties are requested to send an application along with a CV to the email address: johann@ejhotels.is or applications@ejhotels.is
Last application date is November 15th , 2026.

***

**Starfsheiti:** Umsjónaraðili herbergja og morgunverðar
**Staðsetning:** Hótel Skógafoss / Hótel Anna, Skógum
**Starfshlutfall:** Fullt starf
**Starf hefst:** 15. nóvember 2026

Hótel Skógafoss og Hótel Anna, staðsett í hinu fallega umhverfi Suðurlands, óska eftir að ráða þjónustulundaðan og fjölhæfan einstakling í fullt starf. Leitum að ábyrgum og traustum aðila sem hefur metnað til að viðhalda ýtrustu kröfum um hreinlæti og tryggja að gestir okkar fái frábæra byrjun á deginum.

**Helstu verkefni og ábyrgðarsvið:**
* Umfangsmikil þrif á herbergjum og sameiginlegum rýmum hótelsins til að tryggja snyrtilegt og notalegt umhverfi.
* Fullnaðarumsjón með morgunverðarþjónustu, þ.m.t. undirbúningur og áfylling á hlaðborð.
* Umsjón með þvotti hótelsins, s.s. þvottur, þurrkun og frágangur á líni.
* Veita framúrskarandi þjónustu, aðstoða gesti og taka við greiðslum fyrir morgunverð þegar við á.

**Hæfniskröfur:**
* Sönnuð reynsla af þrifum og/eða störfum í veitingaþjónustu er skilyrði.
* Mjög góð enskukunnátta og framúrskarandi samskiptahæfni. Kunnátta í öðrum tungumálum er mikill kostur.
* Gilt ökuskírteini (B-flokkur) er skilyrði.
* Áreiðanleiki, jákvæðni og hæfni til að vinna vel í hóp.
* Sveigjanleiki og vilji til að vinna á breytilegum vöktum.

**Það sem við bjóðum:**
* Öruggt fullt starf á vinalegum og lifandi vinnustað.
* Laun samkvæmt gildandi kjarasamningi við VLFS.
* **Húsnæði er í boði á staðnum gegn gjaldi.**
* Einstakt tækifæri til að búa og starfa á einum fallegasta stað landsins.

**Umsóknir:**
Farið er yfir umsóknir jafnóðum.

Áhugasamir vinsamlegast sendið umsókn ásamt ferilskrá á netfangið: johann@ejhotels.is or applications@ejhotels.is
Umsóknarfrestur er til og með 31.okt 2026.

**Helstu verkefni:**
* Notkun uppþvottavélar til að þrífa diska, glös og hnífapör.
* Handþvottur á pottum, pönnum og öðrum eldhúsáhöldum þegar þörf krefur.
* Tryggja að allir hlutir séu rétt geymdir eftir þvott.
* Viðhalda hreinu og skipulögðu uppþvottasvæði.
* Aðstoða við almenn þrif í eldhúsi, þar með talið að sópa og skúra gólf.
* Förgun sorps og endurvinnslu.
* Aðstoða eldhústeymið til að tryggja hnökralausan rekstur.

**Hæfniskröfur:**
* Fyrri reynsla sem uppþvari eða í svipuðu hlutverki er kostur en ekki skilyrði.
* Hæfni til að vinna á skilvirkan hátt í hröðu umhverfi.
* Nákvæmni í vinnubrögðum varðandi hreinlæti.
* Góð færni í hópavinnu og samskiptum.
* Áreiðanleiki, stundvísi og jákvætt viðmót eru skilyrði.
* Góð enskukunnátta.

**Við bjóðum:**
* Húsnæði gegn gjaldi.
* Laun greidd samkvæmt gildandi kjarasamningi VFLS

jobs.title: Pædagog søges til Holstedgaard
jobs.description:
Er du vores nye Kollega

Brænder du for at skabe meningsfulde relationer og understøtte mennesker i at leve det liv, de ønsker? Så er det måske dig, vi søger til vores engagerede medarbejdergruppe på Holstedgaard.

På Holstedgaard udvider vi vores personalegruppe og søger en pædagog, der gennem tillidsfulde relationer kan motivere, inddrage og samarbejde med vores beboere. Vi arbejder målrettet for, at beboerne oplever medbestemmelse, tryghed og et hjemligt miljø, hvor deres ønsker, behov og drømme er i centrum.

Vores botilbud er først og fremmest beboernes hjem. Da flere af vores beboere udover psykiske lidelser også har somatiske problemstillinger, yder vi en helhedsorienteret indsats. Som pædagog hos os skal du derfor forvente, at der også er perioder, hvor du skal deltage i og være ansvarlig for, at der udføres personlig pleje som en naturlig del af beboerens hverdag og trivsel.

Om Holstedgaard

Holstedgaard har 69 pladser fordelt på flere teams. Vi tilbyder både midlertidige og længerevarende ophold efter Servicelovens §§ 107 og 108 til borgere over 18 år. Målgruppen er mennesker med forskellige psykiatriske lidelser og ofte komplekse somatiske problemstillinger.

Vi er i gang med at implementere og forankre KRAP (Kognitiv, Ressourcefokuseret og Anerkendende Pædagogik), som danner rammen om vores faglige tilgang. Her arbejder vi med fokus på beboernes styrker, ressourcer og udviklingsmuligheder.

Stillingen indebærer dag- og aftenvagter samt arbejde hver anden weekend.

Vi søger en kollega, der:

  • Er uddannet pædagog eller har anden relevant socialpædagogisk uddannelse.

  • Er indstillet på at tage ansvar for og deltage i den personlige pleje og somatiske understøttelse af beboerne.

  • Har erfaring med eller interesse for det socialpædagogiske område, gerne inden for psykiatrien.

  • Arbejder fagligt reflekteret og kan omsætte teori og metode til praksis.

  • Kan dokumentere faglige indsatser og følge op på mål og delmål.

  • Er ansvarlig, fleksibel og kan bevare overblikket i en varieret hverdag.

  • Trives med både selvstændigt arbejde og samarbejde i mindre teams.

  • Værdsætter kollegial sparring, feedback og fælles refleksion.

  • Er initiativrig og ønsker at bidrage til den fortsatte udvikling af vores botilbud.

  • Har mod på at indgå i et læringsmiljø, hvor nysgerrighed, faglig udvikling og refleksion er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

  • Kørekort er ikke et krav, men vil være en fordel.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En engageret og fagligt stærk medarbejdergruppe med fokus på både socialpædagogiske og sundhedsfaglige indsatser.

  • En mangfoldig gruppe beboere, som bidrager til en spændende og meningsfuld hverdag.

  • En uformel og anerkendende arbejdskultur med plads til humor og fællesskab.

  • Indflydelse og medansvar i et teamsamarbejde under fortsat udvikling,med fokus på trivsel og arbejdsglæde.

  • Løbende supervision.

  • Sundhedsforsikring.

Praktiske oplysninger

  • Timetal: Stillingen er på 25-37 timer ugentligt med tiltrædelse snarest muligt.

  • Ansættelsesproces: Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat høre du ikke fra os er stillingen gået til anden side.

  • Straffeattest: Stillingen er omfattet af reglerne om indhentelse af straffeattest. Ansættelse kan først finde sted, når tilfredsstillende straffeattest foreligger.

  • GDPR: Vi behandler og opbevarer alle personoplysninger i overensstemmelse med gældende GDPR-regler.

Vil du vide mere?

Du er velkommen til at kontakte Ann-Sofie Hartvig på telefon 22757735.

Ansøgning og CV sendes til: ash@holstedgaard.dk

jobs.title: Policy and Information Officer
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
ICOS is seeking an experienced Policy and Information Officer to join our Communications Team. The role combines directly engaging with and supporting international students with broader member and stakeholder consultation to inform our advocacy work. jobs.title: Student Assistant - Data & Analytics (BluePool and Data Governance)
jobs.description:
Do you want to help shape the future of Europe’s energy system and contribute to a fully carbon‑neutral, sustainable power grid? Are you a data engineer who is curious, open‑minded, and initiative-taking — someone who enjoys working in an explorative and collaborative environment? Do you want to collaborate with engineers, application developers, and data scientists to unlock insights from the vast amounts of data behind our services? 

We are looking for a Student Assistant to support our Data & Analytics department. This is an excellent opportunity for a student who wants practical experience working with data platforms, governance processes, documentation, and operational support activities in an international and highly technical environment. 

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition 

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. 

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet. 

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.  

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system. 

Right now, we are looking for a Student Assistant to join our Data & Analytics Department. 

What You Will Be Working On 

The Data and Analytics team consists of 10 employees and consultants and plays a central role in enabling data-driven decision-making across Nordic RCC. The team develops and maintains data pipelines, analytics products, BI solutions, platform services, and information services that support operational, strategic, and regulatory needs. 

As Student Assistant, you will support various initiatives across the department, with a primary focus on NRCC's analytics platform ‘BluePool’, and data governance activities. 

Examples of tasks may include: 

BluePool Support 

  • Assisting with user onboarding and access administration 

  • Maintaining onboarding guides and user documentation 

  • Supporting training sessions and workshops 

  • Gathering and tracking user feedback 

  • Assisting with testing of new BluePool functionality 

Data Governance 

  • Supporting data governance processes and documentation 

  • Maintaining data catalogues and metadata documentation 

  • Assisting with data classification and governance activities 

  • Supporting compliance and process-related initiatives 

General Department Support 

  • Coordinating meetings and workshops 

  • Maintaining team documentation and knowledge bases 

  • Preparing presentations and communication materials 

  • Supporting project coordination and follow-up activities 

  • Assisting with ad hoc analytical and administrative tasks 

Who We Are Looking For 

You are currently enrolled in a relevant university programme, for example within data science, computer science, engineering, information management, business analytics, economics, mathematics, or a similar field. 

You do not need extensive professional experience. What matters most is that you are curious, structured, and comfortable taking ownership of practical tasks — from organizing documentation and following up on details to supporting colleagues with day-to-day needs. 

We are looking for someone who: 

  • Is detail-oriented and follows tasks through carefully 

  • Enjoys turning information into clear documentation, guides, or overviews that others can use 

  • Communicates clearly in writing and verbally 

  • Can work independently while also asking for input when needed 

  • Has an interest in data, analytics, and digital platforms 

  • Is comfortable using Microsoft Office tools 

It is an advantage, but not a requirement, if you have experience with one or more relevant tools or concepts, such as Python, SQL, Power BI, enterprise architecture, data governance, or technical documentation. 

What We Offer: 

  • A flexible student position that can be adapted to your studies 

  • Exposure to large-scale data and analytics initiatives within the energy sector 

  • Experience working in an international environment with Nordic stakeholders 

  • Insight into data governance, analytics platforms, and digital transformation 

  • Opportunities to build practical skills that are highly relevant for a future career in data and analytics 

  • A friendly and collaborative team with experienced data scientists, data engineers, and analytics specialists 

Application & Security Clearance 

Please apply online in English no later than 5 November 2026. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.   

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.  Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: OT Security Architect - Renewables, Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced and motivated OT Security Architect and do you want to leave your mark on the global energy industry? If so, we want to hear from you! 
 
Your position
 
In your new position as OT Security Architect in the Renewables division, you will be a valuable member of the OT Security Team, whose mission is to ensure excellent OT security deliveries on large-scale EPC substation projects. You will have the chance to take the architectural lead and help shape a collaborative team culture built on expertise and knowledge-sharing. Above all, your work will make a real difference to the global energy sector.

Your place of work will be at one of our offices in either Esbjerg or Copenhagen. The position is full-time, and you can expect to travel 10–30 days per year.

“Every day, we help enable the green energy transition by building secure, resilient OT solutions that ensure renewable energy assets operate safely and reliably.” - OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.
 
Your tasks & responsibilities 

In our Renewables division, we have major EPC projects in the pipeline for both short- and long-term operations. As an OT Security Architect, you will take the architectural lead and support all OT Security areas across the EPC substation projects.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to:

  • Contributing to the implementation of industry-accepted good practice and required Cyber/OT Security architecture at solution level, typically based on standards such as IEC 62443, ISO 27001, and NIS
  • Helping define products and standards relevant to OT Security and infrastructure
  • Hands-on experience with cybersecurity audits and compliance frameworks, including ISO 27001, Critical Infrastructure regulations, and IEC 62443
  • Reviewing requirements/ITT packages and providing input to tenders consisting of calculations, solutions, descriptions, clarifications, and reservations
  • Taking on an advisory or active role in infrastructure, identity access management, or logging/event-based activities
  • Being responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing FAT, SAT, and SIT activities to ensure successful system delivery and integration
  • Implementing customer-specific Cyber/OT Security requirements in substation design for multiple systems and subsystems, such as SCADA, low-voltage, HVAC, Auxiliary Control and Monitoring System, etc.


Crucial to this position is your ability to take ownership of project deliverables and coordinate OT Security deadlines with internal and external stakeholders. You should thrive in a leading role where your skills, collaboration, and structured approach help ensure that requirements are met.
 
Your profile & qualifications

You are a team player who enjoys leading projects and working with stakeholders to align on timing, scope, and objectives. You know when technical expertise should be brought in to support delivery. To us, this means that you have a structured and solution-oriented approach, the ability to influence stakeholders, and the dedication to see tasks through to completion.

You will be part of a team of six colleagues that values quality, attention to detail, and a flexible working environment. We are sociable, helpful, and open to input, and we work in a dedicated, structured, and execution-focused way while respecting the agility that is a natural part of our core tasks. We want the same from you.

To succeed in this position, we imagine that you have:

  • A minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in OT Security from a similar position
  • A Tech Lead mentality – we are not seeking an extreme subject matter expert, but a well-rounded colleague who can work through heavily structured large projects involving many stakeholders 
  • The ability to know when additional technical specialists or resources are needed to complete a project
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in English
  • Experience working in complex engineering projects, as well as project and stakeholder management, is an advantage


If you have any questions, you are more than welcome to contact OT Security Architect & Team Lead, Reza Sarafrazjoo.
 
Welcome to Semco Maritime

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey: how to get there. We provide the answers needed to make change real, because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever, pragmatic solutions. This is what we do, and this is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.
So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too. 

Care to join the movement?
Change. With us.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Position(s) as Associate Professor in Accounting
jobs.description:
About the position

Oslo Business School is a relatively new business school (founded in 2014) focusing on teaching quality and excellence in research. The school has currently about 2000 students and 80 employees and offers study programs at Bachelor, Master, and PhD level. The Finance and Accounting group, one of the school’s five sections, is a vibrant and diverse group consisting of researchers that regularly publish in recognized international journals. Oslo Business School is located in downtown Oslo and is part of the Oslo Metropolitan University. The school is currently working on obtaining international accreditations and is strongly focusing on enhancing research output in high quality journals. 

Oslo Business School is expanding and invites applications for 1-2 faculty positions in accounting. The positions are within the Finance and Accounting group, and the person(s) appointed will contribute to Oslo Business School's research and teaching in accounting and auditing and related subjects. The formal recruitment will be at the associate professor level with tenure. Candidates who qualify may be promoted to full professor following their appointment.


Your main duties and areas of responsibility will be
  • teaching and supervision at the Bachelor, Master, and PhD level 
  • active contribution to the development of a high-quality education 
  • initiating and carrying out high quality academic research 
  • contributing to the continued development of the research group in accounting and auditing and the department’s study programmes 
  • academic-administrative tasks 
  • active contribution to the development of Oslo Business School, and OsloMet in general 
  • disseminating research outcomes to the academic community and to the broader society

Qualification requirements

The ranking of qualified applicants is based on scientific merits. Teaching experience, personal qualities and suitability for the position are also important factors. We mainly consider recent publications and the potential for future publications in high-quality journals. The candidates we hire should fit the profile of our bachelor and master programs and must be able to contribute to the school’s long-term academic development. We encourage women to apply.

Applicants must:

  • hold a PhD in accounting or related fields (or be close to completion) 
  • have published in international journals and/or document the potential for quality publications in accounting 
  • have good teaching skills 
  • written and oral proficiency in Norwegian, Swedish or Danish (minimum level B2), and English (Language requirements for employees at OsloMet)

Applicants who do not have adequate proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language, will be offered Norwegian courses, and must acquire Norwegian skills corresponding to at least level B2 within three years of appointment.

The applicant must document relevant educational competence in accordance with OsloMet’s Guidelines for the assessment of educational competence at OsloMet. Applicants who do not possess the required educational qualifications must obtain them within two years of employment.

General criteria for appointments to academic positions are covered by the Regulations for appointment and promotion to academic posts.


It will be an advantage if you have
  • high quality research in recognized international journals
  • experience with research networks and externally funded projects
  • teaching and supervision experience from different degree levels
  • quantitative skills, related to empirical research or teaching
  • proficiency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language
  • capability in communicating and cooperating with students and colleagues
  • a relevant professional credential (such as statsautorisert revisor)
  • ability to teach Norwegian accounting standards (GRS norsk regnskapslov)
  • personal qualities that contribute positively to the working environment

Personal qualities

OsloMet evaluates teaching qualifications in conjunction with interviews. It is important for OsloMet to reflect the population in our region, and all qualified candidates are welcome to apply. We make active endeavours to further develop OsloMet as an inclusive workplace and to adapt the workplace if required. If there are periods where you have not been in work, under education or in training, you are also welcome to apply.


We offer
  • engaging professional opportunities at Norway’s third largest university
  • an exciting job opportunity at a new and fast-growing business school in the middle of downtown Oslo 
  • participation in a dynamic professional environment, research groups, and unique academic community
  • a possibility to help map out the direction of a new and growing business school
  • opportunities for academic development in a professional research environment
  • interaction with a diverse student group
  • loan and pension arrangements through the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund 
  • beneficial welfare schemes and a wide range of sports and cultural offers
  • free Norwegian language classes to employees 
  • working location in downtown Oslo with multiple cultural offers

The salary for the position is in accordance with the Basic Collective Agreement for state employees and OsloMet’s pay policy for Associate Professor in code 1011, corresponding to 708 000 – 923 000 NOK per year. A higher salary may be considered for particularly well-qualified applicants. The salary depends on the qualifications of the applicant. From the salary, 2% will be deducted in pension contributions for the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK).

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SHi5avzdHIkApplication Process and Expert Committee

If you wish to apply for the position, you must do so through our recruitment system.
An expert committee will conduct the assessment of relevant applications. Before the application documents are sent to the expert committee, all applications will be reviewed by the faculty. Applications from unqualified candidates will not be forwarded to the expert committee for assessment. If the number of applications requires it, an internal screening committee at OsloMet will carry out an initial selection of candidates. The selected applicants will then be assessed by the expert committee. 

Please upload the following documents by the application deadline: 

  • application letter 
  • CV, letters of recommendations, and all pages of certificates/diplomas. Foreign education should be pre-approved, and a letter of approval must be attached. Information is available via the following link: Recognition of foreign education - to work in Norway | HK-dir 
  • a list of scientific publications/working papers 
  • up to 5 scientific publications (from the last five years), including your PhD thesis 
  • documentation of educational competence including a profiling document

For applicants who cannot document the required competencies in teaching in higher education have to develop this within two years from accession. OsloMet offers courses in teaching and learning in higher education which covers this requirement.

We only consider applications submitted through our electronic recruitment system, and all documents must be uploaded for your application to be considered. The documents must be in English or a Scandinavian language. Translations must be authorized, and you will be asked to present originals if you are invited for an interview. OsloMet verifies documents to give candidates a proper evaluation and ensure fair competition. Incomplete applications will not be considered. If you have documents that cannot be uploaded electronically, please contact stale.bie@oslomet.no

jobs.title: KHOY Company: Chief Marketing Officer
jobs.description:
**_Type:_** _Full-time & permanent_

**_Location:_** _Köydenpunojankatu 2 a D, 00180 Helsinki, Finland_

**_Application deadline:_** _Sunday 25.10.2026_

KHOY has proven that its product can travel. Now the ambition is bigger: to build a rapidly growing DTC success into a globally recognized consumer brand.

**The opportunity**

In just a few years, KHOY has grown from a new Finnish furniture company into an international DTC business with customers across Europe and a growing presence in the United States. Finland now represents only a small share of the business, and KHOY is entering a new stage where international growth – particularly in Central Europe, UK and the US – will define the years ahead.

The foundations are there: a distinctive product, proven demand, international traction and a team that knows how to move fast. KHOY has grown with an entrepreneurial mindset, learning through action and staying close to its customers and commercial performance. Now the company wants to complement that strength with a more strategic approach to brand and marketing.

As Chief Marketing Officer, you will have the opportunity to shape what that next chapter looks like. Your mandate is broad: build KHOY into a stronger global consumer brand while developing the marketing strategy and commercial engine needed to support significant international growth.

**What will you be doing?**

Your core challenge is to bring brand and performance together. You will define KHOYs international marketing strategy and positioning, build a stronger emotional connection between consumers and the brand, and turn that direction into concrete choices across content, performance marketing, PR, partnerships and e-commerce.

Working closely with KHOYs CEO and alongside the founders and leadership team, you will play a key role in shaping the companys growth agenda and translating business ambitions into marketing priorities. You will bring greater structure and commercial insight to marketing through systematic creative testing, customer and performance data, and continuous development of customer acquisition, conversion and e-commerce economics.

You will set priorities and budgets and decide where KHOY should invest, experiment or change direction. Together with KHOYs marketing and creative colleagues and external performance marketing and PR partners, you will bring different areas of expertise together around shared brand and commercial goals.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You have built something, not only inherited it. You have personally helped grow a consumer brand internationally and understand what it takes to move from entrepreneurial growth toward meaningful scale. Experience in DTC or a digitally native consumer business is highly relevant, but what matters most is evidence of building brands and businesses across markets.

You combine brand thinking with commercial depth. You can define positioning and creative direction while also challenging assumptions around digital marketing, customer acquisition and e-commerce performance. You understand the numbers well enough to make informed decisions rather than simply outsourcing that responsibility to partners.

You are strategic, but equally comfortable getting hands-on when needed. You enjoy setting direction and enabling others to succeed, while staying close enough to the work to dig into performance and solve practical problems together with the team. You thrive in a fast-moving environment where priorities can evolve quickly, and know how to bring clarity and structure without slowing down the pace.

**What we expect from you:**

- A demonstrated track record of scaling a consumer brand internationally, ideally from an entrepreneurial growth stage toward meaningful scale

- Senior-level experience in marketing or growth, with clear commercial responsibility and measurable results across multiple international markets

- Strong understanding of direct-to-consumer business and digital commerce, including performance marketing, customer acquisition, creative testing and e-commerce economics.

- Experience building both brand and demand, with the ability to connect long-term brand development with commercial performance.

- The ability to lead internal colleagues and external partners while staying close enough to the work to make informed decisions.

- Good professional English and strong communication and stakeholder management skills.


**What we consider an advantage:**

- Experience entering or growing a consumer brand in the US market, with an understanding of what it takes to succeed there

- Experience from furniture, interiors, home, lifestyle, fashion, mattresses or another design-led consumer category

- Experience developing an omnichannel business while keeping DTC at its commercial core

- First-hand experience building marketing structures and ways of working in a fast-growing scale-up environment


**At KHOY, youll have the opportunity to:**

- Step into a central leadership role and genuinely shape KHOYs brand, international growth and commercial direction

- Build a global consumer brand on the foundation of a proven product and growing international business.

- Shape KHOYs marketing strategy, ways of working and how the function develops as the company grows

- Work closely with the founder and leadership team and have a direct voice in the decisions shaping KHOYs next chapter

- Share in the long-term value you help create, with an equity or option component open for discussion


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and permanent position, and you will be employed directly by KHOY Company (Friends and Furniture Oy). You will report to founder and CEO Visa Friström and be part of KHOYs leadership team. The preferred location for the role is Helsinki, but KHOY is also open to candidates based elsewhere e.g. in the Nordics. If you are based outside Helsinki, the role requires flexibility to travel to Helsinki when needed and spend time working closely with the team.

The starting date will be agreed based on your availability. Compensation will also be negotiated individually based on your experience and overall profile, and an equity or option component can also be discussed.

jobs.title: Data engineer for analytics platform with BI expertise and an interest in the green energy transition
jobs.description:
Do you want to help shape the future of Europe’s energy system and contribute to a fully carbon‑neutral, sustainable power grid? Are you a data engineer who is curious, open‑minded, and initiative-taking — someone who enjoys working in an explorative and collaborative environment? Do you want to collaborate with engineers, application developers, and data scientists to unlock insights from the vast amounts of data behind our services? 

We are looking for a Data Engineer with BI expertise to join our Data and Analytics team at Nordic RCC. If you are excited about building robust data pipelines, developing high‑quality BI products, and enabling data‑driven decision‑making in a mission‑driven organization, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t meet every requirement. 

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition 

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. 

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet. 

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.  

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system. 

Right now, we are looking for a Data Engineer who likes to make a difference! 

Job description

The Data and Analytics team consists of 10 employees and consultants and plays a central role in enabling data-driven decision-making across Nordic RCC. The team develops and maintains data pipelines, analytics products, BI solutions, platform services, and information services that support operational, strategic, and regulatory needs. 

As a Data Engineer with BI expertise, you will help design, build, operate, and improve our analytics platform and the data products built on it. You will work closely with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver reliable data pipelines, intuitive BI solutions, and user-friendly data services. 

Your work will directly influence how Nordic RCC uses data to improve processes, services, and operational decision-making. Your key responsibilities will include: 

  • Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines, data models, integrations, and curated datasets. 

  • Develop BI dashboards, reports, and data products that turn complex data into clear insights. 

  • Operate and improve analytics platform services, including data platforms, BI solutions, JupyterHub, user-facing analytics environments, and supporting applications. 

  • Ensure data quality, reliability, monitoring, and operational visibility across pipelines, BI products, and platform services. 

  • Monitor and optimize platform performance, resource use, computer storage, and analytical workloads. 

  • Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, developers, infrastructure teams, external providers, and stakeholders to deliver production-ready analytics solutions. 

  • Support the development of platform architecture, metadata, governance practices, and service-oriented delivery models such as Data-as-a-Service and Platform-as-a-Service. 

  • Document data flows, platform components, operational procedures, and technical solutions to support maintainability and knowledge sharing. 

We are looking for someone with several of the following qualifications: 

  • Minimum 5 years of experience as a Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, BI Developer, Platform Engineer, Application Developer, or similar. 

  • Strong experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, modern data architectures, SQL, and data warehousing concepts. 

  • Hands-on experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Qlik, or similar. 

  • Experience operating and optimizing analytics platforms in production environments. 

  • Experience with cloud-native technologies and analytics platforms such as Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Azure Synapse, Snowflake, or similar. 

  • Familiarity with orchestration, monitoring, DevOps, CI/CD, Python, containerization, Kubernetes, storage solutions, or data platform infrastructure 

  • Experience operationalizing analytics models, enabling data consumption, or supporting service-oriented delivery models is an advantage. 

  • Knowledge of power systems and the energy sector is a plus, but not a requirement. 

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements. Your experience and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for. 

Working Environment 

You will join a diverse and enthusiastic team in our office at Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. Nordic RCC is home to over twenty nationalities, with a healthy gender balance and a wide range of ages and backgrounds. We value curiosity, fellowship, respect, and transparency—and we hope you see yourself in these values. 

We offer flexible work arrangements to support a healthy work-life balance, including the option to work from home part of the time. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, physical presence in the office is expected on most days. 

You’ll report to Data & Analytics team-lead and collaborate regularly with colleagues from the Nordic RCC and occasionally also from the Nordic TSOs. Travel is limited and will not exceed 15 days per year. 

Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. 

Application & Security Clearance 

Please apply online in English no later than 5 November 2026. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.   

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
