jobs.title: Er du struktureret, arbejdsom og klar til at blive en del af et stærkt team? Vi søger en produktionsmedarbejder!
jobs.description:
Har du styr på detaljerne, hænderne godt skruet på og sætter du en ære i at levere et godt stykke arbejde? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Vi vækster og har derfor brug for flere dygtige hænder i vores produktion, hvor vi giver IT-udstyr nyt liv. Vi arbejder med refurbished laptops, stationære computere, Apple-produkter og meget mere. Hos os handler det om at gøre brugt IT klar til et nyt liv – med kvalitet, omhu og sans for detaljen.

Nu leder vi efter en arbejdsom og struktureret produktionsmedarbejder, der trives med praktisk arbejde, faste processer og et godt samarbejde med kollegerne.

Hvad kommer du til at arbejde med?

Du bliver en vigtig del af vores produktion, hvor vi sørger for, at hver enkelt maskine er klar til sin næste ejer.

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være at:

  • Få maskinerne igennem hele vores procedurer i vores produktion.

  • Sikrer at vi hele tiden lever op til vores egne standarter 

  • Være med til at tage ansvar for vores fælles målsætning 

  • Rengøre og gøre maskinerne præsentable.

  • Pakke de færdige produkter, så de er klar til afsendelse.

Du bliver en del af et flow, hvor struktur, kvalitet og orden er afgørende. Vi har brug for en kollega, der kan holde overblikket, følge processerne og sikre, at opgaverne bliver udført ordentligt – også når der er fart på.

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er struktureret: Du arbejder systematisk, følger procedurer og har styr på detaljerne.

  • Er arbejdsom: Du tager fat, holder tempoet og går til dine opgaver med en positiv indstilling.

  • Har sans for orden: Du sætter pris på en ryddelig arbejdsplads og afleverer altid et ordentligt resultat.

  • Er en holdspiller: Du bidrager til et godt samarbejde og hjælper gerne dine kolleger, når der er brug for det.

  • Tager ansvar: Du kan arbejde selvstændigt og sørger for, at dine opgaver bliver fulgt helt til dørs.

Har du erfaring med IT-hardware, elektronik, klargøring eller produktion, er det en stor fordel. Det vigtigste er dog, at du har den rette indstilling, lysten til at arbejde og øje for kvalitet.

Hvad kan du forvente hos os?

Du bliver en del af en virksomhed i vækst, hvor der er brug for dig og din indsats. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes, når man løfter i flok, hjælper hinanden og har en god hverdag sammen.

Hos os får du:

  • En hverdag med konkrete opgaver og synlige resultater.

  • Gode kolleger og et stærkt fællesskab.

  • En vigtig rolle i en produktion, hvor kvalitet og effektivitet går hånd i hånd.

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med forskellige typer IT-udstyr.

  • Faste arbejdstider, så du ved, hvad du har at planlægge efter.

Arbejdstid og arbejdssted

Arbejdstid: Mandag til fredag kl. 07.00–15.00
Arbejdssted: Edwin Rahrs Vej 66, 8220 Brabrand

Skal du være vores nye kollega?

Hvis du kan se dig selv i en hverdag, hvor struktur, arbejdsomhed og godt kollegaskab går hånd i hånd, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send os din ansøgning og fortæl kort, hvem du er, og hvorfor du vil være en del af vores produktion.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Application developer with an interest in the green energy transition
jobs.description:
Do you want to help shape the future of Europe’s energy system and contribute to a fully carbon‑neutral, sustainable power grid? Are you a developer who is curious, open-minded, proactive and enjoys working in an explorative and collaborative way? Do you want to work together with engineers, IT experts and data scientists trying to find secrets hidden in the vast amounts of data related to our services? 

We’re looking for an application developer to join our Data and Analytics team at Nordic RCC. If you’re excited about developing analytics and reporting platforms and tools in a dynamic, mission‑driven organization, we encourage you to apply — even if you don’t meet every requirement. 

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition 

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. 

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet. 

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.  

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system. 

Job description

The Data and Analytics team plays a central role in enabling data‑driven decision‑making across Nordic RCC. The team develops and maintains analytical products, data pipelines, and information services that support operational, strategic, and regulatory needs. 

As an application developer in our Data and Analytics team, you will build and maintain the applications, integrations and analytics services that turn data into reliable tools for operational support, reporting and decision-making. You will work closely with engineers, data scientists, IT specialists and business stakeholders to develop solutions that are robust, maintainable and aligned with platform standards. 

The analytics work is highly explorative and dynamic, and it is therefore important that you have a proactive, open, and innovative mindset, and are not afraid to challenge the status quo and approach issues in a new way. With a combination of skills within application development and visualization, you will play a crucial role in shaping our approach to business challenges and optimizing our processes and data quality. 

What you will do: 

  • Build Python- and SQL-based applications, APIs and services for analytics, reporting and operational use. 

  • Develop data pipelines and integrations that turn source-system data into trusted analytical products. 

  • Create dashboards, tools and user interfaces that make power-system and operational data easier to use. 

  • Turn data science prototypes into stable applications, automation services and production-ready workflows. 

  • Maintain and improve the Analytics platform, including stability, documentation, releases and technical standards. 

  • Troubleshoot application and data-flow issues and help fix defects. 

  • Work with data engineers, architects, IT operations, cybersecurity and business users to align solutions with user needs and platform standards. 

What you bring: 

  • Experience developing applications or services in Python and working with SQL-based data. 

  • Experience building APIs, back-end services, automation scripts or data-driven applications. 

  • Experience with data pipelines, integrations or orchestration tools such as Dagster, Airflow or similar. 

  • Strong software engineering habits, including readable code, testing, documentation, version control and maintainable design. 

  • Experience using Git, DevOps, CI/CD pipelines or structured release processes. 

  • Ability to investigate technical issues, identify root causes and implement practical fixes. 

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, containers or Kubernetes is an advantage. 

  • Experience working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; knowledge of power systems or the energy sector is a plus, but not required. 

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements. Your experience and perspective could be exactly what we are looking for. 

Working Environment 

You will join a diverse and enthusiastic team in our office at Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. Nordic RCC is home to over twenty nationalities, with a healthy gender balance and a wide range of ages and backgrounds. We value curiosity, fellowship, respect, and transparency—and we hope you see yourself in these values. 

We offer flexible work arrangements to support a healthy work-life balance, including the option to work from home part of the time. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, physical presence in the office is expected on most days. 

You will report to the Data and Analytics head of team and collaborate regularly with colleagues from the Nordic RCC and occasionally also from the Nordic TSOs. Travel is limited and will not exceed 15 days per year. 

Application & Security Clearance 

Please apply online in English no later than 5 November 2026. Interviews will be conducted on a rolling basis. 

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.   

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.title: MIG WELDER
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
MIG Welder to cut and join metals and other materials. MIG Welder operate appropriate equipment to put together mechanical structures or parts with a great deal of precision. It is important as it provides the foundation for strong infrastructure. Include interpreting blueprints, selecting appropriate tools and metals, measuring, and assembling metal pieces, using cutting tools, determining gas ratios, drilling holes, and monitoring inventory. Health and safety regulations must be followed at all times and report any issues to the line manager. Ability to: - Cut and smoothen metal components using plasma cutters, portable grinders, lathe, and milling machines. - Read and interpret blueprints and production drawings in order to lay out a welding project. - Operate forklifts/cranes and use them in conveying work materials to welding site. - Collaborate with project managers and welding supervisors to ensure smooth work operations. - Guide and direct the activities of inexperienced/trainee welders. - Maintain welding safety guidelines and regulations to ensure a risk-free work environment. - Carry out welding according to set dimensions to meet general test requirements. - Organise and clean welding equipment on a regular basis. - Monitor inventory level of materials to notify supervisor of stock shortage. - Bore holes through metal workpieces using drill press. - Weld materials in flat, horizontal, vertical, and overhead positions. -Adjust gas gauges to set the flow rate of shield gas. - Conduct hydrostatic, x-ray, and tolerance tests to assess weld quality and conformance to specification. - Use measuring instruments such as micrometers and calipers to inspect angles, grooves or gap allowances. - Apply knowledge of metallurgy and geometry in selecting welding equipment and configuration.

jobs.title: Liikkuva huoltoasentaja, Cafe Break Finland Oy
jobs.description:
Haluatko työn, jossa yhdistyvät tekniikka, asiakaspalvelu ja itsenäinen työskentely?

Cafe Break on yksi Suomen suurimmista työpaikkojen kahvi- ja vesiratkaisuihin erikoistuneista yrityksistä. Palvelemme yli 1 800 asiakasta ympäri Suomen, ja automaateistamme nautitaan päivittäin yli 350 000 kupillista kahvia. Menestyksemme perustuu erinomaiseen asiakaspalveluun, nopeaan huoltoon sekä paikalliseen, yrittäjähenkiseen toimintatapaan. Asiakkaamme saavat oman kahvin ammattilaisen, joka pitää huolen siitä, että kahvitauot toimivat ilman katkoksia.

Nyt etsimme kasvavaan joukkoomme liikkuvaa huoltoasentajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen palvelemaan asiakkaitamme Pirkanmaan, Varsinais-Suomen ja Satakunnan alueella.

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

Työssä vastaat kahvi- ja vesiautomaattien:

- vikahuolloista
- uusien laitteiden asennuksista
- määräaikaishuolloista ja pesuista
- teknisestä vianetsinnästä
- asiakaspalvelusta asiakkaiden tiloissa
- omien huoltoreittien ja työpäivien suunnittelusta.
Cafe Breakin tärkeimpiä kilpailuetuja ovat huollon laatu ja nopeus. Siksi etsimme henkilöä, joka pystyy reagoimaan nopeasti muuttuviin tilanteisiin ja ratkomaan ongelmia asiakkaiden arjessa.

Saatat olla etsimämme henkilö, jos:

- nautit teknisten ongelmien ratkaisemisesta
- ymmärrät mekaanisten laitteiden toimintaa
- sinua kiinnostavat pumput, venttiilit, putkistot, liikkuvat osat ja elektroniikka
- työskentelet vastuullisesti ja oma-aloitteisesti
- osaat suunnitella työpäiväsi itsenäisesti
- siedät kiirettä, muutoksia ja ajoittaista epävarmuutta
- kohtaat asiakkaat ammattimaisesti myös haastavissa tilanteissa
- kommunikoit sujuvasti suomeksi.
Aikaisempaa kokemusta kahvi- tai vesiautomaateista ei tarvita. Tehtävässä tärkeintä ovat tekninen kiinnostus, oppimiskyky sekä halu sitoutua pitkäjänteisesti uuteen ammattiin.

Miksi tämä tehtävä on erilainen?

Tämä ei ole perinteinen huoltoasentajan työ, jossa päivän tehtävät ovat täsmälleen tiedossa aamulla.

Asiakkaidemme liiketoiminnan kannalta toimivat kahvi- ja vesiautomaatit ovat tärkeitä, joten kiireellinen vikailmoitus voi muuttaa koko päivän aikataulun hetkessä. Menestyäksesi tehtävässä sinun tulee viihtyä liikkuvassa työssä, osata priorisoida ja pysyä toimintakykyisenä myös silloin, kun kaikki ei mene alkuperäisen suunnitelman mukaan.

Jos nautit itsenäisyydestä, vastuusta ja ongelmanratkaisusta, tämä työ tarjoaa siihen erinomaiset mahdollisuudet.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

- vakituisen työsuhteen vakavaraisessa ja kasvavassa yrityksessä
- kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään
- kokeneen organisaation teknisen tuen
- tarvittavat hygienia- ja sähköturvallisuuskoulutukset
- yrityksen auton jolla kulkea työajot sekä polttoainekortin
- ePassi-/lounasedun
- kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen kokemuksesi mukaan (n. 16-18 €/h)
Työaika ja sijainti

- Työ on pääsääntöisesti arkisin tehtävää päivätyötä.
- Toiminta-alueena ovat Pirkanmaa, Varsinais-Suomi ja Satakunta.
- Työ sisältää runsaasti ajamista ja liikkumista asiakaskohteiden välillä.
Barona hoitaa rekrytointiprosessin Cafe Breakin puolesta. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian. Valittu henkilö tulee työllistymään suoraan Cafe Breakille.

Etsimme pitkäaikaista tekijää, joka haluaa kehittyä kahvi- ja vesiautomaattien huollon ammattilaiseksi osana yritystä, jonka toiminnan ytimessä ovat erinomainen asiakaspalvelu, rehellisyys, suomalainen yrittäjyys sekä nopea huoltopalvelu.

Take a break... Cafe Break!

jobs.title: Produktionskoordinator & Creative Specialist – barselsvikariat / Production Coordinator & Creative Specialist (Maternity Cover)
jobs.description:
Hos AVdesign i Billund søger vi en erfaren produktionskoordinator til et barselsvikariat i vores videoteam.

Du skal være god til at planlægge, holde overblik og få produktionerne til at hænge sammen – også når der kommer ændringer undervejs. Du får tæt kontakt med vores kunder og kolleger og deltager både i koordineringen og de praktiske opgaver i studiet og på location.

Om jobbet

Du får en central rolle i planlægningen og gennemførelsen af vores produktioner. Vi arbejder med video, livestreaming, produktoptagelser i studiet og andre medieproduktioner. Opgaverne varierer, og du skal have lyst til at hjælpe til, hvor der er brug for dig.

Vi søger dig, der har erfaring som producer, produktionsleder eller koordinator og er vant til at holde styr på planer, mennesker og deadlines.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Planlægge og koordinere produktioner i samarbejde med teamet.

  • Holde styr på tidsplaner, logistik og praktiske aftaler.

  • Have løbende kontakt med kunder og samarbejdspartnere og sikre, at de er godt informeret undervejs.

  • Deltage i produktionerne og hjælpe med praktiske og kreative opgaver.

  • Følge op på opgaver og sørge for, at projekterne bliver leveret til tiden.

  • Håndtere ændringer og finde løsninger, når noget ikke går som planlagt.

Du bliver en del af et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og deler viden, idéer og erfaringer.

Om dig

Du arbejder struktureret, tager initiativ og følger dine opgaver til dørs. Du er god til at kommunikere med både kunder og kolleger og kan bevare overblikket, når flere opgaver skal løses samtidig.

Vi lægger vægt på, at du:

  • Har erfaring med koordinering, projektarbejde, administration eller produktionsplanlægning.

  • Er god til at planlægge og holde styr på flere projekter og deadlines.

  • Er omhyggelig og har øje for detaljerne.

  • Tager ansvar og selv følger op på det, der mangler.

  • Kan tilpasse dig, når planer og prioriteringer ændrer sig.

  • Har lyst til en hverdag med forskellige opgaver og både koordinering og praktisk arbejde.

  • Er en god kollega, der samarbejder og hjælper til.

Erfaring med video, livestreaming eller broadcast er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det samme gælder lettere billedbehandling, videoredigering eller grundlæggende grafisk arbejde. Dansk er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Om AVdesign

AVdesign er en international produktionsvirksomhed i Billund, grundlagt i 2005. Vi er 16 kolleger inden for blandt andet animation, filmproduktion, lyd og produktionsledelse og løser opgaver for kunder over hele verden.

Du bliver en del af vores videoteam på seks personer. Vi går op i vores fag, godt samarbejde og muligheden for at udvikle os både fagligt og personligt.

Vi deler lokaler med My Instore Radio og er samlet 26 kolleger med forskellige nationaliteter.

Praktisk information

Stillingen er et barselsvikariat med tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt. Arbejdsstedet er Billund, og stillingen kræver fysisk fremmøde.

Send din motiverede ansøgning og dit CV til application@avdesign.dk. Har du spørgsmål, er du også velkommen til at skrive.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og lukker opslaget, når stillingen er besat.

ENGLISH:

Production Coordinator & Creative Specialist (Maternity Cover)

Do you imagine a position where you play a key role in an engaged and committed team creating professional film projects?

Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment and still deliver great results? 

Are you able to facilitate film production and at the same time create a supreme client experience, both in the studio and on location?

As producer at AVdesign you will get the chance to work in a top professional, positive and encouraging work environment with like-minded individuals who have a strong passion within their field. We value rich opportunities for professional and personal development. 

 

About us

We are a Billund based international production company. AVdesign was founded in 2005 and now employs 16 colleagues including animators, CG generalists, producers, production assistants, sound designers, videographers etc.

We create a great variety of content across different platforms and support clients worldwide with a range of exciting projects.

AVdesign is located together with My Instore Radio and in total we employ 26 skilled colleagues of different nationalities.

We are looking for a new colleague to join our video team, where we have gathered some of the most skilled and dedicated enthusiasts from the business. The team consists of 6 people.

 

About the role

This is a maternity cover position, offering a unique opportunity to join AVdesign and play a key role in coordinating and delivering a wide range of media productions.

We are looking for an experienced Producer / Production Manager with a strong background in production planning and project coordination.

 

The ideal candidate is organized, proactive, and adaptable, with an open mindset and a flexible approach to a broad range of assignments. Our projects vary across video production, live streaming, studio product shoots, and other media-related productions, so versatility and a willingness to take on different challenges are important.

At AVdesign, we foster an open, supportive, and collaborative working environment where sharing knowledge, ideas, and experience is highly valued.

Experience within the media industry, such as video production, live streaming, or broadcast, is an advantage, but not a strict requirement.

This is a hands-on role that combines operational coordination with practical involvement in productions. It requires a genuine interest in planning, problem-solving, and collaborating with colleagues, clients, and partners to ensure successful project delivery.

 

About you

You are a natural coordinator who enjoys bringing people, plans, and ideas together. You communicate confidently with clients and colleagues and thrive in a dynamic environment where priorities can change quickly.

You are proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple tasks at once. Whether coordinating logistics, supporting creative productions, or solving last-minute challenges, you take ownership and help keep projects on track. Fluency in Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Your profile:

·      Experience in a coordination, project support, administrative, or production-related role.

·      Strong planning and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.

·      Thrives in a dynamic environment and enjoys wearing multiple hats, contributing wherever needed to support the team and deliver great productions.

·      Excellent attention to detail and a structured approach to your work.

·      Experience with light photo editing, video editing, or basic graphic design is an advantage.

·      A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with a flexible approach to changing priorities.

·      Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

·      A positive team player who enjoys collaborating and helping others succeed.

 

Additional information

If you are interested in the position, we would like to hear from you soon. Potentially we are looking for someone to start as soon as possible.

The role is based in Billund, Denmark. Remote working is not an option. 

If you have any question about the job, please get in touch on: application@avdesign.dk

We look forward to receiving your motivated application and CV on: application@avdesign.dk

We will interview potential candidates on an ongoing basis and deactivate the job advert once the position has been filled.

jobs.title: Nordic Logistics ApS – Moving Employee - Flyttemedarbejder søges

Nordic Logistics ApS provides a wide range of moving, transportation, and delivery services. These include private moves, commercial relocations, transportation and delivery of furniture and equipment, as well as assignments requiring special handling.

We place great importance on our employees treating both customers and their belongings with respect and care. At the same time, we value good teamwork, flexibility, and efficient completion of daily tasks.

With us, you will become part of a workplace where we help each other and share responsibility for ensuring that every job is completed properly.

jobs.title: Yhdistelmäajoneuvonkuljettaja (Parola)
jobs.description:
Haemme yhdistelmäajoneuvonkuljettajaa vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Parolaan!

Etsitkö monipuolista kuljettajan työtä, jossa päivät eivät toista itseään? Tässä tehtävässä pääset yhdistämään ajotyön ja käytännön tekemisen osana vakavaraisen alan yrityksen toimintaa.

Työssäsi kuljetat raskaan kaluston renkaita asiakkaille sekä noudat pinnoitettavia renkaita takaisin käsiteltäväksi. Lähtöpiste sijaitsee Parolassa, josta kuormat lastataan pääsääntöisesti lastauslaiturilta lastaajan avustuksella. Asiakaskohteissa työ on usein omatoimisempaa – renkaita puretaan pumppukärryn avulla, ja noudettavat renkaat voivat sijaita esimerkiksi piha-alueilla, halleissa tai varastoissa. Renkaat painavat noin 50 kg kappaleelta, joten työ edellyttää hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja reipasta työotetta.

Työ sisältää reissutyötä noin 2–3 päivänä viikossa. Yöpymisiä tulee säännöllisesti arkipäivinä, mutta viikonlopputyötä tehdään vain poikkeustapauksissa.

Toivomme sinulta

- CE-ajokorttia ja voimassa olevaa ammattipätevyyttä.

- Kokemusta yhdistelmäajoneuvon kuljettamisesta.

- Hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja valmiutta osallistua myös kuormien käsittelyyn.

- Itsenäistä työotetta, vastuullisuutta ja asiakaspalveluhenkisyyttä.

- Tarjoamme sinulle

- Vakituisen ja kokoaikaisen työn (40 h/viikko).


TES mukaisen palkan.

Varmat tunnit myös hiljaisempina jaksoina. Mikäli ajoa on tilapäisesti vähemmän, työaikaa täydennetään esimerkiksi varastotehtävillä – työtunnit eivät vähene.

Monipuolisen työn, jossa yhdistyvät ajaminen, asiakaskohtaamiset ja käytännön tekeminen.

Perehdytyksen sekä mukavan työyhteisön.

Jos viihdyt ratin takana, et kaihda fyysistä työtä ja arvostat vakituista työpaikkaa luotettavan työnantajan palveluksessa, tämä tehtävä voi olla juuri sinua varten. Lähetä hakemuksesi ja CV mahdollisimman pian, sillä käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Sähköpostimme ovat muotoa etunimi.sukunimi@click-hp.fi. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Jan Kollin, Click Henkilöstöpalvelut, arkisin klo 9–16, puh. 050 411 0390.

jobs.title: Senior Developer to support the Green Energy Transition
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced software developer with a passion for building high-quality applications? Do you enjoy solving complex technical challenges and working closely with business experts to create solutions that support the efficient, reliable, and secure operation of the Nordic power grid? If you are looking to make an impact in supporting the green transition of the energy sector across Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark, you might be the person we are looking for.  

Join a fast-developing Nordic company and become a part of an agile environment where we develop innovative solutions. Nordic RCC is an important contributor to the green energy transition, supporting the Nordic transmission system operators in ensuring efficient and secure operations of the Nordic electricity power system.  

As part of our continued growth, Application Development is expanding significantly. We are strengthening our department with five Senior Developers and two Lead Developers, creating exciting opportunities to join a growing team and help shape the future of software development at Nordic RCC. 

Your role   

As a Senior Developer in Application Development, you will join a collaborative team of approximately 23 developers. Together, you will design, develop, and maintain internal applications that support our current and future business services. Working closely with product owners, architects, engineers, operators, and UX specialists, you will help translate business needs into robust technical solutions. 

You will be part of an application team that values sustainable solutions over quick fixes. We actively collaborate across applications and business services to identify common solutions, increase quality, and continuously improve the way we work. 

What you will do:

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust applications using C# and .NET. 

  • Write clean, maintainable, testable, and well-documented code following established design patterns and development standards. 

  • Transform complex engineering and operational requirements into effective software solutions by collaborating closely with architects, product owners, engineers, operators, and UX designers to build solutions that meet business and operational needs. 

  • Contribute to technical improvements, modernization efforts, and continuous optimization of existing applications. 

  • Participate in code reviews and help ensure high quality, reliability, and maintainability across solutions. 

  • Support troubleshooting and resolution of production issues. 

  • Serve as a technical role model within the team and mentor colleagues who are developing their technical skills. 

  • Stay current with new technologies, tools, and development practices relevant to Nordic RCC's technology landscape. 

Technology Stack:

  • Primary languages and frameworks  
    C#, .NET, SolidJS, JavaScript/TypeScript, Functional programming, Python  

  • Architecture, design patterns & integrations  
    Clean Architecture, SOLID, Event-driven Architecture, Message-driven Architecture, REST APIs 

  • Databases & Storage 
    Relational databases (SQL Server), NoSQL databases (MongoDB), GridFS, S3 

  • Infrastructure & Platform (on-prem)  
    Kubernetes (on-prem), Docker, Rancher, Prometheus/Grafana, ArgoCD, NginX  

  • Tooling and collaboration  
    Git, Visual Studio, VS Code, JetBrains Rider, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines 

We’re looking for someone with:  

  • Collaborative Mindset: You work closely with Application Architects, Product Owners, and fellow developers, contributing technical expertise, mentoring colleagues, and helping to ensure maintainable, scalable, and robust solutions. 

  • Technical Foundation: A degree in Computer Science, IT, Software Engineering, or a related field. 

  • Relevant Expertise: Experience developing enterprise-grade applications in C#/.NET, with a solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and modern development practices. 

  • Continuous Improvement: You identify opportunities to improve code quality, system reliability, team practices, and developer productivity. 

  • Nice to have: Experience working with functional programming, Clean Architecture principles, Azure DevOps, Kubernetes and Scrum processes.  

  • Energy Sector Knowledge: Familiarity with the power systems domain is a plus but not required.  

 
If you do not tick all the boxes, but think you could be a good match, don’t hesitate to apply for this position.   

What We Offer: A Flexible and Inclusive Workplace  

You will join a diverse organization of 23 nationalities, where inclusivity is celebrated, with more than 30% women on board (and a commitment to improving this balance). We are located in Copenhagen Towers office in Ørestad, with the flexibility to balance on-site and remote work 2 days a week.  

At Nordic RCC, we live by the values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency—values defined by our employees that shape how we collaborate and innovate. If you see yourself thriving in such an environment, we’d love to hear from you.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   

Application deadline and contact information  

Please apply online (in English) no later than 15/11-2026. Interviews will be held on a rolling basis up until the right candidate has been found.  

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.  

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system. 

If you have any questions, please contact Pernille Yde Juul Hansen, Manager, Application Development pyh@nordic-rcc.net / +45 3092 3111

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Physics-Adapted Numerical Methods
jobs.description:
Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Physics-Adapted Numerical Methods

The Department of Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Mathematical Sciences at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, has a vacancy for a postdoctoral research fellow in numerical mathematics for a period of 3 years.
 
About the postdoctoral project:

The postdoctoral position is part of the project “Physics-Adapted Numerical Methods for Two-Phase Flow” (PANum) funded by the Research Council of Norway. The project is a joint collaboration between Western Norway University of Applied Sciences and Hasselt University in Belgium.

In PANum the goal is to formulate and implement mathematical methods that are not only robust, efficient and have a low numerical error, but that also guarantee that important physical properties are fulfilled in the numerical solution. Ultimately, PANum will lead to a computational algorithm that reliably simulates two-phase flow.

The postdoctoral project will be part of developing and analyzing relevant numerical methods and implement them in an open-source framework that will be made openly available for others to use. This will be relevant for example for CO2 storage and design of fuel cells. 


Research environment:

The PANum project is situated in the Engineering Computing research group at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, and in the computational mathematics group (CMAT) at Hasselt University. Both groups focus strongly on numerical analysis and mathematical modelling. The prospective postdoctoral researcher will work in close collaboration with Carina Bringedal and Erlend Storvik from Engineering Computing, Jochen Schütz from CMAT, as well as the current PhD and master students connected to the PANum project.

 

Postdoctoral research fellows receive an annual work expense funding which can be used for conference participation, research visits, and equipment. The place of employment is campus Bergen or campus Førde. 


Qualifications:

Criteria for appointment to the position of postdoctoral fellow are regulated in Forskrift til universitets- og høyskoleloven.

Applicants must have earned a PhD degree in computer science, simulation science, applied mathematics or in a closely related field, or have submitted the PhD thesis before the application deadline. The PhD must have been awarded within 6 weeks after the application deadline. The scientific profile of qualified candidates must be within numerical methods for ODEs and PDEs.

 

A solid background in both the following fields is required:

  • Numerical analysis for ODEs and PDEs
  • Scientific programming using Python, MATLAB, C++, Julia, or similar

Furthermore, experience within:

  • collaborative code development and usage of version control tools like git
  • asymptotic methods, like two-scale asymptotic expansions or matched asymptotic expansions, for PDEs

will be considered an advantage when candidates are ranked. 

In addition to the required educational and scientific background, the following criteria will be evaluated:

  • Quality and relevance of PhD thesis
  • Quality and relevance of publications
  • Ability to work in intersection of theoretical and applied research
  • Ability to collaborate, lead the writing of research papers, ability to initiate and advance research, and research and scientific leadership potential
  • Oral and written good communication skills in English.

 

Career plan:

The person appointed shall, together with the institute, prepare a career plan that specifies the skills the postdoctoral researcher is to acquire. Competence goals shall be set both for the postdoctoral project and for any other career‑advancing work included in the position. The postdoctoral researcher will have access to career guidance.


Application procedure:

Applications will be evaluated by an expert panel of three members.

Applicants are asked to submit their application and CV online. Please use the link “Apply for this job” (“Søk stillingen”).

The following documentation should be uploaded as an attachment to the online application: 

  • A brief cover letter (max one page) including a description of research interests and motivation for working within the current project. The cover letter should include a detailed justification of your qualifications in relation to the listed requirements.
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and a complete list of academic publications)
  • PhD thesis
  • Transcripts and diplomas of bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degrees. If you have not yet been awarded your PhD degree, please submit a statement from your institution confirming the submission of the PhD thesis.
  • Copies of up to 5 selected academic publications
  • Names and contact details of 2 references (names, relation to candidate, email and telephone number).

Short-listed candidates might be required to give a research presentation, in addition to an interview. 

 

If the documents submitted are not in a Scandinavian language or in English, the applicants must submit certified translations of these. It is required that the applicant encloses a recognition document showing that their degree is equivalent to a Norwegian bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, or PhD. You can read more about applying for recognition of foreign higher education here.

 

The Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir) offers an automatic recognition document for certain degrees from selected countries. If the applicant’s degree is covered by the automatic recognition, it will be sufficient to attach this document. Read more about automatic recognition here.

 

As the HK-dir application process may take some time it is recommended to apply to HK-dir as soon as possible. If you have not received a recognition document from HK- dir within the application deadline, please enclose documentation from HK-dir showing that they have received your application.

 

Applicants should note that the evaluation will be based on the documentation submitted electronically via Jobbnorge within the submission deadline. The applicants are responsible for ensuring that all the documentation is submitted before the closing date. Applications cannot be sent by e-mail or to individuals at HVL.


Salary and benefits:

Exciting and stimulating work as part of a strong international academic environment.


An open and inclusive work environment with dedicated colleagues Favourable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.

The position as postdoctoral researcher is paid according to the Government's salary regulation, in position code 1352.


There is a compulsory 2 % deduction to the pension fund (see http://www.spk.no/en for more information). The successful applicant must comply with the guidelines that apply to the position at any time.


General information:

The appointment will be made in accordance with the regulations for State employees Law in Norway ("Lov om statens ansatte"). Organizational changes and changes in the duties and responsibilities associated with the position must be expected.

State employment shall reflect the multiplicity of the population at large to the highest possible degree. Western Norway University of Applied Sciences therefore aims to achieve a balanced age and gender composition and the recruitment of persons with diverse backgrounds.

Information about the applicants may be made public even though the applicant has requested not to be named in the list of applicants. The applicant will be notified if his/her request is not respected.

Short-listed applicants will be called in for an interview.

Employed on condition that you are granted a work and residence permit (must be considered individually).


Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is subjected to The Export Control Regulation. The regulation will be applied in the processing of the applications.


Contacts:

1) Professor Carina Bringedal, project leader of PANum

phone: +47 55 58 79 76, e-mail: carina.bringedal@hvl.no 

2) Associate Professor Therese B. Sjursen, assistant department leader

phone: +47 97 14 46 69 , e-mail: Therese.Berge.Sjursen@hvl.no 


Om arbeidsgiveren:

With about 17,500 students, Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is one of the largest higher education institutions in Norway. A broad range of academic programmes are offered at Bachelor, Master and PhD levels, spread out on five campuses Førde, Sogndal, Bergen, Stord og Haugesund.

Our ambition is to build stronger and more solid academic and research environments that will interact nationally and internationally. The aim is to become a recognized actor on the international higher education arena. Increased international cooperation and engagement in externally funded projects will work towards this goal.

The Department of Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Mathematical Sciences has a strong academic and research environment, offering programmes at bachelor’s, master’s and PhD levels. The department has around 1,100 students and more than 120 staff members, and plays a key role in advancing technologies for digitalisation and the green transition.

We offer education across our campuses in Førde, Bergen and Haugesund, with six study programmes in computer science and electrical engineering, and teaching contributions in mathematics, statistics and physics.

The department hosts active research groups in areas such as software engineering, artificial intelligence, robotics, human-computer interaction and sensor networks, and collaborates closely with industry and public sector partners.

jobs.description:

The successful candidates will work as part of a 2–3 person fencing crew, carrying out a wide range of fencing projects throughout County Kerry. The role will suit someone with previous fencing experience, but candidates with a strong construction, agricultural or practical background will also be considered. Full training can be provided. Previous fencing experience is an advantage, but the right attitude, reliability and willingness to learn are equally important. Timber fencing. Deer fencing. Mesh and wire fencing. Installation of gates and gate systems. Fence repairs and maintenance. Setting out fence lines. Digging and installing fence posts. Installing concrete and timber posts. Straining and tensioning wire. Fixing mesh, wire and rails. Using hand and power tools. Removing existing fencing where required. Site preparation and clean-up where required by the particular job. Loading, unloading and handling fencing materials. Maintaining a clean and safe working area. jobs.title: Kunnossapitoinsinööri, Vantaan Energia
jobs.description:
Haemme asiakkaallemme Vantaan Energialle kahta kunnossapitoinsinööriä vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Olemme yksi Pohjoismaiden johtavista kaupunkienergiayhtiöistä ja Suomen suurin jätteen energiahyödyntäjä. Tuotamme ja toimitamme lämpöä ja sähköä sekä tarjoamme näihin liittyviä palveluita. Ratkaisemme asiakkaidemme haasteita varmistamalla, että energia kiertää mahdollisimman tehokkaasti. Kehitämme jatkuvasti uutta, jotta vantaalaisilla olisi tarjolla edullista, toimitusvarmaa ja yhä vähäpäästöisempää energiaa sekä siihen liittyviä palveluita nyt ja tulevaisuudessa. Kunnianhimoisten suunnitelmiemme ydin on osaava, motivoitunutja hyvinvoiva henkilöstömme, josta huolehtiminen on meille ykkösasia. www.vantaanenergia.fi

Tehtävä

Tehtävät sijoittuvat korkealämpötilalaitokselle (HWP) ja jätevoimala 2-laitokselle. Kunnossapitoinsinöörinä vastaat oman laitoksesi kunnossapitotoiminnan johtamisesta, kehittämisestä ja toimintavarmuudesta. Kyseessä on vastuullinen ja monipuolinen asiantuntija-sekä esihenkilörooli, jossa toimit oman laitoksen kunnossapidon vetäjänä. Tavoitteenasi on varmistaa laitoksen turvallinen, tehokas ja häiriötön toiminta sekä tuotanto-omaisuuden pitkäjänteinen kehittäminen.

Tehtävässä toimit kunnossapidon tiimin esihenkilönä sekä vastaat ulkoistenpalveluntarjoajien ja alihankkijoiden ohjauksesta. Osallistut myös kunnossapidon budjetointiin, investointien suunnitteluun sekä kehityshankkeisiin yhteistyössä tuotannon, käytön ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- oman laitoksen kunnossapitotoiminnan sekä tiimin johtaminen ja kehittäminen
- tuotantolaitoksen käytettävyyden, turvallisuuden ja toimintavarmuuden varmistaminen
- kunnossapidon pitkän tähtäimen suunnittelu ja kehitystyö
- kunnossapidon budjetointiin osallistuminen sekä kustannusten seuranta
- hankintojen, kilpailutusten ja ulkoisten palveluiden koordinointi
- kunnossapidon KPI-mittareiden ja tunnuslukujen seuranta sekä kehittäminen
- alihankkijoiden työn ohjaus ja valvonta
- yhteistyö tuotannon, käytön, omaisuudenhallinnan sekä muiden sidosryhmien kanssa
- lakisääteisten velvollisuuksien ja turvallisuusvaatimusten noudattamisen varmistaminen.

Tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden ottaa kokonaisvastuun oman energiantuotantolaitoksen kunnossapidosta osana vakavaraista ja tulevaisuuteen katsovaa energia-alan yritystä. Pääset työskentelemään keskeisessä roolissa, jossa vaikutat suoraan laitoksen suorituskykyyn, turvallisuuteen ja kehitykseen.

Saat tueksesi kokeneen organisaation, osaavat kollegat sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa asiantuntijuuttasi ja johtamisosaamistasi energia-alan mielenkiintoisimpien tehtävien parissa.

Toivomme sinulta

- soveltuvaa teknistä korkeakoulututkintoa esim. kone- tai energiatekniikka (insinööri tai DI)
- usean vuoden kokemusta kunnossapitotehtävistä prosessiteollisuudessa
- voimalaitos-, energia- tai kaukolämpötekniikan tuntemusta
- ymmärrystä kunnossapidon menetelmistä ja kehittämisestä
- hyviä yhteistyö-, vuorovaikutus- ja johtamistaitoja ja valmiuksia toimia esihenkilötehtävistä
- kehitysmyönteistä, suunnitelmallista ja oma-aloitteista työotetta
- sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa sekä hyvää englannin kielen taitoa
- hankinta- ja kilpailutusosaaminen katsotaan eduksi
- kiinteiden polttoaineiden tuntemus katsotaan eduksi.

Työsuhde on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva ja solmitaan suoraan Vantaan Energia Oy:n kanssa.Barona toimii rekrytointikumppanina.

Oletko sinä uusi energia-alan huipputekijä?

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian oheisen linkin kautta. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana ja tehtävät täytetään heti sopivien henkilöiden löydyttyä. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan. Tietosuojasyistä emme vastaanota hakemuksia sähköpostitse tai WhatsAppin kautta.

Tehtävässä työskentely edellyttää hyväksyttyä turvallisuusselvitystä, työhöntulotarkastusta sekä huumausainetestausta. Nämä toteutetaan valituille henkilöille ennen työsuhteen alkamista.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Katri Hyppänen, Seniorikonsultti, Barona Teknisetasiantuntijat p. 050 439 9785 ma-to klo 10-14.

jobs.title: Embedded electronics and integration engineer
jobs.description:
**Role summary**

You are a hands-on electronics engineer focused on fast build–assemble–test–integrate cycles for reference models and NRE projects. Your work shortens iteration loops and increases throughput across multiple customer deliveries, ensuring hardware modules are built and validated reliably.

**What youll do**

- Assemble and bring up PCBs and modules; validate electrical and optical subsystems against defined checks and acceptance criteria.Debug hardware issues efficiently (power, signals, timing, communication, sensor behavior) and document findings and fixes.

- Support integration with firmware/software teams, including effective data sharing on interfaces such as UART/SPI/I²C, timing coordination, power modes, and logging/telemetry.

- Maintain practical test setups and measurement pipelines: fixtures, rigs, scripts, checklists, build documentation, and bench discipline to ensure repeatable results and smooth transfer to manufacturing.

- Interact with manufacturing and component partners to support builds, resolve issues, and improve build quality and consistency.

- Contribute to next-generation hardware concepts through component evaluations, sensor/illumination experiments, and new integration approaches — improving delivery speed and reducing rework across NRE and customer builds.


**What we expect**

- Strong hands-on competence in embedded electronics: PCB/module assembly, bring-up, debugging, and systematic fault isolation.

- Comfort with lab instrumentation and measurement workflows (e.g., oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters; building reliable test routines).

- Practical understanding of embedded interfaces and system integration constraints (UART/SPI/I²C, timing, power, signal integrity at a working level).

- Documentation discipline: you leave behind clear build notes, checklists, and test procedures others can repeat.

- Ability to work independently in a small team, prioritize effectively, and unblock others quickly.

- Experience with optical/IR components, cameras, illumination, or sensor systems is a plus.

- Embedded programming experience (including FPGA-adjacent and HDL work) is a plus, but not required.


**What we offer**

- A core role in building and validating real hardware in a deep-tech company shipping demanding sensing systems.

- Direct impact on delivery speed, reliability, and customer success; close collaboration with the founders and the core engineering team.

- Variety of work across reference designs, customer NRE builds, and next-generation prototypes.

- Competitive compensation aligned with experience; potential equity participation depending on role seniority and responsibilities.

- A culture that values technical rigor, clear communication, and practical execution over bureaucracy.

- Comprehensive health-care package, gym access


**Details**

Reporting to: Chief Technology Officer

Location: Joensuu, Finland, on-site work

Travel: Infrequent

Work authorization: Relocation assistance provided

**Send or submit your CV and portfolio.**

jobs.title: Vi søker utleieansvarlig til vår avdeling i Bergen
jobs.description:
Ramudden Norge AS er en helhetsleverandør innen sikkerhet på arbeidsplassen, med spesialkompetanse på løsninger for trafikkerte miljøer. Vi leverer utstyr, tjenester og kunnskap som bidrar til å skape trygge arbeidsplasser hver eneste dag.  

Vi ser nå etter en engasjert og dyktig kollega til et ettårig vikariat ved vår avdeling i Bergen. Vi ønsker å få vår nye kollega på plass så snart som mulig, og for den rette kandidaten kan det også være muligheter videre etter endt vikariat.

Som utleieansvarlig får du en variert arbeidshverdag der kundekontakt, utleie og koordinering går hånd i hånd med praktiske oppgaver på lageret. Du blir en viktig del av den daglige driften, og vi ser etter deg som liker å ta ansvar, holde oversikt og bidra til god flyt i en tidvis hektisk hverdag. Samtidig er du en lagspiller som samarbeider godt med de rundt deg og har sikkerhet og kvalitet i fokus.

 

Hva vil du jobbe med?  

De viktigste arbeidsoppgavene dine: 

  • Mottak, lasting og lossing av varer
  • Plukking, pakking og klargjøring av utstyr til prosjekter
  • Sørge for god orden og struktur på lageret
  • Ansvar for utleie, inkludert oppfølging av kunder, sjekklister og fakturering
  • Samhandle med kolleger, sjåfører og øvrige avdelinger
  • Daglig bruk av truck og hjullaster
  • Montering av varsling og sikringsutstyr ved arbeid på og langs vei

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som trives med ansvar og har evne til å holde oversikt i en variert og tidvis hektisk arbeidshverdag. Du følger opp oppgaver, prioriterer når det er mye som skjer og trives med å koordinere arbeidet på lageret.

Hos oss er samarbeid en viktig del av hverdagen. Vi håper derfor du er en kollega som bidrar positivt, hjelper til der det trengs og er opptatt av å skape en god arbeidshverdag sammen med menneskene rundt deg.

For å lykkes i rollen tror vi at du:

  • Jobber strukturert og nøyaktig
  • Er selvgående og løsningsorientert
  • Trives i dialog med både kunder og kolleger
  • Har et tydelig fokus på sikkerhet i arbeidshverdagen

Kvalifikasjoner:

  • Førerkort klasse B
  • Kompetansebevis M4 – Hjullaster
  • Gyldig truckførerbevis T1-T4
  • Bestå APV 1 og 3 (ikke et krav før ansettelse)
  • Gode norskkunnskaper, både muntlig og skriftlig
  • Er komfortabel med bruk av digitale verktøy i arbeidshverdagen

Det er en fordel om du også har:

  • Erfaring fra lignende rolle eller relevant bransje
  • Førerkort klasse BE og CE

 

Hvorfor velge oss?

Hos oss blir du en del av et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kolleger som samarbeider godt, deler kunnskap og har det hyggelig sammen på jobb. Du får en variert rolle med ansvar og mulighet til å bli en viktig del av den daglige driften ved avdelingen og bidra til et viktig sikkerhetsarbeid på og langs veiene.

Vi tilbyr:

  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter
  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser
  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med hjelpsomme og trivelige kollegaer
  • En trygg arbeidsplass i et selskap som setter kvalitet og sikkerhet først

 

Høres dette ut som noe for deg? Da håper vi du sender oss en søknad. Vi gleder oss til å høre fra deg!

 

Søknadsfrist: 30.10.26 – Vi vurderer søknader og tar kontakt med aktuelle kandidater fortløpende.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Ramudden Norge er en del av Ramudden Global med over 5 000 medarbeidere og 1 milliard euro i omsetning. Selskapet har hovedkontor i Gävle i Sverige, og består av over 70 avdelinger i 13 land fordelt på 2 kontinenter. Konsernets misjon er å bringe folk hjem trygt hver dag (To get people home safely every day). Ramudden i Norge har vokst siden starten i 2009 og spesielt etter 2015. I dag består selskapet av 13 forskjellige avdelinger fra Steinkjer i nord til Lindesnes i sør. Vi er drøyt 500 medarbeidere og omsetningen nærmer seg 500 millioner kroner, med store ambisjoner om å vokse enda mer. Ramudden leverer sikkerhetstjenester i og rundt veinettet og på byggeplasser i Norge, blant annet rådgivning, utleie av sikkerhetsutstyr, opplæring av personell, og tjenesteleveranser som f.eks. montering av utstyr og trafikkdirigering.

Et hjem med mennesket i centrum

På Løsning Friplejehjem arbejder vi ud fra et kristent menneskesyn, hvor næstekærlighed, respekt, værdighed og omsorg er grundlæggende værdier.

Vi tror på, at et plejehjem først og fremmest skal være et HJEM. Et sted, hvor beboerne oplever tryghed, selvbestemmelse og livsglæde, og hvor der er plads til både fællesskab og individuelle ønsker og behov.

Vi ønsker at skabe en hverdag, hvor vi ikke blot løser plejeopgaver, men ser det hele menneske og har blik for de små øjeblikke, der gør livet værdifuldt.

Vi søger dig, der:

  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedshjælper.

  • Brænder for at skabe en tryg, værdig og meningsfuld hverdag for ældre mennesker.

  • Møder beboere, pårørende og kollegaer med respekt, varme og et positivt menneskesyn.

  • Er fagligt engageret, ansvarsbevidst og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Værdsætter et godt kollegialt samarbejde og bidrager aktivt til et positivt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Er fleksibel og omstillingsparat – og trives med en hverdag, hvor vi hjælper hinanden på tværs.

  • Har lyst til at tage medansvar for udviklingen af vores fælles praksis og kultur.

  • Kan se dig selv arbejde ud fra vores værdigrundlag og omsætte det til handling i hverdagen.

Vi tilbyder dig:

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor værdierne ikke blot står på papir, men skal kunne mærkes i hverdagen.

  • En stilling primært i dagvagt med enkelte aftenvagter efter behov.

  • Mulighed for indflydelse på arbejdsgange, kultur og udviklingen af vores friplejehjem.

  • Et engageret kollegialt fællesskab, hvor vi hjælper hinanden og løfter i flok.

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på høj faglighed, trivsel og arbejdsglæde.

  • En nærværende ledelse med fokus på dialog, tillid og frihed under ansvar.

  • En hverdag, hvor der er plads til humor, forskellighed og gode idéer.

  • Mulighed for at gøre en reel forskel i beboernes liv.

Vil du være en del af vores fællesskab?

Vi søger en kollega, som har hjertet på rette sted, og som har lyst til at være med til at skabe et hjem, hvor både beboere, pårørende og medarbejdere føler sig velkomne, set og værdsat.

Vi tror på, at den bedste ældrepleje skabes i fællesskab – gennem faglighed, nærvær, engagement og respekt for det enkelte menneske.

Har du lyst til at være med? Så glæder vi os til at høre fra dig!

Arbejdstid og ansættelsesvilkår

Stillingen er primært i dagvagt, men du skal være indstillet på, at der efter behov kan forekomme enkelte aftenvagter.

Du indgår i et fast weekendrul med 5 arbejdsweekender over 12 uger.

jobs.title: Product Design Lead
jobs.description:
Fuel50 is a workforce transformation platform helping organisations understand workforce capability, build skills and enable internal mobility in an AI-driven world. Our products combine skills intelligence, talent marketplace experiences and responsible AI to help people and organisations take their next step.Â 

We are looking for a Product Design Lead to shape the next chapter of our product experience and design organisation.Â 

This is a senior player-coach role. You will lead and develop our product design team while staying close to the work, setting direction, shaping product strategy, prototyping ideas and helping teams ship high-quality experiences.Â 

You will work closely with Product and Engineering as a leadership trio, influencing decisions across the organisation and helping Fuel50 build products that are simple, trusted and valuable.Â 

If youâre a strategic design leader who still loves getting close to the work, developing people and shipping real product, weâd love to hear from you!Â 

What you'll do:
  • Lead, manage and coach our product designers, supporting their growth and helping them reach their next level.Â 
  • Set and communicate a clear product design vision across Fuel50's skills intelligence, talent mobility and AI-powered experiences, and tell the story of where our products are going in a way that excites customers, colleagues and leadership.Â 
  • Own the design direction without waiting for it to be handed to you. Spot opportunities, form a point of view, and prototype ideas to make them tangible.Â 
  • Bring a strong point of view to senior conversations, challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions across the business.Â 
  • Partner with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery, balancing customer value, design quality, technical reality and pace.Â 
  • Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.Â 
  • Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.Â 
  • Evolve our design system, accessibility standards (including WCAG compliance) and design-to-code practices so Fuel50 feels coherent and high quality across every product.Â 
  • Shape design team structure, capability, hiring, planning and ways of working as the organisation evolves.Â 
What you'll bring:
  • Experience in product design in a SaaS or technology environment (we suggest 7 or more years), including at least 2 years leading, managing or coaching designers, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing teams.Â 
  • Strong product design craft across discovery, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, research and shipped digital products.Â 
  • Experience designing complex, connected systems and journeys for multiple personas, ideally in an enterprise or B2B product.Â 
  • The ability to think big and set a compelling vision, while staying pragmatic about what can be learned and shipped next.Â 
  • The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.Â 
  • Confidence working with experienced senior stakeholders and influencing through clarity, judgement and strong communication.Â 
  • Experience working closely with Product and Engineering as a genuine cross-functional trio.Â 
  • Technical fluency and a willingness to get into the code. You should be comfortable building working prototypes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or similar tools, and have contributed code that has shipped to production, for example front-end changes or design system components submitted through pull requests.Â 
  • Hands-on experience using AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, to prototype faster and ship real work. We want someone who uses these tools well and can show how they have changed the way their team works.Â 
  • Working knowledge of accessibility and WCAG. You have designed to WCAG standards, tested for it, and built accessibility into your team's design system and review process.Â 
  • An interest in design systems and data-informed decision-making.Â 

You do not need to tick every box. We care about the quality of your thinking, the way you work with people and your ability to turn ambitious ideas into better product experiences.Â 

All Fuellies are a core part of our culture and making Fuel50 an amazing place to work. Some additional benefits are:Â Â 

  • A day off on your birthday and your Fuel50 anniversaryÂ 
  • A âReFuel Dayâ once a quarter to relax and refuelÂ 
  • Remote work and flexible work times - we're supportive of school commitments, traveling in off-peak hours, and attending to lifeâs eventsÂ 
  • A progressive parental leave policyÂ 
  • Comprehensive fully subsidised health insurance with Southern CrossÂ 
What's it like to be a Fuellie?

Fuel50âs team is fully remote, with an HQ in New Zealand, and team members across five countries. We have a co-working space in the BHive in Takapuna that we use to meet occasionally for team and strategic planning and other team events. If youâre based outside of Auckland and are needed on-site for anything, weâll pay for you to get here.Â 

We know that having the right people with the right attitude and behaviour is a big part of what makes us successful.Â  Living our values is an important part of being successful in this role.Â Â 

  • We have a culture around continuous and respectful feedback and recognition - be part of a team working towards a common goal and helping each other every step of the way.Â Â 
  • We have #SuperheroAwards at quarterly planning meetings and spontaneous recognition and shout-outs across the business.Â Â 
  • We'll have your back when you need help - your colleagues want to see you succeed and work hard to help you do so.Â Â 
  • We work hard and deliver amazing results to our clients - when you see our amazing feedback, you'll be proud to be a Fuellie.Â 
Application process:

If this sounds like you, then please apply. If youâre not sure you're ready or perhaps you don't meet all requirements yet, please apply anyway. We'll review every application that we get.Â Â 

Please include a link to your portfolio or attach it as part of your application.Â 

This role is based in New Zealand, candidates must hold the relevant right to work in NZ i.e. Citizenship or a work visa at the time of application.Â

HELSINKI

Salin palvelupäällikkö, NORD, Radisson Blu Royal Hotel, Helsinki

Uudistunut Radisson Blu Royal Hotel, Helsinki avautui keväällä 2026. Muodonmuutoksen kokenut ydinkeskustan hotelli on Helsingin halutuin kokous- ja tapahtumahotelli.

Hotellissa on 261 huonetta, 13 täysin uudistettua kokous- ja juhlatilaa jopa 600 hengen tilaisuuksiin, tyylikäs cocktailbaari sekä pohjoismaisia makuja tarjoava ravintola NORD.

Hotellimme ylittää korkeimmatkin turvallisuuden ja laadun vaatimukset, oli kyseessä sitten kansainvälinen VIP-vieras tai suurempi ryhmä. Osaava henkilökuntamme kykenee täyttämään vaativimmatkin erityistoiveet ja on omistautunut tekemään asiakkaidemme vierailusta ikimuistoisen Yes I Can- palveluasenteella.

Haemme salin palvelupäällikköä NORD-ravintolaan. Työsuhde on vakituinen ja osa-aikainen (90 h / 3 vko).

Etsimme lämminhenkistä ja myynnillistä ravintola-alan ammattilaista, joka arvostaa laadukasta asiakaspalvelua. Toimit vuorossa olevan tiimin esihenkilönä, johdat arkea esimerkilläsi ja luot edellytykset tiimin onnistumiselle. Kehität NORDin palvelukulttuuria ja varmistat, että jokainen vieras saa odotukset ylittävän elämyksen. Odotamme sinulta kokemusta vastaavanlaisista tehtävistä sekä erinomaisia asiakaspalvelu- ja organisointitaitoja.

Työssäsi raportoit ravintolapäällikölle ja teet tiivistä yhteistyötä muun hotellin kanssa.

Vastuullisen ja monipuolisen työtehtävän yhdessä Suomen kiinnostavimmista tapahtumataloista

Vahvan tuen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön
Alan monipuolisimmat henkilökuntaedut mm. S-ryhmän henkilökuntaedut, ePassi, hotelli- ja ravintolaetuja Suomessa sekä Virossa ja Radisson Hotel Group -verkoston edut maailmalla

Kokemusta esihenkilötyöstä korkeatasoisessa ravintolaympäristössä
Aitoa myyntihenkisyyttä ja kykyä rakentaa kannattavaa palvelua
Erinomaista tilannetajua, vieraanvaraisuutta ja esimerkillä johtamista
Alan koulutus ja kansainvälinen kokemus katsotaan eduksi
Valmiutta työskennellä vuorotyössä, painottuen iltaan

Työsuhde on vakituinenjaosa-aikainen 90 h/3 vko. Aloitus sopimuksen mukaan. Jos kiinnostuit ja haluat päästä työskentelemään hotelliimme, täytä hakemus 25.10.2026 mennessä.

Me operoimme Suomessa neljäätoista Sokos Hotels -ketjun hotellia ja kahdeksaa Radisson Hotels -ketjun hotellia. Sokotel Oy toimii pääkaupunkiseudulla, Tampereella ja Oulussa.

jobs.title: Corporate Trainer, EMEA
jobs.description:
Do you want to work in a sustainable industry that will transform our daily lives? Then join us! We have an exciting opportunity for a technically adept, customer-oriented Corporate Trainer in our EMEA organization. In this role your focus will be on developing EYKONs training offering, especially focusing on software trainings portfolio.

Your Responsibilities:

\- Developing & implementing EYKONs training strategy

\- Continuously reviewing the performance of our training offering, including tools, format and platform used. You will also identify areas of improvement and initiate changes where needed.

\- Regularly evaluate and adapt training offerings to meet evolving customer and market needs.

\- Applying best practice to develop a focused and concise application/software training portfolio and secure a modern and attractive knowledge transfer to our customers, partners and employees.

\- Delivering applications/software and device training in local language for EN, FI, and possibly Swedish.

\- Working closely with other EMEA functions, such as Customer Support, Customer Projects, Product Management, Sales & Training Team to develop trainings matching customer expectations and specificities

\- Getting to know the customers and software product portfolio in practical terms by assisting in some technical support topics

What you bring with you:

You have experience as a technical trainer and a passion for helping customers and colleagues build their knowledge and skills. Ideally, you have worked with B2B software, applications, or technical products and understand how to deliver engaging learning experiences.

You are familiar with modern training methods, including classroom training, virtual instructor-led training, e-learning, webinars, and other digital learning solutions. Experience in developing training concepts, programs, or strategies is considered an advantage.

You enjoy working in an international environment and collaborating with colleagues, customers, and partners across different cultures and functions. You are customer-focused, proactive, and able to work independently while driving improvements and new ideas.

To succeed in this role, you should have:

\- Experience delivering technical or software-related training

\- Strong presentation and communication skills

\- Fluency in English, both written and spoken

\- A collaborative and customer-oriented mindset

\- A proactive, self-driven, and hands-on approach

\- Experience working in international or matrix organizations

The following would be considered an advantage:

\- Additional European language skills, especially Finnish or Swedish

\- Knowledge of SaaS, IoT, cybersecurity, or other software-related technologies

\- Understanding of communication technologies such as LTE, G3 Powerline, and Ethernet

\- Background in electrical engineering, measurement technologies, or related technical fields

We are also driven by the mission of creating an exceptional place to work for our people, therefore we will provide you with:

\- Exciting and meaningful career in multicultural environment embracing change for a greener tomorrow

\- Talented colleagues and high performing teams

\- Versatile work tasks and support for professional development

\- Work community where we respect each other and have open information sharing

\- Flexible working model to fit individual needs

\- Wellbeing support including Epassi flex & lunch benefit, and preventive dental care support

Location: Jyväskylä or Vantaa, Finland

For more information, please contact Johanna Ekwere, johanna.ekwere@eykon-solutions.com

Ready to make an impact through learning and development? We would love to hear from you. Apply today and help shape the future of EYKON's training excellence across EMEA.

Please submit your application and CV latest on 5th of November 2026.

jobs.title: Skønne Frederik i Farum mangler sin voksenven. Så søger du et deltidsarbejde, hvor hyggelige cykelture er i højsædet så se her!
jobs.description:
Måske er du uddannet socialpædagog, pædagog eller har masser af erfaring med børn med særlige behov. Og kan du betegne dig selv som værende moden, med en mental robusthed, og trives med en fast struktur så se her!

Om Frederik                                             

Frederik er 8 år gammel men grundet hans kognitive udfordringer er han sammenligning med et barn på 1,5. Han har diagnoserne infantil autisme og mental retardering i sværere grad. Derudover har Frederik ADHD og har ikke et talesprog. Frederik er en sød og kærlig dreng som hurtigt viser tillid til de personer han omgås. Kvag hans diagnoser er Frederik meget afhængig af en fast struktur, rutiner og forudsigelighed, så det er et krav at du som hjælper har erfaring indenfor området og kan bidrage til en struktureret og forudsigelig dag. 

 

Om opgaven 

Opgaven går ud på at aflaste forældrene i eftermiddagstimerne, hvor en stor del af dette er, at hjælpe Frederik ud på sin faste daglige tur ud af huset, på en fast rute i det naturskønne område omkring familiens hjem. Til turen som varer ca. en time, har familien en el dreven ladcykel til formålet. 

Derudover holder Frederik også af at hoppe på familiens trampolin i haven, så du skal som hjælper også bruge tid på trampolinen, sammen med ham. Det er vigtigt at du er klar på at Frederik skal overvåges hele tiden og have hjælp til det meste i løbet af dagen, inklusiv eventuel hjælp til bleskift.. Familien vil stå for grundig oplæring af alle opgaver omkring Frederik, da det er vigtigt for dem at du som hjælper føler dig tryg og du vil derfor blive budt indenfor i et kærligt og omsorgsfuldt hjem. 

Hvem er du?

Du skal være i stand til at skabe de trygge rammer og forudsigelighed som Frederik har behov for. Have et kærligt sind, let til smil og sidst men ikke mindst, lyst til at være fysisk aktiv på de daglige cykelture året rundt som jobbet kræver. Kan du sige ja til disse ting, vil du blive budt indenfor hos en kærlig, rummelig familie hvor du vil gøre en kæmpe forskel.

Timerne

Stillingen er på 18 timer om måneden fordelt på 1 til 2 vagter om ugen om eftermiddagen i hverdage fra ca. kl. 14.00 og 3-4 timer per vagt som planlægges med familien. Der vil på sigt når der er dannet en solid tryg relation imellem Frederik, hans familie og dig være mulighed for flere timer, hvor disse også kan placeres om natten.               

                                
 Hvem er Olivia Danmark ? 

  • Vi står for kvalitet, viden og dedikation og arbejder med det daglig. 
  • Vi tror på ordentlighed i alt det, vi gør 
  • Vi arbejder med at vi meningsfuldt forskellige
  • Vi tager ansvar og skaber løsninger – hver dag


  Løn og vilkår

Som ansat hos Olivia Danmark er du sikret Løn og ansættelsesvilkår som følger overenskomst med FOA, og fastsættes ud fra dine kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Ansøgning og kontakt 

Ansøg stillingen hurtigst muligt eller inden deadline. Vi kalder løbende til samtale, så skriv gerne til os i dag.   

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte Charlotte Bay Wedebye på mail charlotte.wedebye@oliviadanmark.dk 

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Operations Manager for Lapland Luxury DMC
jobs.description:
Lapland Luxury DMC is a private destination management company (DMC) specialising in tailor-made luxury experiences in Lapland. Our portfolio includes Hidden Arctic Cloud Villas, located approximately 30 minutes from Rovaniemi city centre, AINO Private Island, and other exclusive luxury villas.

We are now looking for a passionate and experienced Operations Manager to lead and develop our operations in Lapland Luxury DMC and ensure exceptional experiences for our international guests.

**About the role:**

As an Operations Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth daily operations and high-quality delivery of Lapland Luxury's exclusive experiences and services.

You will lead your team, coordinate operational resources, and work closely with other departments to ensure that every guest experience meets our high standards. In this role, you will combine hands-on operational leadership with a proactive approach to developing our services, processes, and ways of working.

**Your key responsibilities include:**

- Operational management – overseeing the daily operations, quality, and delivery of Lapland Luxury's services and guest experiences.

- Team leadership and development – recruiting, onboarding, training, and supervising team members while fostering a positive and service-oriented working environment.

- Resource planning and coordination – ensuring effective scheduling and coordination of operational resources to support seamless service delivery.

- Guest experience and customer relationships – maintaining exceptional service standards, managing guest-related matters, and continuously improving customer satisfaction.

- Service and event coordination – planning and coordinating tailored experiences, activities, and events in close collaboration with other departments and partners.

- Continuous improvement – actively developing operational processes, service quality, and efficiency to ensure the fulfilment of our customer promise.


**What we expect from you:**

We are looking for a confident, hands-on leader who thrives in a dynamic hospitality environment and is passionate about delivering outstanding guest experiences.

To succeed in this role, we value:

- Previous experience in operational management, hospitality or tourism

- Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to motivate, support, and develop a team.

- Excellent organizational, planning, and problem-solving skills.

- A genuine passion for exceptional customer service and attention to detail.

- A proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to take ownership and make decisions independently.

- Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced environment where priorities may change.

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and build lasting customer relationships.

- Fluency in English; other languages are considered an advantage.

- Good digital skills and the ability to manage operational systems and processes.


We expect you to have previous experience in luxury hospitality, destination management, or Arctic programme services, along with a solid understanding of delivering high-quality guest experiences.

**What we offer:**

At Lapland Luxury, you will have the opportunity to lead and develop exceptional hospitality experiences in one of the most unique destinations in the world.

We offer you:

- A diverse and responsible management role within an exclusive luxury hospitality environment.

- The opportunity to make a real impact on operational excellence, guest experiences, and service development.

- A supportive and collaborative team within the SantaPark Arctic World.

- The opportunity to work with international guests and unique, tailor-made luxury experiences.

- Professional development opportunities and the chance to grow your leadership expertise.

- An inspiring working environment surrounded by the extraordinary nature of Finnish Lapland.

- Full-time, permanent contract

- Employee benefits across the SantaPark Arctic World group.


Position will be filled as soon as the right person is found so please send your application soon - We are excited to hear from you!

jobs.title: IT-Manager
jobs.description:

Etsimme kokenutta ja kehittämishenkistä IT Manageria vastaamaan konsernimme IT-ympäristön toimivuudesta, turvallisuudesta ja jatkuvasta kehittämisestä. - Konsernin IT-ympäristön, järjestelmien, laitteiden ja infrastruktuurin hallinta ja kehittäminen

- IT-strategian toteuttaminen, IT-budjetin seuranta ja kehityshankkeiden koordinointi

- Tietoturvan, tietosuojan ja järjestelmien toimintavarmuuden varmistaminen

- IT-palvelukumppaneiden, toimittajasuhteiden ja palvelutasojen hallinta

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Etsimme oma-aloitteista ja ratkaisukeskeistä IT-alan ammattilaista, joka hallitsee laajoja kokonaisuuksia ja tarttuu tarvittaessa myös käytännön tekemiseen.

Odotamme sinulta:

- Vahvaa kokemusta IT-ympäristöjen hallinnasta ja kehittämisestä sekä vastuullisista IT-tehtävistä

Arvostamme kokemusta matkailu-, majoitus- tai palvelualalta sekä ymmärrystä sesonkiluonteisen liiketoiminnan erityispiirteistä.

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

- Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän ainutlaatuisessa matkailualan konsernissa
