jobs.title: Asennustyönjohtaja / vastaava työnjohtaja
jobs.description:
_Me Parmacolla uskomme, että rakennusten tulisi olla yhtä joustavia kuin yhteisöt, joita ne palvelevat. Muutamme yhteiskuntaa dynaamisella arkkitehtuurilla – muunneltavilla, siirrettävillä ja kiertotalouteen perustuvilla rakennuksilla, jotka elävät käyttäjiensä mukana. Tule mukaan tekemään tilaa kestävälle tulevaisuudelle!_

Haemme kokenutta **asennustyönjohtajaa / vastaavaa työnjohtajaa** itsenäiseen ja vastuulliseen rooliin johtamaan rakennushankkeitamme Helsingin seudulla. Vastaat samanaikaisesti yhden tai useamman hankkeen päivittäisestä johtamisesta ja varmistat, että työt etenevät turvallisesti, laadukkaasti, aikataulussa ja suunnitelmien mukaisesti.

Rakennustemme moduulit valmistetaan tehtaillamme ja asennetaan sekä viimeistellään valmiiksi työmaalla. Johdat työmaata kokonaisvaltaisesti, vastaat työmaan viranomaisvelvoitteista, sovitat yhteen työvaiheita ja aliurakoitsijoiden työtä, koordinoit - toimituksia sekä laadit tarvittavat työmaasuunnitelmat ja -dokumentaation. Seuraat ja raportoit työn etenemistä, ratkaiset työmaalla syntyviä tilanteita sekä osallistut työmaakokouksiin, katselmuksiin, tarkastuksiin ja luovutuksiin. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä projektinjohdon, suunnittelun, hankinnan, asiakkaiden, aliurakoitsijoiden ja tehtaidemme kanssa.

Tehtävässä ei ole ennalta määriteltyä päivittäistä työaikaa, vaan suunnittelet ja rytmität työsi itsenäisesti hankkeiden tavoitteiden ja työmaiden vaiheiden mukaan. Tämä tuo työhön vapautta, mutta edellyttää myös valmiutta mukauttaa työpäivää työmaiden tilanteisiin.

Työskentelet pääasiassa Helsingin seudun rakennuskohteissa. Tehtävään kuuluu lisäksi satunnaisia käyntejä Parmacon tehtailla Hämeenlinnassa, Leppävirralla ja Pyhäjoella. Voimassa oleva B-ajokortti vaaditaan, mutta omaa autoa ei edellytetä.

**Menestyt tehtävässä hyvin, kun**

- Sinulla on soveltuva rakennusalan korkeakoulututkinto, esimerkiksi rakennusmestarin, rakennusinsinöörin tai diplomi-insinöörin tutkinto.

- Sinulla on vaativan luokan vastaavan työnjohtajan pätevyys tai valmiudet hakea sitä sekä osaamista toimia vastaavana työnjohtajajana.

- Työmaan eri työvaiheet ovat sinulle tuttuja ja hallitset tarvittavien työmaasuunnitelmien ja -dokumentaation laatimisen.

- Pystyt johtamaan ja priorisoimaan useita samanaikaisia hankkeita ja työvaiheita.

- Osaat johtaa aliurakoitsijoita ja tehdä sujuvaa yhteistyötä eri osapuolten kanssa.

- Sinulla on toimiva ja kattava rakennusalan yhteistyö- ja aliurakoitsijaverkosto.

- Toimit käytännönläheisesti ja ratkaisukeskeisesti sekä viet sovitut asiat määrätietoisesti maaliin.

- Turvallisuus ja laatu ohjaavat toimintaasi.

- Hallitset tietotekniset työvälineet ja viestit sujuvasti suomeksi.


Kokemus koulu-, päiväkoti- tai muista julkisista rakennushankkeista sekä moduuli-, elementti- tai teollisesta rakentamisesta katsotaan eduksi. Arvostamme myös erittäin vaativan luokan vastaavan työnjohtajan pätevyyttä, muuta kielitaitoa ja Dalux-osaamista.

**Mitä tarjoamme?**

- Itsenäisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän, jossa johdat työmaan toteutusta ja vaikutat suoraan hankkeen onnistumiseen.

- Monipuolisia, yhteisöille tärkeitä rakennushankkeita pääosin koulu- ja päiväkotisektorilla.

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja työmaidemme toimintatapoja.

- Osaavan projektinjohdon, suunnittelun, hankinnan ja tuotannon tuen.

- Kokemukseesi ja osaamiseesi perustuvan palkan sekä tehtävän hoitamiseen tarvittavat työvälineet.


**Haku ja lisätiedot**

Haastatteluihin edetään arviolta viikoilla 45–46. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa tehtävän esihenkilö, työpäällikkö Jussi Lavikainen, p. 040 145 5221.

jobs.title: Sähköautomaatioasentaja, Turku
jobs.description:
_Asiakkaamme on suomalainen Turussa sijaitseva teollisuuden kunnossapidon vahva ammattilainen ja yritys on perustettu vuonna 1995. Yritys tarjoaa asiakkailleen muun muassa tuotantokoneiden- ja laitteiden asennukset, korjaukset sekä huollot. Tavallisten kunnossapitopalveluiden lisäksi he tarjoavat kokonaisvaltaisia kunnossapidon palvelusopimuksia ja kiinteähintaisia tuotteistettuja palveluita. Yritys tarjoaa myös kiinteistöjen LVIS-palveluita._

Nyt heidän riveissään on paikka automaatioasentajalle. Työnkuva koostuu teollisuuden sähköautomaatiolaitteiden asennus-, kytkentä- ja huoltotöistä. Tämän lisäksi automaatioasentaja vastaa järjestelmien tarkastuksista ja niiden toimivuuden testauksesta. Työ on osaltaan liikkuvaa, joten valittavan henkilön tulee olla valmis liikkumaan myös eri asiakkaiden toimipisteisiin. Tämän vuoksi vaadimme hakijalta B-ajokorttia.

Hakijalta odotamme aikaisempaa työkokemusta teollisuuden kunnossapidosta, sähkö- tai automaatioalan koulutusta sekä kokemusta sähkö- ja automaatioalan asennuksista. Tulevan sähköautomaatioasentajan tulee olla oma-aloitteinen, itseohjautuva sekä motivoitunut ja aidosti kiinnostunut alasta. jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer, Konecranes
jobs.description:
We are now looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join Konecranes' Shipyard Cranes team and contribute to some of the world's most demanding crane engineering projects.

Konecranes moves what matters. We are a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with more than 16,000 professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs.

Konecranes is committed to ensuring that all employees and job applicants are treated fairly in an environment free from discrimination and where diversity, equity and inclusion are valued.

[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/49cf9064-f425-4d1c-b5e9-ecfdc64d4c69/original.jpeg]

Would you be our new Mechanical Engineer?

As a Mechanical Engineer, you will join Konecranes' Shipyard Cranes team and work on some of the world's largest and most technically demanding crane projects.

Your responsibilities include structural analyses, strength calculations and mechanical design throughout both the tendering and project execution phases. You will perform strength analyses, mass, cross-sectional and machinery calculations, transportation and erection analyses, and support design decisions by interpreting standards, specifications and customer requirements.

Working closely with designers, project teams and customers, you will contribute to solving complex engineering challenges while gradually taking on broader technical responsibilities. The role offers a unique opportunity to develop towards future mechanical Chief Project Engineer responsibilities with support from experienced senior engineering professionals.

The position is full-time and employed through Biisoni. The role offers flexible working hours, a hybrid working model with approximately one office day per week in Hyvinkää, and international travel of around 30-60 days per year.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for an engineer with experience in strength analysis and steel structures. Your background may come from industrial machinery, mobile equipment, heavy industrial equipment, steel structures, or similar engineering environments.

To succeed in this role, you have a good understanding of structural mechanics, strength calculations, dynamic analysis and mechanical design as well as the ability to interpret 2D engineering drawings. A Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, with major in Machine Design, Steel Structures, Engineering Mechanics or similar is preferred, but candidates with relevant practical experience are also encouraged to apply.

Experience with Finnsap, NX, Simcenter, Ansys, or similar engineering tools is considered an advantage. Strong communication skills in English are required, while Finnish language skills are considered a plus. As a person, you are analytical, proactive and eager to learn. You enjoy solving technical challenges, taking ownership and developing your expertise over the long term.

Why us?

Konecranes' Shipyard Cranes business offers a highly specialised engineering environment where every project is unique. You will work on some of the worlds largest and most technically advanced shipyard cranes, learn from experienced experts and build expertise in demanding structural engineering and strength analysis. The role provides a clear development path towards broader engineering responsibility and future mechanical Chief Project Engineer responsibilities in an international project environment.

Have we got your interest?

If you are interested, we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Please submit your application via the link by 30.10.2026. We review applications and start interviews already during the application period.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. The employment relationship will be established with Biisoni. For more information about the position, please contact Saija Salter, Recruitment Consultant, via email at saija.salter@biisoni.fi [saija.salter@biisoni.fi].

jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE ROLE: 

We're seeking an Engineering Manager, Mobile to lead the future of our mobile experiences at Replit. In this role, you'll build and manage a team that bridges design and engineering to create intuitive, performant mobile interfaces that make software creation accessible on any device. You'll guide your team in building production-ready frameworks and patterns that enable high-quality in-product experiences, ensuring users can create apps from their phones or tablets with the same power as desktop.




YOU WILL:

 - Build, mentor, and grow a team of mobile design engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and design craftsmanship

jobs.title: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems (m/f)
jobs.description:
Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems

Position: Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer – Adaptive Security Systems
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette, Luxembourg
Start Date: Immediate
Type: Full-time

Company Overview

We're LuxQuantum, a Luxembourg-based deep-tech startup developing the next generation of quantum-safe communication systems.

Our mission is to address one of the key challenges in modern cybersecurity: how to combine Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) and Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) into a unified, adaptive, and scalable security architecture.

At LuxQuantum, we believe security decisions should not be static. Different data, infrastructures, risks, trust assumptions, and operational conditions may require different protection strategies. That's why we are developing intelligent and adaptive approaches to model these complex environments and support dynamic security and orchestration decisions.

Our work brings together AI, systems modeling, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications, creating research challenges that span multiple scientific and engineering disciplines.

We are a small and ambitious team of researchers, engineers, and innovators who enjoy exploring difficult problems, learning across disciplines, and turning research ideas into real-world technology.

Role Overview

As a Systems Modeling & AI Research Engineer, you will contribute to the research and development of the intelligence and decision-making capabilities behind LuxQuantum's adaptive quantum-safe security systems.

You will investigate how complex security and communication systems can adapt to changing risks, uncertainty, trust requirements, infrastructure conditions, and operational constraints. Your work may involve mathematical and computational modeling, optimization, probabilistic methods, AI, or other data-driven and decision-support approaches.

You will work closely with our research and engineering team to formulate research problems, explore and compare different approaches, develop models and algorithms, evaluate them through experiments and simulations, and translate promising results into working prototypes.

The research sits at the intersection of systems modeling, intelligent decision-making, cybersecurity, and quantum-safe communications.

What You'll Do

• Investigate challenging research problems in intelligent and adaptive security systems
• Formulate research questions, develop new approaches, and design experiments and simulations to evaluate them
• Develop mathematical, computational, and AI-based models for decision-making under uncertainty, risk, and changing operational conditions
• Explore adaptive approaches for the orchestration and optimization of hybrid quantum-safe systems
• Design and evaluate methods that help security systems dynamically respond to changing infrastructure, trust, and operational requirements
• Translate research ideas, models, and algorithms into working prototypes and validate them in realistic scenarios
• Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers across software, AI, cybersecurity, and quantum technologies
• Contribute to the technical direction, architecture, and documentation of LuxQuantum's research and development activities

What We're Looking For

• PhD in a quantitative, scientific, engineering, or computing-related field; or a Master's degree with strong relevant research or R&D experience
• Strong research and analytical abilities, with the capacity to investigate complex problems, develop new approaches, and evaluate them systematically
• Experience with quantitative, computational, modeling, optimization, AI/ML, or related research methods
• Good programming and computational skills in one or more languages such as Python, C++, Rust, or similar
• Ability to translate research ideas, mathematical models, or algorithms into working prototypes
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a small multidisciplinary team
• Curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn and work across different technical domains
• Understanding of startup environments and research-driven innovation
• Fluent written and verbal communication in English

We welcome candidates from different scientific, engineering, and computational backgrounds, including PhD graduates, postdoctoral researchers, and researchers interested in transitioning from academia to industrial R&D. Prior experience in quantum technologies or quantum-safe cybersecurity is welcome but not required.

Nice to Have

Experience in any of the following is a plus, but not required:

• Cybersecurity, risk modeling, or security-related systems
• Quantum technologies, Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), or Quantum Key Distribution (QKD)
• Complex or distributed systems, simulation, or system orchestration
• Research software development and building experimental prototypes
• APIs, containerization, or ML/MLOps tools such as Docker, FastAPI, MLflow, or similar

Who You Are

• Curious and motivated by difficult problems where the answer is not always known in advance
• An independent thinker who enjoys exploring, testing, and improving new ideas
• Interested in turning research and theory into working systems with real-world impact
• Comfortable taking ownership while collaborating closely with a small multidisciplinary team
• Open to learning across disciplines and applying your expertise to new technical challenges
• Excited by the pace, responsibility, and opportunity to shape technology in an early-stage
deep-tech startup

Why Join LuxQuantum

Research with Real-World Impact

Work on challenging R&D problems and help turn research ideas, models, and algorithms into technologies for next-generation secure communication systems.

High Ownership

Take meaningful ownership of your work and have the opportunity to influence technical decisions and the direction of LuxQuantum's technology.

Work Across Disciplines

Collaborate at the intersection of systems modeling, AI, cybersecurity, software engineering, and quantum-safe communications, with the opportunity to expand your expertise into new areas.

Grow with a Deep-Tech Startup

Join LuxQuantum at an early stage, with the autonomy to explore ideas, take responsibility, and contribute to the development of both our technology and our research-driven engineering culture.

How to Apply

Please send:

• Your CV
• A short cover letter describing your background, relevant research or technical experience, and interest in the role
• Links to relevant projects, technical work, GitHub, or other examples of your work, if available (optional)

to:

contact@luxquantum.lu

Join us in building intelligent, adaptive security systems for the future of quantum-safe communications.

Your role & work environment

The Investment Strategist is part of the Global Investment Center within ISIM in Luxembourg. The role focuses on building and articulating ING's investment vision from a macro and multi asset perspective, ensuring full alignment between global strategy and the Luxembourg platform.

As the local SPOC, the Investment Strategist works closely with Private Bankers and commercial teams, acting as the key relay for investment insights and ensuring consistent communication of ING's house view across the market.

ISIM, ING's “Super ManCo”, manages both UCITS and AIFs and acts as the Group's central platform for investment fund solutions.

Drives Vision – Macro & Tactical Asset Allocation

• Analyze internal and external sources, build scenarios, and produce high-quality investment materials.
• Monitor macroeconomic developments and financial markets to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
• Synthesize complex information into actionable investment insights supporting the monthly investment cycle.
• Contribute to ING's global investment strategy through cross-asset allocation views.
• Translate macroeconomic perspectives into portfolio positioning guidelines.
• Support the performance of centrally managed portfolios and long-term value creation.

Communication & Strategic Alignment

• Act as the local point of contact for communicating ING's investment vision in Luxembourg.
• Provide regular market updates and investment insights to Private Bankers and commercial teams.
• Prepare and deliver presentations on market developments and investment themes.
• Represent ING's investment views at client events and group presentations.
• Support selected media interactions by communicating aligned investment messages.
• Ensure consistency and alignment with the Global Investment Center's investment strategy and messaging.

We look for

A colleague with a talent for taking it on and making it happen, enthusiasm for helping others to be successful and a knack for always being a step ahead. In other words, you strive to bring fresh ideas to life and embrace challenges in a fast changing and complex environment. You are a naturally collaborative person who listens and invests in others to achieve common goals. You love to challenge the status quo and are eager to propose creative solutions to problems.

As an Investment Strategist – local SPOC you will also need:

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics or a related field (CFA charter holder is considered as an asset)
• Minimum of 10+ years of experience in financial markets as Portfolio Manager or Investment Strategist, with a proven track record in macro analysis and multi asset allocation.
• Excellent command of English and French (written and spoken), speaking Dutch or any other European language is considered as an asset.
• Strong expertise in macroeconomics, market analysis and cross asset dynamics, with the ability to identify key trends, risks and structural shifts.

• Excellent communication skills to support strategic alignment with commercial teams and act as a local SPOC for the Global Investment Center.
• High degree of autonomy, intellectual curiosity and ability to operate effectively in fast moving market environments.
• Excellent presentation skills (orally and powerpoint) for internal and external audiences (including panel discussions with peers) with the capability to present complex matters in (1) an easy way and (2) keep your audience captivated.
• Contribute to strategic projects with your relevant management, including taking ownership on relevant change projects if and when possible.

We offer you  

• Shape ING's investment vision and contribute directly to the performance of centrally managed portfolios.
• Collaborate with leading investment professionals across Luxembourg, Brussels, and Amsterdam in a truly international setting.
• Take ownership of strategic projects and influence key investment decisions in a dynamic and fast-evolving market environment.

We redefine banking. What about you?

There has never been a more interesting time to work at ING. We're on a journey that's centered around our customers, powered by technology and driven by smart, determined people. Our customers feel our people are empowering them to stay a step ahead in life and in business. We're proud of that!

jobs.title: Operations Analyst (m/f)
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As an Operations Analyst - New Issues, you will play a key role in supporting securities operations through the analysis, onboarding, monitoring, and maintenance of financial instruments. This position offers the opportunity to work across a broad range of products while contributing to data quality, operational excellence, and regulatory compliance within an international banking environment.

RESPONSABILITIES

Securities Documentation and Analysis

• Review and analyze securities documentation, including prospectuses, final terms, key information documents, term sheets, issuer notices and other supporting documents.
• Assess documentation for completeness, consistency and operational usability before the instrument is created or maintained in the Bank's systems.
• Identify documentation gaps, inconsistencies or unclear product features and coordinate clarification with issuers, arrangers, custodians and internal stakeholders.
• Maintain a complete and traceable repository of instrument documentation for operational, audit and regulatory purposes.

Instrument Data Validation

• Validate instrument static data and key economic characteristics, including ISIN, issuer, currency, coupon, maturity, underlying, payment frequency, call features and market classification.
• Ensure instrument data recorded in internal systems is complete, accurate and consistent with the official documentation and approved data sources.
• Investigate data discrepancies and coordinate timely correction with relevant internal teams and external data providers.
• Perform periodic data-quality reviews and support control evidence and audit-trail requirements.

Pricing and Tolerance Controls

• Perform daily or periodic pricing controls and review price movements against established tolerance thresholds.
• Investigate missing, stale or out-of-tolerance prices and obtain supporting information from approved market data sources, issuers or valuation providers.
• Escalate material pricing exceptions and ensure that corrections or overrides are appropriately supported, approved and documented.
• Contribute to the maintenance and enhancement of pricing-control procedures and tolerance parameters.

Fiscal Impacts and Fiscal Documentation

• Analyze potential fiscal impacts associated with financial instruments, income events, redemptions and other lifecycle events.
• Collect, validate and maintain fiscal documentation required for withholding-tax treatment, tax relief, reclaim processes and applicable reporting obligations.
• Coordinate with Tax, Compliance, custodians and issuers to clarify the fiscal treatment of instruments and specific events.
• Ensure fiscal assumptions, supporting evidence and operational instructions are clearly documented and escalated when uncertain.

Funds – NAV Control

• Monitor and control Net Asset Value (NAV) information for investment funds using approved sources.
• Investigate missing, stale or unusual NAV movements and coordinate resolution with fund administrators, custodians, distributors and data providers.
• Validate that fund prices and relevant reference data are correctly reflected in internal systems.
• Maintain supporting evidence for NAV exceptions, corrections and escalations.

Onboarding of Structured Products

• Coordinate the operational onboarding of structured products from initial request through instrument readiness.
• Review final terms, term sheets, payoff descriptions, issuer information, relevant risk indicators and operational settlement details.
• Coordinate instrument creation and data validation with internal functions and confirm that required documentation and regulatory information are available before activation.
• Track open onboarding items, dependencies and approvals, escalating issues that could prevent timely product availability.

Monitoring of Specific Events

• Monitor instrument-specific events and issuer notices that may affect product terms, valuation, client positions or operational processing.
• Analyze relevant event information, identify impacted instruments and coordinate required updates in the Bank's systems.
• Communicate material events and operational impacts to the relevant internal stakeholders in a clear and timely manner.
• Maintain evidence of the analysis, decisions, actions and follow-up performed.
• Coordination with Issuers and External Parties
• Act as an operational point of contact with issuers, arrangers, custodians, fund administrators and data providers for instrument documentation, reference data, pricing and event-related queries.
• Coordinate the collection of missing information and follow up on outstanding requests within required operational timelines.
• Ensure communications and received documentation are retained in accordance with applicable internal record-keeping requirements.
• Escalate unresolved or material issues to the Senior Operations Analyst or Operations Manager.
• General Responsibilities
• Maintain clear and timely communication with internal and external stakeholders.
• Identify operational risks and opportunities to improve data quality, controls and process efficiency.
• Participate in system enhancements, user acceptance testing, process documentation and operational projects.
• Execute assigned controls and reporting activities while maintaining accuracy, traceability and appropriate escalation.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field.
• Minimum 3 years of experience in securities operations, instrument data management, product onboarding, pricing controls, funds operations, or related areas.
• Strong understanding of financial instruments, including bonds, equities, investment funds, and structured products.
• Knowledge of securities documentation, instrument static data, and product lifecycle events.
• Understanding of pricing controls, tolerance monitoring, NAV validation, and related operational processes.
• Awareness of withholding tax documentation and tax-related operational impacts is an advantage.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet operational and regulatory deadlines.
• Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
• Fluent English is required; Portuguese is considered an advantage.

WORKING ENVIRONMENT

This position is based in Luxembourg and primarily office-based. The role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a deadline-driven environment. You will work closely with internal teams and external market participants, including issuers, custodians, fund administrators, and data providers. Successful candidates will demonstrate resilience, sound judgment, and a commitment to delivering accurate and timely operational outcomes while contributing to continuous process improvement. Occasional additional effort may be required to meet operational, regulatory, or project-related deadlines.

DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

At XXXX, diversity is both a value and a strategic priority. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences are welcomed, respected, and valued.

If you are looking for a role where you can make a tangible impact while contributing to the transformation of an international banking institution, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Apply now and become part of XXXX's journey of trust, innovation, and sustainable growth.

une commerciale ou un commercial - (B2B)

- Bonnes capacités linguistiques en anglais tant à l’oral qu’à l’écrit (niveau B1)

- Un salaire attractif ainsi que des avantages sociaux

À propos de nous

La société EC Bioenergie GmbH & Co. KG a son siège à Heidelberg. Elle fait partie des pionniers et leaders sur le marché allemand des granulés de chauffage. Grâce à un maillage d’usines réparties sur l’ensemble du territoire allemand, notre société est en mesure de proposer un approvisionnement énergétique sûr et respectueux du climat en granulés pour des clients professionnels de toute taille en Allemagne, en Suisse et dans l’Est de la France. La construction d’un nouveau site de production en France est actuellement en voie d’achèvement.

jobs.title: Automation Service Engineer
jobs.description:
For our client were looking for an experienced Automation Service Engineer.

You will support customers under service agreements in sectors such as life sciences, chemicals, food and beverage, power and heat generation, and energy management. Your work covers engineering and commissioning, both in ongoing service and in projects. Most assignments are in Finland, with the occasional trip abroad. Expect roughly 30-150 travel days a year, depending on how you split your time between remote work and customer sites.

What you will do:
 Handle service requests and help customers solve urgent issues
 Plan and carry out control system hardware and software work, and commission systems on site or remotely
 Maintain the quality of installed base records
 Work closely with service coordinators, project managers, lead engineers, teammates and customer contacts
 Join upgrade and modernization projects from time to time
 Deliver service work efficiently and to a high standard, within contract terms, budget, quality and safety rules

What you bring:
 Degree in automation engineering, or comparable hands-on experience
 Understanding of power plant automation and electrical systems, including PLC design
 Background in engineering work in life sciences, chemicals, food and beverage, or power generation
 Good command of Finnish and English, spoken and written. Swedish is a plus.
 A customer-minded, collaborative way of working, with drive to deliver and keep learning
 Familiarity with IT and cyber security, or readiness to learn

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have a B.Sc., M.Sc. or equivalent work experience in automation engineering?*
- Do you have hands-on experience with PLC design for power plant automation or electrical systems?*
- Have you worked on engineering or commissioning in life sciences, chemicals, food and beverage, or power generation?*
- Are you fluent in both Finnish and English, spoken and written?*
- Are you able to work onsite in Helsinki, Pirkkala or Vaasa and able to travel 30-150 days a year?*

Please apply as soon as possible with your updated CV, that clearly demonstrates your skills and experience relevant to this role.

Location: Helsinki, Vaasa or Pirkkala (hybrid)
Start: As soon as possible

jobs.title: Manager, Support Engineering (AMER)
Legal Trainees @ Stora Enso
jobs.description:
**Are you a law student who:**

- is eager to gain experience in varying legal tasks in an international environment?

- has previous experience working in a law firm or an in-house legal department?

- is at least halfway through your law studies? If you responded **YES** to all three questions, this position might be for you!


We are looking for **two Legal Trainees** to join **Stora Enso** for a 12-month fixed-term position. The first Legal Trainee term is scheduled to start in January 2027, and the second in September 2027. In your application, please indicate which term you are applying for or which term you would prefer. The position is full-time and based at Stora Enso's headquarters in Katajanokka, Helsinki. Although this is a full-time role, there's flexibility for you to attend lectures and exams when necessary.

**In your day-to-day work**, you will gain comprehensive insights into different areas of the legal function and collaborate with a variety of stakeholders across Stora Enso. You will support legal counsels with a range of day-to-day tasks, including conducting legal research, preparing corporate documents (e.g., AGM materials), and drafting, negotiating, and reviewing agreements (e.g., non-disclosure agreements). You will also work on compliance matters, including policy administration and contributing to AI-related projects.

In this role, you will work directly with internal stakeholders and take ownership of assignments independently, with the support of your colleagues whenever needed. This is an excellent opportunity for a law student to broaden their knowledge and develop practical skills across different areas of law.

**This position is a perfect fit for you if you have:**

- at least 180 credits of completed legal studies and a background in diverse legal tasks from previous internships;

- a proactive and self-driven approach to accomplishing tasks and an ability to learn quickly;

- an analytical mindset and the competence to prioritize conflicting demands from multiple business clients in a fast-paced environment;

- a curious mindset and a strong willingness to learn; and

- strong communication skills – fluency in both written and oral English and Finnish is required.


**Stora Enso offers you:**

- a unique opportunity to learn about the tasks and responsibilities of the legal department within an international corporation;

- a possibility to work on versatile assignments with highly skilled professionals;

- modern, high-quality office spaces in a prime location; and

- a diverse working culture with a low hierarchy and support from your team when needed.


_Part of the global bioeconomy, Stora Enso is a leading provider of renewable products in packaging, biomaterials, and wooden construction, and one of the largest private forest owners in the world. Stora Enso creates better choices for society by accelerating the transition to a circular bioeconomy._

_Stora Enso Group Legal consists of several sub-teams: Legal Services, Ethics and Compliance, Responsible Value Chain, Governance and Intellectual Property, supporting the six Business Areas and Group Functions. Stora Enso's Legal organization provides all colleagues with high-quality legal advice in all areas from contracts to competition law to enable the realization of Stora Enso's strategy. Stora Enso Legal is headed by EVP People and Legal, General Counsel who is reporting to the CEO._

**Did we pique your interest?**

If this sounds like the perfect next career move for you, please send us your CV, cover letter, and up-to-date transcript of studies by **20 October 2026** to get the conversation going! If you have any questions, do not hesitate to contact our recruitment consultant Milla Numminen (from Monday to Wednesday and on Friday, +358 50 336 4396 / milla.numminen@minjon.fi).

**P.S.: Apply as soon as possible** – we will start reviewing applications and getting to know candidates already during the application period.

_The selected person will undergo a health check-up and drug testing._

jobs.title: Director, M&A Legal @ UPM
jobs.description:
**Hey lawyer with a proven track-record in M&A,**

Are you ready to take the lead on strategic transactions in a multinational and multifaceted business environment? Do you find meaning in using your skills to promote sustainable and innovation-driven future in a global material solutions company?

If these sound like your career goals, please keep reading, because you could be the one we are looking for to join **UPM** as a **Director, M&A Legal** in a newly established role.

_UPM is entering an exciting phase where strategic transactions continue to play an important role in shaping our future. We are building a dedicated M&A Legal capability to support that journey, and we are looking for a business-minded lawyer who enjoys collaboration, takes ownership and thrives in helping organizations navigate complex opportunities and change._

**\-Markus Skrabb, VP, Chief Compliance Officer and M&A Legal**

**As a Director, M&A Legal**, you will join UPM's Legal and Compliance function. The role is preferably based in Helsinki, Finland (or other UPM location), and you will report to VP, Chief Compliance Officer and M&A Legal.

**In this role,** you will take a leading, hands-on role in mergers, acquisitions, divestments, joint ventures and other strategic transactions. You will operate across UPM's business areas and geographical footprint, and work with business area leaders, senior management, Legal and Compliance colleagues, other corporate functions and external advisers. In addition to legal support in transactions, you will contribute to developing consistent, efficient and practical M&A legal ways of working across UPM.

**Your key responsibilities will include**:

- leading and coordinating legal workstreams in acquisitions, divestments, joint ventures, reorganizations and other strategic transactions;

- providing pragmatic, commercially focused advice to transaction teams, business leadership and senior management;

- coordinating legal due diligence and translating material findings into contractual protections, risk-mitigation actions and clear decision-making materials;

- drafting, reviewing and negotiating transaction documentation, including share and asset purchase agreements, shareholders' agreements and ancillary documents;

- planning and coordinating signing, closing and transaction implementation activities;

- working with legal specialists and other functions on merger control, compliance, finance, tax, sustainability, employment, intellectual property, data protection and other relevant matters;

- managing external legal advisers, including scope, resourcing, quality and cost; and

- developing UPM's M&A legal governance, templates, playbooks and transaction tools (including legal tech & AI solutions), and promoting lessons learned and knowledge sharing.


The role involves travel according to transaction activity. UPM's team members currently work based on a hybrid work policy, but due to the collaborative and fast-paced nature of this role, frequent office presence is preferred.

**You could be an ideal candidate if you:**

- are an experienced M&A lawyer with a masters degree in law (or an equivalent legal qualification), who combines strong transaction expertise with sound business judgement and a practical, solution-oriented approach;

- have substantial M&A experience from a reputable law firm, an international company or a combination of both, in which context you have led complex domestic and cross-border transactions and have strong experience in legal due diligence as well as assessing, drafting and negotiating transaction documentation;

- take ownership, communicate clearly and move complex matters forward in demanding and time-sensitive situations;

- are a credible leader and influencer who can build trust across the organization, aligning stakeholders with different perspectives, and influencing outcomes without relying on formal authority;

- understand transaction structures and the interaction between legal, commercial, financial, tax, regulatory and operational considerations;

- can translate legal risks into clear, proportionate and actionable advice and have strong leadership, influencing, project-management, stakeholder-management and negotiation skills;

- work effectively with business leaders, internal specialists, external counsel and counterparties;

- are proactive, structured and comfortable managing several workstreams under pressure; and

- have excellent written and spoken English (Finnish or other relevant language skills are an advantage). Experience in listed-company transactions, carve-outs, joint ventures, merger control, foreign investment screening or post-merger integration is an advantage.


**UPM offers you:**

- **A meaningful role**: You will contribute directly to UPM's strategic development by supporting in transactions of significant importance to the company.

- **A key role with broad exposure**: You will work across UPM's businesses, functions, countries and organizational boundaries, including with senior management.

- **An opportunity to build**: As the first dedicated M&A Legal resource, you will help shape UPM's shared M&A legal practices, governance, tools and institutional knowledge.

- **Inspired and motivated colleagues**: You will join an experienced, collaborative and international Legal and Compliance community.

- **Development opportunities**: The role offers varied and demanding transaction work and broad exposure to UPM's businesses, strategy and operating environment.

- **Responsibility for people and the environment**: UPM's ethical principles embrace people and the environment, and the company continuously works to build a more sustainable future.


**_UPM_** _is a material solutions company, renewing products and entire value chains with an extensive portfolio of renewable fibers, advanced materials, decarbonization solutions, and communication papers. UPM's performance in sustainability has been recognized by third parties, including EcoVadis and the Dow Jones Sustainability Indices. UPM operates globally and employs approximately 15,100 people worldwide, with annual sales of approximately €9.7 billion. UPM's shares are listed on Nasdaq Helsinki Ltd._

jobs.title: Industrielektrikere til Kjærgaard A/S – Løsning
jobs.description:
Efterspørgslen fra vores industrikunder betyder, at vi har travlt på alle fronter. Derfor søger vi dygtige og engagerede industrielektrikere til stillinger hos vores faste industrikunder og til skiftende projektopgaver. Lyder dette som noget for dig, så læs stillingsopslaget her – og søg stillingen nederst på siden.

 

Om jobbet

Vi kan garantere dig for en spændende og afvekslende hverdag, der bl.a. byder på industriopgaver, projekter og serviceopgaver inden for industriens mange brancher.

Vores projektafdeling sørger løbende for nye projekter, samt udbygning af eksisterende anlæg, som du kan blive en del af. Ligesom vi hverdag udvikler nye løsninger til vores kunder, er vi interesserede I at udvikle vores medarbejderes kompetencer efter ønske.

Hos Kjærgaard stiler vi efter vores K7-værdier for at skabe konkurrencefordele for vores kunder og sikre en kultur, hvor vi er fælles om at skabe en god arbejdsplads og et sundt Kjærgaard – nu og i fremtiden.

Dine kvalifikationer

Du er uddannet industrielektriker, automatiktekniker eller lignende og med erfaring inden for industri og automatik. Du kunne også være installationselektriker med erfaring fra industri eller ønsker at dygtiggøre dig indenfor industri.

Din energi og dit gode humør smitter af på de opgaver og mennesker, du omgiver dig med. Du arbejder selvstændigt med et godt overblik og tager et stort ejerskab for dine opgaver.

Du er desuden kvalitetsbevidst og ligger vægt på ordentlighed i udførelsen af dit arbejde, så dine kunder får en tilfredsstillende service. Dine gode samarbejdsevner gør dig til en vellidt kollega og en god ambassadør for Kjærgaard ude hos kunden.

Du skal kunne identificere dig i overensstemmelse med vores værdisæt K7.

Kjærgaard tilbyder dig 

Du tilbydes en spændende og ansvarsfuld stilling som Industrielektriker i en virksomhed i sund udvikling og vækst. For den rette person vil der være rig mulighed for såvel faglig som personlig udvikling. Kjærgaard er en moderne og uformel arbejdsplads, hvor du vil få engagerede kollegaer. Vores tværfaglige profil gør os til et spændende team af medarbejdere, med mange forskellige kompetencer.

Vi bor i nye lokaler og arbejder med de nyeste teknologier. Vores organisation er flad og kan beskrives som uformel og hvor måldrevne, hurtige og effektive beslutninger indgår i virksomhedens DNA.

For at skabe et godt sammenhold og nærværende miljø, arrangeres der mange sociale arrangementer og vi griller gerne når solen skinner. Til de faste traditioner, som fastelavn og firmafest, bliver familien også inviteret med.

Ansøgning og CV

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Niels Abildgaard på tlf. 4080 0192.
Upload din ansøgning og dit CV via nedenstående link.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Sjúkraþjálfari - Physiotherapist
jobs.description:
Physiotherapist – Akureyri Hospital

We are looking for a physiotherapist to join our excellent team at Akureyri Hospital (SAk). This is a 75–100% permanent position, available immediately or by mutual agreement.
Physiotherapists at Akureyri Hospital work in the hospital’s acute care departments at Eyrarlandsvegur and/or in the rehabilitation department. Following the relocation of the rehabilitation department from Kristnes, rehabilitation services will now be provided in two locations: an inpatient rehabilitation unit at SAk’s facility at Eyrarlandsholt, and a day and outpatient rehabilitation unit outside the hospital. The service will provide multidisciplinary rehabilitation both individually and in groups. The location of the position may depend on the applicant’s interests and area of expertise.
The position is primarily daytime work. The current working week for full-time employees is 36 hours. Occasional weekend and public holiday shifts in the hospital’s acute care departments are also required. These shifts are paid separately and provide additional earning opportunities.
The position is varied and offers excellent opportunities to develop professional and specialised knowledge and to participate in the development of a day and outpatient rehabilitation service at a new location. We warmly welcome new colleagues and provide a comprehensive induction supported by experienced physiotherapists. This is an excellent opportunity for both experienced physiotherapists and newly qualified professionals to deepen their knowledge and become part of a strong and supportive team.

Main Duties and Responsibilities
•    General physiotherapy practice in a multidisciplinary environment
•    Providing education and guidance to patients and their families
•    Multidisciplinary collaboration within hospital departments
•    Duties and responsibilities will be tailored to the applicant’s experience
•    Participation in professional development

Qualifications and Requirements
•    A recognised qualification in physiotherapy and a valid Icelandic professional licence (we will assist applicants in applying for icelandic license)
•    In the recruitment process, emphasis will be placed on professional knowledge, experience and interest, independence in working methods, and strong communication and teamwork skills
•    Applicants must demonstrate integrity and professionalism, including a good reputation and conduct, both inside and outside the workplace, that is compatible with the requirements of the position
•    A clean criminal record

Further Information
Salary is in accordance with the current collective agreement between the Minister of Finance and Economic Affairs and the Icelandic Association of Physiotherapists.
All applications must be submitted electronically through the Icelandic government’s recruitment system. Applications should include detailed information about education and employment history, as well as copies of diplomas/certificates and professional licences, where applicable.
Akureyri Hospital’s equality policy is taken into consideration when recruiting staff. Applications may remain valid for six months from the date of publication of the advertisement, in accordance with Article 2, paragraph 2, item 3 of Regulation No. 1000/2019 on the advertising of vacant positions, as subsequently amended. All applicants will receive a response.
Akureyri Hospital provides internationally DNV-GL-certified healthcare services through an ISO-certified quality management system, with an emphasis on the active participation of all employees in meeting the quality requirements set out in the international standard under which the hospital is certified.
According to Akureyri Hospital’s human resources policy, emphasis is placed on recruiting and retaining talented individuals. When selecting employees, education, experience, skills and competence are taken into consideration. The human resources policy serves as a guiding principle for managers and staff, supporting the hospital as a progressive and desirable workplace. It is based on the hospital’s core values:

SAFETY, COLLABORATION and PROGRESSIVENESS
Employment percentage: 75–100%
Application deadline: 30 September 2026

Further Information

Chief Physiotherapist

Phone: 852-5608

Við ráðningu verður lögð áhersla á faglega þekkingu, reynslu og áhuga, sjálfstæði í vinnubrögðum og hæfileika í samskiptum og samvinnu

Gerð er krafa um vammleysi, s.s. að vera með gott orðspor og að framkoma og athafnir á vinnustað og utan hans samrýmist starfinu

Hreint sakavottorð

Frekari upplýsingar um starfið
Laun samkvæmt gildandi kjarasamningi sem fjármála- og efnahagsráðherra og Félag sjúkraþjálfara hafa gert.

Allar umsóknir þurfa að fara rafrænt í gegnum ráðningarkerfi ríkisins. Umsóknum skulu fylgja ítarlegar upplýsingar um nám og starfsferilskrá ásamt afriti af prófskírteinum og starfsleyfi, ef við á. Tekið er mið af jafnréttisstefnu Sjúkrahússins á Akureyri við ráðningar í störf á sjúkrahúsinu. Umsóknir geta gilt í 6 mánuði frá birtingu auglýsingar, sbr. 3. tl. 2. mgr. 2. gr. reglna nr. 1000/2019 um auglýsingar lausra starfa með síðari breytingum. Öllum umsóknum verður svarað.

Sjúkrahúsið á Akureyri veitir alþjóðlega DNV-GL vottaða heilbrigðisþjónustu með ISO vottuðu gæðastjórnunarkerfi þar sem áhersla er á virka þátttöku allra starfsmanna til að uppfylla þær gæðakröfur sem gerðar eru í alþjóðlegum staðli sem sjúkrahúsið er vottað eftir.

Samkvæmt mannauðsstefnu Sjúkrahússins á Akureyri er lögð áhersla á að ráða til starfa og halda í hæfileikaríka einstaklinga. Við val á starfsfólki er menntun, reynsla, færni og hæfni höfð að leiðarljósi. Mannauðsstefnan er leiðarljós stjórnenda og starfsfólks sem gerir sjúkrahúsið framsækinn og eftirsóknarverðan vinnustað, en hún byggir á grunngildum sjúkrahússins sem eru: ÖRYGGI, SAMVINNA og FRAMSÆKNI.

jobs.title: QC Strategic Operation Lead
jobs.description:
The Quality Control department at Alvotech is looking for a dedicated and quality-minded QC Analytical Product Testing Senior scientist with extensive experience in the field, who will be a part of the Quality control team responsible for quality control and release testing of product manufactured at Alvotech.

Scope and responsibility:

Performs routine analytical testing using advanced analytical techniques including Chromatography, Electrophoresis, Compendial and functional testing to support stability, in-process and release analysis.
Expertise in selected analytical techniques and through understanding and overview of all analytical methods applied for product testing and stability testing.
Be aware of compendia and routine testing equipment used during product testing
Complete laboratory documentation and records in accordance with Good Documentation Practices (GDP).
Proactively communicate analytical issues, deviations, and concerns to relevant stakeholders.
Review and verify analytical data and test results.
Support and lead CAPAs, change control, Document change controls and the investigations for quality issues such as Invalid assay, OOS/OOT/OOE results.
Review and approve technical documentation within the document management system, as required.
Provide support and oversight to other scientists in the laboratory
Proactively ensure the QC Analytical laboratory and equipment is at all times maintained in a state of Inspection readiness.
Perform training of other scientist in laboratory activities and specific methods.
Creates and updates documents for analytical methods
Knowledge about basic tasks in the labs and responsible for analytical methods.
Actively involved and contributes to cross functional activities.

Job requirements:

Minimum M.S in technical discipline, (e.g., pharmacy, biotechnology, biochemistry, or a related field)
5-10 years of experience in Pharmaceutical or Biopharmaceutical industry and preferably a project management background/exposure.
Good conceptual, problem solving, and organizational skills – must be detail-oriented and able to work independently and in teams
Independence in assignments. Routinely leads projects and/or supervises small or medium teams. Additionally takes part in larger projects.
Expert knowledge within field of expertise such as methods, techniques as well as relevant procedural/process knowledge
Open to flexible working hours.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

What we offer:

An inspiring challenge to work with great co-workers on ambitious projects that change people's lives.
The chance to be a part of a global and fast-growing company.
An international work culture that encourages diversity, collaboration and inclusion.
Positive, flexible, and innovative work environment.
Support for personal growth and internal career development.
Company social events and milestone celebrations.
Excellent in-house canteen and coffee house.
Exercise and wellbeing support for full-time employees.
On-site shower facility.
Transportation grant towards eco-friendly modes of travel for full-time employees.
Internet at home for full-time employees.

jobs.title: Driller

Iceland Drilling Company (IDC) is an international leader in geothermal drilling, committed to providing safe and efficient drilling solutions with a focus on sustainability. We take pride in operating advanced, automatic drilling rigs that create a safe and positive working environment for our highly motivated crew members. Currently, we are seeking skilled assistant driller to join our team for a long-term geothermal drilling projects.

Position Overview:
As a driller, you will be responsible for operating and supervising the drilling operations on the rig. You will ensure that all drilling activities are conducted safely, efficiently, and in compliance with company standards and regulations. Your expertise will be critical to maintaining the smooth operation of the drilling process and ensuring that all objectives are met.

• Ensure the maintenance and proper functioning of drilling equipment and tools.
• Monitor drilling parameters and adjust operations to optimize drilling performance.
• Ensure adherence to safety protocols, maintaining a focus on the well-being of the crew and compliance with industry standards.
• Provide training, guidance, and leadership to junior crew members.
• Communicate effectively with the Tool Pusher, engineers, and other staff to assess drilling progress and resolve any issues.
• Maintain detailed records of drilling operations and report progress to management.
• Manage equipment and materials to ensure smooth operations and prevent delays.

Qualifications and Requirements:

jobs.title: Join Landspítali as a Consultant in Respiratory Medicine in Iceland
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Consultant in Respiratory Medicine to join Landspítali University Hospital, with a start date of 1 November 2026 or as otherwise agreed.
The position is full-time; however, a lower employment ratio may be considered by mutual agreement.

Our Department of Pulmonary Medicine consists of a strong and ambitious team of physicians managing a broad range of clinical responsibilities in close collaboration with other healthcare professionals. We are looking for a dedicated and motivated specialist who wishes to contribute to highly specialised care and follow-up of patients with respiratory diseases.

Why Join Landspítali?

At Landspítali, we offer:
•    A stimulating and rewarding consultant-level position at Iceland's national university hospital, with diverse and interesting clinical responsibilities.
•    A 36-hour work week that supports a healthy work-life balance.
•    Close collaboration with experienced multidisciplinary teams and specialists across a range of clinical disciplines.
•    An academic environment where clinical practice, research, teaching, and innovation go hand in hand.
•    A supportive workplace that values staff wellbeing, professional development, and continuous learning.
•    Opportunities to learn Icelandic, including language courses offered partly during working hours during the first two years of employment.
•    The opportunity to live and work in Iceland and enjoy a high quality of life in a safe and well-functioning society.
•    Easy access to spectacular nature, clean air, and year-round outdoor activities, including hiking, skiing, geothermal bathing, and unique natural experiences.

Duties and Responsibilities
•    Care of patients on hospital wards and in the intensive care unit.
•    Outpatient clinics and day-ward services involving a broad range of pulmonary conditions, including but not limited to:
   o    Interstitial lung diseases
   o    Severe asthma
   o    Lung cancer diagnostics and follow up
   o    Advanced COPD and other late-stage obstructive lung diseases
   o    Acute and chronic respiratory failure
   o    Home mechanical ventilation and other ventilatory support therapies
•    Performance of interventional procedures, including:
   o    Bronchoscopy
   o    Pleural procedures/thoracentesis
   o    Exercise testing (cardiopulmonary excercise testing)
•    Participation in the pulmonary medicine on-call service.
•    Participation in acute internal medicine services, including on-call duties, as agreed with the Head of Pulmonary Medicine.
•    Teaching and supervision of medical students, intern/foundation doctors, and specialty trainees.
•    Participation in research activities.
•    Other duties as agreed with the Head of Department.

Qualifications
•    Specialist certification in Pulmonology/Respiratory Medicine.
•    Icelandic medical licence and specialist recognition in Pulmonology, or eligibility to obtain these credentials.
•    Broad knowledge and experience in Internal Medicine and Pulmonology.
•    Proven ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
•    Positive attitude, flexibility, and strong collaborative skills.
•    Experience in teaching and research is considered an advantage.

Additional Information
A full-time position is exclusively affiliated with the hospital in accordance with Article 3.3 of the current collective agreement between physicians and the Icelandic State.

The position is available from 1 November 2026 or by mutual agreement. The application deadline is 23 October 2026.

For further information, please contact:
Sif Hansdóttir, Consultant Physician
E-mail: sifhan@landspitali.is

Application Requirements
Applications should include information on:
•    Previous employment, education, and professional qualifications
•    Positions of trust and references

Mandatory Attachments
•    Certified copies of degree certificates and specialist qualifications/licences
•    Curriculum Vitae (CV), including teaching, research, and leadership experience
•    List of scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals. Applicants should either provide a link to their Google Scholar profile or submit publication documentation from PubMed.
•    Cover letter describing the applicant's qualifications and interest in the position

All attachments must be submitted in PDF format.

Selected candidates will be invited for interviews. Appointment decisions will be based on interviews and submitted documentation. Recruitment is conducted in accordance with Landspítali's Equal Opportunities Policy. All applicants will be informed of the outcome of the recruitment process.

Information regarding residence and work permits is available on our website.
To apply for the position, click the dark blue button "Sækja um starf" (Apply for Position). You may then switch the website language to English and log in to the Icelandic Government's recruitment system.

About Landspítali
Landspítali is a dynamic and diverse workplace where approximately 7,000 employees work in multidisciplinary teams and in close collaboration across professional groups. The hospital's vision is to provide healthcare of the highest quality, based on science, professionalism, and compassion, delivered by skilled staff and supported by modern facilities and a positive working environment.
Landspítali is certified according to the Icelandic Equal Pay Standard ÍST 85:2012. The certification has been awarded following an audit conducted by Versa Vottun ehf.

Applications may remain valid for up to six months from the publication date of the advertisement, in accordance with Icelandic Government Regulation No. 1000/2019 on the advertisement of vacant public positions, as amended.

Vi søger en pædagog med hjertet på det rette sted til vores lille og hyggelige private daginstitution. Vuggestuepædagog med interesse for pædagogisk idræt.
jobs.description:
Vil du have et kig ind i idræt, leg og bevægelse? Nu har du chancen for at blive en del af Jellerød Børnegård – en lille privat institution, hvor faglighed og fællesskab vægtes højt.

Vi søger en pædagog i faste stillinger på 34 timer ugentligt.

Vægter du nærhed, tryghed og tæt kontakt til børn og forældre højt? Ønsker du faglig udvikling, et fællesskab og engagerede kolleger? Så er det måske dig vi søger.

Jellerød Børnegård er en lille privat institution, Kokkedals mindste, hvor vi værner om at småt er godt. Vi har plads til 24 vuggestuebørn og 32 børnehavebørn fordelt på fire stuer med hver sin faste stuepædagog. Vi søger en ny pædagog på 34 timer/ugen til den ene vuggestuegruppe på 12 børn og du vil blive pædagog nr. 2 ud af de 3 voksne.

Som pædagog vil du indgå i et fast team tilknyttet stuen. De ældste børn fra begge stuer danner et par dage om ugen deres egen store-gruppe med vores pædagogstuderende som den 7 voksen. Det vil sige stuen har 10 børn flere dage ugentligt til 3 voksne.

 Vi har desuden en køkkeneneansvarlig, som sørger for alle børnenes måltider, som et pædagogiske måltid.

Vi forventer, at du

-          er motiveret til at arbejde med Vuggestuelivet

-          kan trives i en virksomhed, hvor struktur og mange husaftaler allerede er defineret

-          tør overveje, hvorfor du gør som du gør, og dermed reflektere over egen praksis

-          er åben, professionelt imødekommende og respektfuld i din tilgang til børn, forældre og kolleger

-          er nysgerrig, lyttende og nærværende i dialog og samvær

-          kan arbejde med at planlægge, udføre, dokumentere og evaluere din pædagogiske praksis.

-          interesserer dig for at bidrage til et godt arbejdsmiljø og det kollegiale fællesskab, da det sociale for os som kolleger er betydningsfuldt.

-          er fleksibel mht. vores åbningstid og opgaver, da vi er et lille hus

Det er en fordel og ikke et krav, hvis du har kendskab til arbejdet med den nye styrkede læreplan og til værktøjerne Hjernen og Hjertet, Sprogtrappen, Sproggaven, dialogisk læsning og Fri For Mobberi.

Vi ser os selv som et hus, der prioriterer høj faglighed og et pædagogisk overskud, så vi kan tilgodese børnenes individuelle behov og interesser. Vi fungerer som én enhed i huset, der lærer af og tager hensyn til hinanden, og vi løfter i flok uagtet titel. Vi er stolte af vores fælles faglighed, fx er hele personalegruppen uddannet i at bruge værktøjerne fra ”Fri For Mobberi” og alle er udannet inden for Via som bevægelsescertificeret institution. Vi har årligt to pædagogiske dage, hvor vi holder lukket og arbejder med vores faglighed. Derudover holdes der 6 personalemøder årligt, der indgår i din årsnorm, ligesom forældremødet og sommerfesten gør.

Vi arbejder altid ud fra vores børnesyn ”Børn gør det godt, når de kan”, hvilket betyder at børn gør det godt, når vi voksne gør det muligt for dem at gøre netop det. Det er derfor de voksnes opgave at få øje på barnets intentioner og adfærd. Det kommer også til udtryk, når vi reflekterer over, hvorfor vi gør, som vi gør.

Vi arbejder anerkendende og tydelig i vores kommunikation, både i forhold til børn, forældre og kolleger med afsæt i vores værdigrundlag:

-          Vi er nysgerrige, åbne og imødekomne overfor det vi ikke kender

-          Vi er empatiske og rækker ud for at favne, hjælpe og støtte hinanden

-          Vi vægter tryghed og nærhed højt og skaber små børnefællesskaber hver formiddag

-          Vi giver plads i fællesskabet, og vi giver rum til forskellighed, hvor der tages hensyn til det enkelte individ, kunnen og formående.

-          Vi har respekt for faglighed, vi træffer beslutninger sammen, vi tilegner os ny viden og vi deler viden på tværs at personale- og faggrupper.

Du er velkommen til at kontakte leder Pia Starberg på 93392980, hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen.

 Ansøgning og CV med emnet ”Ansøgning” sendes til pist@jellerod.dk. De indkomne ansøgninger vil blive evalueret løbende, og samtaler afholdes løbende.

Ansøgningsfrist: Når rette kandidat er fundet.         

 Tiltrædelse febuar 2027

Læs mere om os på www.Jellerod.dk

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår: Fastsættes efter forhandling inden for gældende overenskomst

Mulighed for at tilvælge privat sundhedsforsikring.

 GDPR

 Jellerød Børnegård er dataansvarlige for de oplysninger, som du sender os i din jobansøgning via email. Se vores datapolitik for yderligere information.

 Når du ansøger, accepterer du, at vi registrerer og samler dine personlige oplysninger, som du angiver i forbindelse med din ansøgning. Dette gælder også videopræsentationer, billeder mm.

Vi kan dele din ansøgning med vores medarbejdere, som er involveret i rekrutteringen og tredjeparter, som hjælper os med processen. Dette inkluderer også rekrutteringsfirmaer, som udbyder personlighedstests mm.

Vi opbevarer din ansøgning samt de andre oplysninger, som du har angivet, indtil rekrutteringsprocessen er afsluttet, og i den periode efterfølgende, hvor vi mener, at din ansøgning er relevant for os, men aldrig mere end 6 måneder.

Ved at indsende dine personlige oplysninger accepterer du:

-          at du har læst og forstået ovenstående persondatapolitik

-          at oplysningerne som du har indtastet, er sande og efter din ærlige mening også det mest korrekte. Herunder forstår du også, at hvis ikke oplysningerne stemmer overens, kan det forårsage, at ansøgningen ikke accepteres eller ikke vil tages i betragtning

-          at du giver samtykke af egen fri vilje til, at vi må indsamle og anvende dine  oplysninger
