Vi arbejder altid ud fra vores børnesyn ”Børn gør det godt, når de kan”, hvilket betyder at børn gør det godt, når vi voksne gør det muligt for dem at gøre netop det. Det er derfor de voksnes opgave at få øje på barnets intentioner og adfærd. Det kommer også til udtryk, når vi reflekterer over, hvorfor vi gør, som vi gør.

Vi arbejder anerkendende og tydelig i vores kommunikation, både i forhold til børn, forældre og kolleger med afsæt i vores værdigrundlag:

-          Vi er nysgerrige, åbne og imødekomne overfor det vi ikke kender

-          Vi er empatiske og rækker ud for at favne, hjælpe og støtte hinanden

-          Vi vægter tryghed og nærhed højt og skaber små børnefællesskaber hver formiddag

-          Vi giver plads i fællesskabet, og vi giver rum til forskellighed, hvor der tages hensyn til det enkelte individ, kunnen og formående.

-          Vi har respekt for faglighed, vi træffer beslutninger sammen, vi tilegner os ny viden og vi deler viden på tværs at personale- og faggrupper.

Du er velkommen til at kontakte leder Pia Starberg på 93392980, hvis du vil vide mere om stillingen.

Ansøgning og CV med emnet ”Ansøgning” sendes til pist@jellerod.dk. De indkomne ansøgninger vil blive evalueret løbende, og samtaler afholdes løbende.


Ansøgningsfrist: Når rette kandidat er fundet.       

 Tiltrædelse Januar 2027

Læs mere om os på www.Jellerod.dk

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår: Fastsættes efter forhandling inden for gældende overenskomst

Mulighed for at tilvælge privat sundhedsforsikring.

 GDPR

 Jellerød Børnegård er dataansvarlige for de oplysninger, som du sender os i din jobansøgning via email. Se vores datapolitik for yderligere information.

 Når du ansøger, accepterer du, at vi registrerer og samler dine personlige oplysninger, som du angiver i forbindelse med din ansøgning. Dette gælder også videopræsentationer, billeder mm.

 Vi kan dele din ansøgning med vores medarbejdere, som er involveret i rekrutteringen og tredjeparter, som hjælper os med processen. Dette inkluderer også rekrutteringsfirmaer, som udbyder personlighedstests mm.

 Vi opbevarer din ansøgning samt de andre oplysninger, som du har angivet, indtil rekrutteringsprocessen er afsluttet, og i den periode efterfølgende, hvor vi mener, at din ansøgning er relevant for os, men aldrig mere end 6 måneder.

 Ved at indsende dine personlige oplysninger accepterer du:

-          at du har læst og forstået ovenstående persondatapolitik

-          at oplysningerne som du har indtastet, er sande og efter din ærlige mening også det mest korrekte. Herunder forstår du også, at hvis ikke oplysningerne stemmer overens, kan det forårsage, at ansøgningen ikke accepteres eller ikke vil tages i betragtning

-          at du giver samtykke af egen fri vilje til, at vi må indsamle og anvende dine  oplysninger

jobs.title: Kundeservicemedarbejder søges til fuldtidsvikariat i Rødovre
jobs.description:
På vegne af en af vores kunder i Rødovre søger FIRMAVIKAR en serviceminded og ansvarsbevidst medarbejder til telefonpasning og kundesupport på fuldtid.

Der er tale om et længerevarende vikariat på 37 timer om ugen med opstart hurtigst muligt og forventet varighed frem til nytår. For den rette medarbejder vil der være mulighed for forlængelse.

Vi søger en person, der trives med kundekontakt, har gode kommunikationsevner og kan håndtere forskellige henvendelser på en professionel og imødekommende måde.

Arbejdsopgaver

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Besvare indgående telefonopkald

  • Hjælpe kunder med spørgsmål og henvendelser

  • Yde telefonisk kundeservice og support

  • Registrere og følge op på kundehenvendelser

  • Diverse administrative opgaver efter behov

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har erfaring med kundeservice, telefonpasning eller support

  • Har gode kommunikationsevner og er venlig og professionel i telefonen

  • Er serviceminded, tålmodig og løsningsorienteret

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret

  • Har gode IT-kompetencer og hurtigt kan sætte dig ind i nye systemer

  • Gerne har erfaring med Salesforce, men det er ikke et krav

  • Er mødestabil, ansvarsbevidst og har en positiv indstilling

Vi tilbyder

  • Et fuldtidsvikariat på 37 timer om ugen

  • Ansættelse frem til nytår med mulighed for forlængelse

  • En arbejdsplads med varierende opgaver og daglig kundekontakt

  • Mulighed for at udvikle dine kompetencer inden for kundeservice og support

  • Ansættelse gennem FIRMAVIKAR med ordnede forhold

Praktiske oplysninger

Arbejdssted: Rødovre
Stilling: Kundeservicemedarbejder – telefonpasning og support
Arbejdstid: Fuldtid, 37 timer om ugen
Opstart: Hurtigst muligt
Varighed: Frem til nytår med mulighed for forlængelse
Erfaring med Salesforce: En fordel, men ikke et krav

Interesseret?

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig?

Så send dit CV og en kort beskrivelse af din erfaring til FIRMAVIKAR.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og kontakter relevante kandidater hurtigst muligt.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Udlejningsmægler i Aalborg?
jobs.description:
Er du vores næste udlejningsmægler i Aalborg?

Der er travlt hos Lejeboligmægleren, og vi søger derfor endnu en dygtig udlejningsmægler til vores afdeling i Aalborg.

Lejeboligmægleren er en landsdækkende virksomhed med afdelinger i København, Aarhus, Odense og Aalborg. Vi er specialiseret i udlejning af boliger og samarbejder med både professionelle ejendomsinvestorer, ejendomsselskaber og private udlejere om alt fra enkeltstående boliger til større projektbyggerier.

Vi er bindeleddet mellem udlejer og lejer og arbejder hver dag for at sikre en professionel og effektiv udlejning samt den gode oplevelse for begge parter.

Vi er en virksomhed i vækst med ambitionen om at være den største og foretrukne lejeboligmægler i Danmark – og vi søger nu en ny kollega, der har lyst til at være med på rejsen.

 

Hos os får du blandt andet:

·         En flad organisation, hvor der ikke er langt mellem medarbejdere og ledelse.

·         En ung arbejdsplads med højt tempo og stærkt socialt sammenhold.

·         Daglige sparringsmøder på tværs af afdelinger.

·         Fleksible arbejdsdage og stor grad af frihed under ansvar.

·         Sociale arrangementer og fælles aktiviteter på tværs af virksomheden.

·         En lønpakke med fast løn og provision.

 

Om jobbet

Som udlejningsmægler bliver din primære opgave at udleje vores kunders boliger og sikre det rette match mellem bolig og lejer.

Du får en alsidig hverdag med mange boliger og kundehenvendelser i gang på samme tid. Derfor er det vigtigt, at du arbejder struktureret, følger dine opgaver til dørs og samtidig sikrer en professionel og personlig service over for både lejere og udlejere.

Du bliver en del af et ungt og energisk team, hvor samarbejde, sparring og gode resultater er i fokus. Vi arbejder tæt sammen, men du får samtidig stor frihed og ansvar for dine egne opgaver.

Stillingen er på fuld tid og der vil være weekendarbejde, som på nuværende tidspunkt er hver 3. weekend.

Det er et krav, at du har kørekort, da en stor del af arbejdsdagen foregår ude på fremvisninger. Når du ikke er på farten, har du din daglige base på vores kontor på Alexander Foss Gade 15 i Aalborg.

 

Dine arbejdsopgaver vil blandt andet være:

·         Fremvisninger og udlejning af boliger.

·         Kommunikation og koordinering med nuværende og potentielle lejere.

·         Besvare henvendelser via diverse platforme og telefon.

 

Dine kvalifikationer

For at trives i rollen som udlejningsmægler er det vigtigt, at du har fokus på service, stærk kommunikation og en positiv indstilling. Du skal også have kendskab til Aalborg og omegn samt være i stand til at kommunikere på både dansk og engelsk.

Erfaring fra ejendomsbranchen, salg eller kundeservice er en fordel, men ikke et krav. For os er din personlighed, dit drive og din tilgang til kunderne mindst lige så vigtig.

Derudover skal du være:

·         Serviceminded

·         Struktureret og god til at organisere

·         Udadvendt og trives i en kundekontaktrolle

·         Samarbejdsvillig og en holdspiller

·         Energisk, positiv og klar til nye udfordringer

Opstart: Hurtigst muligt

Er du vores nye udlejningsmægler? Send din ansøgning til job@lejeboligmaegleren.dk med emnet "Udlejningsmægler, Aalborg". Vi afholder samtaler løbende og forbeholder os retten til at fjerne opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning og CV.

Har du spørgsmål?

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller os, er du velkommen til at kontakte vores direktør Martin Winther Larsen på tlf. 5354 5054 eller mail mwl@lejeboligmaegleren.dk.

jobs.title: Klyngemedarbejder til Danmarks nationale klynge for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed
jobs.description:
Klyngemedarbejder søges til CenSec – Center for Defence, Space & Security 

Vil du arbejde med at styrke vækst, innovation og internationalisering inden for den danske forsvarssektor? Og være med til at udvikle Danmarks nationale innovations- og erhvervsklynge for aktører inden for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed?   

  

Om stillingen 

CenSecs mission er at være drivkraften bag et stærkt dansk SMV-økosystem, der former fremtidens løsninger inden for forsvar, sikkerhed og rum – og som ansat i CenSec kommer du til at spille en vigtig rolle her.   

Du får ansvar for, sammen med dine kolleger, at planlægge og afvikle forskellige klyngeaktiviteter som netværksmøder, workshops, konferencer, delegationsture, matchmaking events mv. Du får også til opgave at udvikle og drive forskellige klyngeinitiativer.  

Klyngeaktiviteterne skal hjælpe CenSecs medlemmer med at få ny viden, skabe samarbejde på tværs og øge medlemmernes kommercielle udvikling. Aktiviteterne har både nationalt og internationalt fokus. 

En del af arbejdet udføres i regi af eksternt finansierede projekter, hvor du vil få ansvaret for leverancerne heri.   

Udover arbejdet med klyngeaktiviteterne får du til opgave at rekruttere nye medlemmer, være kontaktperson for medlemsvirksomheder og deltage i flere af klyngens interne udviklingsopgaver- og processer.  

Arbejdet med udvikling af klyngen omfatter også en del administration, opgaver relateret til formidling og kommunikation, samt samarbejde med andre aktører i det forsvarsindustrielle økosystem på både nationalt og europæisk niveau.  

  

Din profil 

Der kan være mange indgangsvinkler til denne stilling. Vigtigst er det at du er en “do’er”, som har vilje og evne til at omsætte input og viden til konkret værdi for vores medlemmer og samarbejdspartnere.  

Vi forventer en høj grad af selvstændighed og professionalisme, og at du kan varetage det ansvar og mandat, der medfølger at være ansat i den nationale klyngeorganisation for forsvarsindustrien. Samtidig forventer vi en høj grad af teamånd og at du evner at samarbejde tæt med dine kolleger.  

Derudover er du ekstrovert, kommunikativt stærk, omstillingsparat, fleksibel og taler og skriver engelsk på højt niveau. 

Stillingen henvender sig særligt til dig, der er nyuddannet eller har et par års erfaring på arbejdsmarkedet. Vi vægter potentiale og engagement højere end et langt CV, og vi sørger for en grundig oplæring – og forventer at du tager ansvar og initiativ til at få opgaverne løst.  

 

Vi tilbyder 

En betydningsfuld rolle i en internationalt anerkendt klyngeorganisation, som skaber innovation, vækst og arbejdspladser. Du får en unik mulighed for at optage ny viden og udvikle dine faglige kompetencer, og udvikle din rolle i organisationen alt efter hvad det er du byder ind med.   

Vi tilbyder en fleksibel arbejdsuge med to ugentlige fremmødedage på vores kontor i Viborg og hjemmearbejde de resterende ugedage. Det er ikke muligt at komme i betragtning til stillingen hvis du ikke har mulighed for fysisk fremmøde i Viborg to dage om ugen.  

 

Arbejdstid og løn m.m. 

Arbejdstiden er 37 timer ugentligt på funktionærvilkår. 

I forbindelse med klyngeaktiviteter i ind- og udland vil der være nogen rejseaktivitet, som altid aftales på forhånd og i god tid. 

Løn efter kvalifikationer og evner til at skabe værdi for CenSec. 

Læs mere om CenSec her: www.censec.dk  

 

Om CenSec 

CenSec er Danmarks nationale klynge for forsvar, rum og sikkerhed.  

Som national klynge er vores mandat at samle og styrke hele økosystemet, heriblandt virksomheder, videninstitutioner og myndigheder. 

Vi har en dyb forståelse af økosystemet og en dybdegående viden om vores medlemmer. Vores ambition er at være et omdrejningspunkt hvor alle aktører ser os som den primære drivkraft til at fremme samarbejde på tværs og øge innovation i industrien.  
 
Vi er en tillidsbaseret og stærk medlemsorganisation. Siden 2004 har vi arbejdet for at styrke netværk, samarbejds- og forretningsmuligheder på tværs af sektorer og grænser, gennem facilitering af nationale og internationale netværksaktiviteter.  
 
CenSec – skaber innovation, vækst og robusthed for Danmark.  

 

Ansøgning 

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kontakt venligst Anders Laustsen, på tlf. 52 13 15 42 eller skriv til anders@censec.dk  

Vi ser frem til at modtage din motiverede ansøgning og CV til samme mailadresse snarest muligt og senest fredag den 30. oktober kl. 12.00 

Ansættelsessamtaler forventes gennemført løbende med henblik på ansættelse hurtigst muligt. Vi forbeholder os ret til at ansætte før deadline, hvis vi finder den rette kandidat.

jobs.title: Researcher position in Early Earth Processes
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for a Researcher position in Early Earth Processes, available at the Centre for Planetary Habitability (PHAB), Department of Geosciences, Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences, University of Oslo (UiO).

The position is a full-time position for a period of 3 years.

Starting date no later than 01.01.2027.

Place of work is PHAB, the Department of Geosciences at Blindern, Oslo.


Project description

The position is associated with PHAB and linked to the research theme ‘Planets and Early Earth’, which addresses planet formation, evolution and comparative planetology to identify the initial conditions for habitability and how a planet’s composition and interior influence its ability to nurture a biosphere. The researcher will be part of a project group that explore the conditions for early life and Earth’s evolution as a habitable planet, and specifically, through geochemical investigations of ancient cratons and greenstone belts to understand habitable environments and key geological events (e.g., the Great Oxidation Event) to shed light on crustal and atmospheric processes during Archean-Paleoproterozoic times. The project requires considerable field and laboratory experience, and we seek a candidate with a strong Archean-Paleoproterozoic geological background with a proven record in early Earth surface processes, sedimentology, geobiology, micropaleontology, evolutionary processes, geochemistry and geochronology.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe's leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in geosciences. Doctoral dissertation must be submitted for evaluation by the closing date. Only applicants with an approved doctoral thesis and completed defence are eligible for appointment.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English 
  • Strong publication track record.
  • Extensive Archean craton and greenstone belt field experience.
  • Early Earth geobiological research background using stable isotope systematics (C, N, S, O) and Secondary Ion Mass Spectrometry (SIMS).
  • Experience with U-Pb zircon geochronology and Lu-Hf isotopic systematics.

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience working in large-scale multi-partner projects.
  • Experience in paleo sea-temperature proxies and pH modelling of oceans.
  • Experience in advanced methods, e.g. high-resolution synchrotron-based techniques.  
  • Experience in fundraising.

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks
  • Good communication and collaboration skills
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal skills.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.  A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Salary in position as Researcher, position code 1109 in salary range NOK from 646000 to 745000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund. 

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter (statement of motivation, summarizing scientific work and research interest)
  • Your Project Vision (1 page) 
  • CV (summarizing education, positions, pedagogical experience, administrative experience and other qualifying activity) 
  • Copies of educational certificates, academic transcript of records and letters of recommendation
  • A complete list of publications and academic works that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


Formal regulations

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

According to the Norwegian Freedom and Information Act (Offentleglova) information about the applicant may be included in the public applicant list, also in cases where the applicant has requested non-disclosure.

Please see Rules for the use of research posts SKO 1108, 1109, 1110 and 1183 at UiO. 

The University of Oslo has an agreement for all employees, aiming to secure rights to research results a.o.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

Centre for Planetary Habitability (PHAB) is a Norwegian Centre of Excellence that provides a stimulating and well-funded research environment. PHAB’s main goal, based on detailed studies of Earth and our solar system, is to develop predictive models to identify habitable planets around other stars. PHAB research activities comprise three interrelated research themes: (1) Planets and Early Earth, (2) Modern Earth and (3) Exo-Earths. The centre was established in 2023 and will consist of approximately 70 full time and part time professors and researchers, PhD Research Fellows and Postdoctoral Research Fellows.

jobs.title: Tenure Track Assistant Professor in Infectious Animal Disease Modelling for Sustainable One Health Actions
jobs.description:
Tenure Track Assistant Professor in Infectious Animal Disease Modelling for Sustainable One Health Actions Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences
Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences
University of Copenhagen

The University seeks to appoint a tenure track assistant professor to commence 1 May 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Information on the department can be found at: http://www.sund.ku.dk/.

Subject area: Infectious disease epidemiology, modelling, animal health, One Health, and sustainable health systems

The Tenure-Track Assistant Professor will lead research on the dynamics of infectious disease spread in health systems, with particular emphasis on how changes in environmental conditions, animal populations, production systems, and management practices influence disease emergence, transmission, and control. The position will combine infectious disease epidemiology, mathematical and statistical modelling, data science, and economic analysis to generate evidence supporting disease preparedness, prevention, and control.

The successful candidate will:

  • Lead independent research on the dynamics of infectious disease spread in health systems, including the influence of environmental and production system changes.
  • Develop and apply simulation, epidemiological, and statistical models to assess disease and spillover risks, evaluate mitigation and control strategies, and quantify their economic implications.
  • Demonstrate strong programming skills in R and other relevant programming languages, including experience in managing, processing, and analysing large and complex datasets.
  • Have experience in developing and applying epidemiological disease-spread models, including model calibration, validation, parameter estimation, and calculation of epidemiological indicators such as the basic reproduction number (R₀) across different animal species and production systems.
  • Design and implement epidemiological modelling frameworks.
  • Validate and calibrate models using large-scale national datasets, ensuring scientific robustness, methodological validity, and relevance for policy and decision-making.
  • Translate research findings into evidence supporting risk-based disease prevention, preparedness, and control.
  • Establish and maintain collaborations with key stakeholders, including the Danish Veterinary and Food Administration, industry partners such as SEGES and Landbrug & Fødevarer (L&F), and international organisations such as the FAO.
  • Lead and secure independent research funding through competitive national and international funding calls. The position requires demonstrated experience in securing external funding, as well as the ambition to develop research ideas into externally funded projects and provide scientific leadership for such projects within the TIPTON Research Group.
  • Contribute to the development and delivery of One Health and sustainability teaching, with a particular focus on infectious diseases, disease preparedness, and the interactions between animal, human, and environmental health.
  • Contribute to teaching in data science, including data management, dataset preparation and handling, statistical analysis, programming, and the analysis of large-scale and complex datasets.
  • Supervise students and contribute to research capacity building within infectious disease epidemiology, disease modelling, data science, and One Health.
  • Contribute to the delivery of government services undertaken by the Department, including research-based advice, preparedness activities, risk assessments, and other activities relevant to infectious disease modelling and control.
The position is expected to combine methodological excellence in infectious disease modelling and data science with applied epidemiological research, generating evidence that is directly relevant to disease preparedness, private and public bodies, sustainable production systems, animal health and resilient health systems.

The tenure track assistant professor’s responsibilities will primarily consist of:

  • research, including publication/academic dissemination
  • research-based teaching
  • sharing knowledge with society
  • participation in formal pedagogical training programme for assistant professors
The tenure track assistant professor’s performance will be evaluated through annual evaluations. Furthermore, the tenure track assistant professor will be evaluated in a mid-track appraisal.

After no more than six years of employment and on condition of a positive final appraisal, the tenure track assistant professor will be employed as associate professor. Find more information about tenure track at the University of Copenhagen.

Required qualifications
To be qualified for an assistant professor position, you will be assessed according to these five overall criteria for recognising merit at the University of Copenhagen: Research, teaching, innovation & societal impact, organisational contribution and leadership. Find information about each criterion.

Furthermore, each applicant must be able to document:

  • a PhD degree or similar qualifications within the subject area
  • research experience within the field of the position
The tenure track assistant professor must have an academic standing showing internationally competitive research, and/or have internationally recognized high potential to make a future impact.

The assistant professor is also required to possess good interpersonal and communicative skills.

Salary and employment conditions
The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

The position is permanent.

Employment is as Tenure Track Assistant Professor under the applicable collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant professional organisations.

There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector at www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish).

The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025.

Questions
For further information, please contact Research Group Leader: Professor Beate Conrady, bcon@sund.ku.dk

Foreign applicants may find the university’s International Staff Mobility useful.

Application
The application must be submitted in English, and must include the following documents:

  • Application (Including motivation for applying for this position (Maximum 2 pages))
  • Curriculum vitae (Including information about external funding)
  • Diplomas (Master’s, PhD and other relevant diplomas)
  • A complete list of publications
  • Research plan (2-4 pages)
  • Teaching plan
  • Uploads of maximum 5 publications to be considered in the assessment
  • Teaching portfolio, if applicable (Guidelines)
Please note: It is mandatory to upload a teaching plan in the online application form. Should you not be able to produce a teaching plan, please upload a blank document in this box instead.

Application procedure
After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the Appointments Committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment. The Dean then appoints an expert assessment committee in order to make an assessment of the selected applicants for the specific post. Selected applicants are notified of the composition of the committee and each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself. You can read about the recruitment process at the university's Job Portal.

Please note that the applicant will be contacted if the assessment committee requires further documentation.

The application will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

The University of Copenhagen encourages all interested in this post to apply.

Please submit the application with the required attachments. Only online applications will be accepted. The closing date for applications is 23.59 p.m. CET, 18 November 2026.

Interviews for this position are likely to be held on 7 April 2027.

jobs.title: Bank Allied Health Professionals
Talent Sourcer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking to hire a new Talent Sourcer in Tokyo to build top-of-funnel talent pipelines and shape talent strategy across our Go-To-Market (GTM) organization. In this role, you'll partner with regional leadership to fill critical GTM roles like Solutions Consultants https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/notion/15dde0f5-b3fd-4d46-8ec2-0858ebdd888d and Outcomes Architects https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/notion/7030916f-4277-45db-9fed-644bb3fba059 primarily in Japan.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

 - You'll manage the sourcing process from inception through successful close, ensuring an exceptional experience for candidates and hiring managers at every step

 - You'll serve as a strategic advisor and talent sourcing expert, leading successful searches across GTM roles

 - You'll conduct initial qualification screenings and casual chats with candidates to assess fit and build relationships

 - You'll collaborate with the broader team on process improvements, programs, and strategic initiatives

 - You'll lead talent branding initiatives, including organizing hiring webinars and publishing blogs and articles that feature our employees

 - You'll provide talent mapping and market insights to support local and global recruiting and hiring teams

 - You'll make informed data-driven decisions that build efficiencies into the sourcing process

 - You'll find creative and unconventional ways to help us build a diverse top-of-funnel for GTM roles across all levels

 - You'll help build and manage partnerships to bring more underrepresented talent to Notion

 - You'll advance our Inclusion, Diversity, Equity, and Accessibility (I.D.E.A) strategy, working to build more diverse and inclusive teams

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Manage sourcing for multiple complex and evergreen searches, creating innovative strategies and engagement to bring the best and most diverse talent to Notion

 - Help develop and execute comprehensive sourcing plans, analyzing role requirements to define target profiles and identify qualified candidates

 - Partner closely with other members of the Recruiting team to ensure we hit our hiring targets without sacrificing quality

 - Collaborate closely with Hiring Managers throughout the recruiting process to ensure we meet their hiring needs and goals

 - Establish and maintain meaningful relationships with management and key cross-functional stakeholders

 


SKILLS AND TOOLSET YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - At least 3 years of experience in talent sourcing or recruitment, whether in-house or agency, or relevant transferable skills from related fields

 - Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter and other sourcing tools, with skills in Boolean and AI-powered searches (or eagerness to learn these tools)

 - Persistence, consistency, and attention to detail - if we hire one person out of 200 candidates, you'd ensure the other 199 have a great experience. You care deeply about your craft.

 - Strong time management, prioritization, and organizational skills. You are self-motivated and committed to excellence

 - You are kind, warm, and thoughtful - you'll represent the company when you interact with thousands of candidates each year

 - You'll contribute across the full scope of recruiting operations, from maintaining our ATS database and finding new ways to source candidates to analyzing data to improve recruiting efficiency and managing sourcing channels

 - Fluency in Japanese and business-level English




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: SMB Account Executive (New Business)
Chef - Zoku Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you a passionate chef with great cooking skills who loves to work in an open kitchen? Then keep reading.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

Life doesn’t become more social than through sharing food. That’s our founding food philosophy and it can be yours too. The food that comes out of our Living Kitchen is fresh, simple, honest, healthy and local. With short-end preparation times, simple ingredients and limited preparation steps, our assortment is incredibly intelligent and facilitates fast service.

As our new chef you'll be responsible for any food that comes out of our Living Kitchen. You'll plate beautiful dishes and at times make creative buffets that not only look good, but also taste amazing.

You’ll work closely together with our team of chefs, to develop menu offerings and forecast supply needs. You like to take on responsibility, thrive with independence in your work and function as a substitute for our chefs. 


WHAT MAKES OUR KITCHEN UNIQUE?

  • You won’t hide in the background. You'll get to work in an open kitchen environment with plenty of space and natural daylight.

  • You'll get the ultimate flexibility. You can come up with your own dishes and let your creativity run wild.

  • You can have good conversations with visitors. You’re the face of the kitchen and you'll get to directly chat with guests.

  • You get to be independent in your work. You like doing your own thing and can cook solo when you need to.

  • You can get to know the entire team. You'll be in close contact with our front of house and the entire Zoku team.

  • You can work in a unique kitchen setup. We’re not like your average kitchen (feel free to stop by our rooftop to see for yourself!).

  • You are encouraged to work with fresh and seasonal ingredients. We put a strong emphasis on incorporating vegetables into our dishes.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • A market conform salary package including pension and health insurance.

  • Cool benefits like an after-work drink, access to all community events, various discounts like 40% discount on F&B for you and 4 friends, plus Employee and Friends & Family rates in all Zoku Locations.  

  • A free night stay for you and your +1 in your first 3 months at your Zoku (dinner & breakfast) and a free night at any Zoku location for your birthday, including welcome drink & breakfast to experience Zoku as a true guest. 

  • No boring canteen!! Staff meals enjoyed from our Living Kitchen.

  • A personal budget unlocked after 1 year at Zoku to spend on extra days off, learning & development, extra cash or discounted vouchers. 

  • A fun, young, and international team to grow with. Plus, exciting training and events to celebrate every step of the journey!

  • A job at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.

WE LOVE PEOPLE WHO...

  • Show their creativity through their passion for food and never settle for less.

  • Can juggle many tasks at the same time while remaining cool headed and warm hearted.

  • Enjoy variety in their day and are happy to switch things up, whether that means breakfast, brunch, lunch buffets, a la carte dinners or cheffing up something special for our Meetings & Events.

  • Have experience in working independently and don't believe in traditional kitchen hierarchies.

  • Enjoy working in an open kitchen and love to chat up a storm with our residents.

  • Have experience in healthy homestyle cooking – vegetarian cooking skills are a plus.

  • Have provable knowledge of various cooking techniques.

A FEW MUST HAVES

  • You have a minimum of 1 year working experience in a kitchen or restaurant environment. 

  • You have experience with implementing the local HACCP guidelines (Hygiejnebevis).

  • You are fluent in English – Danish and other languages are a plus.

  • You are an EU resident or have a working and living permit valid for Denmark including a CPR.

  • You are fully flexible, as there won't be fixed working days / hours, including availability on some weekends. Shifts include AM, Mid-shifts, and PM.

  • You love to work as we'll need you Full Time (37 hours- 5 shifts weekly)

  • Available to start As Soon As Possible.

WHAT WE ARE PROUD OF 

Our fresh take on hospitality has been recognized around the world with plenty of press attention and design awards.

We’re also proudly B Corp certified at all four of our locations (Amsterdam, Copenhagen, Paris and Vienna), which means we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to social and environmental impact, transparency and accountability.

WHAT IS ZOKU

Zoku is a new type of hotel that offers a place to live, co-work and socialize in Europe's most livable cities: Amsterdam, Vienna, Copenhagen & Paris. 

Designed for the new generation of travellers, Zoku is so much more than a long stay hotel. It is a place you can call your second home, even on your first visit. Zoku is a hive of private Lofts and rooftop Social Spaces, so travellers can stay connected and well rested as they live and work throughout Europe. Throw yourself into your work and play, and effortlessly discover one of our home cities.

Du får:

Vår avdeling i Sandefjord er tilgjengelig alle dager så arbeidstiden vil være skiftbasert.

jobs.title: Terminal worker wanted for Bring in Greve
jobs.description:
We are looking for a reliable and hardworking terminal worker for Bring in Greve for the evening team.

This is a job where the pace can be high at times, so we are looking for someone who enjoys staying busy and can handle pressure when things get hectic.

The job mainly involves loading and unloading trucks, as well as operating an electric pallet truck. It is therefore important that you are used to physical work and preferably have experience operating an electric pallet truck.

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has experience operating an electric pallet truck and can work at a fast pace

  • Is reliable and available Monday to Friday from 3:00 PM to 11:00 PM

  • Enjoys physical work and can maintain a good pace, even when it gets very busy

  • Has a good attitude and is not afraid to get stuck in

It is important that you are available all five days, as we need someone who can provide a stable presence throughout the week.

You will be employed under a collective agreement, and your total hourly wage will be DKK 190 per hour + evening shift allowance.The position will initially be a temporary position, but if you enjoy the job and prove to be the right person for the role, there is an opportunity for a permanent contract after approximately 3-4 months.

Don’t wait to apply! We review applications on an ongoing basis and invite candidates for interviews continuously. We look forward to hearing from you.

Job Title:  Business Analyst, Banking Operate Services

Company:  Deloitte Tax & Consulting
Job Function:  Consulting Services
Level of Experience:  Experienced
Contract Type:  Open-term
Req ID:  14080

Job Description:  

Your future team

As a global leader in providing managed services to the financial industry, Deloitte is deeply committed to expanding its Operate offering in the banking space, a model where Deloitte takes ownership of running critical middle- and back-office processes on behalf of banking clients, combining operational excellence with innovative technology.

Our Banking Operate practice has already identified and validated a comprehensive portfolio of services to be launched, covering multiple banking value chains. We are now entering a decisive phase: translating this strategic vision into detailed, actionable specifications that will serve as the foundation for service delivery, technology enablement, and client onboarding.

We are seeking a Business Analyst to join our Banking Operate development team. In this role, you will be responsible for authoring Business Requirements Documents (BRDs) and Service Functional Descriptions (SFDs) across our target service catalogue. You will work hand-in-hand with subject matter experts, partners, and technology teams to transform high-level service concepts into structured, implementable specifications, at pace.

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of our banking managed services from the ground up, with a clear evolution path toward a Project Manager role to oversee the implementation and go-live of the services you will have helped design.

The advantages of joining us

• Career growth, your way Access top-notch training and career development. Start as the architect of our service specifications, then evolve into a project leadership role to drive implementation, with a clear progression path tailored to your ambitions.
• Global impact, local connections Work on strategic banking initiatives with international reach, collaborate with diverse teams of experts, and contribute to building a market-leading Operate offering from Luxembourg.
• Innovative work that matters Leverage the latest AI and LLM technologies to accelerate your work, tackle greenfield service design challenges, and directly contribute to a high-visibility growth initiative backed by firm leadership.
How you'll contribute to our success
• Author high-quality BRDs and SFDs for a portfolio of banking Operate services spanning multiple value chains (payments, securities, lending, investment management, cash management, trade finance, and more).
• Translate strategic service concepts into structured specifications, detailing functional scope, process flows, roles and responsibilities, SLAs, controls, data requirements, and technology dependencies.
• Engage with senior stakeholders and subject matter experts (partners, banking operations specialists, technology leads) to capture requirements, challenge assumptions, and ensure completeness and feasibility of specifications.
• Map end-to-end banking processes across middle and back office, identifying operational touchpoints, regulatory constraints, and integration requirements for each target service.
• Leverage AI tools and Large Language Models (LLMs) to accelerate research, drafting, benchmarking, and structuring of documentation, enabling rapid turnaround without compromising quality.
• Ensure consistency and standardisation across the full service catalogue, establishing reusable templates, taxonomies, and documentation standards.
• Identify dependencies, risks, and gaps early in the specification phase, proactively escalating and proposing solutions to keep the programme on track.
• Contribute to the definition of target operating models for each service, including process design, governance frameworks, technology requirements, and staffing considerations.
• Support the transition from design to delivery by preparing the ground for implementation, you will be positioned to take on project management responsibilities as services move into build and launch phases.
• Act as a central knowledge hub for banking Operate service design, maintaining a clear and organised repository of all specifications and supporting documentation.

Why this role is different

You'll be joining at the inception of a strategic growth programme, in a role that goes beyond traditional maintenance or support, where the services you design today will become the backbone of Deloitte's Banking Operate offering tomorrow. You'll have direct visibility with partners and leadership, and as the portfolio moves from design to delivery, you'll have the opportunity to step into a Project Manager role to oversee implementation, client onboarding, and operational go-live, ideal for someone passionate about banking operations, turning complexity into clarity, and being at the forefront of building something new.

Your skills

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Banking, Economics, Engineering, or Information Technology (Master's preferred), or equivalent professional experience.
• Around 3-4 years of relevant experience in the banking industry, with demonstrated exposure to middle- and/or back-office operations.
• Solid knowledge of multiple banking value chains, including but not limited to:  

1. Payments & Cash Management
2. Securities (custody, settlement, corporate actions)
3. Investment & Portfolio Management
4. Credit & Lending (consumer, corporate, syndicated)
5. Mortgage & Real Estate Finance
6. Lombard & Collateral Management
7. Trade Finance
8. Regulatory Reporting & Compliance Operations

• Proven experience writing Business Requirements Documents, functional specifications, or service descriptions in a structured and professional manner.
• Strong understanding of banking processes, controls, and regulatory environment (e.g., PSD2, MiFID II, Basel, AML/KYC operations).
• Proficient in using AI tools and Large Language Models (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude) to enhance productivity, for research, drafting, analysis, and structuring of complex documentation.
• Strong data affinity, including awareness of data flows, data governance, and data quality principles within banking operations.
• Ability to translate high-level strategic intent into detailed, workable operational and technology specifications.
• Familiarity with target operating model design, process mapping (BPMN or equivalent), and service delivery frameworks.
• Proficiency in project management methodologies and tools; certifications (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, Agile) are an asset.
• Pragmatic, autonomous, solution-oriented, and comfortable working at speed across multiple workstreams simultaneously.
• Exceptional written communication skills — ability to produce clear, structured, and professional documentation.
• Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, comfortable engaging with senior leadership and subject matter experts.
• Fluent in English; French and/or any additional language is an asset.
• Ability to efficiently manage multiple deliverables and priorities in a fast-paced, high-ambition environment.

Head of Vendor Management & Outsourcing (M/F)

Luxembourg | req1172

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

The Head of Vendor Management and Outsourcing is responsible for defining and executing the Bank's vendor strategy framework and leading end-to-end commercial, contractual, and regulatory vendor management activities. The role acts as the Finance-led control tower across the vendor lifecycle, ensuring financial discipline, contractual control, and regulatory compliance while optimizing vendor value and supporting outsourcing decisions.

Your next challenge:

• Define and maintain vendor segmentation (strategic / critical / commodity) and steer the vendor portfolio.
• Act as the Outsourcing Activity Manager and represent the Bank towards the Regulator on outsourcing.
• Support outsourcing and make-or-buy decisions and monitor vendor concentration and exposure.
• Own budgeting, forecasting, cost control, benchmarking and value realization for vendor spend.
• Establish and maintain comprehensive reportings, leveraging data analytics to drive decision-making, monitor performance, and provide actionable insights.
• Lead contract negotiation, lifecycle management, renewal and commercial governance.
• Act as primary commercial face to vendor and manage relationships with strategic vendors and group entities.
• Ensure compliance with DORA, EBA and CSSF requirements and maintain outsourcing register.
• Establish end-to-end vendor lifecycle governance and coordinate with CIO, Procurement, Legal and Risk.
• Lead change management initiatives related to vendor and outsourcing processes, and educate internal stakeholders on best practices, regulatory requirements, and risk awareness.
• Foster a culture of continuous learning, provide mentoring and coaching to team members, and promote knowledge sharing and best practices within the team.
• Maintain strong first line operational risk controls by overseeing vendor, facility and infrastructure processes, ensuring compliance with internal policies and escalating operational or safety risks.

Your skills:

• Master's degree in Business, Finance or Engineering.
• Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in vendor management, procurement or outsourcing in regulated environment.

jobs.title: RESEARCHER IN ATOMISTIC MODELLING OF FERROELECTRIC DYNAMICS (m/f)
jobs.employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
jobs.description:
How will you contribute?
Get ready to dive into the captivating realm of ferroelectrics, where surprises at the nanoscale await discovery! We are thrilled to announce a unique opportunity for a curious and skilled Postdoctoral Researcher to join our dynamic team.
Ferroelectrics continue to mesmerize at the nanoscale. By inducing electrostatic or mechanic frustration on them, we can unlock a rich tapestry of dipole structures, including skyrmions and vortex lattices. Such polar textures are a hot research topic and offer a dual promise. First, their origin and behaviour pose intriguing questions begging for answers. Second, they hold great potential for groundbreaking applications, from outstanding voltage amplifications to shaping the future of 6G technologies.
In the realm of ferroelectric ultrathin films, we are facing new challenges. Applying an electric bias transforms the dipole landscape, giving rise to confined nanoregions (bubbles) with a polarization opposite to their embedding matrix. These bubbles are electric versions of magnetic skyrmions, and are more than just a rarity; they constitute a novel quasiparticle in their own right. Recent experimental observations and successful manipulation attempts have set the stage. Yet, their dynamical behaviour remains a largely unexplored frontier. Lately our group at LIST predicted that electric bubbles will display Brownian motion and that this motion can be harnessed to produce bubble currents.
We offer you a postdoc position in the project “Bubblaced”, led by Hugo Aramberri (hugo.aramberri@list.lu), and focused on the modelling of electric bubble quasiparticles. You will join the ongoing work by Hugo Aramberri and Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) on understanding these objects using second-principles atomistic simulation methods, focusing on their dynamics and possible ways to act on them. You will also benefit from interactions with other team members. Join us in exploring the fascinating world of electric bubbles!

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!
• You hold a PhD in Condensed Matter Physics, Materials Science, Computational Physics, Chemistry, or a closely related field.
• You have hands-on experience with atomistic modelling (DFT, second-principles, machine-learned force fields), scripting for automation and data analysis (e.g. Python, Bash), and working in a Linux/HPC environment. Knowledge of ferroelectricity and/or molecular dynamics is a strong asset.

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/
You will join the Environmental Health (EH) group within the Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit at LIST. SUSTAIN conducts cross-disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society, combining expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation.
The Environmental Health group conducts cutting-edge research at the intersection of environmental toxicology, human health, and regulatory science, integrating in vitro toxicology, systems toxicology, exposure science, and sustainability assessment to develop next-generation tools and methods that inform decision-making and support the development of safe and sustainable products and policies.
This PhD position is embedded in the AIM-PACE project, which aims at developing a new generation of safe-and-sustainable-by-design, bio-based and circular plastics by combining AI, microbial technology, computer modelling, and polymer science. The PhD candidate is expected to support the operationalisation of the Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) framework, actively contribute to the Safety Assessment of the novel bio-based polymers and the integration of results for informed decision making along the life-cycle and innovation routes. Production of chemical safety data, primarily generated through in vitro New Approach Methodologies (NAMs), and computational modelling are expected to be key outcomes. The PhD candidate will combine experimental toxicology with computational approaches and scientific literature data to validate relevant case studies, supporting the identification of methodological gaps and challenges, and contributing to the advancement of SSbD approaches for bio-based materials.
The PhD will be co-supervised by Dr. Ivana Vinkovic (Institute for Medical Research and Occupational Health, Zagreb), a leading international expert in safety and toxicology assessment of advanced materials. Her research group performs cutting edge research at the nano-bio interface to identify opportunities and risks of nanomaterials and advanced materials at early stage of development, in a multidisciplinary environment covering chemistry, biochemistry, molecular biology, toxicology, risk assessment and regulatory science. In addition, it operates a high-impact testing platform for more tailored risk assessment and decision making which based on advanced biochemistry, immunology, toxicology, molecular and cell biology facilities. The academic supervisor will provide scientific guidance and mentorship throughout the doctoral research, support the development of the research plan, monitor progress, facilitate integration within the academic environment, and ensure compliance with the requirements of the PhD programme. The Faculty of Science, University of Zagreb, is one of the leading research and higher education institutions in Croatia, offering advanced training and research infrastructure in chemistry, biochemistry, nanotechnology, biosensors, environmental health, and biomedical sciences. The host group has expertise in Safe and Sustainable by Design (SSbD) approaches, nanomaterials, advanced analytical methods, and translational biomedical research.

How will you contribute?
As a PhD Student within the AIM-PACE project, your main responsibilities will include:
• Supporting the scoping analysis of the AIM-PACE scenarios and products, as part of the SSbD framework implementation.
• Conducting a comprehensive literature review and data collection on hazard profiles of existing substances/materials and use of computational modelling for data gap filling.
• Identifying, reviewing and using models and tools for hazard screening, exposure assessment and risk assessment in the context of SSbD.
• Application of new approach methodologies (NAMs), including in vitro and computational tools, for hazard, exposure and risk assessment of AIM-PACE materials.
• Collaborating with project partners in integrating safety output with sustainability, techno-economic and social indicators.
• Collaborating with the team of Dr. Ivana Vinkovic Vrček to explore research activities, scientific training, conferences, and dissemination activities, and complete all doctoral requirements according to University of Zagreb regulations.
• Contributing to the dissemination of results through peer-reviewed scientific publications, conference presentations, and technical reports.
• Actively participating in AIM-PACE consortium activities, including meetings, workshops, and stakeholder engagement.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator - AMER
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

The People Team at Notion exists to help build a generational company - one that enables people to do their best and most meaningful work. Hiring exceptional talent, at the right time and with care, is central to that mission.

We’re looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to partner closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to create a thoughtful, well-run, and genuinely human candidate experience. This role sits at the center of our hiring process and plays an important role in how candidates experience Notion.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:



CREATE A CANDIDATE EXPERIENCE THAT REFLECTS NOTION

You’ll be one of the first and most consistent touchpoints candidates have with Notion. From scheduling interviews to answering questions and resolving issues, you’ll help ensure every interaction feels organized, respectful, and intentional. You’ll collaborate closely with Recruiters and Hiring Managers to continually refine our processes—so candidates leave feeling excited about what we’re building, regardless of the outcome.



COORDINATE INTERVIEWS WITH CARE AND PRECISION

You’ll manage and schedule a high volume of interviews across primarily non-technical roles, balancing speed with attention to detail. You’ll anticipate needs, communicate clearly, and keep candidates and interviewers aligned - making the process feel smooth and predictable, even as things move quickly.



BUILD STRONG RECRUITING FOUNDATIONS

This role is designed for someone early in their recruiting career who wants to build durable fundamentals. Over time, you’ll gain exposure to how we plan, execute, and scale hiring at Notion. With support from the team, you could take on light sourcing work, process improvements, and additional ownership as your skills grow - creating a strong foundation for future growth in recruiting, operations, or people-focused roles.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 6–12 months of experience in recruiting coordination or interview scheduling, ideally in a high-volume environment

 - Strong organizational and prioritization skills - you’re proactive, reliable, and thoughtful about details

 - A steady, calm approach in fast-moving environments

 - Ability to navigate ambiguity with optimism

 - Clear, kind, and professional communication skills - you’ll represent Notion to a large and diverse group of candidates

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience supporting both technical and non-technical roles, including remote and in-person interview scheduling

 - Experience with Ashby, Workday, Slack

 - Experience in a high-growth or startup environment



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $85,000 - $95,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: SPREMAČ/ICA
jobs.description:
Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine br. 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10. - ispr., 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18 i 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 156/23), članka 13. Pravilnika o radu i članaka 6. i 7. Spremač/ica, na neodređeno, puno radno vrijeme, 1 izvršitelj/ica Uvjeti: Kandidati uz opće uvjete za zasnivanje radnog odnosa, sukladno općim propisima o radu, moraju ispunjavati i posebne uvjete propisane Zakonom o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine br.: 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 156/23) i Pravilnikom o radu OŠ Remete Na natječaj se mogu javiti muške i ženske osobe u skladu sa Zakonom o ravnopravnosti spolova (Narodne novine br. 82/08 i 69/17) U prijavi na natječaj navode se i podaci podnositelja prijave (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela, adresa e-pošte, isključivo za potrebe postupka), naziv radnog mjesta za koje se prijavljuje i datum objave natječaja.

Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj, kandidati su dužni priložiti: 1. životopis 2. dokaz o državljanstvu 3. dokaz o prijavljenom prebivalištu u RH 4. dokaz o stečenoj razini i vrsti obrazovanja 5. uvjerenje nadležnog suda da kandidat nije pod istragom i da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela iz čl.106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi, ne starije od 6 mjeseci od dana raspisivanja natječaja 6. elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje

Navedene isprave odnosno prilozi dostavljaju se u neovjerenoj preslici i ne vraćaju se kandidatu nakon završenog natječajnog postupka. Prije sklapanja ugovora o radu odabrani kandidat dužan je sve navedene priloge odnosno isprave predočiti u izvorniku ili u preslici ovjerenoj od strane javnog bilježnika. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19 i 84/21), članku 48. stavku 1.-3. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13 i 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20) dužna je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja i ovisno o kategoriji u koju ulazi sve potrebne dokaze (članak 103.st.1.Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Osoba koja se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata uz prijavu na natječaj dužna je priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja te priložiti dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju (čl.49.st.1. Zakona) dostupne na poveznici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Prijavom na natječaj svaki kandidat daje privolu Osnovnoj školi Remete za obradu osobnih podataka u skladu s propisima kojima je propisana zaštita osobnih podataka za svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka i objave rezultata natječaja. Rok za podnošenje prijava kandidata je osam (8) dana od dana objave natječaja. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj i o tome se ne radi posebna obavijest. Kandidat/kinja koji/a je pravodobno dostavio/la potpunu prijavu sa svim ispravama odnosno prilozima i ispunjava uvjete natječaja dužan/a je pristupiti procjeni odnosno testiranju prema odredbama Pravilnika. Odluku o vremenu, mjestu i načinu održavanja procjene vrednovanja kandidata/kinje Škola će objaviti na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr s napomenom da se kandidati/kinje neće posebno pozivati. Obavijest o ishodu natječajnog postupka, objavit će se na mrežnoj stranici Osnovne škole Remete http://www.os-remete-zg.skole.hr najkasnije u roku od osam dana od dana sklapanja ugovora s odabranim kandidatom. U slučaju da se na natječaj prijave kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom propisu, kandidati će se obavijestiti prema članku 17. stavku 4. Pravilnika. Prijave na natječaj s potrebnom dokumentacijom kandidati dostavljaju neposredno ili poštom na adresu: Osnovna škola Remete, Remete 99a, 10 000 Zagreb, s naznakom “za natječaj- Spremač/ica“.

jobs.title: SISTEM INŽENJER/KA
jobs.description:
OPIS POSLA

Kao Sistem inženjer, bit ćeš ključna osoba za osiguravanje stabilnosti, sigurnosti i optimalnih performansi naše IT infrastrukture. Tvoji glavni zadaci uključivat će:

  • Virtualizacija i serveri: Instalacija, konfiguracija i proaktivno održavanje Windows servera te upravljanje Hyper-V virtualizacijskom okolinom i virtualnim strojevima (VM).
  • Sigurnost podataka: Konfiguracija, nadzor i redovito testiranje sustava za sigurnosnu pohranu (backup) i oporavak podataka korištenjem Veeam rješenja.
  • Upravljanje domenom: Administracija Active Directoryja (upravljanje korisničkim računima, grupama, pravima pristupa i GPO politikama).
  • File serveri: Održavanje i strukturiranje mrežnih dijeljenih mapa (File servers), dodjeljivanje prava i praćenje dostupnosti.
  • Korisnička podrška i oprema: Instalacija, održavanje i rješavanje problema na radnim računalima (hardware i software) te konfiguracija mrežnih printera i ostale periferne opreme.
  • Nadzor sustava: Praćenje rada cjelokupnog informacijskog sustava i pravovremeno rješavanje tehničkih poteškoća.

UVJETI

  • Minimalno 1 godina radnog iskustva na istim ili sličnim poslovima.
  • Napredno poznavanje Microsoft Windows Server okruženja je prednost.
  • Praktično iskustvo s Hyper-V tehnologijom virtualizacije.
  • Iskustvo u radu s Veeam Backup & Replication alatima.
  • Odlično poznavanje Active Directory, DNS, DHCP servisa.
  • Sposobnost samostalnog rješavanja problema s računalima (Windows 10/11) i perifernom opremom (printeri, skeneri).
  • Poznavanje osnovnih mrežnih koncepata (LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, VPN).

ŠTO NUDIMO

  • Ugovor na neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rok.
  • Pristup najnovijim tehnologijama.

jobs.description:
AUTOELEKTRIKÁŘ - DIAGNOSTIK (M+Ž)

Zajišťování servisu a oprav na nákladních vozidlech. Provádění diagnostiky, montáž, údržba a servis el. systémů, spolupráce s kolegy v servisu. Zajišťování odborných prohlídek a preventivní údržby, práce s interním systémem, výjezdy k poruchám.
Vzdělání v oboru je výhodou, ne podmínkou.
Praxe v oboru, zájem a záliba v autech je vítána.
Manuální zručnost, pečlivost a samostatnost.
Nutností je řidičský průkaz skupiny B. Řidičský průkaz skupiny C a průkaz profesní způsobilosti řidiče je výhodou. Měsíční prémie až do výše 30 - 40 % základní mzdy.
Jednosměnný provoz od PO-PÁ (7:00 - 15:30).
Nástup možný ihned.

Zaměstnanecké výhody: firemní benefity jsou samozřejmostí, budou upřesněny na pracovním pohovoru

SIA Metsatek (reģ. Nr. 40003917967) ir viens no Baltijā vadošajiem autobūves uzņēmumiem, kas specializējas kravas automašīnu ražošanā un aprīkošanā, kā arī nodrošina to tehnisko apkopi un remontu.

Aicinām komandai pievienoties grāmatveža palīgu, kura galvenais uzdevums būs nodrošināt precīzu un savlaicīgu grāmatvedības dokumentu apstrādi un uzskaiti, sadarbojoties ar galveno grāmatvedi.

Galvenie darba pienākumi

  • Veikt ienākošo un izejošo grāmatvedības dokumentu pārbaudi, apstrādi un uzskaiti.
  • Pārbaudīt un apstrādāt avansa norēķinu un komandējumu atskaites.
  • Sagatavot maksājumus piegādātājiem un kontrolēt rēķinu apmaksas termiņus.
  • Nodrošināt autotransporta izdevumu uzskaiti.
  • Piedalīties inventarizācijās un to rezultātu apkopošanā.
  • Sagatavot mēneša, ceturkšņa un gada statistikas pārskatus iesniegšanai valsts institūcijās.
  • Sniegt atbalstu galvenajam grāmatvedim ikdienas uzskaites un pārskatu sagatavošanas darbā.


Prasības kandidātiem

  • Izglītība grāmatvedībā, finansēs vai saistītā jomā un praktiska pieredze grāmatvedības darbā.
  • Izpratne par grāmatvedības uzskaites pamatprincipiem un attaisnojuma dokumentu noformēšanu.

un Jums ir:

jobs.title: Autoelektrik
jobs.description:
Autodiagnostika spetsialist

Tööülesanded: Sõidukite elektroonika ja elektrisüsteemide diagnostika kaasaegsete seadmetega.
Mootori-, käigukasti-, ABS- ja muude juhtplokkide veaotsing. Tarkvara uuendamine ja veakoodide kustutamine. Diagnostika tulemuste põhjal remondi vajalikkuse selgitamine klientidele. Auto elektrisüsteemide (starter, generaator, aku, juhtmestik, valgustus, kliimaseadmete elektriline osa jms) kontroll, hooldus ja remont. Lisaseadmete (signalisatsioon, parkimisandurid, lisatuled jms) paigaldus ja ühendamine. Koostöö meeskonnaga tööde teostamisel ja lahenduste leidmisel.

Omalt poolt pakume: Kaasaegseid diagnostikaseadmeid ja töötingimusi.
Võimalust spetsialiseeruda ning areneda autodiagnostika ja autoelektri valdkonnas. Konkurentsivõimelist töötasu vastavalt kogemusele ja tulemustele. Koolitusi ja professionaalset arengut. Sõbralikku ja toetavat meeskonda.

jobs.title: Ofsettrükkal
jobs.description:
Ofsettrükkal (Ryobi 755 P)

Tööülesanded: Kas Sul on silma detailidele, kirg trükikunsti vastu ja kogemus poognatrüki masinatega? Meie meeskond otsib just Sind!
Otsime oma meeskonda kohusetundlikku ja kogenud ofsettrükkalit, kelle peamiseks ülesandeks on kvaliteetsete trükiste valmistamine Ryobi 755 P (B2-formaat, 5 sektsiooni + pööramisseade) ofsettrükimasinal. Sinu peamised töökohustused: • Trükimasina Ryobi 755 P seadistamine, juhtimine ja igapäevane hooldus. • Trükiprotsessi pidev jälgimine, värvitasakaalu ja trükikvaliteedi kontrollimine (nii ühe kui ka kahepoolse trüki puhul). • Pööramismehhanismi õige seadistamine ja toimivuse tagamine. • Võimalike trükivigade kiire tuvastamine ja operatiivne lahendamine. • Puhtuse ja korra tagamine oma töölõigus.

Omalt poolt pakume: • Stabiilset ja pikaajalist tööd kaasaegses trükiettevõttes.
• Konkurentsivõimelist ja oskustele vastavat töötasu. • Toetavat, sõbralikku ja oma ala professionaalidest koosnevat meeskonda.

Muud nõuded: Eelnev töökogemus ofsettrükkalina (otsene kogemus Ryobi 750-seeria või pööramismehhanismiga B2-masinatega on suureks eeliseks)
• Ofsettrükitehnoloogia, poognasöödu, paberitüüpide ja värvide põhjalik tundmine • Tehniline taiplikkus, väga hea analüüsivõime ja otsustusvõime • Hea värvitaju, täpsus, korrektsus ja tehniline taip • Valmisolek vahetustega tööks (hommikune/õhtune) • Suutlikkus ja soov teha meeskonnatööd • Hea füüsiline vastupidavus ja pingetaluvus • Eesti keele oskus suhtlustasemel
